papers.title: Human dietary exposure and ecological risk assessment of endocrine-disrupting pesticide residues in fish from Lake Malawi and the Shire River, Malawi
papers.authors: Nyirenda, Samson; Kuyeli, Stephen; Thulu, Fabiano; Kumwenda, Save; Njalam’mano, John; Kaonga, Chikumbusko C.
papers.abstract: Fish supplies up to 30% of animal protein in Malawi, so pesticide residues in fish are a public-health concern. We assessed the dietary risk, and screened the ecological risk, posed by four endocrine-disrupting pesticides (EDPs): atrazine, malathion, total DDT (ΣDDT; DDT and its metabolites) and endosulfan. Wet-season residues were measured in two fisheries, analysed separately because each is represented by different species: Oreochromis karongae and Engraulicypris sardella from nine Lake Malawi landing sites (n = 72) and Clarias gariepinus and Oreochromis shiranus from five Shire River sites (n = 40). Estimated daily intakes for children and adults, based on national household-survey ingestion rates, were compared with USEPA reference doses to derive Hazard Indices (HIs), and ΣDDT Lifetime Cancer Risk (LCR) was estimated with the USEPA slope factor. Because water concentrations were not measured, ecological risk was screened by back-calculating water concentrations from tissue residues with literature bioconcentration factors (BCFs) and comparing them with predicted no-effect concentrations (PNECs) as risk quotients (RQs). Within each water body, residues differed significantly among sites (two-way ANOVA, p < 0.001). The maximum HI was 0.074 at baseline and 0.279 in the combined worst case. LCR fell in the tolerable range (10 -6 -10 -4 ) for three species (maximum 1.61 × 10 -5 in the worst case) and was acceptable (<10 -6 ) for E. sardella . In a 200,000-iteration Monte Carlo analysis, fewer than 0.1% of simulations gave an HI above 1. In contrast, 41%-75% gave a ΣDDT screening RQ above 1 for C. gariepinus , depending on the PNEC, and malathion RQs for the Shire River species also exceeded 1 with the more protective PNEC, although these are indicative only. At the sampled sites, dietary risk is low, but the ecological screening for the Shire River species is inconclusive and cannot be inferred from dietary safety. We recommend dry-season sampling, direct measurement of water concentrations, and precautionary dietary guidance for frequent consumers of Shire River fish.
papers.summary_cn: 马拉维湖9个登陆点（n=72，Karongae罗非鱼与Engraulicypris sardella）和Shire河5个站点（n=40，Clarias gariepinus与Oreochromis shiranus）雨季鱼体四种内分泌干扰农药（atrazine、malathion、ΣDDT、endosulfan）残留显示，各水体内部站点间差异显著（双因素ANOVA，p<0.001）。以USEPA参考剂量推算的危害指数基线最高0.074、最坏合并情景0.279，ΣDDT终身致癌风险对三种鱼处于可耐受范围（10⁻⁶–10⁻⁴，最坏1.61×10⁻⁵），E. sardella可接受（<10⁻⁶）；20万次Monte Carlo模拟中HI>1者不足0.1%。但以文献BCF反算水体浓度与PNEC比较的生态筛查显示，C. gariepinus的ΣDDT风险商在41%–75%模拟中>1，Shire河物种malathion在更保守PNEC下RQ亦>1（仅为指示性），故膳食风险低而Shire河生态筛查结论不确定，建议旱季采样、直接测定水体浓度并对Shire河鱼高频消费者给出预防性膳食指导。

papers.title: FLUCTUATING ASYMMETRY AND HEAVY METAL DISTRIBUTION IN TISSUES OF FISH WITH DIFFERENT FEEDING HABITS IN THE WESTERN BUG RIVER WITHIN THE AREA OF INFLUENCE OF THE DOBROTVIR THERMAL POWER PLANT
papers.authors: Butsiak, V. V.; Butsiak, H. A.
papers.journal: Scientific and Technical Bulletin оf State Scientific Research Control Institute of Veterinary Medical Products and Fodder Additives аnd Institute of Animal Biology
papers.abstract: The intensive development of industrial-energy complexes and the increasing anthropogenic pressure on aquatic ecosystems necessitate the search for reliable bioindication methods to assess the ecological status of river basins. The middle reach of the Western Bug River near the Dobrotvir thermal power plant is affected by heated water discharge, coal combustion products, municipal wastewater carried by the Poltva River and agricultural runoff. While the results of physicochemical water monitoring capture the ecological situation only at the exact moment of sampling, aquatic organisms, particularly fish, accumulate and integrate the toxic impact of pollutants over a prolonged period. This study aims to investigate developmental stability, as well as the patterns of accumulation and topographic distribution of Cu, Zn, Fe, and Pb in target organs (muscles, liver, gills) of four fish species with different trophic preferences: roach, bleak, European perch, and Prussian carp. The research was conducted at the monitoring station near the village of Staryi Dobrotvir. Fluctuating asymmetry was assessed from five bilateral meristic traits; metals were determined by atomic absorption spectrophotometry. Fluctuating asymmetry was highest in roach (0.48) and bleak (0.42), intermediate in perch (0.35) and lowest in Prussian carp (0.21), corresponding to environmental quality classes II-IV. The mean total metal content increased in the order planktivore (bleak, 28.1 mg/kg dry weight)
papers.summary_cn: 研究了西布格河Dobrotvir热电厂影响区四种不同食性鱼类（拟鲤、欧鳊、河鲈、普鲁士鲤）的发育稳定性与Cu、Zn、Fe、Pb在肌肉、肝脏、鳃中的积累及组织分布，以波动性不对称（fluctuating asymmetry）和原子吸收分光光度法分别评估五项双侧分体性状与金属含量。波动性不对称指数以拟鲤（0.48）和欧鳊（0.42）最高、河鲈居中（0.35）、普鲁士鲤最低（0.21），对应环境质量II–IV级。平均总金属含量按食性由浮游生物食性（欧鳊，28.1 mg/kg干重）起递增。

papers.title: Marine Fish-Derived Collagen for Eco-Compatible Cartilage Tissue Engineering
papers.authors: Ngernyuang, Nipaporn; Srisucharitpanit, Kanokporn; Tangsongcharoen, Chontida; Chonanant, Chirapond
papers.abstract: Abstract Marine fish-derived collagen has gained attention as a promising source for collagen extraction for tissue engineering applications. In this study, collagen was isolated from the scales of Asian seabass (Lates calcarifer) using acetic acid and pepsin extraction methods, followed by physicochemical characterization. Sodium dodecyl sulfate-polyacrylamide gel electrophoresis (SDS-PAGE) revealed characteristic α1, α2, and β chains, while Fourier Transform Infrared (FTIR) showed characteristic amide bands, supporting the molecular and structural similarity of the extracted collagen to standard type I collagen. The amino acid compositions, thermal stability, and structural organization were evaluated. The extracted collagen was subsequently incorporated into scaffold fabrication using the freeze-drying technique by blending with agarose, chitosan, and gelatin. The resulting scaffold demonstrated successful formation of a three-dimensional (3D) scaffold with porous and sponge-like characteristics. The fabricated scaffolds exhibited pore sizes of 75 to 200 μm, a high water absorption capacity of up to 90%, and a degradation rate of 39% after 4 weeks. Mechanical compression analysis revealed elastic modulus values ranging from 112 to 141 kPa. Furthermore, chondrocytes cultured on the scaffolds for 3 weeks were able to proliferate and grow effectively. These findings suggest that the natural biomaterial-based scaffolds developed in this study were noncytotoxic and capable of supporting chondrocyte proliferation. Importantly, the research also demonstrates the value-added utilization of fish scale waste through collagen extraction for the development of scaffolds with properties suitable for future tissue engineering applications.
papers.summary_cn: 以醋酸和胃蛋白酶法从尖吻鲈（Lates calcarifer）鱼鳞中提取胶原，SDS-PAGE显示α1、α2和β链，FTIR显示特征酰胺带，表明其与标准I型胶原分子和结构相似。将该胶原与琼脂糖、壳聚糖、明胶共混冻干制备三维多孔海绵状支架，孔径75~200 μm，吸水率高达90%，4周降解率39%，弹性模量112~141 kPa。软骨细胞在支架上培养3周可有效增殖生长，支架无细胞毒性。研究实现了鱼鳞废弃物的增值利用，所制支架性能适合未来组织工程应用。

papers.title: Isolation, Identification, and Antibiotic Resistance Profiles of Aeromonas hydrophila Isolated from Sangkuriang Catfish ( Clarias gariepinus ) at Aqsa Sabar Subur Aquaculture Farm, Kupang City
papers.authors: Naolin, Amanda Caroline; Sanam, Maxs Urias Ebenhaizar; Tangkonda, Elisabet; Loe, Fhady Risckhy
papers.abstract: Aeromonas hydrophila (A. hydrophila) is an opportunistic Gram-negative bacterium commonly found in aquatic environments and is the principal causative agent of Motile Aeromonas Septicaemia (MAS) in cultured fish, including Sangkuriang catfish (Clarias gariepinus). Infection with A. hydrophila can cause substantial economic losses due to increased morbidity and mortality in cultured fish. Bacterial infections are commonly controlled using antibiotics; however, indiscriminate and repeated antibiotic use may induce antibiotic resistance, thereby reducing treatment efficacy. This study aimed to identify the presence of A. hydrophila and to determine its resistance status against ciprofloxacin, gentamicin, and tetracycline in Sangkuriang catfish (C. gariepinus) cultured at Aqsa Sabar Subur Farm, Kupang City. A descriptive method with purposive sampling was employed. A total of 30 kidney samples from apparently healthy Sangkuriang catfish were isolated on Rimler-Shotts Agar (RSA), followed by confirmatory testing through Gram staining and biochemical assays. Antibiotic susceptibility testing was carried out using the Kirby-Bauer disc diffusion method on Mueller-Hinton Agar (MHA), with results interpreted according to Clinical and Laboratory Standards Institute (CLSI) breakpoints. Data were analysed descriptively and presented in tabular form. The results showed that 12 of 30 samples (40%) were confirmed positive for A. hydrophila. All isolates were fully susceptible to ciprofloxacin (100%) and predominantly susceptible to gentamicin (58.33% susceptible, 41.67% intermediate), whereas 25% of isolates were resistant to tetracycline, 16.67% intermediate, and 58.33% susceptible.
papers.summary_cn: 从Kupang市Aqsa Sabar Subur养殖场外观健康的Sangkuriang鲶（Clarias gariepinus）肾脏中分离Aeromonas hydrophila，30份样本经Rimler-Shotts琼脂分离及革兰染色和生化鉴定，12份（40%）确认为阳性。采用Kirby-Bauer纸片扩散法按CLSI标准检测分离株对环丙沙星、庆大霉素和四环素的耐药性：全部菌株对环丙沙星敏感（100%），对庆大霉素以敏感为主（58.33%敏感、41.67%中介），对四环素则25%耐药、16.67%中介、58.33%敏感。

papers.title: Domesticated oceans and biotechnological capital: future marine proteins in polarized Japanese seafood geographies
papers.authors: Ganseforth, Sonja
papers.abstract: This paper examines how emerging biotechnologies are transforming Japan's seafood sector, driving the exploitation of new ocean frontiers and the commodification of marine life, and reshaping food sovereignty. Drawing on ethnographic fieldwork, qualitative interviews, and industry publications, it traces how the three exemplary innovations - bioactive “functional foods”, industrialized aquaculture and genome-editing, and cell-based seafood - are reconfiguring ocean-fishery assemblages and seafood geographies. The paper argues that capital-intensive “promissory proteins” are shifting power from coastal fisheries toward urban, terrestrial centres. This polarization is intensified by recent legal reforms prioritizing corporate capital investment over community-based resource management, under the banner of promoting self-sufficiency and economic growth. Meanwhile, large transnationally operating seafood corporations are eager to expand their pharmaceutical and life sciences divisions. Corporate, biotech-driven models are thus recasting multi-species relations, consumer practices, and the governance of ocean resources, blurring the social and spatial boundaries of the ocean as the primary space of marine resource extraction and food sovereignty.
papers.summary_cn: 日本海产行业正被新兴生物技术重塑：基于民族志田野、定性访谈与行业出版物，研究追踪了生物活性“功能性食品”、工业化养殖与基因编辑、细胞培养海产品三类创新的作用。资本密集的“承诺蛋白”将权力从沿岸渔业转向城市陆域中心，近期法律改革以自给与增长为名优先企业资本投资而非社区资源管理，加剧了这一极化。跨国海产企业积极扩张制药与生命科学部门，企业生物技术模式由此重构多物种关系、消费实践与海洋资源治理，模糊了海洋作为资源提取与食物主权首要空间的社会与空间边界。

papers.title: Feeding habits of the notothenioid fishes P atagonotothen sima ( R ichardson, 1845) and Patagonotothen cornucola ( R ichardson, 1844) along shallow waters of argentine patagonia
papers.authors: Marcinkevicius, Mauro; Bovcon, Nelson D.; Cochia, Pablo D.; Cárcamo, Damian J. A.; Opazo, Facundo A.; Jacobi, Kevin J.; Llompart, Facundo M.
papers.abstract: Abstract Information on the feeding ecology of intertidal notothenioid fishes remains limited in Argentine Patagonia, particularly for Patagonotothen sima . This study examined the diets of P. sima and P. cornucola and their spatial and seasonal variation using stomach-content analysis. Sampling was conducted at four coastal localities between March 2021 and March 2022. Patagonotothen sima was collected at two localities and P. cornucola at three; the interspecific comparison was restricted to Cerro Avanzado during winter. Patagonotothen sima fed mainly on polychaetes and small crustaceans, including tanaidaceans, amphipods and decapods, and exhibited an intermediate niche breadth (0.44). In P. cornucola , amphipods and polychaetes were important at Cerro Avanzado, whereas Exosphaeroma sp. and amphipods were prominent at Yamana. At El Pique, the diet was dominated by Exosphaeroma sp., with a narrow niche breadth (0.25), compared with intermediate values at Cerro Avanzado (0.56) and Yamana (0.59). Significant Site × Season interactions were detected in both species, as well as an interspecific difference at Cerro Avanzado during winter. These findings provide a detailed characterisation of the diet of P. sima in Argentine Patagonia and highlight spatial and seasonal variation in the trophic ecology of both species.
papers.summary_cn: 对阿根廷巴塔哥尼亚潮间带两种南极鱼科鱼类 *Patagonotothen sima* 与 *P. cornucola* 进行胃含物分析，2021年3月至2022年3月在4个沿岸地点采样，*P. sima* 采自2个地点、*P. cornucola* 采自3个地点，种间比较仅限冬季 Cerro Avanzado。*P. sima* 主要摄食多毛类和小型甲壳类（tanaidaceans、amphipods、decapods），生态位宽度居中（0.44）；*P. cornucola* 在 Cerro Avanzado 以 amphipods 和多毛类为主，Yamana 以 *Exosphaeroma* sp. 和 amphipods 为主，El Pique 以 *Exosphaeroma* sp. 为主且生态位宽度较窄（0.25），Cerro Avanzado（0.56）和 Yamana（0.59）居中。两物种均存在显著的站点×季节交互作用，冬季 Cerro Avanzado 存在种间差异，揭示了两者摄食生态的空间与季节变异。

papers.title: CRAB-DETR: robust state detection of Portunus trituberculatus under adverse imaging conditions in industrial aquaculture
papers.authors: Dai, Hongjing; Ye, Rong; Shi, Rui; Cui, Zhibo; Xiang, Wanwan; Wang, Yue; Yu, Hong
papers.abstract: Robust state detection of Portunus trituberculatus in industrial aquaculture is essential for screening abnormal individuals and issuing risk alerts. However, nonuniform illumination, visibility degradation, and complex backgrounds weaken object boundaries and local phenotypic cues, hindering individual localization and state detection. In this study, the detection task distinguishes three observable phenotypic states, namely Sick, Healthy, and Dead. Specifically, the Sick class represents individuals exhibiting visually abnormal external phenotypes, rather than individuals with clinically or etiologically confirmed disease. Image enhancement can recover partial visual information, yet its utility varies markedly across space: the same operation may reveal structures in dark regions while introducing noise and pseudo-textures in highlights or reflections. A central challenge is therefore to exploit useful cues from enhanced views without allowing unreliable enhancement features to corrupt the original representation. To address this issue, we propose CRAB-DETR. Built on RT-DETR-L, CRAB-DETR treats the original image as the primary representation and introduces a detail-enhanced view and an illumination-compensated view as complementary visual evidence. We further develop TriStemFusion, a discrepancy-guided selective multi-view fusion module that explicitly describes changes between each enhanced view and the original representation, dynamically modulates their local contributions, and performs controlled feature correction through original-anchored bounded residual compensation. During training, progressive multi-scale dense auxiliary supervision provides more positive learning signals for difficult objects, while inference retains the standard RT-DETR detection path. Under a unified experimental protocol, CRAB-DETR achieved competitive performance on our Portunus trituberculatus dataset and outperformed several representative detectors. Stratified evaluation under multiple imaging-degradation conditions further demonstrates its practical potential.
papers.summary_cn: 针对工业养殖三疣梭子蟹（Portunus trituberculatus）在光照不均、能见度下降和复杂背景下个体定位与状态检测困难的问题，提出基于RT-DETR-L的CRAB-DETR，将原图作为主表示，引入细节增强视图与光照补偿视图作为互补视觉证据，并通过TriStemFusion模块以差异引导的选择性多视图融合和原图锚定的有界残差补偿抑制不可靠增强特征。训练阶段采用渐进式多尺度密集辅助监督，推理阶段保持标准RT-DETR检测路径。在自建三疣梭子蟹数据集上，该方法区分Sick（表型异常，非临床确诊疾病）、Healthy和Dead三种状态，性能优于多个代表性检测器，并在多种成像退化条件下的分层评估中显示出实际应用潜力。

papers.title: Effect of Different Probiotic Concentrations on the Growth of Catfish (Clarias gariepinus) Cultured in a Bucket-Based Aquaculture System (Budikdamber)
papers.authors: Manganang, Yessi Ayu Putri; Indriani, Yeni; Mose, Numisye Iske
papers.abstract: Effective water quality management is essential for optimizing fish growth in the Budikdamber (fish-in-a-bucket) aquaponic system. This study evaluated the effects of different EM4 probiotic concentrations on the growth performance of catfish (Clarias gariepinus). The experiment used a completely randomized design with four treatments and three replicates: 0 (A), 10 (B), 15 (C), and 20 ml/L EM4 (D). Parameters included relative growth rate (RGR), feed utilization efficiency (EPP), survival rate (SR), and water quality. EM4 significantly affected RGR, which increased from 5.54% in the control to 7.24% in treatment D. EPP showed an increasing trend, reaching 5.27% in treatment D, although differences among treatments were not significant. Survival rates ranged from 7.77% to 44.43%, with the highest values recorded in treatments B and D. Although pH and dissolved oxygen remained within acceptable ranges, ammonia concentrations exceeded recommended standards in all treatments, while nitrate levels exceeded the limits in treatments A and B. In conclusion, EM4 at 20 ml/L produced the highest RGR but did not yield the best results across all parameters. Therefore, improved water quality management remains necessary.
papers.summary_cn: 在Budikdamber（桶式鱼菜共生）系统中设置0、10、15、20 ml/L四个EM4益生菌浓度处理，评估其对革胡子鲶（Clarias gariepinus）生长的影响。20 ml/L处理组相对生长率最高（7.24%，对照组5.54%），饲料利用效率呈上升趋势但组间无显著差异；成活率仅7.77%–44.43%，以10和20 ml/L组最高。各处理氨氮均超标，10和20 ml/L组硝酸盐亦超标，表明高浓度EM4虽提升生长但仍需改善水质管理。

papers.title: Unequal Footprints: Comparing Catch Composition and Ecological Indicators Across Small-Scale Fishery Métiers
papers.authors: Karatza, Alexandra; Ganias, Kostas
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Small-scale fisheries (SSF) play an important role in coastal Mediterranean communities but may also produce high proportions of discards and interact with vulnerable marine taxa. This study provides a comparative assessment of three métiers practiced in a Mediterranean SSF, each targeting a different species using static nets: gillnets for surmullet ( Mullus surmuletus ; MULLUS), and trammel nets for common cuttlefish ( Sepia officinalis ; SEPIA) and common sole ( Solea solea ; SOLE). A total of 334 hauls were analyzed between 2019 and 2023 under commercial fishing conditions. Catch composition was recorded at species level and categorized as target, retained bycatch, and discards, while elasmobranchs, predominantly comprising batoid species of varying conservation status, were treated as a separate category. Indicators describing catch characteristics and fishing practices included the proportions of immature and physically damaged individuals, catch-category biomass, fuel consumption standardized by landed commercial catch, soak time, fishing depth, haul income, and dolphin-depredation frequency. Principal component analysis and cumulative dominance curves were used to explore métier-specific patterns. The métiers differed in catch composition and in the profiles of ecological and operational indicators. MULLUS exhibited lower discard biomass shares and negligible recorded chondrichthyans biomass compared with two trammel-net métiers, but higher proportions of immature and damaged individuals and a higher frequency of dolphin depredation than SEPIA. SOLE had a high recorded contribution of elasmobranchs, while fuel-use intensity relative to landed commercial catch was highest in SEPIA. Hypothetical reclassification scenarios also illustrated how local market practices can affect estimates of retained bycatch and discards. The findings show that métiers operating in the same fishery can exhibit contrasting profiles, underscoring the need for métier-specific assessments and tailored management measures rather than assuming that interventions will be equally effective across fishing practices.
papers.summary_cn: 基于2019—2023年商业捕捞条件下334网次数据，比较地中海小规模渔业三种静态网作业方式（MULLUS刺网、SEPIA与SOLE三重刺网）的渔获组成与生态指标。各 métier 在渔获组成及生态、操作指标上差异明显：MULLUS 丢弃生物量占比更低、记录到的软骨鱼生物量可忽略，但未成熟与受损个体比例及海豚掠食频率高于SEPIA；SOLE 的板鳃类贡献高，SEPIA 单位上岸商业渔获的燃油消耗强度最高。PCA与累积优势曲线揭示了 métier 特异性模式，且假想重分类情景显示本地市场惯例会影响留捕副渔获与丢弃的估算。结果表明同一渔业内不同 métier 呈现迥异特征，需开展 métier 特异性评估并制定针对性管理措施，而非假定干预在各作业方式间效果等同。

papers.title: Modelling Co-Occurrence of Marine Pelagic Species in the Northern Humboldt Current System
papers.authors: Galloso, Paola; Grados, Daniel; Legendre, Pierre
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The northern Humboldt Current System (nHCS) is among the most productive marine ecosystems worldwide, supporting highly dynamic pelagic communities. However, the relative contributions of environmental conditions, spatial processes and species associations to community organization have not been quantified together. We asked to what extent community structure is dominated by environmental variables versus residual (biotic or abiotic) dependencies. We fitted year-specific Joint Species Distribution Models (JSDMs) to acoustic data for six pelagic taxa from summer surveys collected by the Instituto del Mar del Perú (IMARPE) between 2013 and 2019. We modelled the community abundance matrix using a two-part hurdle approach to account for zero inflation in the acoustic data, allowing the joint analysing of species occurrence and abundance patterns in relation to environmental and spatial drivers. Occurrence models showed good predictive performance (mean cross-validated AUC = 0.83), whereas abundance models had low explanatory power (mean = 0.07). Environmental covariates, led by distance to the shelf break, dissolved oxygen and sea surface temperature, jointly accounted for 69%-83% of the explained variance in occurrence, versus 17%-31% for the spatial random effect. Significant residual species associations were observed only in occurrence models and were weaker or absent in years of strong environmental anomalies. Environmental filtering is therefore the primary organising mechanism of pelagic community structure in the nHCS, with spatial and biotic processes modulating it among years. For ecosystem-based management, these results support monitoring and managing co-occurrence of pelagic taxa jointly, using oxygen and temperature conditions as early indicators of community reorganization under ENSO and climate variability.
papers.summary_cn: 基于2013—2019年秘鲁IMARPE夏季声学调查数据，对北洪堡海流系统6个中上层类群拟合逐年JSDM，采用两部分hurdle模型联合分析物种出现与丰度对环境及空间驱动因子的响应。出现模型预测表现良好（交叉验证AUC均值0.83），丰度模型解释力低（均值0.07）；以陆架坡折距离、溶解氧和海表温度为首的环境协变量共同解释出现变异解释量的69%—83%，空间随机效应仅占17%—31%。显著的物种残差关联仅见于出现模型，且在环境异常强年较弱或缺失，表明环境过滤是该系统中上层群落结构的主要组织机制，空间与生物过程起年际调节作用；建议以氧和温度条件作为ENSO及气候变率下群落重组的早期指示，联合监测与管理中上层类群的共现。

papers.authors: Noor, Noorashikin Md; Kemarau, Ricky Anak; Juneng, Liew; Sa’adi, Zulfaqar; Sakawi, Zaini; Ayup, Sofia; Mohd Tahir, Khaitrul Ediana; Maidin, Mohd Samsul Rohizad; Mahram, Marlinda Anim; A. Bakar, Yazeeren

papers.title: Associations between fruit, vegetable and fish and epigenetic markers of ageing and protein EpiScores in Generation Scotland
papers.authors: Gregory, Sarah; Mur, Jure; Shannon, Oliver M.; Smith, Hannah M.; Marioni, Riccardo E.; Tzioras, Makis; Muniz-Terrera, Graciela
papers.abstract: Abstract Consumption of foods such as fruit, vegetables and fish has been associated with a reduced risk of non-communicable diseases (NCDs) and greater longevity. These effects could, at least in part, be underpinned by epigenetic alterations, including changes in DNA methylation (DNAm) patterns. The aim of the current study was to characterise cross-sectional associations between three selected food components (fruit, vegetables and fish) and measures of DNA methylation associated with biological ageing (DNAm PhenoAge, DNAm GrimAge and DNAm Telomere Length), and epigenetic scores-or EpiScores-for 109 proteins in Generation Scotland. This study used dietary data collected on frequency and consumption quantities of fresh fruit ( n = 8648), vegetables ( n = 8686) and fish ( n = 5070). Linear regression models were used to test associations between food components and DNAm GrimAge, DNAm PhenoAge, DNAm Telomere Length, DNAm IL6 and the 109 EpiScores), After correction for multiple testing, there were several significant associations between food and the epigenetic biomarkers.. These findings provide additional evidence that dietary behaviours are associated with DNA methylation-derived biomarkers of ageing and health. Future research could focus on external validation of our results, and use longitudinal data to explore causal pathways.
papers.summary_cn: 在Generation Scotland队列中分析水果（n=8648）、蔬菜（n=8686）和鱼（n=5070）摄入频率与摄入量与DNAm表观遗传衰老指标（DNAm PhenoAge、DNAm GrimAge、DNAm端粒长度）及109种蛋白EpiScores的横断面关联，采用线性回归模型并经多重检验校正。结果显示多种食物成分与表观遗传生物标志物存在显著关联，提示膳食行为与DNA甲基化衍生的衰老及健康标志物相关，后续需外部验证及纵向数据探讨因果通路。

papers.title: Research Progress on the Regulatory Mechanisms of Circadian Rhythms in Fish and Their Applications in Aquaculture
papers.authors: You, Yuzhuo; Yu, Guo; Fu, Zhengyi
papers.abstract: Circadian rhythms constitute an endogenous timekeeping system that fish have evolved to anticipate the alternation of light and darkness, and their molecular basis centers on the rhythmic expression of core clock genes. Teleosts display a markedly decentralized organization, in which multiple brain regions and peripheral tissues harbor endogenous, directly photoreceptive oscillators; consequently, fish rhythms are highly sensitive and plastic with respect to environmental factors such as light, temperature, salinity, dissolved oxygen and feeding. Advances in multi-omics, gene editing and live imaging have substantially deepened understanding of fish circadian biology, including the functional dissection of clock genes, the characterization of tissue-specific expression profiles, and the characterization of interactions between the clock and metabolism, immunity and reproduction. Against this background, chrono-aquaculture-the scheduling of farming practice to match the endogenous rhythms of the cultured species-has emerged as a promising framework for improving production efficiency and animal welfare while reducing environmental load. Nevertheless, important challenges remain, including a pronounced reliance on a small number of model species, limited understanding of multi-factor interactions, and a persistent gap between laboratory findings and large-scale application. This review synthesizes the molecular regulatory networks of fish circadian rhythms, the mechanisms through which environmental factors act, physiological and behavioral rhythms, and their application in aquaculture, and discusses key bottlenecks and future directions, with the aim of supporting both fish chronobiology and precision aquaculture management.
papers.summary_cn: 鱼类生物钟以核心钟基因的节律性表达为分子基础，真骨鱼呈高度去中心化组织，多个脑区和外周组织均含可直接感光的內源性振荡器，因而其节律对光照、温度、盐度、溶氧和投喂等环境因子高度敏感且可塑。多组学、基因编辑和活体成像等技术推进了钟基因功能解析、组织特异性表达谱刻画以及生物钟与代谢、免疫和繁殖互作的研究。在此基础上，按养殖对象内源节律安排生产操作的“时间水产养殖”（chrono-aquaculture）成为兼顾生产效率、动物福利与环境负荷的潜在框架，但仍受限于模式物种依赖、多因子交互认识不足及实验室成果向规模化应用转化不畅等瓶颈。

papers.title: Beyond the epipelagic zone: unexpected deep occurrence of holoplanktonic gastropods in the Central Indian Ridge
papers.authors: Kim, Minju; Choi, Hyeongwoo; Kim, Hyeon; Kil, Haelim; Eyun, Seong-il; Kang, Jung-Hoon
papers.abstract: Holoplanktonic gastropods are important components of oceanic ecosystems and contribute to trophic transfer, biogeochemical cycling, and pelagic carbonate production. Despite their importance, we know surprisingly little about the vertical distribution and mitochondrial genomes of holoplanktonic gastropods in the deep Indian Ocean. To shed light on this topic, we investigated surveys in the waters above the Central Indian Ridge in June 2018 and July 2019. Depth-stratified samples were collected using a Multiple Opening/Closing Net and Environmental Sensing System, and then employed next-generation sequencing to identify the species present and assess phylogenetic relationships. Our result revealed two species of holoplanktonic gastropods: Atlanta oligogyra , and Heliconoides inflatus . A. oligogyra was restricted to the Onnuri Vent Field but was deepest recorded down to 1,600 m, while H. inflatus peaked abundance in the epipelagic zone. Environmental analyses indicated a positive association between H. inflatus abundance and temperature, whereas no clear relationships were detected for the A. oligogyra . COX1 sequences showed 98.9-100% similarity to public reference sequences, supporting the morphological identifications for both species. Phylogenetic analyses recovered the major Atlantidae and Pteropoda lineages but provided limited resolution among closely related Atlanta species. Genomic divergence among H. inflatus specimens despite identical COX1 barcodes may indicate cryptic diversity. These findings provide the first integrated ecological and molecular assessment of holoplanktonic gastropods from the Central Indian Ridge and establish a baseline for future studies of pelagic biodiversity in the Indian Ocean.
papers.summary_cn: 2018年6月与2019年7月在中印度洋海岭上方水域用Multiple Opening/Closing Net and Environmental Sensing System进行分层采样，并结合next-generation sequencing鉴定全浮游腹足类并分析系统发育。共记录Atlanta oligogyra与Heliconoides inflatus两种，前者仅见于Onnuri Vent Field且最深记录至1600 m，后者在水表层（epipelagic zone）丰度最高；H. inflatus丰度与温度正相关，A. oligogyra未见明显环境关系。COX1序列与公共参考序列相似度98.9–100%，支持形态鉴定；系统发育分析恢复了Atlantidae与Pteropoda主要谱系但近缘Atlanta种间分辨率有限，H. inflatus在COX1条形码一致情况下仍存在基因组分化，提示cryptic diversity。

papers.title: Socio-Ecological Transformations in Small-Scale Fisheries: Assessing the Impact of Maritime Modernization in Southeast Sulawesi, Indonesia
papers.authors: Bunga, Bunga Indah Rahayu; Syahrul, Syahrul Ramadhan; Agus, Agus Febrian; Adellina, Adellina Langitan; Zahrah, Zahrah Nafisa Ibrahim; Abid, Abid Rohani; Adisya, Adisya Alsyafira; Wilyam, Wilyam Novisai Kullu; Agnesia, Agnesia Salsabila Mandilebang; Pendais, Pendais Haq
papers.journal: Journal of Law, Social Science and Management
papers.abstract: Background: Small-scale fisheries in Southeast Sulawesi face significant socio-ecological pressures driven by maritime modernization programs and technological change. Objectives: This study aims to assess the socio-ecological impacts of maritime modernization on small-scale fishing communities in Southeast Sulawesi, Indonesia. Method: A mixed-methods approach was employed, combining structured interviews with 120 fishing households across four coastal villages in Kendari, Baubau, Muna, and Wakatobi districts, with ecological assessments of fish catch trends over five years (2019-2023). Results: Findings reveal that modernization has increased fishing capacity and short-term income, yet has simultaneously eroded traditional ecological knowledge (TEK), disrupted customary fishing territories, and intensified resource competition. Ecological indicators show declining fish abundance near inshore areas, while fishers increasingly venture into deeper waters. Social stratification has widened as capital-intensive technologies favor wealthier fishers. Conclusion: Maritime modernization in Southeast Sulawesi has generated a dual socio-ecological transformation: improved economic efficiency for some, but increased vulnerability and reduced ecological resilience for many. Adaptive co-management integrating local knowledge systems is urgently needed. Keywords: small-scale fisheries, socio-ecological transformation, maritime modernization, Southeast Sulawesi, coastal resilience
papers.summary_cn: 对印尼东南苏拉威西四个沿海村落120户渔民家庭的访谈与2019–2023年渔获趋势的生态评估显示，海洋现代化提升了捕捞能力与短期收入，却侵蚀了传统生态知识（TEK）、扰乱了习惯性渔场并加剧资源竞争；近岸鱼类丰度下降，渔民被迫向深水拓展，资本密集型技术使社会分层扩大。现代化带来双重社会生态转型：部分渔民经济效率提高，但多数人脆弱性上升、生态韧性下降，亟需整合地方知识体系的适应性协同管理。

papers.title: Hydrodynamic Resistance and Intact Stability Assessment of Modern Small Scale Fishing Vessels for Indonesian Coastal Fisheries
papers.authors: Romadhoni, Romadhoni; Santoso, Budhi; Amin, Bintal; Feliatra, Feliatra; Sari, T E Y
papers.abstract: Small scale fishing vessels are central to Indonesian coastal fisheries, yet traditional wooden hulls often fall short on hydrodynamic efficiency, operational safety, and stability. This study evaluates hydrodynamic resistance, propulsion power requirements, hydrostatic characteristics, and intact stability in traditional wooden and redesigned Fiberglass Reinforced Plastic (FRP) fishing vessels. The comparison was carried out numerically on a 3 GT vessel measuring 8.50 m in length, 2.20 m in breadth, and 0.80 m in draft. Across the speed range examined, the FRP configuration cuts total resistance and effective propulsion power by about 12.49%; at 10 knots, resistance falls from 46.735 kN to 40.899 kN and effective power from 240.43 kW to 210.40 kW. Hydrostatic analysis shows gains of roughly 1.9-4.8% in the selected parameters. The FRP vessel also yields a higher initial metacentric height (0.606 m) and a larger maximum righting lever (0.699 m) than the wooden vessel (0.566 m and 0.308 m, respectively). These results point to the potential of an integrated FRP hull redesign to improve both hydrodynamic performance and intact stability, and thereby to support safer, more efficient small-scale fishing vessel development in Indonesian coastal waters.
papers.summary_cn: 针对8.50 m×2.20 m×0.80 m、3 GT的印尼沿岸小型渔船，数值比较了传统木壳与重新设计的FRP（玻璃钢）船型在阻力、推进功率、静水力与完整稳性上的差异。在所考察速度范围内，FRP方案的總阻力与有效推进功率均降低约12.49%，10 kn时阻力由46.735 kN降至40.899 kN、有效功率由240.43 kW降至210.40 kW，静水力参数提升约1.9%–4.8%。FRP船的初稳性高（0.606 m）与最大复原力臂（0.699 m）均高于木船（0.566 m与0.308 m）。结果表明一体化FRP船体重设计可同时改善水动力性能与完整稳性，有助于印尼沿岸更安全高效的小型渔船发展。

papers.title: Subsistance Fisheries Characteristics in Androy Madagascar Towards Sustainability
papers.authors: Fidison, Rasolondraizafy Jean; Sylvain, Ramananarivo; Romaine, Ramananarivo; Rolland, Razafindraibe
papers.journal: International Journal of Scientific Research and Modern Technology
papers.abstract: Recurring droughts lead to environmental degradation, reduce agricultural yields and render the social fabric of the Androy region highly vulnerable. Indeed, rural communities are restructuring their productive systems to exploit marine resources, despite the social constraints involved. This study aims to understand the dynamics of the community-led institutionalisation of marine fishing and to examine the socio-environmental management of this new productive model. The study was conducted in three coastal villages in Ambovombe district during April 2025. A total 93 of fishermen and several fisherwomen were sampled using purposive and snowball sampling techniques. Primary data were collected through in-depth guided interviews, focus-group discussions and informal conversations. The study’s findings reveal the characteristics of small-scale fishers in Androy and the challenges they face. Subsistence fisheries tend to be deeply rooted in local communities, with 67% of participants being family members (Fly), reflecting historical links to adjacent fishery resources dating back to the 1990s as sources of household income (Gn) for 100% of respondents. Subsistance fishers face a variety of challenges to their livelihoods. These challenges are from socio-economics conditions (SuW ; SoL), climate variability (Cv) and environmental degradation, the most felt compromising ressources collection (Rs). Mean while, as from the political dimensions, government policies (Ste) are most felt problems. Androy coastal fishers face different threats, and have different coping mechanism and resources reflecting their traditions and values, and supporting social cohesion through seasonal ocean sacrifice (SC). Studies of the key characteristics of subsistance marine fisheries in Androy and the challenges they face are deemed very necessary for small-scalled fisreries sustainability.
papers.summary_cn: 针对马达加斯加Androy地区反复干旱导致农业减产、社区脆弱化的背景，通过2025年4月在Ambovombe三个沿海渔村的93名渔民及若干渔妇的深度访谈、焦点小组和非正式交谈，考察社区主导型海洋捕捞制度化动态及其社会-环境管理。结果显示，当地生计渔业深植于社区，67%参与者为家庭成员（Fly），捕捞资源自1990年代即为全部受访者的家庭收入来源；渔民面临社会经济条件、气候变异与环境退化等生计挑战，其中资源采集受限感受最强，政策层面则以政府政策干预最为突出。渔民依托传统与价值观形成多样化应对机制，并通过季节性海洋祭祀（SC）维系社会凝聚力，这些特征与挑战的识别对小规模渔业可持续性十分必要。

papers.title: Fish Oil Nanoliposomes Coated with Carboxymethyl Chitosan: Preparation, pH Responsiveness and Sustained Release
papers.authors: Meng, Ke; Zhou, Ziqi; Liu, Liang; Wang, Jing; Wang, Jie; Yan, Jinxin; Wang, Zhigao; Huang, Zhihai; Cao, Shaoqian; Qi, Xiangyang
papers.abstract: The nanoliposomes coated with carboxymethyl chitosan (CM-NLs) were prepared to deliver fish oil. The encapsulation efficiency (EE) of CM-NLs was 95.82% at 0.3% carboxymethyl chitosan (CMCS), with an average particle size of 89.24 nm and a zeta potential of 3.43 mV. The shape of nanoliposomes changed from spherical to irregular ellipsoidal after modification with CMCS. Structural analysis indicated that CMCS mainly encapsulated the nanoliposomes through hydrogen bonding, increasing the phase transition temperature from 183 °C to 208 °C. The in vitro release profiles showed that CM-NLs exhibited a significant sustained-release effect in simulated gastrointestinal fluids, with an approximately 18 h delay in release compared to NLs; yet, the release rates at 48 h were 53.87% and 67.32% for NLs and CM-NLs, respectively. CM-NLs remained relatively stable in the oral and gastric phases, while it was digested in the intestinal phase, resulting in a decrease in particle size. Moreover, CM-NLs were more sensitive to pH compared to NLs, and its particle size significantly increased under strong acid and alkali conditions. This study developed a nanoliposome delivery system for fish oil with enhanced encapsulation, sustained release, and pH-responsive properties. It provides an approach for the development and application of fish oil liposomes.
papers.summary_cn: 以0.3%羧甲基壳聚糖（CMCS）包覆鱼油纳米脂质体（CM-NLs），包封率达95.82%，平均粒径89.24 nm，zeta电位3.43 mV；CMCS主要通过氢键包覆并使其相变温度由183 °C升至208 °C，形貌由球形变为不规则椭球形。体外模拟胃肠释放显示CM-NLs具明显缓释效果，较未包覆脂质体（NLs）释放延迟约18 h，48 h释放率分别为53.87%（NLs）和67.32%（CM-NLs）；CM-NLs在口腔和胃相较稳定、在肠相被消化致粒径下降，且对pH更敏感，强酸强碱下粒径显著增大。该体系实现了鱼油的高包封、缓释与pH响应特性。

papers.title: Haplotype-Resolved Comparative Epigenomics Reveals Stable Accommodation of Divergent Parental Transposable Elements in a Fertile Intergeneric Hybrid Fish
papers.authors: Wang, Chong; Zhang, Bo; Wei, Tingchu; Gu, Xuedie; Luo, Yuxiang; Lin, Guoliang; Zhang, Chun; Zhou, Yi; Li, Yan; Zhang, Yaping
papers.abstract: Distant hybridization brings divergent parental genomes into a shared nucleus and may trigger genomic shock. TE derepression can accompany this response and further promote genomic instability. Yet some hybrids remain stable and fertile. How divergent parental TEs are retained and regulated in such hybrids remains unclear. We investigated a fertile diploid intergeneric hybrid (Megalobrama amblycephala, ♀ × Culter alburnus, ♂) that retains both parental chromosome sets. This hybrid system allows us to compare TE occupancy and regulatory patterns associated with each parental species across the F1 haplotypes. Here, we generated a 2.11 Gb chromosome-level, haplotype-resolved genome of hybrid and performed multi-omics analyses. Among 6347 parent-informative Pan-TE clusters, 507 (8.0%) showed ≥2-fold parental differences in genomic occupancy, with divergence concentrated in LTR-associated elements. Of these parent-biased clusters, 90.7% retained the same bias in F1 haplotypes. Pan-TE transcription largely remained within the parental range. Parental DNA methylation and chromatin accessibility showed strong matched-parent rank correspondence, although relative parental contrasts were less concordant, particularly for chromatin accessibility. Parental divergence in TE genomic occupancy was associated with larger deviations in chromatin accessibility, but not with transgressive expression. Together, these findings reveal stable TE accommodation, characterized by broad retention of matched-parent epigenetic patterns, selective reorganization of parental contrasts, and largely parental-range TE transcription. This work advances understanding of hybrid genome compatibility and may inform the development of stable hybrid breeding materials.
papers.summary_cn: 对一种可育二倍体属间杂交鱼（团头鲂♀×翘嘴鲌♂）构建了2.11 Gb染色体级别、单倍型分辨的基因组并开展多组学分析，以比较双亲来源单倍型上转座元件（TE）的占据与调控模式。在6347个亲本信息性Pan-TE簇中，507个（8.0%）在基因组占据上呈≥2倍亲本差异，差异集中于LTR类元件，其中90.7%在F1单倍型中保持相同偏倚；Pan-TE转录基本处于亲本范围内。亲本DNA甲基化与染色质可及性表现出与亲本匹配的强等级对应，但相对亲本对比一致性较低（尤其染色质可及性）；TE基因组占据的亲本分歧与染色质可及性偏离较大相关，而与越亲表达无关。结果表明该杂交鱼实现了稳定的TE容纳，即广泛保留匹配亲本的表观遗传模式、选择性重塑亲本对比、TE转录大体维持亲本范围，为理解杂交基因组相容性及培育稳定杂交育种材料提供了依据。

papers.title: Contaminant Attenuation of Some Potential Toxic Metals and Antibiotic Residues in Aquifers Due to Unlined Aquaculture Discharge in Kokori Niger Delta
papers.authors: Etaga, Onovwede Daniel
papers.journal: IIARD INTERNATIONAL JOURNAL OF GEOGRAPHY AND ENVIRONMENTAL MANAGEMENT
papers.abstract: Aquaculture effluent can introduce dissolved nutrients, metals and veterinary pharmaceuticals to shallow groundwater where ponds and waste-disposal structures are hydraulically connected to permeable sediments. This study evaluated the spatial occurrence of selected heavy metals and antibiotic residues in groundwater associated with unlined fish ponds in Kokori, western Niger Delta, Nigeria. Seventeen groundwater sampling locations associated with eight fish-farming areas yielded 25 water samples comprising eight borehole samples and 17 hand-dug-well samples. Ten subsurface soil samples were collected by hand auger to a maximum depth of 4 m and characterized by sieve analysis. Field measurements included pH, electrical conductivity (EC), total dissolved solids (TDS), dissolved oxygen (DO) and biochemical oxygen demand (BOD); cadmium (Cd), lead (Pb), chromium (Cr) and manganese (Mn) were determined by atomic absorption spectrophotometry, while tetracycline, chloramphenicol and formalin were analyzed using procedures based on HPLC and Nash methods respectively. Groundwater was acidic, with mean pH values of 5.58-5.77. Mean Cd concentrations were 0.0041 mg/L in boreholes and 0.0048 mg/L in hand-dug wells close to ponds, compared with 0.0020 mg/L in hand-dug wells located farther from the farms; the first two means exceed the 0.003 mg/L value. The Mean Pb and Cr concentrations remained below the corresponding drinking-water values. Mean Mn increased from 0.14 mg/L in wells near ponds to 0.17 mg/L in the farther well group. Mean tetracycline declined from 0.26 to 0.006 µg/L between the near-pond and farther well groups, corresponding to approximately 97.7% spatial attenuation, whereas chloramphenicol declined from 0.011 to 0.005 µg/L (approximately 54.5%). The patterns are consistent with attenuation during subsurface transport. The findings demonstrate localized deterioration of shallow groundwater quality near aquaculture facilities and support improved effluent management, appropriate siting of water supply wells, and routine monitoring of aquaculture-impacted groundwater.
papers.summary_cn: 尼日利亚Kokori地区无衬砌鱼塘排水与浅层地下水存在水力联系，研究采集8口机井和17口手挖井共25个水样及10个4 m以浅土样，测定pH、EC、TDS、DO、BOD及Cd、Pb、Cr、Mn和四环素、氯霉素、福尔马林。地下水呈酸性（pH 5.58–5.77），近塘机井和手挖井Cd均值分别为0.0041和0.0048 mg/L，高于0.003 mg/L限值，远离鱼塘的手挖井为0.0020 mg/L；Pb、Cr均值未超标，Mn由近塘0.14 mg/L升至远塘0.17 mg/L。四环素由近塘0.26 µg/L降至远塘0.006 µg/L（衰减约97.7%），氯霉素由0.011降至0.005 µg/L（约54.5%），符合地下迁移过程中的衰减特征。结果表明水产养殖设施周边浅层地下水质量存在局部退化，需加强尾水管理、供水井选址和常规监测。

papers.title: Sustainable aquafeeds: integrating alternative proteins, feed biotechnology, and gut microbiome modulation for one health aquaculture
papers.authors: Nazir, Mir Ishfaq; Wani, Mohasin Nazir; Khurshid, Zakir; Gargotra, Pankaj; Asimi, Oyas A.
papers.abstract: The aquaculture industry supplied 94.4 million tonnes of aquatic animals in 2022, which constituted nearly half of global aquatic animal production, yet most feeds still rely on fishmeal and fish oil from forage-fish fisheries that cannot be scaled any further. This review considers alternative proteins, feed biotechnology, and gut microbiome modulation as one connected system rather than three separate research lines. It covers six groups of alternative proteins, eight processing and biotechnology tools (microbiological, biochemical, thermal, and chemical), and nine microbiome modulation strategies, and it compares marine carnivorous species with freshwater omnivorous species. Replacement ceilings depend largely on habitat and feeding guilds, where freshwater omnivores such as tilapia tolerate high plant-protein inclusion, whereas marine carnivores usually keep growth and gut health only up to roughly 20 to 35% fishmeal protein replacement with a single ingredient. Processing that removes anti-nutritional factors or opens cell walls raises these ceilings in some trials but not in others. The gut microbiome is a plausible mediator between ingredient and host health; substrate supply and taxonomic shifts are better documented than microbial metabolites and signaling, and causal evidence is scarce. From a One Health perspective, lower antimicrobial use, reduced nutrient discharge, and preserved fillet omega-3 content have each been supported in part, but never together for the same feed. A central gap is the lack of studies linking life cycle assessment to microbiome-mediated health outcomes. Future work should focus on precision aquafeeds, artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted formulation, and non-lethal biomarkers.
papers.summary_cn: 2022年水产养殖供应水生动物9440万吨、约占全球产量近半，但饲料仍主要依赖无法再扩规模的饵料鱼鱼粉与鱼油。综述将替代蛋白、饲料生物技术与肠道菌群调控作为一体系统，覆盖六类替代蛋白、八种加工与生物技术工具及九种菌群调控策略，并比较海水肉食性与淡水杂食性物种。替代上限取决于栖息地与摄食类型：罗非鱼等淡水杂食鱼可耐受高比例植物蛋白，而海水肉食鱼单一原料替代鱼粉蛋白通常仅约20%–35%即维持生长与肠道健康；去除抗营养因子或破壁的加工在部分试验中提高该上限、另一些则无效。肠道菌群可能是连接原料与宿主健康的介导者，但底物供给与分类群变化的研究多于微生物代谢物与信号传导，因果证据稀缺；One Health视角下减少抗菌药使用、降低营养排放与保持鱼片omega-3含量各自获部分支持，但从未在同一饲料中同时实现，且缺乏将生命周期评价与菌群介导健康结局关联的研究，未来应聚焦精准水产饲料、AI辅助配方与非致死生物标志物。

papers.title: Renal Production of Recombinant Proteins in Fish Using a Novel Lipocalin Family Gene Promoter: Verification of the Production Concept Through Generation of Transgenic Medaka Expressing Model Fluorescent Proteins
papers.authors: Yao, Yunxuan; Yamaguchi, Yo; Nomura, Kiri; Todo, Takashi; Hiramatsu, Naoshi

papers.title: From Traditional Diagnosis Toward Early Warning: Advances in Surveillance Technologies for Bacterial Diseases in Aquaculture
papers.authors: Liu, Zi-Yan; Yu, Yang
papers.abstract: Intensive aquaculture creates interconnected host, microbial, and environmental conditions that facilitate bacterial disease emergence and spread. Conventional surveillance relies heavily on clinical signs, bacterial isolation, and laboratory confirmation, potentially delaying intervention until infection is established. This review summarizes advances in bacterial disease surveillance in aquaculture, focusing on the transition from individual-animal diagnosis to population-level monitoring and early warning. Culture-based methods remain essential for recovering viable bacteria and obtaining isolates for further characterization. Biochemical identification and MALDI-TOF MS facilitate bacterial identification, whereas immunological assays provide complementary antigen- or antibody-based detection. Phenotypic antimicrobial susceptibility testing further supports the characterization of resistance profiles. Molecular methods, including PCR, quantitative PCR, multiplex PCR, and digital PCR, improve sensitivity and support pathogen quantification, whereas loop-mediated isothermal amplification, recombinase polymerase amplification (RPA), recombinase-aided amplification (RAA), and CRISPR/Cas assays offer opportunities for rapid, field-deployable detection. Environmental DNA monitoring, biosensors, microfluidic systems, whole-genome sequencing, and metagenomics extend surveillance to water, sediment, biofilms, and connected production environments, enabling the analysis of pathogen dynamics, strain relationships, virulence-associated determinants, and antimicrobial resistance. However, detecting bacterial nucleic acids or resistance genes alone does not establish pathogen viability, disease causation, or phenotypic resistance. Moreover, subclinical pathogen detection should not automatically be interpreted as predictive early warning because lead times and farm-specific alert thresholds remain insufficiently validated for most bacterial pathogens. Effective early warning therefore requires standardized sampling, validated assays, longitudinal field studies, and interpretation alongside host health, environmental conditions, and epidemiological evidence. Integrating complementary technologies into risk-based surveillance frameworks could support earlier intervention and strengthen bacterial disease prevention and biosecurity in aquaculture.
papers.summary_cn: 集约化养殖形成宿主—微生物—环境相互关联的条件，促进细菌性疾病的出现与传播；传统监测依赖临床症状、细菌分离和实验室确认，往往在感染确立后才干预。综述梳理水产细菌病监测从个体诊断向群体监测和早期预警的转变：培养法仍是获取活菌和分离株的基础，生化鉴定与MALDI-TOF MS便于菌种鉴定，免疫学方法提供抗原/抗体互补检测，表型药敏试验支持耐药谱表征；PCR、qPCR、多重PCR和digital PCR提高灵敏度并支持病原定量，LAMP、RPA、RAA和CRISPR/Cas等适合快速现场检测；eDNA监测、生物传感器、微流控、全基因组测序和宏基因组学将监测拓展至水体、沉积物、生物膜及关联生产环境，可分析病原动态、菌株关系、毒力相关决定因子和耐药性。但仅检出细菌核酸或耐药基因不能确定病原活性、致病因果或表型耐药，亚临床病原检出也不应自动视为预测性早期预警，因多数细菌病原的预警提前期和养殖场特异性警报阈值尚缺乏验证；有效早期预警需标准化采样、经验证的检测方法、纵向现场研究，并结合宿主健康、环境条件和流行病学证据，将互补技术整合入基于风险的监测框架可支持更早干预并加强水产细菌病防控与生物安全。

papers.title: Pan-Arctic population genomics reveals connectivity and regional structuring in the widespread gelatinous snailfish (Liparis fabricii)
papers.authors: Christensen, Jacob Max; Præbel, Kim; Bhat, Shripathi; Møller, Peter Rask; Lynghammar, Arve
papers.abstract: Introduction The marine environment contains vicariant barriers that are less apparent than those of freshwater or terrestrial systems. These obstacles, often oceanographic features and seafloor topography, can hinder dispersal and gene flow. This is particularly true amongst bottom dwelling species such as demersal fishes. To overcome this, many demersal species have biphasic life histories that can facilitate gene flow through pelagic larvae, connecting otherwise isolated populations. One such species is the gelatinous snailfish, Liparis fabricii . It is amongst the most widespread and abundant fish species native to the Arctic Ocean, and is an important forage species, linking both pelagic and demersal components of Arctic food webs. Materials and methods Here, we used genome-wide single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) and mitochondrial protein-coding genes (mtPCGs) to investigate its population structure throughout the Arctic. Results We found small, but significant, population genetic structuring between regions, with the most distinctive structural signature observed in individuals from Baffin Bay. Despite vast distances between sampling sites, gene flow and physical migration was evident between regions, likely facilitated through its prolonged pelagic larval stage. Discussion As climate change affects Arctic fish communities, identifying patterns of genetic connectivity and biogeographic boundaries amongst fish populations is crucial for the understanding and management of Arctic marine ecosystems.
papers.summary_cn: 全北极范围的基因组SNP与线粒体蛋白编码基因数据揭示，广泛分布于北极、连接浮游与底栖食物网的胶状狮子鱼（Liparis fabricii）存在虽小但显著的区域种群遗传结构，其中Baffin Bay个体的结构信号最为独特。尽管采样点间距离遥远，区域间仍存在明显的基因流与物理迁移，可能由其延长的浮游幼虫期促成。研究结果为理解气候变化背景下北极鱼类种群的遗传连通性与生物地理边界提供了依据。

papers.title: Aquaponics at the Water-Food-Energy Interface: A Critical Review of RAS Coupling, Nutrient Cycling, Commercial Viability, and Expert-Derived Development Priorities
papers.authors: Wei, Ying-Qin; Wang, Hui; Shih, Chun-Han; Kao, Wei-Chieh; Chu, Ta-Jen
papers.abstract: Aquaponics couples recirculating aquaculture systems (RAS) with plant production so that water and feed-derived nutrients are reused rather than discharged; however, resource efficiency at the system boundary does not guarantee environmental or commercial success. This review addresses four linked questions: How are fish and crop production coupled? How are nitrogen, phosphorus, solids, and water managed? Which operating and market conditions determine commercial viability? To what extent can expert-derived priorities support project screening without substituting for measured performance? The narrative synthesis draws on technical reviews, mass-balance experiments, operating-farm studies, life-cycle assessments, and techno-economic analyses, most of which were published between 2016 and 2026. Decoupled and sludge-mineralizing designs can substantially increase nutrient recovery, but gaseous nitrogen losses, potassium and micronutrient deficits, electricity demand, and capital intensity remain persistent constraints. As a quantitative complement, we reanalyzed 1504 archived pairwise judgments provided in 2022 by 16 Chinese experts across five dimensions, 18 criteria, and 53 indicators. Under the aggregation of individual judgments (AIJ), the economic environment (0.0432), water-source availability (0.0428), and water quality control (0.0412) received the highest global indicator weights. AIJ and the aggregation of individual priorities (AIP) shared nine of the ten highest-ranked indicators (Spearman ρ = 0.9548), although agreement among experts was modest (Kendall’s W = 0.2743; p
papers.summary_cn: 循环水养殖（RAS）与植物生产耦合的鱼菜共生系统可实现水与饲料源养分的再利用，但系统边界上的资源效率并不等同于环境或商业成功。该综述围绕鱼菜如何耦合、氮磷固体物与水的管理、商业可行性的运营与市场条件，以及专家优先级能否用于项目筛选四个问题，综合技术综述、质量平衡实验、运营农场研究、生命周期评价与技术经济分析（多发表于2016—2026年）进行叙述性合成。解耦设计与污泥矿化设计可显著提高养分回收，但气态氮损失、钾与微量元素亏缺、电力需求及资本密集度仍是持续约束；对2022年16位中国专家在5个维度、18项准则、53项指标上的1504组两两判断再分析显示，经济环境（0.0432）、水源可得性（0.0428）和水质控制（0.0412）的全局指标权重最高，AIJ与AIP前十指标有九项一致（Spearman ρ=0.9548），但专家间一致性仅为中等（Kendall's W=0.2743）。

papers.title: Effects of Dietary Artemia Biomass Hydrolysate Supplement on Muscle Quality and Immune Responses of Hybrid Grouper (Epinephelus fuscoguttatus ♀ × Epinephelus lanceolatus ♂)
papers.authors: Lan, Yaleng; Ma, Haoran; Yan, Xinrong; Gao, Meirong; Sorgeloos, Patrick; Sui, Liying; Xie, Wei
papers.abstract: Artemia is abundant in protein with a balanced amino acid profile, rich in lipids, and may serve as an alternative to fish meal and a source of functional feed additives. This study aims to evaluate the effects of dietary Artemia biomass hydrolysate supplement on the grouper growth, muscle quality, and immunity of hybrid grouper (Epinephelus fuscoguttatus ♀ × Epinephelus lanceolatus ♂). Juveniles (initial weight 6.75 ± 0.09 g) were randomly divided into four groups (15 fish per tank, 3 replicates) and fed diets supplemented with 0% (Ctrl), 2% Artemia hydrolysate (AH), 2% Artemia protein enzymatic hydrolysate (APEH), and 4% APEH for 8 weeks. The results showed that growth performance was not compromised across all treatments. Notably, dietary inclusion of 4%APEH significantly enhanced the content of polyunsaturated fatty acids (PUFAs) in muscle, especially linolenic acid (C18:3 n-3) and eicosapentaenoic acid (EPA) (p
papers.summary_cn: 以初始体重6.75±0.09 g的杂交石斑鱼（Epinephelus fuscoguttatus ♀ × E. lanceolatus ♂）幼鱼为对象，设置0%（对照）、2%卤虫水解物（AH）、2%卤虫蛋白酶解物（APEH）和4% APEH四个饲料处理组，养殖8周，评估卤虫生物质水解物对生长、肌肉品质和免疫的影响。各处理组生长性能均未受损害；4% APEH显著提高肌肉多不饱和脂肪酸（PUFA）含量，尤其是亚麻酸（C18:3 n-3）和EPA。

papers.title: Growth Performance, Hematological and Metabolic Responses of Juvenile Piaractus brachypomus Exposed to Different Temperatures and Dietary Hesperozygis ringens Essential Oil Supplementation
papers.authors: Magalhães, Thamara Bentivole; Silva, Sidney dos Santos; Ananias, Imaculada de Morais Carvalho; Martins, Wagner Junio de Freitas; da Silva, Narcia Carolina Santos; Souza, André de Sena; Santos, Fabio Aremil Costa dos; Baldisserotto, Bernardo; Rosa, Isadora Aguirre; Heinzmann, Berta Maria
papers.abstract: This study evaluated growth and physiological responses of juvenile Piaractus brachypomus fed Hesperozygis ringens essential oil (HREO) at two temperatures. Fish (n = 448; 9.38 ± 1.75 g) received 0.00, 0.75, 1.00, or 2.00 g kg-1 HREO at 27 or 31 °C for 30 days. There were four recirculating systems per temperature, and each contained one tank per diet. Compared with 27 °C, fish at 31 °C showed higher final weight (34.27 versus 28.53 g; p = 0.0041) and specific growth rate (4.26 versus 3.69% day-1; p = 0.0050), and lower apparent feed conversion ratio (0.86 versus 1.09; p = 0.0047). Plasma alanine aminotransferase activity was lower at 31 °C (10.14 versus 21.17 U L-1; p 0.05). Thus, 31 °C was associated with better growth performance, whereas HREO modified feeding responses without cumulative growth benefits. Dissolved oxygen differences should also be considered when interpreting temperature-associated responses.
papers.summary_cn: 在27和31 ℃下投喂含0、0.75、1.00或2.00 g kg⁻¹ Hesperozygis ringens精油（HREO）的饲料30天，评估幼鱼Piaractus brachypomus的生长与生理响应。31 ℃组终末体重（34.27 vs 28.53 g）、特定生长率（4.26 vs 3.69% day⁻¹）显著高于27 ℃组，表观饲料转化率更低（0.86 vs 1.09），血浆丙氨酸氨基转移酶活性亦较低（10.14 vs 21.17 U L⁻¹）。31 ℃更利于生长性能，HREO改变了摄食响应但未产生累积性生长收益；解释温度相关响应时还需考虑溶解氧差异。

papers.title: Social Enrichment Enhances Aggression Sinks Without Reducing In-Group Aggression in an African Cichlid Fish
papers.authors: Bell, William E.; Dijkstra, Peter D.
papers.abstract: For social animals, aggression in captivity is often intensified by spatial constraints, compromising welfare by increasing injury and mortality risk. Aggression can be reduced through an ‘aggression sink’, a form of social enrichment in which aggression is redirected to alternative social targets rather than concentrated on vulnerable group members. In the cichlid fish Astatotilapia burtoni, males aggressively defend mating territories. We tested whether limiting space between neighboring territorial males would enhance the aggression sink effect. To this end, we housed two groups each consisting of one male and seven females divided by a clear divider with artificial caves placed either close (proximal) or far apart (distal). Aggressive behaviors of dominant males were quantified in response to weekly alternating territorial cave position during a four-week period. We found that aggression directed at the neighboring group was greater in the proximal position. However, this increased aggression sink effect did not reduce aggression directed towards group members because the overall rate of aggression was higher in the proximal position than in the distal position. These findings suggest that territory proximity can alter the aggression sink effect, though it may not necessarily translate to reduced in-group aggression due to parallel changes in overall aggression levels.
papers.summary_cn: 以非洲慈鲷 Astatotilapia burtoni 为对象，将两个各含1雄7雌的群体用透明隔板分隔，人工洞穴按近（proximal）或远（distal）布置，并在4周内每周轮换洞穴位置，量化优势雄性的攻击行为。近距布置下指向邻群的攻击增强，即 aggression sink 效应增强，但指向本群成员的攻击并未减少，因为近距条件下总体攻击率更高。结果表明领域邻近度可改变 aggression sink 效应，但总体攻击水平的同步上升使其未必转化为群内攻击下降。

papers.title: A Four-Stage Ethogram Reveals Diet-Specific Feeding Dynamics and Limited Sex Effects in Subadult Chinese Mitten Crab (Eriocheir sinensis)
papers.authors: Wang, Jie; Liu, Shikun; Liu, Xingguo; Zhang, Kai
papers.abstract: Feeding behaviour in cultured crustaceans consists of feed encounter, acceptance, manipulation and ingestion, yet these components are rarely quantified separately, so that a single measure such as time to complete feeding is often used to infer palatability. This study aimed to (i) establish a reproducible operational ethogram for subadult Chinese mitten crab (Eriocheir sinensis), (ii) test whether sex and food type alter the duration of the four behavioural stages, (iii) compare pellet ingestion rate between sexes, and (iv) quantify first-choice preference among four foods. Eriocheir sinensis females (67.73 ± 3.05 g, mean ± standard deviation, SD) and males (71.05 ± 1.53 g, SD) were acclimated for 7 d and fasted individually for 48 h; feeding on pelleted feed, chilled fish, chilled clam or dried corn was video-recorded for 4 h, with 15 independent crabs of each sex per food. A separate four-choice assay recorded the first food ingested by 15 crabs of each sex. Feeding was consistently resolved into exploration, localization, probing and ingestion, and exploration dominated the time budget (70.05-96.10% of total duration). Phase durations did not differ between sexes within any food, whereas food type reshaped the time budget: exploration was shorter for chilled fish and chilled clam than for pellet feed and corn, and ingestion was shortest for pellet feed. Pellet ingestion rate was lower in females (1.79 ± 0.08%, SD) than in males (1.91 ± 0.06%, SD). Chilled clam was the most frequent first choice (40% in both sexes) and corn the least frequent (7% in females and 13% in males). Attraction and post-contact ingestibility are therefore distinct, independently adjustable properties of a feed: animal-derived foods shortened exploration whereas formulated pellets shortened ingestion. Optimizing these two properties separately, and screening attractants and pellet texture with different behavioural endpoints, offers a practical route to reduce feed waste in Eriocheir sinensis culture.
papers.summary_cn: 建立中华绒螯蟹（Eriocheir sinensis）亚成体四阶段行为谱（探索、定位、试探、摄食），以录像量化不同性别与饲料类型对各阶段时长的影响，并另设四选一实验记录首次摄食选择。探索阶段占总时长70.05%–96.10%，各饲料下两性间各阶段时长无差异，但饲料类型重塑时间分配：冷藏鱼与冷藏蛤的探索时长短于颗粒饲料和玉米，颗粒饲料的摄食阶段最短。雌蟹颗粒饲料摄食率（1.79%±0.08%）低于雄蟹（1.91%±0.06%）；冷藏蛤为两性最常见首选（均40%），玉米最少（雌7%、雄13%）。诱食性与接触后可摄食性是可独立调控的饲料属性，分别优化并以不同行为终点筛选诱食剂与颗粒质地，可减少养殖饲料浪费。

papers.title: Do MSC Assessment Scores Reflect Fish Stock Sustainability? Evidence from Certified and Uncertified Fisheries
papers.authors: Wakamatsu, Hiroki; Sakai, Yutaro; Toyofuku, Shuto; Yagi, Nobuyuki
papers.abstract: Seafood ecolabeling has recently highlighted the global concern about overexploitation of fish stocks. While seafood ecolabeling is generally viewed as a valuable tool for increasing the value of certified fisheries, it has faced criticism regarding the credibility and fairness of its assessments. This study matches MSC assessment scores with fishery statuses in the RAM Legacy Stock Assessment Database using scientific species names and fishing grounds as criteria, and constructs a comparison group of uncertified fisheries targeting the same species in different fishing areas, to investigate whether the assessment scores are appropriately set to preserve fish stocks and regulate fishing activity. MSC-certified fisheries were associated with higher stock levels and lower exploitation rates. The results generally support the notion that MSC-certified fisheries were associated with higher stock levels in the post-certification period. Among 48 certified fisheries, random forest and adaptive LASSO regressions revealed that MSC assessment scores are correlated, both positively and negatively, with stock status and fishing rates.
papers.summary_cn: 研究将MSC评估得分与RAM Legacy Stock Assessment Database中的渔业种群状态按科学种名和渔场匹配，并构建在不同渔区捕捞相同物种的未认证渔业对照组，检验评估得分是否与种群可持续性相符。结果显示，MSC认证渔业对应更高的种群水平和更低的开发率，总体上支持认证后种群水平更高的判断。对48个认证渔业的随机森林和自适应LASSO回归表明，MSC评估得分与种群状态和捕捞率同时存在正、负相关。

papers.title: Dominica's Small-Scale Fisheries: Biological Sampling Underpins the Need for Balanced Fishing on Inshore and Offshore, Reef and Pelagic Species
papers.authors: Engelhard, Georg H.; Pinnegar, John K.; Norris, Norman J.; Degallerie, Diana; Joseph, Wynnona; Baron, Zethra; Harrod, Olivia L.; Defoe, Jullan; Hilton, Kurt; Theophille, Derrick
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Dominica's small-scale fisheries provide vital food and income for coastal communities but face increasing pressure from climate-driven shifts in fish distributions, reef degradation, and extreme events such as Hurricane Maria in 2017, which caused catastrophic damage. In response to these challenges, a biological sampling programme was initiated in 2018-2019 to measure fish species landed by Dominican fishers across the island. The dataset, comprising 3007 measurements sampled at 12 landing sites, provides a detailed picture of catches and size distributions. These showed that for the key pelagic species dolphinfish ( Coryphaena hippurus ), 99% of individuals measured exceeded length-at-maturity, indicating generally sustainable exploitation. In contrast, some reef-associated species showed high proportions of small fish in landings-for example, 71% below length-at-maturity in blackfin snapper ( Lutjanus buccanella ). These patterns underline the importance of balanced fishing on inshore and offshore, reef and pelagic species. Strengthening long-term data collection will support evidence-based management to enhance climate resilience and ensure the ongoing sustainability of Dominica's fisheries.
papers.summary_cn: 2018–2019年在多米尼克12个上岸点对渔获物开展生物学采样，共获得3007尾测量数据，用以刻画近岸与 offshore、礁区与 pelagic 物种的渔获组成及体长分布。关键 pelagic 物种鲯鳅（Coryphaena hippurus）99%的个体超过 length-at-maturity，开发状况总体可持续；而部分礁区鱼类小型化明显，如黑鳍笛鲷（Lutjanus buccanella）71%的个体未达性成熟。结果表明需在近岸与 offshore、礁区与 pelagic 物种间实现均衡捕捞，并加强长期数据收集以支撑基于证据的管理、提升气候韧性。

papers.title: Toxic Metal Contamination, Seasonal Variation, Cooking Effects, and Human Health Risks Associated with Fish Consumption from the Suez Canal, Egypt
papers.authors: Ahdy, Asmaa Mohammed; Imre, Kálmán; Zakaria, Amira Ibrahim; Morar, Adriana; Imre, Mirela; Sallam, Khalid Ibrahim
papers.abstract: This study aimed to assess the potential human health risks associated with metal and metalloids exposure through the consumption of gilthead seabream (Sparus aurata), common sole (Solea solea), and marbled spinefoot (Siganus rivulatus) collected from the Suez Canal, Egypt. The mean ± SE concentrations (mg/kg wet weight) of mercury (Hg), total arsenic (As), lead (Pb), and cadmium (Cd) were 0.72 ± 0.087, 9.3 ± 0.59, 0.130 ± 0.0189, and 0.04 ± 0.0049 in gilthead seabream; 0.65 ± 0.081, 9.7 ± 0.69, 0.140 ± 0.0181, and 0.036 ± 0.0035 in common sole; and 0.70 ± 0.094, 108 ± 0.57, 0.132 ± 0.0166, and 0.041 ± 0.0044 in marbled spinefoot, respectively, with no significant differences in metal concentrations among the three fish species for any of the analyzed metals. Results revealed that 52-58%, 88-100%, 12-16%, and 24-34% of the fish species analyzed surpassed the maximum permissible limits for Hg, As, Pb, and Cd, respectively. Seasonal variations showed higher metal concentrations in summer compared to winter. Thermal cooking caused element-specific apparent concentration reductions (notably Pb and Cd) on a wet-weight basis via fluid exudation rather than elemental destruction. The estimated daily intakes (EDI) of all metals stayed below their Provisional Tolerable Daily Intake (PTDI) values. Target Hazard Quotient (THQ) for Hg exceeded 1.0 in all species, indicating potential non-carcinogenic health risks, while the estimated arsenic-related carcinogenic risk values surpassed the acceptable limit of 1 × 10-4 in all three fish species, suggesting a potential concern that warrants further investigation. However, a key limitation of the health-risk assessment is that inorganic arsenic (iAs) was estimated as 10% of total arsenic rather than determined through direct speciation analysis; therefore, the associated arsenic-related risk estimates are provisional and should be interpreted cautiously. These findings highlight the need for stringent control of aquatic contamination, particularly Hg and As, to ensure seafood safety and protect public health in Egypt.
