papers.summary_cn: 利用鲶鱼（Clarias sp.）内脏和鱼骨等本地有机废弃物作为替代鱼饲料的营养添加原料，以缓解商业饲料价格持续上涨的问题，并向Kediri县Mejono村Melati 2老年妇女小组开展教育和培训。活动前学生团队先行试验以确定高效可行的配方与生产工艺，核心环节为50人参加的宣讲，涵盖营养成分、废弃物利用价值、饲料配方和制粒流程。前后测经Wilcoxon符号秩检验显示参与者理解程度显著提升。

papers.title: Isolation, characterization, and ecotoxicological testing of aquaculture-native bacterial antagonists against the fish pathogen Flavobacterium psychrophilum
papers.authors: Athena-Vasileiadi, Despoina; Skjolding, Lars Michael; Steffensen, Anne Østergaard; Strube, Mikael Lenz; Middelboe, Mathias; Bentzon-Tilia, Mikkel; Gram, Lone
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Intensive aquaculture is experiencing bottlenecks due to diseases caused by bacterial pathogens, such as Flavobacterium psychrophilum , the agent of Bacterial Cold-Water Disease and Rainbow Trout Fry Syndrome in salmonids. With rising antimicrobial resistance and limited vaccine efficacy, biocontrol alternatives are needed. Here, we developed an integrated screening pipeline to isolate native bacterial antagonists of F. psychrophilum from a rainbow trout recirculating aquaculture system. Combining an agar-based inhibition assay, in silico antimicrobial resistance, and virulence screening, and ecotoxicity evaluation toward Raphidocelis subcapitata and Daphnia magna , we identified three Flavobacterium -antagonizing strains with favorable preliminary safety profiles: Pseudomonas palmensis BG17, Rhodococcus qingshengii IW15, and Janthinobacterium sp. CB21. Cell-free supernatants of these isolates suppressed F. psychrophilum growth in vitro , with concentration-dependent effects for CB21 and IW15, and across the tested supernatant dilution range for BG17. Growth of antagonists in 50 μM and 200 μM FeCl 3 reduced pathogen inhibition by BG17 across all supernatant concentrations. Its iron-free supernatant absorbed near 405 nm and fluoresced at 440-445 nm, while direct FeCl 3 addition shifted both signals, and growth of the antagonist in extra iron reduced them. Together with an NRPS cluster of low similarity to a characterized pyoverdine biosynthetic gene cluster (BGC) and a positive CAS assay, these findings are consistent with an iron-responsive fluorescent chelator in BG17. The effect of iron on the inhibition caused by IW15 supernatant differed depending on the iron concentration tested, suggesting a more complex iron-responsive phenotype rather than a simple concentration-dependent effect. Inhibition by CB21 supernatant was not significantly affected by iron under the tested conditions, and its genome did not encode a dedicated siderophore BGC. These aquaculture-native isolates inhibit F. psychrophilum in vitro through apparently distinct mechanisms and warrant further evaluation as biocontrol candidates. IMPORTANCE Worldwide production of intensively farmed salmonids in aquaculture represents a valuable source of high-quality protein but is challenged by significant losses caused by bacterial pathogens, such as Flavobacterium psychrophilum . On a global scale, outbreaks are treated with antibiotics, leading to the development of antimicrobial resistance, while farm effluents can spread resistant bacteria into surrounding freshwater ecosystems, even reaching human pathogens with clinical relevance. Safer biocontrol alternatives are necessary, and probiotics have gained interest as a promising option. Here, we describe three native bacterial strains from a rainbow trout farming environment that through apparently distinct mechanisms inhibit the tested F. psychrophilum strain in vitro . The strains were selected via combined genomic safety and ecotoxicity screening on non-target eukaryotic organisms. By integrating functional, genomic safety, and environmental criteria early in the in vitro screening process, this study advances a One Health approach to develop sustainable disease management alternatives for aquaculture.
papers.summary_cn: 从虹鳟循环水养殖系统中分离水产原生细菌拮抗菌，采用琼脂抑制试验结合基因组抗菌药耐药性与毒力筛查，并以羊角月牙藻和大型溞进行生态毒性评价，筛出3株对杀鲑鱼黄杆菌（Flavobacterium psychrophilum）具拮抗作用且初步安全性良好的菌株：Pseudomonas palmensis BG17、Rhodococcus qingshengii IW15和Janthinobacterium sp. CB21，其无细胞上清在体外均抑制病原生长。BG17的抑制作用随FeCl₃浓度（50、200 μM）升高而减弱，其无铁上清在405 nm附近吸收、440–445 nm发射荧光，加铁后信号改变，结合低相似度NRPS簇与阳性CAS试验，提示其产生铁响应型荧光螯合剂；IW15受铁影响随浓度而异，机制较复杂；CB21上清抑菌不受铁显著影响且基因组无专用铁载体BGC。三株菌经表观不同的机制在体外抑制F. psychrophilum，可作为生物防控候选菌株进一步评估。

papers.title: Climate Change-Induced Projected Black Sea-Level Rise Effects on Dniester Estuary Fish Diversity: Potential Responses to Estuarine Habitat Diversity Transformations
papers.authors: Afanasyev, Sergiy; Lietytska, Olena; Gupalo, Olena; Petrovici, Milca; Bănăduc, Doru
papers.abstract: A globally recognized biodiversity hotspot, the Dniester Estuary supports an extremely rich and valuable ichthyofauna of high conservation status and commercial interest. This matrix of wetlands plays a crucial role in preserving the diversity of fish in the Dniester River basin and the northwestern Black Sea, serving as a key ecological buffer, refuge, foraging ground, and spawning place enabling smooth migratory transitions for many species. Human-induced climate change is driving a sea-level rise within the Black Sea, a phenomenon that is likely to critically disrupt the aquatic and semi-aquatic ecosystems and related fish diversity of the Dniester Estuary, its adjacent low-lying floodplains, and the neighboring marine coasts, directly threatening the fish fauna. In this sea-level rise risk assessment, 53 fish species were studied (Gobiidae, 18; Cobitidae, 8; Percidae, 7; Clupeidae, 5; Mugilidae, 3; Syngnathidae, 3; Gasterosteidae, 2; and one species each for Siluridae, Esocidae, Umbridae, Lotidae, Atherinidae, Centrarchidae, and Pleuronectidae). As a result of sea-level rise, three fish species will be strongly negatively impacted (Misgurnus fossilis, Umbra krameria, and Zingel streber), five will be moderately negatively impacted (Cobitis taenia, Lota lota, Sander lucioperca, Neogobius gymnotrachelus, and Alosa pontica), three will be weakly moderately negative impacted (Sabanejewia baltica, Silurus glanis, and Esox lucius), four will be neutrally impacted (Benthophilus brauneri, Clupeonella cultriventris, Syngnathus argentatus, and Nerophis teres), ten will be neutrally to positively impacted (Pungitius platygaster, Gasterosteus aculeatus, Lepomis gibbosus, Percarina demidoffii, Neogobius melanostomus, Engraulis encrasicolus, Liza haematochelius, L. aurata, L. saliens, and Platichthys flesus), and one will be positively influenced (Atherina pontica).
papers.summary_cn: 针对黑海海平面上升对德涅斯特河口鱼类多样性的风险，评估了53种鱼（以Gobiidae 18种、Cobitidae 8种、Percidae 7种为主）在河口栖息地多样性转变下的潜在响应。结果显示，海平面上升将使3种（Misgurnus fossilis、Umbra krameria、Zingel streber）受到强烈负面影响，5种中度负面、3种弱中度负面影响，4种中性，10种中性至正面影响，1种（Atherina pontica）正面影响。该河口作为鱼类多样性热点及洄游、索饵、产卵的关键生态缓冲与避难所，其鱼类区系正面临海平面上升的直接威胁。

papers.title: The fishing cat in the Kingdom of Water: first review of presence, population size, distribution and conservation in Cambodia
papers.authors: Herranz Muñoz, Vanessa; Sophatt, Reaksmey; Tantipisanuh, Naruemon; Gale, George Andrew; Virgós, Emilio
papers.abstract: Abstract The fishing cat Prionailurus viverrinus in Southeast Asia is threatened by habitat destruction and poaching. In Cambodia, despite the availability of suitable habitat in extensive wetlands, evidence of the species’ presence is scarce. This study presents the results of surveys for fishing cats at four wetland sites, a review of all records of presence and an assessment of the extent of predicted suitable habitat in Cambodia. We also report on threats to fishing cat survival and a population estimate to inform the species’ categorization on the IUCN Red List. Camera-trap surveys showed a decline in frequency of captures during 2017-2023. More recent records from 2021-2023 confirmed a breeding population in the mangrove wetlands of south-west Cambodia. There were no records of presence on the Tonle Sap Lake floodplain in central Cambodia (2021-2022) or along the Mekong River (2022), apart from a single photographic record south-east of Tonle Sap Lake in 2022. The presence of wetlands and high levels of precipitation were predictors of fishing cat presence, and 17% of Cambodia’s wetlands are predicted to offer suitable habitat. We identified 19 protected areas as priority sites for conservation action and population monitoring. High priority sites (c. 5% of Cambodia was identified as highly suitable habitat) are located along the coast and moderately suitable areas (c. 12.5% of Cambodia) on the Tonle Sap floodplain. Poaching and deforestation are the main threats to fishing cats in Cambodia. We extrapolated the size of the fishing cat population from available data and estimated 34-67 individuals in Cambodia, which is low and warrants urgent and effective conservation action.
papers.summary_cn: 2017–2023年柬埔寨四个湿地点的红外相机调查显示渔猫（Prionailurus viverrinus）拍摄频率下降，2021–2023年记录确认西南部红树林湿地存在繁殖种群，而洞里萨湖洪泛平原（2021–2022）与湄公河沿岸（2022）无分布记录。湿地存在与高降水量是渔猫出现的预测因子，预测柬埔寨17%的湿地为适宜栖息地，并识别出19个优先保护与种群监测的保护地，其中沿海约5%区域为高度适宜、洞里萨洪泛平原约12.5%为中度适宜。偷猎与森林砍伐是主要威胁，基于现有数据外推柬埔寨种群约34–67只，数量偏低，亟需有效保护行动。

papers.title: Perception of Challenges and Needs Regarding Animal Welfare in Latin American and the Caribbean Aquaculture
papers.authors: Medina, Paula; Rosas, Carlos; López Greco, Laura; Baltazar-Guerrero, Paul; Roque, Ana; Llonch, Pol; Saraiva, João L.; Arechavala-López, Pablo; Bertini, Giovana; Blázquez, Mercedes
papers.journal: Journal of Applied Animal Welfare Science
papers.abstract: Aquatic animal welfare is increasingly recognised as essential to sustainable aquaculture in Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC). This study identified the principal welfare challenges perceived by scientists, Competent National Authority staff, and industry professionals during a three-day online workshop. Latent Dirichlet Allocation was used to analyse responses concerning nutrition, environment, health, and behaviour across developmental stages, production systems, transport, slaughter, and species-specific issues. Major concerns included animal-based assessments, feeding strategies, and sanitary conditions. Across developmental stages, participants emphasised feed quality, stress, cannibalism, sanitation, and spawning behaviour. Production-system challenges included water quality, stocking density, predator exposure, and facilities supporting natural behaviours. Participants also highlighted limited veterinary capacity and inadequate behavioural assessment tools. Transport and slaughter priorities included capacity building, protocol standardisation, and reducing stress and suffering. Species-specific concerns focused on nutrition, behaviour, and disease diagnosis. Overall, stakeholders recognised substantial gaps in theoretical knowledge and practical capacity. Priorities included nutrition, stress reduction, water management, environmental-impact mitigation, husbandry, personnel training, and comprehensive guidance to strengthen welfare assessment and implementation across species, life stages, and aquaculture production contexts throughout the LAC aquaculture sector.
papers.summary_cn: 通过三日在线工作坊收集科学家、国家主管机构人员和产业从业者对拉丁美洲与加勒比地区水产养殖动物福利挑战的看法，并用LDA主题模型分析营养、环境、健康和行为等议题。主要关切集中在基于动物的评估、投喂策略和卫生条件，各发育阶段强调饲料质量、应激、同类相食、卫生与产卵行为，生产系统层面涉及水质、放养密度、捕食者暴露及支持自然行为的设施。运输与屠宰环节优先事项为能力建设、规程标准化和减少应激与痛苦，物种特异性问题聚焦营养、行为和疾病诊断；利益相关者普遍认为理论知识与实践能力存在显著缺口，优先领域包括营养、应激缓解、水质管理、环境影响减缓、养殖管理、人员培训及跨物种、生命周期和生产情境的福利评估与实施综合指南。

papers.title: Building Climate Resilience in Aquaculture: A Framework for Strengthening Resilience in Kenya’s Aquaculture Value Chain
papers.authors: Adekola, Olalekan; Gatonye, Margaret; Orina, Paul
papers.abstract: Aquaculture is increasingly recognised as a key sector for achieving global development goals, including improving nutrition, ending hunger, poverty reduction, and economic growth. However, the sector remains highly vulnerable to climate change impacts. Addressing this requires integrated, cross-sectoral solutions involving collaboration across biological, technical, economic, and socio-cultural domains. This paper presents a framework for building a climate-resilient aquaculture value chain, using Kenya as a case study. Drawing on data collected through workshops, interviews and field observations, the study identifies the four key stages of the aquaculture value chain most affected by climate change: feed production, fish production, transportation and distribution, and post-harvest processing. It also maps relevant stakeholders and outlines specific adaptation pathways such as ecosystem-based approaches, policy reforms, and technical innovations that can be co-produced to enhance resilience at each stage. The framework emphasises the importance of multi-stakeholder collaboration and highlights the need for inclusive approaches that address gender and socio-economic inequalities within the sector. Findings suggest that, despite existing institutional and infrastructural challenges, there is a strong appetite among stakeholders in Kenya for collective action. While the proposed framework offers a practical tool for guiding resilience-building, efforts should be made to test the framework across different contexts.
papers.summary_cn: 基于肯尼亚案例，通过研讨会、访谈和实地观察识别出受气候变化影响最大的水产养殖价值链四个环节：饲料生产、鱼类养殖、运输分销和采后加工。框架梳理了相关利益方，并提出生态系统方法、政策改革与技术创新等可在各环节共同制定的适应路径，强调多利益相关方协作及纳入性别与社会经济不平等因素的包容性方法。尽管存在制度和基础设施障碍，肯尼亚利益相关方展现出较强的集体行动意愿；该框架可作为韧性建设的实用工具，但需在不同情境下进一步检验。

papers.title: Sustainable Aquaculture and Livelihood Improvement through Integrated Fish-Pig Farming in Kolli Hills, Tamil Nadu, India
papers.authors: Paulpandi, S.; Sathya, S.; Velmurugan, K.; Kannan, V.
papers.journal: Journal of Scientific Research and Reports
papers.abstract: Integrated fish-livestock farming offers a means of recycling livestock waste within pond-based aquaculture, potentially reducing dependence on purchased inputs. This study evaluated fish production, water quality and economic outcomes under four farming systems in Kolli Hills, Namakkal district, Tamil Nadu. Frontline demonstrations conducted during 2023-2024 compared fish culture integrated with poultry (T1), ducks (T2) and pigs (T3) with conventional fish farming (T4). Demonstration ponds measured approximately 0.25-0.30 ha, and fingerlings were stocked at 8,500 per hectare. Pond-water characteristics were assessed biweekly, while final fish weight, survival and total production were evaluated across six cultured species. Water temperature ranged from 22.6 to 33 °C, pH from 6.5 to 8.5 and dissolved oxygen from 3.83 to 8.7 mg/L across treatments. The fish-pig system recorded the highest overall reported fish survival (71.37%) and production (4,417.67 kg), compared with 61.50% and 2,205.05 kg under conventional farming. The corresponding production figures for fish-poultry and fish-duck systems were 3,100 kg and 2,964.95 kg, respectively. For a 0.3-ha pond, the reported net returns were ₹108,597 for fish-pig integration, ₹68,691 for fish-poultry integration and ₹22,685 for conventional culture. Under the demonstration conditions, fish-pig integration was associated with higher production and economic returns. Careful manure loading and pond-water quality management remain important considerations for implementation.
papers.summary_cn: 在印度泰米尔纳德邦Kolli Hills开展2023–2024年前线示范，比较鱼–家禽（T1）、鱼–鸭（T2）、鱼–猪（T3）综合养殖与常规养鱼（T4）的水质、鱼类生产及经济效果，示范塘约0.25–0.30 ha、放养密度8,500尾/ha，养殖6种鱼。鱼–猪系统报告的最高成活率（71.37%）和产量（4,417.67 kg）均高于常规养殖（61.50%、2,205.05 kg），鱼–家禽和鱼–鸭产量分别为3,100 kg和2,964.95 kg。0.3 ha塘的净收益以鱼–猪综合养殖最高（₹108,597），鱼–家禽为₹68,691，常规养殖仅₹22,685。示范条件下鱼–猪综合养殖伴随更高产量和经济回报，但粪肥加载量与池塘水质管理仍是实施关键。

papers.title: A spatial thermal suitability assessment for offshore aquaculture of striped bass (Morone saxatilis) in the U.S
papers.authors: Couture, Jessica L.; Wieczorek, Daniel; Riley, Kenneth L.; Morris, James A.
papers.abstract: Offshore aquaculture is widely recognized as the next frontier for animal production. Several candidate species for offshore aquaculture development have been identified for the United States (U.S.), with striped bass ( Morone saxatilis ) emerging as one of the leading contenders. Marine spatial planning methods use robust tools to identify suitable space for emerging industries but often focus on minimizing risks and conflicts rather than identifying the most suitable locations for production. Here we present a framework for assessing the spatial biophysical potential of offshore aquaculture by establishing species-specific biophysical requirements and developing metrics to identify optimal areas for striped bass. We conducted a systematic review of the literature to define the biophysical limitations of striped bass and applied these restrictions to modeled data to spatially assess the potential for ocean-based striped bass aquaculture within the U.S. Exclusive Economic Zone. While some areas on the West Coast experience several days at suitable temperatures, they generally do not reach the optimal thermal range required for striped bass aquaculture. In contrast, three subregions along the Atlantic and Gulf coasts were identified as having the highest potential for offshore striped bass aquaculture: North Carolina, the Florida Atlantic coast, and the Northern Gulf. As ocean temperatures rise, these select regions will largely stay within suitable ranges but experience less time within optimal temperatures by mid-century.
papers.summary_cn: 通过系统综述界定条纹鲈（Morone saxatilis）的生物物理限制条件，并将其叠加至模型化环境数据，评估美国专属经济区内海上养殖的空间生物物理潜力。西海岸部分海域虽有适宜温度天数，但总体未达最优温度范围；大西洋与墨西哥湾沿岸的北卡罗来纳、佛罗里达大西洋沿岸和墨西哥湾北部三个亚区潜力最高。至本世纪中叶，这些区域随海水升温仍多处于适宜范围，但处于最优温度的时间将减少。

papers.title: Community acceptance of aquaculture introduction varies across food, economic, and ecological goals
papers.authors: Wade, Eric; Skinner, Maximillian
papers.journal: Journal of the World Aquaculture Society
papers.abstract: Abstract Aquaculture has been identified as a viable approach to address the socio-ecological challenges facing wild-capture fisheries. However, its success is not merely a technocratic matter of deploying new technology; it depends on communities' acceptance and active participation. This is especially important for communities deeply connected to wild-capture fisheries, where aquaculture may be perceived as disrupting their identity and well-being. Framing plays an important role in community acceptance, as the ways in which aquaculture's benefits are presented can shape levels of public support. We examined community acceptance of aquaculture by comparing framings around food security, environmental benefits, and economic development and by identifying the factors that shape support within each. Using a structured questionnaire administered to 948 North Carolina residents, we found that community acceptance differed significantly depending on how the benefits of aquaculture were framed. Support for aquaculture was highest when framed in terms of economic benefits and lowest when framed in terms of ecological benefits. The predictors of acceptance varied across framings. However, the perceived need for aquaculture was the only factor that consistently influenced support across all outcomes. These findings highlight that aquaculture's legitimacy and acceptance depend on the alignment between emphasized benefits and residents' individual values, climate attitudes, and perceived local priorities. More broadly, they suggest that communication strategies for aquaculture development may be more effective when tailored to the values and concerns most salient to the intended audience and that governance processes attentive to community expectations may help build broader support.
papers.summary_cn: 以948名北卡罗来纳州居民的结构化问卷为基础，比较了水产养殖在粮食安全、环境效益和经济发展三种框架下的社区接受度。接受度随框架显著变化：以经济效益呈现时支持度最高，以生态效益呈现时最低，且各框架下的接受度预测因子不同。感知的水产养殖必要性是唯一在所有框架下均稳定影响支持度的因素，表明水产养殖的合法性与接受度取决于所强调效益与居民价值观、气候态度及本地优先事项的匹配程度。

papers.title: Distance- and Direction-Dependent Effects of Macroalgae on Early Epilithic Bacterial Assemblages and Coral Settlement Processes
papers.authors: Pozas-Schacre, Chloé; Bischoff, Hugo; Clerissi, Camille; Nugues, Maggy M.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT While the expansion of macroalgae on coral reefs is a global concern, the spatial scales and mechanisms through which macroalgae inhibit coral recruitment processes and the role of epilithic bacteria in coral settlement remain inadequately understood. Using tiles preconditioned at three distances of two algal species in both up and down-current directions, we show that macroalgae shape early epilithic bacterial assemblages, with strong effects 1 cm downstream of both algae. When exposing the tiles to larvae of two coral species in ex situ settlement experiments, the coral Acropora pulchra showed reduced larval settlement on cryptic surfaces of tiles conditioned 1 cm up and downstream of the alga Dictyota bartayresiana , whereas the coral Pocillopora acuta showed the opposite pattern. Specific bacterial taxa within the families Bdellovibrionaceae, Pirellulaceae, Flavobacteriaceae and Rhodobacteraceae were associated with P. acuta settlement with differences across algal species. When tiles with coral spat were returned to their initial positions on the reef, spat survival was consistently reduced closer to, and particularly 1 cm downstream of, D. bartayresiana . These results demonstrate that macroalgae influence coral settlement and post-settlement survival at centimetre scales through distance- and flow-dependent effects and indicate that these effects may be mediated by epilithic bacterial assemblages.
papers.summary_cn: 以两种大型海藻（含 Dictyota bartayresiana）上、下游不同距离（1 cm 等三个距离）预处理的瓷砖，考察大型海藻对早期石面附着细菌群落及珊瑚幼体附着的影响。宏藻塑造了早期石面细菌群落，且在两藻下游 1 cm 处效应最强；离体附着实验中，Acropora pulchra 在 D. bartayresiana 上、下游 1 cm 处理瓷砖的隐蔽面附着率降低，而 Pocillopora acuta 呈相反格局，Bdellovibrionaceae、Pirellulaceae、Flavobacteriaceae 和 Rhodobacteraceae 中特定细菌类群与 P. acuta 附着相关且随藻种而异。将带珊瑚稚体的瓷砖放回礁区原位后，靠近 D. bartayresiana（尤其下游 1 cm）稚体存活率持续降低，表明大型海藻通过距离与流向依赖的厘米级效应影响珊瑚附着及附着后存活，且可能由石面细菌群落介导。

papers.title: Sedimentation regimes determine variations in the structure of macroalgal assemblages on coral reefs in the Eastern Tropical Pacific Ocean: a case study
papers.authors: López, Norma; Candelaria, Carlos
papers.abstract: Introduction Coastal urbanization and land-use changes have increased terrigenous sediment inputs into tropical marine ecosystems, altering benthic habitat structure. While broad functional-group models are commonly applied to assess sedimentation impacts on coral reefs, species-level responses remain poorly understood. To evaluate the influence of local sedimentation regimes on macroalgal community structure, species composition and sediment deposition rates were monitored across five sampling periods in 2014 at two fringing reefs with contrasting environmental exposures (Caleta de Chon and Zacatoso) in the Mexican Tropical Pacific. Methods Sedimentation rates were partitioned into fine and coarse fractions, and macroalgal diversity and assemblage composition were evaluated using taxonomic identification to the species level. Results Macroalgal species diversity ( H’ ) exhibited significant spatial contrasts during May ( t = 3.55, df = 10.87, p = 0.0046) and November ( t = 3.34, df = 25.85, p = 0.0025), with Caleta de Chon consistently supporting higher diversity and species richness than Zacatoso. Multivariate community composition differed significantly between reefs (one-way PERMANOVA, F = 2.495, p = 0.0074), but showed no significant temporal variation ( F = 0.9148, p = 0.6571). Two-way PERMANOVA revealed a strong main temporal effect on deposition rates (F4,59 = 18.35, p = 0.0001) and a significant site-by-time interaction ( F 4,59 = 2.69, p = 0.0252), despite no main effect of reef location ( F 1,59 = 1.87, p = 0.1673). Both reefs experienced a synchronous total sedimentation peak in May (0.031 g m -2 d -1 at Caleta de Chon vs. 0.034 g m -2 d -1 at Zacatoso); however, deposition at Caleta de Chon was dominated by fine silts (0.022 g m -2 d -1 ), whereas Zacatoso was driven by a coarse sediment pulse (0.0209 g m -2 d -1 ). Discussion These findings demonstrate that local geomorphology and hydrodynamic energy filter sediment grain-size fractions, shaping distinct macroalgal assemblage structures at local spatial scales despite shared regional weather drivers. Evaluating species-level composition alongside sediment grain-size fractions provides high diagnostic resolution to disentangle coastal watershed runoff from wave-driven bedload transport, establishing a critical baseline to anticipate benthic community shifts under accelerating coastal development
papers.summary_cn: 在墨西哥热带太平洋两个环境暴露条件不同的岸礁（Caleta de Chon 与 Zacatoso），2014年五个采样期同步监测了沉积速率（分细粒与粗粒组分）及大型海藻群落，并鉴定至种级。Caleta de Chon 的物种多样性与丰富度持续高于 Zacatoso，群落组成在两礁间差异显著（PERMANOVA，p=0.0074）但无显著时间变化；沉积速率则呈显著时间主效应及站点×时间交互，两礁5月同步出现沉积峰值，但前者以细粉砂为主（0.022 g m⁻² d⁻¹），后者由粗粒沉积脉冲驱动（0.0209 g m⁻² d⁻¹）。局地地貌与水动力能量通过筛选沉积物粒径组分，在局地尺度塑造了不同的大型海藻群落结构，种级组成结合粒径组分可区分流域径流与波浪驱动的底载输运，为预测沿岸开发下的底栖群落变化提供基线。

papers.title: In Vitro Synergism and Preliminary In Vivo Efficacy of Florfenicol Combined with Oxytetracycline against Streptococcus agalactiae Infection in Nile Tilapia ( Oreochromis niloticus )
papers.authors: Wu, Chi-Ming; Rairat, Tirawat; Chuchird, Niti; Keetanon, Arunothai; Uchuwittayakul, Anurak; Chou, Chi-Chung
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Streptococcus agalactiae is one of the most serious diseases in Nile tilapia aquaculture. The objective of this study was to evaluate the potential combinational therapy of florfenicol (FF) and oxytetracycline (OTC) against S. agalactiae strains. Checkerboard microdilution assays of FF + OTC showed that among 10 S. agalactiae isolates, 9 were synergistic and 1 was additive. In the efficacy test, Nile tilapia juveniles were divided into 6 groups (in triplicate): control, FF 10 mg/kg/day, FF 20 mg/kg/day, OTC 50 mg/kg/day, OTC 100 mg/kg/day and a combination of FF 10 + OTC 50 mg/kg/day. Each fish was injected intraperitoneally with a resistant isolate of S. agalactiae at 10 8 CFU and treated with antibiotics via medicated feeds twice daily for 7 days. The survival rate of the FF + OTC combination was 100%, significantly higher than the control (23.33%), low-dose OTC (43.33%) and FF groups (53.33%). The total bacterial counts in the liver of FF + OTC-treated fish were significantly lower than those of the control group (1.05 and 5.15 × 107 CFU/ g , respectively). This preliminary study demonstrates that the FF + OTC combination was effective against S. agalactiae infections.
papers.summary_cn: 棋盘微量稀释法显示，10株无乳链球菌（Streptococcus agalactiae）中9株对氟苯尼考（FF）与土霉素（OTC）联用呈协同、1株呈相加作用。尼罗罗非鱼幼鱼腹腔注射耐药菌株（10⁸ CFU）后经药饵给药7天，FF 10 + OTC 50 mg/kg/day联合组存活率达100%，显著高于对照组（23.33%）、低剂量OTC组（43.33%）及FF组（53.33%），且肝脏总菌数显著低于对照组（1.05 vs 5.15×10⁷ CFU/g）。结果初步表明FF+OTC联用对无乳链球菌感染有效。

papers.title: Effects of Dietary Eucommia ulmoides Extract on Growth, Serum Antioxidant Capacity, and Gut Microbiota of Large Yellow Croaker (Larimichthys crocea) Fed Oxidized Soybean Oil
papers.authors: Xie, Jianjun; Yang, Xinyu; Xu, Yexiang; Wang, Gengshen; Jiang, Min; Wang, Wei; Xu, Wenjun
papers.abstract: Costly fish oil remains the main constraint on large yellow croaker (Larimichthys crocea) farming, and what dietary oil oxidation implies for the fish is still poorly defined. In a 2 × 2 factorial trial, adult fish (184.66 ± 10.72 g) received normal or oxidized soybean oil (4%) with or without 0.2% Tu-chung (Eucommia ulmoides) extract for 30 days (groups S, OS, Esu and EsuOS; three cages per group). Growth, serum and hepatic indices, together with the gut microbiota, were determined on days 10 and 30. papers.summary_cn: 以2×2析因试验（正常/氧化豆油4% × 添加/不添加0.2%杜仲提取物，30 d）评估氧化豆油及杜仲提取物对大规格大黄鱼（184.66±10.72 g）生长、血清与肝脏指标及肠道菌群的影响。氧化豆油显著降低增重率（S组48.01±7.86% vs OS组25.81±1.15%）。

papers.title: Genomic Organization and Transcriptional Regulation of Piscidin Paralogues in the Orange-Spotted Grouper (Epinephelus coioides)
papers.authors: Huang, Xia-Zi; Li, Zi-Ran; Chen, Lei; Zhang, Kai; Chen, Jian-Chao; Duan, Bin-Wei; Jiang, Shou-Jia; Shi, Qiong; Deng, Li
papers.abstract: Piscidins are fish-exclusive antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) with broad-spectrum and immunomodulatory activity. Piscidin paralogues with divergent expression are widespread in fish, but how their transcription is regulated remains unknown. The four orange-spotted grouper (Epinephelus coioides, EC) paralogues were characterized at genomic and transcriptional levels. Mapping their cDNAs onto the published genome assembly yielded over 30-kb sequences covering the genes and their flanking regions. Interestingly, these piscidin genes form a tandem array in a syntenic cluster on chromosome 12 (ecPis3-ecPis1-ecPis2-ecPis4). This arrangement is conserved among five groupers examined by micro-collinearity. Predicted transcription factor (TF) binding repertoires differed among the promoters, and KEGG enrichment results were interpreted with a focus on immune system and signal transduction pathways. Dual-luciferase assays indicated paralogue-specific control: MAFA and MAFBb activated ecPis1 and ecPis2 promoters, whereas MAFF and MAFK reduced their activity; ESR1 activated ecPis4 promoter and ZBTB26-like reduced that of ecPis3. In EC head-kidney leukocytes (HKLs), the four piscidin genes responded differentially to lipopolysaccharide (LPS) and poly(I:C), varying with stimulus, dose and time. These results together suggest that the EC piscidin paralogues, despite a conserved locus, are under distinct transcriptional control that may underlie their divergent antibacterial and antiviral roles.
papers.summary_cn: 橙点石斑鱼（Epinephelus coioides）4个piscidin旁系同源基因成串排列于12号染色体同一共线性簇（ecPis3-ecPis1-ecPis2-ecPis4），该排列在5种石斑鱼中保守。各基因启动子预测的转录因子结合谱存在差异，双荧光素酶实验显示MAFA/MAFBb激活ecPis1和ecPis2启动子而MAFF/MAFK抑制之，ESR1激活ecPis4、ZBTB26-like抑制ecPis3。头肾白细胞中4个基因对LPS和poly(I:C)的响应随刺激种类、剂量和时间而异，提示保守基因座下各旁系同源基因受不同转录调控，可能与其抗菌和抗病毒功能分化相关。

papers.title: Structural and Phylogenetic Analysis of the Complete Mitochondrial Genome of Acrossocheilus longipinnis (Wu, 1939)
papers.authors: Zhang, Jiajun; Shao, Liming; Xiong, Fangyuan; Yan, Pan; Wang, Li; Dong, Shenhui; Mo, Xiaoyang; Shen, Zhongyuan
papers.abstract: Acrossocheilus longipinnis (Wu, 1939) is a species endemic to China and distributed in the Pearl River basin. Although its taxonomic placement and conservation-genetic background have long attracted attention, its mitochondrial genome structure and phylogenetic position within the genus have not yet been subjected to a dedicated whole-genome-level examination. In this study, we sequenced the complete mitochondrial genome of A. longipinnis collected from the Hongshui River basin in Guiping, Guangxi, and analyzed its gene content, nucleotide composition, codon usage, tRNA secondary structures, selective pressure on the 13 protein-coding genes (PCGs), and phylogenetic relationships within Acrossocheilus. The genome is 16,597 bp in length and contains 37 genes and one control region, with an A + T content of 55.95%, showing a pronounced AT bias. The 13 PCGs span 11,410 bp in total; COX1 starts with GTG, whereas the remaining 12 PCGs start with ATG, and some genes end with the incomplete stop codons T- or TA-. A total of 3619 codons were identified, with leucine codons being the most abundant and CUA having the highest usage frequency. Of the 22 tRNAs, all except trnS1, which lacks the DHU arm, fold into the canonical cloverleaf structure. The Ka/Ks values of the 13 PCGs ranged from 0.02 to 0.19 and were all lower than 1, indicating that these genes have experienced strong purifying selection during evolution; ND6 had the highest Ka/Ks value and COX1 the lowest. Phylogenetic trees were reconstructed using both the concatenated 13 protein-coding genes (PCGs) and the whole mitochondrial genome to test topological stability. The 13 PCGs tree recovered the sampled Acrossocheilus species as a strongly supported mitochondrial clade, with A. longipinnis first clustering with the previously published GenBank sequence MK296412 and subsequently forming a sister group with A. wuyiensis. While the whole-mitochondrial-genome tree exhibited topological conflicts likely due to alignment ambiguities in the non-coding regions, the strictly aligned 13 PCGs provided a more robust matrilineal signal.
papers.summary_cn: 对珠江流域特有鱼类长鳍光唇鱼（Acrossocheilus longipinnis）的线粒体全基因组进行了测定与结构、系统发育分析：基因组全长16,597 bp，含37个基因和1个控制区，A+T含量55.95%，呈明显AT偏好；13个PCGs中COX1以GTG起始、其余以ATG起始，部分基因以不完整终止密码子T–或TA–结束，共编码3619个密码子，亮氨酸密码子最多、CUA使用频率最高；22个tRNA中除trnS1缺失DHU臂外均呈典型三叶草结构。13个PCGs的Ka/Ks为0.02–0.19，均远小于1，显示受强纯化选择，其中ND6最高、COX1最低。基于13个PCGs串联序列与全线粒体基因组的系统发育树中，13个PCGs树支持采样光唇鱼属物种构成高支持率线粒体支系，长鳍光唇鱼先与GenBank序列MK296412聚在一起，再与武夷光唇鱼（A. wuyiensis）构成姐妹群；全线粒体基因组树因非编码区比对模糊出现拓扑冲突，而严格比对的13个PCGs提供了更可靠的母系信号。

papers.title: Pathogenic Characteristics and Host Immune Responses of Two Virulence-Differentiated Aeromonas veronii Strains Isolated from Diseased Large-Scale Loach (Paramisgurnus dabryanus)
papers.authors: Feng, Yongyong; Ma, Song; Zhu, Ying; Ding, Yueying; Wang, Nuo; Wang, Wenhui; Gao, Fengtao
papers.abstract: Aeromonas veronii is a prevalent opportunistic pathogen that causes severe disease and economic losses in freshwater aquaculture. In this study, two A. veronii strains, designated Ly-Av-1 and Ly-Av-2, were isolated from diseased large-scale loach (Paramisgurnus dabryanus) exhibiting different clinical symptoms. Hemolytic activity on blood agar, virulence gene profiles and antimicrobial susceptibility of the isolates were determined. Following artificial infection of loaches, serum activities of AKP, ACP, ALT, AST, SOD, CAT, GSH-Px and MDA content were measured. Meanwhile, the expression of oxidative stress-related genes and immune-related genes in the liver, spleen, kidney and skin was also evaluated. The results showed that infection with both A. veronii strains induced hepatic injury and upregulated the expression of immune genes in the spleen. Strain Ly-Av-1 exhibited hemolytic activity in vitro and caused skin swelling, ulceration and marginal hemorrhage in infected P. dabryanus. Compared with Ly-Av-2, Ly-Av-1 had a lower LD50 and harbored virulence genes hlyA, alt and lip. Oxidative stress injury and elevated expression of inflammatory factors were detected in loaches infected with Ly-Av-1. In contrast, Ly-Av-2, in which the hlyA gene was not detected, induced skin swelling and ulceration without skin hemorrhage. These results indicate that skin hemorrhage induced by A. veronii is correlated with the presence of the hlyA gene. Both isolates exhibited multidrug resistance. Extensive use of enrofloxacin has reduced the susceptibility of A. veronii to fluoroquinolones, whereas antibiotics such as tetracycline and doxycycline still show good inhibitory effects. These results indicate that differences in virulence-gene repertoires drive divergent host oxidative stress and immune outcomes during A. veronii infection. This work provides foundational data for understanding the pathogenesis of A. veronii, supporting disease prevention and the rational use of antibiotics in loach farming.
papers.summary_cn: 从患病大鳞副泥鳅（Paramisgurnus dabryanus）分离出两株症状不同的维氏气单胞菌（Aeromonas veronii）Ly-Av-1与Ly-Av-2，比较其溶血活性、毒力基因谱和耐药性，并经人工感染测定泥鳅血清AKP、ACP、ALT、AST、SOD、CAT、GSH-Px活性及MDA含量，同时评估肝、脾、肾、皮肤中氧化应激与免疫相关基因表达。两株均引起肝损伤并上调脾免疫基因，但携带hlyA、alt、lip的Ly-Av-1具体外溶血性、LD50更低，感染后出现皮肤肿胀、溃疡及边缘出血，并伴氧化应激损伤和炎症因子表达升高；未检出hlyA的Ly-Av-2仅致皮肤肿胀溃疡而无出血，提示皮肤出血与hlyA基因相关。两株均为多重耐药，恩诺沙星广泛使用降低了其对氟喹诺酮类的敏感性，四环素和多西环素仍有良好抑制作用；毒力基因谱差异驱动了宿主氧化应激与免疫应答的分化。

papers.title: Integrated Multi-Omics Characterizes Epithelial Barrier Remodeling and Inflammatory Signaling Associated with Adipose Eyelid Opacification in Chub Mackerel (Scomber japonicus), with Exploratory Microbial Community Profiling
papers.authors: Dong, Hongming; Yuan, Shipeng; Wang, Huan; An, Changting; Li, Ang; Che, Shuai; Zhang, Hesen; Liu, Shufang
papers.abstract: Artificial propagation of chub mackerel (Scomber japonicus) has recently been achieved in China, making ocular health an emerging concern for farmed stocks. Adipose eyelid opacification, distinct from the ophthalmia reported in Japan, remains poorly characterized, and its structural and molecular basis and potential link to mortality are unresolved. In a farm survey of 300 early-life live fish, 21 (7%) exhibited this phenotype; technicians reported that affected fish appeared more likely to die, although survival and growth were not systematically quantified. We compared transparent (HG) and opacified (WG) eyelids using histology, optical measurements, transcriptomics, proteomics, and RT-qPCR, with three biological replicates per group. Opacified tissues showed structural disorganization, higher relative opacity signals (600 nm: 30.79 ± 9.05 in HG vs. 84.20 ± 4.94 in WG, mean ± SD), and pigment-like aggregates. Proteomics revealed decreased abundance of keratins (e.g., KRT8, KRT15) and ECM-associated proteins (e.g., COL12A1A, EMILIN1A), but increased abundance of the cell-adhesion protein CDH2 and stress-response chaperones (e.g., HSPD1, HSP90AB1) in WG. Transcriptomic data, treated as exploratory due to technical constraints, suggested alterations in structural and inflammatory pathways (e.g., lum, l1cam, arpc1a/b), which were partially supported by RT-qPCR. Exploratory bacterial profiling described genus-level differences involving Vibrio and Photobacterium without establishing infection. These findings provide candidate molecular targets and baseline information for further investigation of adipose eyelid opacification in cultured chub mackerel.
papers.summary_cn: 对300尾早期成活鱼场调发现，7%（21尾）出现脂眼睑混浊，技术人员反映患病鱼更易死亡，但未系统量化。组织学、光学、蛋白质组和转录组比较显示，混浊眼睑结构紊乱、相对混浊信号升高（600 nm处HG 30.79±9.05 vs WG 84.20±4.94），角蛋白（KRT8、KRT15）及ECM相关蛋白（COL12A1A、EMILIN1A）丰度下降，而CDH2及应激 chaperone（HSPD1、HSP90AB1）丰度上升；转录组（因技术限制仅作探索性分析）提示结构与炎症通路改变，RT-qPCR部分支持。探索性菌群分析发现弧菌属与发光杆菌属的属水平差异，但未确立感染关系。

papers.title: Morphological, Intestinal Physiological, and Gut Microbial Characteristics of Chinese Spiny Frogs Under Two Commercial Feeding Regimes: A Farm-Based Observational Survey
papers.authors: Zhao, Ji; Jiang, Pengxin; Zeng, Gaoxiong; Liao, Mengxiang; Li, Wensheng; Lin, Shengjie; Huang, Zhen; Wu, Bin; Lai, Mingyong; Xue, Lingzhan
papers.abstract: Quasipaa spinosa, the Chinese spiny frog, is a commercially important amphibian for which captive production commonly relies on live mealworms (Tenebrio molitor), while some farms have adopted formulated feeds. We conducted a farm-based observational survey comparing two existing adult populations at a commercial farm, one maintained on live mealworms (JA) and the other on formulated feed (JB). Thirty frogs per population were assessed for body weight and linear morphological traits, and six frogs per population were further examined for intestinal morphology, digestive enzyme and antioxidant indices, and 16S rRNA-based gut microbiota. Frogs from JB were larger at sampling, and intestinal length was greater, whereas eight intestinal histomorphological indices were broadly comparable. Trypsin, α-amylase, lipase, CAT, SOD, MDA, and T-AOC did not differ detectably, while GSH-Px activity was higher in JB. Gut microbial alpha diversity showed no detectable differences, whereas exploratory Bray-Curtis-based analyses suggested metric-dependent differences in microbial community composition. JA samples showed a higher relative representation of several lactic acid bacteria-related genera, whereas JB samples exhibited greater relative abundances of Cetobacterium and Terrisporobacter, genera that have been previously associated with vitamin B12 metabolism and amino-acid fermentation, respectively. Overall, these observations document an established commercial population maintained on formulated feed and identify morphological, physiological, and microbial patterns that warrant further evaluation in replicated studies.
papers.summary_cn: 在商业养殖场对分别投喂活黄粉虫（JA）和配合饲料（JB）的两组成年棘胸蛙（Quasipaa spinosa）进行观察性比较：每组测30只的体重与形态线性指标，另取6只检测肠道形态、消化酶与抗氧化指标及基于16S rRNA的肠道菌群。JB组采样时体型更大、肠长更长，但8项肠道组织形态指标总体相当；胰蛋白酶、α-淀粉酶、脂肪酶、CAT、SOD、MDA和T-AOC均未见明显差异，仅GSH-Px活性JB组更高。肠道菌群α多样性无可检出差异，基于Bray–Curtis的探索性分析提示群落组成差异依所用指标而异；JA组若干乳酸菌相关属相对丰度较高，JB组Cetobacterium与Terrisporobacter相对丰度更高，前者曾与维生素B12代谢、后者与氨基酸发酵相关联。

papers.title: Elemental signatures in otoliths of Sparus aurata support robust differentiation of nursery habitats
papers.authors: Matić-Skoko, Sanja; Bašić, Sanja; Vrdoljak, Dario; Madunić, Lea; Uvanović, Hana; Pavičić, Mišo; Mertz-Kraus, Regina
papers.abstract: Introduction The study was conducted along the eastern Adriatic coast to assess whether otolith elemental signatures can differentiate nursery types of gilthead seabream ( Sparus aurata ) and support inference of age-class-3 fish nursery origin. Methods A total of 143 specimens were collected from 11 sites, including 76 juveniles sampled between May and June 2021 and 67 age-class-3 fish sampled between December 2023 and April 2024. Adult specimens were selected from a larger dataset assembled for ongoing studies of Sparus aurata . Age had been estimated by reading annual growth increments in the otoliths, and only specimens assigned to age class 3 were included in the present study. Otolith-based age estimates were therefore used as a specimen-selection criterion. Laser ablation inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry (LA-ICP-MS) measurements of the otolith region corresponding to the juvenile nursery stage were used to derive the Q10 and Q90 concentration descriptors for Sr, Na, and Mg.K-means clustering identified two chemically distinct clusters, with the optimal number of clusters determined by a silhouette analysis. Cluster stability was determined using a combination of bootstrap resampling and Jaccard similarity index. Results Principal component analysis showed separation between clusters, primarily along PC1, which was mainly associated with Sr Q10, Sr Q90 and Na Q10. Cluster assignments corresponded closely with nursery type classifications: Nursery Type N 1 was predominantly associated with Cluster 1, whereas Nursery Type N 2 showed greater site-specific variability and mixed cluster composition. 92.86% of N1 individuals were assigned to Cluster 1, compared with 47.06% of N2 individuals assigned to Cluster 2. All three PC1-associated parameters differ significantly between clusters and nursery types. Sr-related variables were higher in Cluster 2 and N 2 , whereas mean Na and Na Q10 were higher in Cluster 1 and N 1 , indicating distinct otolith chemical profiles among groups. Distributional descriptors, particularly Q10 and Q90, provided stronger discrimination than mean values alone. When age-class-3 fish specimens were included, the two-cluster structure was largely retained, although some boundary individuals showed classification uncertainty. Based on the juvenile otolith region in age-class-3 fish otoliths, A 1 age-class-3 fish were mainly associated with Cluster 1 (66.67%), which resembled N 1 , whereas A 2 sub-adults more often belonged to Cluster 2 (64.86%), which suggest differing nursery contributions to the age-class-3 fish sampling areas, alongside substantial overlap in otolith chemical profiles. Discussion These results indicate that otolith elemental signatures retain ecologically meaningful information and may support inference of nursery origin, with potential application in targeted conservation and management of S. aurata stocks.
papers.summary_cn: 对亚得里亚海东岸11个站点的143尾金头鲷（Sparus aurata，含2021年5–6月采集的76尾幼鱼和2023年12月–2024年4月采集的67尾3龄鱼）进行耳石LA-ICP-MS分析，基于幼鱼育幼期耳石区域的Sr、Na、Mg浓度及其Q10、Q90分布描述符，用K-means聚类（轮廓分析定簇数，bootstrap重采样结合Jaccard相似度评估稳定性）识别出两个化学特征显著不同的簇。聚类结果与育幼场类型高度对应：N1型个体92.86%归入簇1，N2型仅47.06%归入簇2且站点间变异较大；簇2及N2型的Sr相关变量较高，簇1及N1型的Na均值与Na Q10较高，Q10、Q90等分布描述符的判别力优于均值。将3龄鱼纳入分析后两簇结构基本保留，A1亚组成体主要归入簇1（66.67%，类似N1），A2亚组成体多归入簇2（64.86%），提示不同育幼场对3龄鱼采样区的贡献存在差异，但耳石化学特征重叠明显；结果表明耳石元素特征可保留具有生态学意义的育幼场信息并支持育幼来源推断，有望用于该种群的针对性保护与管理。

papers.title: Seagrass as a boundary object linking science, stewardship, and resilience in Sanday, Orkney
papers.authors: Boyle, Joseph S.; Lilley, Richard J.; Agardy, Tundi; Stanković, Anka T.; Brogan, Kieron; Ghaleb, Jake; Lennie, William; Smith, Phillippa; Ljosland, Ragnhild; Jones, Joanna
papers.abstract: Seagrass recovery depends on aligning scientific research, community leadership, governance, and locally relevant priorities. The diverse ecological and social functions of seagrass position it as a useful ‘boundary object’: a shared reference point through which different actors can collaborate without requiring identical understandings. This Community Case Study examines this role through a collaborative programme of seagrass research and stewardship in Sanday, Orkney, UK, developed with Sanday Development Trust. Sanday supports approximately 21 ha of Zostera marina meadows alongside diverse marine habitats and cultural practices, while facing increasing coastal erosion associated with climate change. Since 2022, participatory mapping, ecological research, reciprocal capacity-building, educational co-design, cultural practice, and policy dialogue have connected seagrass stewardship with wider priorities for coastal and island resilience. Local knowledge helped identify previously undocumented seagrass meadows and was translated through ecological research into georeferenced habitat evidence subsequently incorporated into government datasets and regional marine planning. Reciprocal training and field support have expanded monitoring capability, while educational co-design enabled scientific understandings of seagrass to be reinterpreted through pupils’ preferred approaches to learning and incorporated into locally relevant lesson plans. Creative practice translated relatively inaccessible submerged ecology into locally meaningful cultural forms, while collaboration with Sanday Development Trust increasingly connected seagrass research with multi-habitat restoration, coastal erosion, adaptation, and wider island resilience planning. Across these activities, seagrass was understood and valued differently by residents, researchers, educators, community organisations, cultural actors, and planners, while remaining a recognisable shared reference point through which knowledge, meanings, and priorities could be translated and coordinated. Collaboration did not imply consensus or equal authority between actors, but enabled different forms of expertise and institutional responsibility to interact around a common ecological object. This case demonstrates how seagrass can support place-based collaboration across different social worlds, embedding habitat recovery within wider social-ecological systems and community priorities.
papers.summary_cn: 以英国奥克尼Sanday岛约21 ha的Zostera marina草床为对象，通过参与式制图、生态研究、互惠能力建设、教育共建、文化实践与政策对话，将海草管护与岛屿海岸韧性议题相衔接。当地知识帮助识别了此前未记录的海草草床，并经生态研究转化为地理参照的生境证据，纳入政府数据集与区域海洋规划。海草作为“boundary object”使居民、研究者、教育者、社区组织与规划者在不要求共识或平等权威的前提下，围绕同一生态对象协调知识、意义与优先事项，将生境恢复嵌入更广泛的社会-生态系统与社区优先议程。

papers.title: Spatial distribution patterns and driving pathways of the normalized biovolume size spectrum of zooplankton in the coastal waters of the Shandong Peninsula
papers.authors: Huang, Wenjing; Lei, Mingyu; Jiang, Huichao; Fu, Ping; Zhang, Yixuan; He, Jianlong; He, Xin; Zhang, Xiaowen; Qiu, Shaonan; Liu, Caili
papers.abstract: To investigate zooplankton size structure and its environmental drivers, a survey was conducted off the Shandong Peninsula in May 2025 using ZooScan, d-RDA, and structural equation models (SEMs). Normalized biovolume size spectrum (NBVS) parameters and environmental traits exhibited pronounced spatial heterogeneity. The terrestrially influenced Bohai Sea-characterized by higher temperature, shallower depth, lower salinity, and elevated TSS, nutrient, and Chl-a levels-displayed steep NBVS slopes (-2.58 to -0.60) and lower mean equivalent spherical diameter (Mean ESD) and plankton particle size diversity index (PSDI). Conversely, the deeper, higher-salinity Yellow Sea maintained flatter slopes (-1.40 to -0.10) and significantly higher Mean ESD and PSDI ( p < 0.05). d-RDA showed environmental variables explained 21.7% of size-structure variance ( p = 0.001, Adj. R 2 = 0.217), reflecting a gradient from nearshore terrestrial influences to offshore oceanographic conditions. SEMs results further revealed regional differences in the environmental association pathways of the NBVS slope between the Bohai and Yellow Seas. The Bohai Sea operated under a “resource-driven” regime, where Chl-a accumulation acted as the dominant driver steepening NBVS slopes; whereas the Yellow Sea exhibited an “environment-driven” pattern directly constrained by water temperature and depth. These findings demonstrate that NBVS metrics can serve as sensitive indicators for coastal ecological health monitoring.
papers.summary_cn: 基于2025年5月山东半岛近海ZooScan调查，结合d-RDA与结构方程模型解析浮游动物归一化生物体积粒径谱（NBVS）的空间格局及驱动路径。受陆源影响的渤海特征水域（高温、浅水、低盐、高TSS、营养盐和Chl-a）NBVS斜率更陡（-2.58至-0.60），平均等效球径（Mean ESD）和粒径多样性指数（PSDI）较低；深水高盐黄海斜率较平缓（-1.40至-0.10），Mean ESD与PSDI显著更高（p<0.05）。环境变量解释粒径结构变异的21.7%（p=0.001，Adj. R²=0.217），且两海区NBVS斜率的关联路径不同：渤海为Chl-a积累主导的“资源驱动”型，黄海则为水温与深度直接约束的“环境驱动”型。NBVS指标可作为近岸生态健康监测的敏感指示。

papers.title: Bacterial isolates, microbiome structure and host pathology during a mass mortality event in Arca noae from the Ebro Delta (Northwestern Mediterranean Sea, Spain)
papers.authors: López, Jose R.; Cruz-Quintana, Yanis; Reinoso, Samira; Fernández-Tejedor, Margarita; Gisbert, Enric; Furones, Dolors
papers.abstract: Mass mortality events affecting marine bivalves can have important ecological and socioeconomic consequences, yet their underlying causes often remain poorly understood. The Noah’s ark shell ( Arca noae ) is an ecologically and commercially valuable Mediterranean bivalve, and in July 2022, approximately 90% of individuals in natural populations from the Ebro Delta (northwestern Mediterranean Sea) were affected by a severe mortality event. To investigate potential factors contributing to this event, a mortality-affected site was compared with a nearby site where no mortality was observed, integrating environmental, microbiological, histopathological, and experimental evidence. A total of 166 bacterial isolates were recovered, with Acinetobacter johnsonii and Enterobacter sp. exclusively detected in samples from the mortality-affected site. Experimental challenges with one representative isolate of each bacterial taxon showed that both isolates significantly reduced host survival, resulting in cumulative mortalities of 81-85%, compared with 26% in controls, indicating their potential to contribute to host mortality under the experimental conditions tested. Samples from the mortality-affected site showed marked differences in microbiome composition, including reduced alpha diversity and differences in community structure, together with higher relative abundances of Acinetobacter , Enterobacter , and Stenotrophomonas . Histopathological examination revealed more severe lesions in the digestive gland and gills, including hemocytic infiltration, epithelial sloughing, and necrosis. Environmental analyses revealed significant differences in temperature, salinity, dissolved oxygen, and chlorophyll- a between sites, suggesting that environmental conditions may have contributed to host susceptibility. Together, these findings support a multifactorial mortality scenario in which environmental conditions, host alterations, and differences in the microbiome may have interacted to contribute to mortality in A. noae . This integrated evidence highlights the complexity of mortality events in this species and provides a basis for future surveillance and health management of natural populations.
papers.summary_cn: 2022年7月Ebro Delta（西北地中海）天然Arca noae种群约90%个体发生严重死亡事件；比较死亡发生点与邻近无死亡点，整合环境、微生物、组织病理与实验证据。共分离166株细菌，Acinetobacter johnsonii与Enterobacter sp.仅在死亡点样品中检出；两株代表分离株实验攻毒使宿主累积死亡率达81–85%（对照26%）。死亡点样品microbiome alpha多样性降低、群落结构改变，Acinetobacter、Enterobacter与Stenotrophomonas相对丰度升高，消化腺与鳃出现血细胞浸润、上皮脱落及坏死等较重病变；两站点温度、盐度、溶解氧与叶绿素a存在显著差异。结果支持环境条件、宿主病变与microbiome差异交互作用的多因子死亡情景。

papers.title: Temporal association of the diatom Actinocyclus cf. subtilis with the late phase of Ostreopsis blooms in Mediterranean coastal communities
papers.authors: Kryk, Adrian; Mann, David G.; Vila, Magda; Homedes, Sofía I.; Estrada, Marta; Laza-Martínez, Aitor; Berdalet, Elisa; Trobajo, Rosa
papers.abstract: The toxigenic marine dinoflagellate Ostreopsis cf. ovata and accompanying periphytic diatoms were studied over two annual cycles on a reef platform at Llavaneres, Catalonia, Spain. In each year, as the Ostreopsis bloom peaked, a large centric diatom began to appear and became dominant as the Ostreopsis declined. Previous records at Llavaneres and elsewhere along Catalan and Mediterranean coast, and also on the Atlantic coast of the Basque country, similarly document a temporal association between the later phases of Ostreopsis blooms and the abundance of a large centric diatom. The diatom at Llavaneres and at Donostia was identified as Actinocyclus cf. subtilis and examination of historical materials revealed close agreement between the Llavaneres specimens and some of the earliest records of A. subtilis , in brown mucilaginous growths on rocks in the UK. Elsewhere, large centric diatoms associated with Ostreopsis in the benthos have sometimes been identified as the planktonic genus Coscinodiscus , but this may be because the pseudonodulus characteristic of Actinocyclus cannot be detected in living or uncleaned cells. The association between Ostreopsis and Actinocyclus is often physically close, with healthy Actinocyclus growing alongside Ostreopsis in a common mucilaginous matrix. Our findings are significant in (1) demonstrating an in situ shift in dominance from Ostreopsis to Actinocyclus at a number of Mediterranean and NE Atlantic sites, consistent with (2) a possible tolerance of Actinocyclus to any allelochemicals produced by Ostreopsis ; (3) providing clear documentation of A. cf. subtilis , including recognition of living cells, LM and SEM characterization, and an rbcL based phylogeny; and (4) highlighting a temporal association that suggests Actinocyclus could be explored further as a potential indicator of Ostreopsis bloom decline.
papers.summary_cn: 在地中海西班牙Llavaneres礁平台的两年周期观测中，产毒甲藻Ostreopsis cf. ovata暴发达到峰值后，一种大型中心目硅藻开始出现并在Ostreopsis衰退时成为优势种；该硅藻被鉴定为Actinocyclus cf. subtilis，历史标本比对显示其与英国早期记录的A. subtilis高度一致，且在其他地中海及东北大西洋站点也观察到类似的Ostreopsis后期与大型中心目硅藻共现现象。二者常在同一黏液基质中紧密共存，健康Actinocyclus与Ostreopsis并生，提示Actinocyclus可能耐受Ostreopsis产生的化感物质。研究还提供了A. cf. subtilis的活细胞识别、LM与SEM特征及基于rbcL的系统发育信息，并指出该硅藻可作为Ostreopsis暴发衰退的潜在指示种进一步探索。

papers.title: Occurrence patterns of elasmobranch fishes in a semi-regulated urban recreational fishery
papers.authors: Kolakkodan, Maryam Saleel; Ng, Sirius Z. H.; Xu, Kathy Tingting; Choy, Christina P. P.; Jaafar, Zeehan
papers.abstract: Introduction In Southeast Asia, 58.6% of elasmobranch fish species are threatened with extinction. The primary threat driver is their targeted and incidental commercial fishing. In Singapore 84.6% of all native elasmobranch species are threatened with extinction, even though there exist no significant commercial fisheries within her territorial waters. Extensive marine urbanization may have contributed to the vulnerability of these populations, although ecological and distributional data remain limited. Methods Using publicly-available records, we characterize elasmobranch diversity and distribution in data-poor Singapore using 977 verified and georeferenced observations over a 25-year period (2000-2024). Results Our findings show that elasmobranch fishes occurred within key coastal marine habitats, underscoring the urgent need to conserve these areas. Discussion We discuss the potential impacts of urbanization, recreational fishing, and abandoned, lost, or otherwise discarded fishing gear (ALDFG) on these threatened taxa. This study demonstrates how long-term data can establish a baseline understanding of Singapore’s wild elasmobranch species and provides a foundation for future ecological research and conservation planning.
papers.summary_cn: 基于2000–2024年977条经核实并地理定位的公开记录，刻画了数据匮乏的新加坡板鳃类鱼类的多样性与分布格局。结果显示板鳃类出现在关键沿海海洋生境中，凸显了保护这些区域的紧迫性；并讨论了城市化、休闲渔业及废弃、丢失或丢弃渔具（ALDFG）对这些受威胁类群的潜在影响。

papers.title: Challenges in the detection of crayfish in large rivers with droplet digital PCR-based environmental DNA methods: a Danube River case study
papers.authors: Novaković, Andrea; Kračun-Kolarević, Margareta; Ilić, Marija; Andjus, Stefan; Paunović, Momir; Kolarević, Stoimir
papers.abstract: The applicability of species-specific droplet digital PCR (ddPCR) was evaluated for environmental DNA (eDNA) detection of two invasive alien species in the Danube River Basin (DRB): round goby (Neogobius melanostomus) and spiny-cheek crayfish (Faxonius limosus). Available species-specific primers and probes targeting the cytochrome c oxidase subunit I gene were re-assessed in silico and validated in vitro using genomic DNA from specimens caught within the DRB. Analytical sensitivity was assessed by establishing the limit of blank, detection, and quantification, alongside a double-threshold approach for low-level F. limosus detections. Field validation revealed consistently detectable and quantifiable eDNA signals for N. melanostomus, whereas F. limosus was detected only at low levels. Microcosm experiments demonstrated substantially higher eDNA shedding by N. melanostomus and increased F. limosus eDNA signals during molting and increased activity. In addition, higher eDNA signals were observed in DNA extracts obtained from glass microfiber (GF/C) filters compared to Sterivex filters. By integrating field and experimental data, this study highlights the utility and sensitivity of targeted ddPCR-based approach for detecting crayfish eDNA in large rivers, while simultaneously providing a comprehensive evaluation of ecological and species-specific parameters influencing observed eDNA detection patterns of N. melanostomus and F. limosus.
papers.summary_cn: 针对多瑙河流域两种入侵物种（黑口新虾虎鱼 Neogobius melanostomus 与刺颊螯虾 Faxonius limosus），重新评估并验证了靶向 COI 基因的物种特异性 ddPCR 引物探针，建立了空白限、检出限与定量限，并对低浓度 F. limosus 采用双阈值判定。野外验证中 N. melanostomus 的 eDNA 信号可稳定检出并定量，而 F. limosus 仅以低水平检出；微宇宙实验显示 N. melanostomus 的 eDNA 释放量明显更高，F. limosus 在蜕壳和活动增强时 eDNA 信号升高，且 GF/C 滤膜提取的 DNA 中 eDNA 信号高于 Sterivex 滤膜。结果表明靶向 ddPCR 可用于大型河流中螯虾 eDNA 的灵敏检测，并揭示了影响两种物种 eDNA 检出格局的生态与物种特异性因素。

papers.title: Contrasting Landscape Features Support Salmonid Rearing in a Seasonally Warm Watershed
papers.authors: Ortega, Jordan D.; Hahlbeck, Nicholas; Rich, Shahnie; Tinniswood, William; Kaylor, Matthew; Davis, Melanie; Sloat, Matthew; Pess, George; Armstrong, Jonathan
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Juvenile cold-water fishes inhabiting seasonally warm rivers must balance tradeoffs among temperature, food availability and energetic costs, yet the riverscape features supporting production remain poorly understood. We combined spatially extensive surveys with temporally intensive growth and bioenergetics analyses to evaluate how juvenile redband trout ( Oncorhynchus mykiss newberrii ) rear within the seasonally warm Sprague River, Upper Klamath Basin, Oregon, USA. We sampled fish distribution across 130 km of mainstem and off-channel habitats using backpack electrofishing, boat electrofishing and snorkelling, then quantified growth and consumption dynamics within core rearing habitats. Juvenile redband trout were patchily distributed, with 60% of sites containing no trout and the top 10% of sites containing 53% of all individuals sampled. Peaks in abundance were associated with two contrasting landscape features: groundwater habitats and a warm, high-gradient canyon reach lacking detectable groundwater inputs. Off-channel groundwater habitats also supported high juvenile densities and rapid growth. Surprisingly, juvenile trout in the warm high-gradient reach also maintained positive summer growth despite temperatures exceeding 27°C. Bioenergetics modelling suggested fish in this habitat compensated for elevated metabolic costs through substantially higher food consumption. Our findings demonstrate that rare riverscape features can disproportionately support salmonid rearing in seasonally warm rivers. By linking spatial patterns of abundance with temporal patterns of growth and energetics, this study provides insight into how habitat heterogeneity may promote adaptive capacity and resilience of cold-water fishes in warming environments.
papers.summary_cn: 在季节性升温的Sprague River（美国俄勒冈Upper Klamath Basin），通过130 km主干与离岸生境的背包电捕、船电捕和浮潜调查结合生长与生物能量学分析，评估幼体redband trout（Oncorhynchus mykiss newberrii）的育肥格局。幼鱼分布高度斑块化，60%样点无鱼，数量最多的10%样点集中了53%的个体；丰度峰值对应两类对比性景观：地下水生境与无地下水输入的温暖高梯度峡谷段。离岸地下水生境维持高密度与快速生长，而温暖高梯度段幼鱼在超过27°C下仍保持夏季正生长，生物能量学模型提示其通过显著提高摄食量补偿升高的代谢成本。结果表明稀有河景特征可不成比例地支撑季节性温暖河流中的鲑科鱼类育肥，生境异质性有助于提升冷水鱼类的适应能力与韧性。

papers.title: Integrated paternal genome governs sex-specific fertility in synthetic allopolyploid fish
papers.authors: Lu, Meng; Zhang, Qin-Can; Zhu, Zi-Yu; Wang, Yang; Wang, Zhong-Wei; Li, Xi-Yin; Li, Zhi; Hu, Zhen; Yu, Peng; Zhang, Xiao-Juan
papers.abstract: Changes in ploidy and genomic composition shape fertility by altering chromosome behavior during gametogenesis, providing a genetic basis for fertility control in agriculture. Recently, we identified a novel amphitriploid female in the Carassius complex with ameio-fusiongenesis, which produces unreduced eggs via ameiotic oogenesis and generates higher-ploidy offspring through egg-sperm fusion. We crossed this female with males of three distinct cyprinid species-congeneric amphidiploid C. auratus , distant amphidiploid Cyprinus carpio , and even more distant diploid Ancherythroculter nigrocauda -thereby generating two synthetic octaploids (S8n- Ca and S8n- Cc ) and one synthetic heptaploid (S7n- An ). In early ovaries before 100 days post-hatching (dph), oocytes in all three synthetic allopolyploids underwent apoptosis in association with improper synaptonemal complex assembly and incomplete double-strand break (DSB) repair associated with aneuploidy or failed homologous pairing. Interestingly, between 100 and 140 dph, a small proportion of oocytes initiated alternative pathways. Approximately 5.0% of S8n- Ca oocytes produced unreduced eggs via ameiotic or endoreplicated oogenesis pathways, rendering S8n- Ca females fertile. In contrast, only 0.9% (S8n- Cc ) and 0.7% (S7n- An ) of oocytes underwent endoreplication, yet only those in S8n- Cc developed into mature eggs. Consequently, S8n- Cc females were partially fertile, whereas S7n- An females were completely sterile. Notably, incomplete DSB repair did not compromise spermatocyte development; rather, these cells underwent extensive apoptosis from failed segregation at anaphase I, leading to azoospermia in all three synthetic allopolyploid males. This study reveals a mechanistic association between integrated paternal genomes and sex-specific fertility outcomes, providing a theoretical foundation for generating sterile polyploids in aquatic animal breeding.
papers.summary_cn: 以携带无减数分裂卵子发生（ameio-fusiongenesis）的雌性鲫复合体三倍体为母本，分别与同属双二倍体金鱼、远缘双二倍体鲤及更远缘二倍体黑尾近红鲌雄鱼杂交，人工合成两个八倍体（S8n-Ca、S8n-Cc）和一个七倍体（S7n-An）。孵化后100天内，三个合成异源多倍体卵母细胞均因联会复合体组装异常及与异倍体或同源配对失败相关的双链断裂（DSB）修复不完全而发生凋亡；100–140天间少部分卵母细胞启动替代途径，S8n-Ca约5.0%卵母细胞经无减数分裂或核内复制途径产生未减数卵而可育，S8n-Cc（0.9%）仅部分可育，S7n-An（0.7%）完全不育。三个合成多倍体雄性虽DSB修复不完全不影响精母细胞发育，但减数第一次分裂后期分离失败引发广泛凋亡，均表现为无精子症，表明整合的父本基因组与性别特异性育性结局存在机制关联。

papers.title: Bioaccessibility of leached heavy metals from plastic particles in the gastrointestinal tract of fish and its associated health risks: An in vitro assessment
papers.authors: Bwala, Mathias Nzitiri; Gaya, Abalis Ezra; Nayaya, Ahmad Jibrin; Buba, Toma
papers.abstract: Micro-sized and nano-sized plastic particles (MNPs) are ubiquitous in aquatic environments. Fish may mistake them for food or ingest them accidentally during filter feeding. Some MNPs contain heavy metals that, when ingested, can subsequently leach into the digestive tract of the fish, posing health risks to the fish themselves and to animals higher up the food chain, including humans. This study aimed to assess the bioaccessibility of heavy metals leached from MNPs by using an in chemico digestion model. Plastic pellets were crushed and sieved into micro-sized and nano-sized particles. The stomach and intestine of the fish were simulated in vitro to reproduce the digestion process, in order to evaluate leaching capacity, bioaccessibility and the potential human health risk of the heavy metals. The results indicate that heavy metals in the MNPs exhibited varying bioaccessibility (with As in vitro assay could be used to investigate the bioaccessibility of heavy metals and thus avoid the use of fish in in vivo testing.
papers.summary_cn: 采用体外化学消化模型模拟鱼胃与肠道环境，评估微/纳米塑料颗粒（MNPs）中重金属的浸出能力与生物可给性（bioaccessibility）及潜在人体健康风险。结果显示不同重金属的生物可给性存在差异（如As等），该体外方法可替代活体鱼试验用于重金属生物可给性研究。

papers.title: Dietary Iron in Fish: Requirements, Metabolism, and Emerging Role of Nanotechnology in Aquaculture
papers.authors: Naz, Sana; Khan, Mukhtar Ahmad
papers.abstract: Iron is an essential trace element required for numerous physiological and biochemical processes in fish, including oxygen transport, energy metabolism, and antioxidant defence. In aquaculture systems, where natural mineral availability may be insufficient, dietary supplementation of iron plays a critical role in maintaining optimal growth and health. However, both deficiency and excess of iron can adversely affect fish performance, leading to anaemia or oxidative stress, respectively. The bioavailability of iron is influenced by its chemical form, dietary composition, and interactions with other nutrients. Recent advances in aquaculture nutrition have highlighted the potential of nano-scale iron supplementation to enhance iron absorption efficiency and reduce environmental losses. This review provides a comprehensive overview of iron metabolism, dietary requirements, sources, nutrient interactions, deficiency and toxicity effects, and environmental considerations in fish. Furthermore, emerging perspectives on the application of nanotechnology in iron nutrition are discussed, emphasizing the need for precise and sustainable feeding strategies.
papers.summary_cn: 铁是鱼类氧运输、能量代谢和抗氧化防御所必需的微量元素，养殖系统中天然矿物供给常不足，日粮补铁对维持生长与健康至关重要，但缺乏与过量分别导致贫血和氧化应激。铁的生物利用度受化学形态、日粮组成及与其他营养素相互作用影响。纳米尺度铁补充剂可提高吸收效率并减少环境流失，本文综述了鱼类铁代谢、日粮需要量、来源、营养互作、缺乏与毒性效应及环境考量，并讨论了纳米技术在铁营养中的应用前景与精准可持续投喂策略需求。

papers.title: Simultaneous Nutrient Removal and Reduction in Microcystis aeruginosa Abundance in Aquaculture Wastewater During Co-cultivation with Saccharomyces cerevisiae NM2
papers.authors: Nguyen, Anh Thao; Dang, Thi Mai Anh; Nguyen, Minh Thu; Le, Minh Vu; Nguyen, Sy Nguyen; Duong, Thi Thuy; Nguyen, Phuong Nhue
papers.abstract: Intensive aquaculture systems are frequently affected by nutrient accumulation and harmful cyanobacterial blooms, creating a need for biological approaches capable of addressing both issues simultaneously. This study investigated the performance of the halotolerant yeast Saccharomyces cerevisiae NM2 for concurrent nutrient removal and the population response of Microcystis aeruginosa NA during co-cultivation in aquaculture wastewater at a salinity of 1.5%. In monoculture, S. cerevisiae NM2 achieved chemical oxygen demand (COD) removal efficiencies of 87.34-91.35% at initial COD concentrations of 100-750 mg/L within 24 h. Total nitrogen (TN) and total phosphorus (TP) removal efficiencies reached 64.12-71.21% and 96.80-97.68%, respectively, resulting in residual TP concentrations below 0.35 mg/L. In co-culture with M. aeruginosa NA, cyanobacterial abundance decreased by 86.3-97.6% over the 24-h experimental period. COD and TP removal efficiencies under co-culture conditions remained high, ranging from 91.08% to 93.94% and exceeding 97%, respectively, while TN removal efficiencies ranged from 50.41% to 70.40%. The mechanism underlying the decline in M. aeruginosa NA abundance was not resolved by the present experimental design and may involve nutrient-mediated effects, direct inhibitory activity, or other microbial interactions. These findings demonstrate effective nutrient removal by S. cerevisiae NM2 accompanied by a marked decrease in M. aeruginosa NA abundance under the tested co-culture conditions.
papers.summary_cn: 耐盐酵母Saccharomyces cerevisiae NM2在1.5%盐度养殖废水中24 h内对COD去除率达87.34–91.35%（初始COD 100–750 mg/L），TN和TP去除率分别为64.12–71.21%和96.80–97.68%，出水TP低于0.35 mg/L。与铜绿微囊藻NA共培养时，藻丰度下降86.3–97.6%，同时COD去除率保持91.08–93.94%、TP去除率超过97%、TN去除率50.41–70.40%。藻丰度下降机制尚未明确，可能涉及营养竞争、直接抑制或其他微生物相互作用。

papers.title: Antiviral Signaling and Innate Immune Networks in Penaeid Shrimp: WSSV -Centered Evidence and Aquaculture Health Management
papers.authors: Guo, Shengtao; Liu, Hongtao; Yang, Linwei; Zhang, Rusong; Zhang, Kai; Zhang, Xinhui; Bian, Chao; Shi, Qiong
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Viral disease constrains penaeid shrimp aquaculture by destabilizing production, animal welfare and aquatic food-system resilience. White spot syndrome virus (WSSV)-penaeid shrimp models provide the strongest mechanistic evidence for antiviral immunity, but they cannot serve as universal proxies for RNA viruses, decapod iridescent virus 1 (DIV1), crayfish, crabs or freshwater prawns. This review treats crustacean antiviral immunity as an evidence-weighted network rather than a catalog of immune genes, distinguishing study-level evidence for host defense from the separate maturity of proposed aquaculture applications. We integrate Toll/immune deficiency (IMD)-nuclear factor kappa B (NF-κB), stimulator of interferon genes (STING)-interferon regulatory factor (IRF)-Vago-Janus kinase/signal transducer and activator of transcription (JAK/STAT), RNA interference (RNAi), recognition-entry duality, cellular clearance, antimicrobial peptides, and prophenoloxidase (proPO)-linked defense into interacting signaling and innate immune networks. The central conclusion is that pathway biology becomes useful for practical aquaculture when it yields molecular markers and management interventions for validation against diseases and production outcomes rather than simply stronger immune activation.
papers.summary_cn: 以WSSV-对虾模型为主要证据，将Toll/IMD–NF-κB、STING–IRF–Vago–JAK/STAT、RNAi、识别-入侵双重性、细胞清除、抗菌肽及proPO相关防御整合为相互作用的抗病毒信号与先天免疫网络，并按证据权重区分宿主防御机制与水产养殖应用成熟度。指出WSSV模型不能作为RNA病毒、DIV1、螯虾、蟹或淡水虾的通用替代。核心结论是：通路生物学只有产出可针对不同疾病和生产结果验证的分子标记与管理干预，才对实际养殖有用，而非仅追求更强的免疫激活。

papers.title: Macroinvertebrate and Fish Assemblages in Drainage Ditches and Adjacent Rivers of the Syr Darya River Basin (Central Asia: Kazakhstan)
papers.authors: Kobeshova, Zhansaya Bayzhighitovna; Mamilov, Nadir Shamilevich; Koshkimbayev, Karshyga Sarsenbaevich; Khassengazieva, Gulnur Kuanyshkyzy; Amirbekova, Fariza Talgatovna; Ibrayeva, Gulmira Sayfullaevna; Sharakhmetov, Sayat Ermukhanbetovich; Mazhibayeva, Zhanara Omirbekovna; Assylbek, Ayan Makhmutovich
papers.abstract: This study examined the contribution of drainage and collector ditches in the Syr Darya River basin to local and regional aquatic biodiversity by comparing fish and macroinvertebrate assemblages in these anthropogenic habitats with those in adjacent natural river sections. Assemblages were analyzed in relation to eight abiotic environmental variables, with particular attention to blackflies and fish. Ditches differed from adjacent river habitats in several environmental characteristics, most notably lower summer water temperatures and reduced turbidity, and supported distinct aquatic assemblages. Of the 46 animal taxa recorded, 11 were restricted to ditches, indicating that these habitats contributed a distinct component to regional biodiversity. Drainage and collector ditches also provided suitable habitats for Simuliidae larvae and supported local blackfly populations. In contrast, fish assemblages in both ditch types were dominated by non-native species, potentially reflecting environmental filtering and repeated immigration from established populations. Although ditches exhibited lower species richness than adjacent river sections, they supported several species not recorded in natural river habitats. Thus, anthropogenic ditches cannot replace natural rivers but may increase habitat heterogeneity and contribute to biodiversity conservation in highly modified landscapes. Extensive networks of irrigation canals and drainage collectors have been established throughout much of the Syr Darya River basin, substantially modifying natural freshwater habitats. This study investigated the contribution of two types of anthropogenic ditches-drainage and collector ditches-to local and regional fish and macroinvertebrate diversity by comparing their assemblages with those of adjacent natural river sections. The diversity and distribution of macroinvertebrates and fish were examined in relation to eight abiotic environmental variables, with particular attention to blackflies (Diptera: Simuliidae) and fish as ecologically and socioeconomically important components of regional aquatic ecosystems. Drainage and collector ditches differed from adjacent river habitats in several environmental characteristics, most notably lower summer water temperatures and reduced turbidity. These conditions were associated with distinct aquatic assemblages in the ditches. Of the 46 animal taxa recorded, 11 were restricted to ditches, indicating that these anthropogenic habitats supported a distinct ditch-associated component of the regional fauna. Drainage and collector ditches also provided suitable habitats for Simuliidae larvae and supported local blackfly populations. In contrast, fish assemblages in both types of ditches were dominated by non-native species. The occurrence and distribution of non-native fishes may reflect a combination of environmental filtering and repeated immigration from established populations, although the relative contribution of these mechanisms remains to be determined. Overall, the ditches exhibited lower species richness than adjacent river sections but contributed to regional biodiversity by supporting several species that were not recorded in natural river habitats. Thus, although anthropogenic ditches cannot be considered substitutes for natural river ecosystems, they increase habitat heterogeneity and provide additional aquatic habitats within highly modified landscapes. Their ecological significance should therefore be assessed not only in terms of species richness but also with regard to the composition, origin, ecological roles, and conservation status of the species they support.
papers.summary_cn: 在锡尔河流域，排水沟与集水沟同邻近天然河段相比，夏季水温更低、浊度更低，承载了不同的鱼类与大型无脊椎动物群落；记录的46个动物分类单元中有11个仅见于沟渠，沟渠还为蚋科（Simuliidae）幼虫提供了适宜生境。两类沟渠的鱼类群落均以非本地种为主，可能反映环境过滤与已建立种群的反复迁入。沟渠物种丰富度低于邻近河段，但支持了天然河流中未记录的物种，因而不能替代自然河流，却可提高生境异质性并在高度改造景观中补充水生生物多样性。

papers.title: Analysis Of The Added Value Of Baby Fish Nilem Crispy Products In Baby Fish MSMES Mr. O In Rancapaku Village, Tasikmalaya Regency
papers.authors: Fitriani, Dhean Nova; Heryadi, H. D Yadi; Jakiyah, Ulpah
papers.abstract: Downstream processing activities are a strategic sector that increases the added value of fishery products and supports regional economic growth. One product with development potential is crispy nilem baby fish, which represents a strategic effort to increase the economic value of bycatch and address the fish’s tendency to spoil easily. This activity is carried out, among other places, by the Baby Fish Mr.O MSME in Rancapaku Village, Tasikmalaya Regency. This study assessed the value added generated from processing of crispy nilem baby fish in MSMEs Baby Fish Mr.O in one production. The type of research used in this study is quantitative data with a case study approach. The data collection technique is through interviews with tools in the form of questionnaires and observations. Data is obtained from primary and secondary data. The sample extraction technique is carried out by the purposive sampling method. The data analysis in this study uses the Hayami method. The results of the study show that based on the analysis of the Hayami method, the added value of processing crispy nilem baby fish in Baby Fish Mr.O MSMEs is IDR 234,798 per kilogram of raw materials with an added value ratio of 78.27%. The added value of this product is in the high category
papers.summary_cn: 以Tasikmalaya县Rancapaku村Baby Fish Mr.O微小型企业为案例，采用Hayami法核算脆炸尼罗小杂鱼（crispy nilem baby fish）加工环节的附加值。结果显示，每公斤原料可产生附加值234,798印尼盾，附加值率达78.27%，属高附加值类别。该加工方式可提升副渔获物经济价值并缓解小杂鱼易腐问题。

papers.title: Revealing the elasmobranch diversity off the southern coast of Rio de Janeiro (22°55′S-23°27′S), an ecologically important area for conservation in the Western South Atlantic
papers.authors: Santos, Sérgio Ricardo; Pereira, Camila Ferreira; Julio, Tainá Guimarães; Maciel, Thaís Rodrigues; Hauser-Davis, Rachel Ann; Vianna, Marcelo
papers.abstract: Abstract Elasmobranchs are key components of marine trophic webs, functioning as top and mesopredators, but they are under considerable pressure from fishing activities and environmental degradation. Although the region was among the first Brazilian areas to be settled, the sharks and rays off the southern coast of Rio de Janeiro remain poorly known. This study aimed to assess the diversity of demersal elasmobranchs in a potentially relevant region of southeastern Brazil and to investigate the reproductive aspects of the most abundant species. Fourteen campaigns were carried out along the ocean side of Grande Island and the mouth of the Ilha Grande Bay using trawls and bottom longlines, between January 2006 and August 2007. The observed diversity was supplemented by a comprehensive literature review and recent records from citizen science databases. Twenty-one species were identified, with the most abundant comprising Atlantoraja cyclophora , Psammobatis extenta , Psammobatis rutrum , Rioraja agassizii , and Rhizoprionodon lalandii , with a substantial presence of juveniles. The L 50 values for A. cyclophora were 38 cm for females and 37.2 cm for males, 29.2 cm for females and 25.4 cm for males for R. agassizii , and 59.5 cm for male R. lalandii specimens. Results suggested a year-round reproductive activity for Arhynchobatidae, as females with eggs in the uterus or displaying vitellogenic activity were captured throughout the entire study period. The study highlights the need for conservation efforts in the region’s inner coastal shelf waters, given their potentially significant ecological role for elasmobranchs.
papers.summary_cn: 2006年1月至2007年8月在里约热内卢南部Grande岛外海及Ilha Grande湾口开展14次拖网与底层延绳钓调查，并结合文献综述和公民科学数据库记录，评估该区域底栖板鳃类多样性及优势种繁殖特征。共鉴定21种，优势种为*Atlantoraja cyclophora*、*Psammopatis extenta*、*P. rutrum*、*Rioraja agassizii*和*Rhizoprionodon lalandii*，幼鱼占比高。估算*A. cyclophora*雌、雄L50分别为38 cm和37.2 cm，*R. agassizii*为29.2 cm和25.4 cm，*R. lalandii*雄鱼为59.5 cm；Arhynchobatidae雌鱼全年可见含卵或卵黄发生个体，提示全年繁殖活动。研究强调该内大陆架水域对板鳃类具有重要生态作用，需加强保护。

papers.title: First record of the batfish † Eoplatax (Acanthomorpha: ?Ephippidae) from the Eocene (Lutetian) of Pakistan, with comments on the ephippid fossil record and the distribution of Paleogene marine fishes
papers.authors: Saad, Hadeel; Gingerich, Philip; Friedman, Matt
papers.abstract: A single fossil referable to the putative ephippid (batfish) †Eoplatax sp. is reported from the Eocene (Lutetian) Habib Rahi Formation of northwest Pakistan, where it is associated with a modest undescribed marine teleostean fauna. The specimen is incompletely preserved and lacks many of the cranial features used to diagnose †Eoplatax, but postcranial characters described here support its attribution to the genus. Additional traits distinguishing †Eoplatax from Platax are reviewed. Extinct taxa traditionally aligned with ephippids have never been formally investigated alongside extant species. We provide a critical review of the putative ephippids represented by skeletal fossils in order to facilitate future work.
