Apart from the new specimen of †Eoplatax reported here, all of these examples come from the Paleogene record of Europe. This †Eoplatax from eastern Tethys represents the first record of the genus outside the celebrated Bolca assemblage of the western Tethyan region, and hints that other nearshore teleostean lineages may have had wide geographic ranges at this time. Investigation of fossils from deposits outside of Europe and central Asia, even incomplete material like the specimen of †Eoplatax presented here, is essential for constraining biogeographic hypotheses of marine fish biogeography in the Cenozoic.
papers.summary_cn: 巴基斯坦西北部始新世（Lutetian）Habib Rahi组发现一件可归入†Eoplatax sp.的化石，与一批尚未描述的海生真骨鱼类伴生；标本保存不完整、缺乏多数用于鉴定†Eoplatax的颅部特征，但依据颅后骨骼特征支持其属级归属，并据此复核了†Eoplatax与Platax的鉴别特征。对骨骼化石所代表的疑似鲳科（ephippid）类群进行了系统评述，指出除该新标本外，这些材料均来自欧洲古近系。该†Eoplatax产于东特提斯，是该属在著名的西特提斯Bolca组合之外的首次记录，提示当时其他近岸真骨鱼类谱系可能具有较广的地理分布；欧洲和中亚以外（即使如本标本这样不完整）的化石材料对检验新生代海鱼生物地理假说至关重要。

papers.title: Niche partitioning between sympatric skates Rostroraja alba and Raja clavata: insights from spatial ecology and dietary analysis using acoustic telemetry and faecal DNA metabarcoding
papers.authors: Abecasis, David; Aires, Tania; Winkler, Alexander Claus; Kraft, Sebastian
papers.abstract: Understanding how ecologically similar species coexist is central to ecology, particularly in environments where interspecific competition is high. We investigated niche partitioning between two sympatric batoid species, white skate (Rostroraja alba) and thornback ray (Raja clavata), in a coastal marine protected area (the Professor Luiz Saldanha Marine Park, Portugal) using a combination of acoustic telemetry and DNA metabarcoding. The acoustic telemetry results revealed substantial spatial and behavioural overlap between species, including similar diel patterns and habitat preferences, with no evidence of fine-scale spatial segregation. In contrast, metabarcoding analyses of cloacal swabs indicated significant dietary differentiation. Rostroraja alba exhibited a higher diversity and number of exclusive prey taxa compared to R. clavata, suggesting broader or more opportunistic feeding strategies. These findings indicate that trophic niche partitioning, rather than spatial or temporal segregation, supports the coexistence of these ecologically similar skates. This study highlights the value of integrating spatial ecology with molecular diet analysis to better understand mechanisms of niche differentiation and species coexistence in marine predators.
papers.summary_cn: 在葡萄牙Professor Luiz Saldanha海洋保护区内，结合声学遥测与DNA宏条形码比较同域白鳐（Rostroraja alba）与背棘鳐（Raja clavata）的生态位分化。声学遥测显示两者在空间利用、昼夜节律和栖息地偏好上高度重叠，无细尺度空间隔离证据；而泄殖腔拭子宏条形码显示显著食性分化，R. alba的饵料类群多样性和专属饵料数量更高，提示其摄食策略更广或更机会主义。结果表明，营养生态位分化而非空间或时间隔离支撑了这两种生态相似鳐类的共存。

papers.title: A Comparative Evaluation of the Efficacy of the Tobique River Atlantic Salmon Smolt-to-Adult Supplementation Program
papers.authors: Holborn, Melissa; McWillian, Sherisse; Hogan, J. Derek; Jones, Ross A.; Moreau, Darek T.R.; Brodeur, Nathalie N; de Mestral, Louise Gabrielle; Bradbury, Ian; Reader, Jeffrey M; Anderson, Eric C
papers.abstract: As salmonid marine survival declines and the causes of marine mortality remain uncertain, supplementation programs are increasingly adopting strategies that bypass this life stage. Smolt-to-adult supplementation (SAS) programs collect migrating smolts, rear them to maturity in captivity, and release them to spawn in the wild. Despite ongoing debate regarding the risks and benefits of SAS and other stocking approaches, empirical evaluations remain limited. We evaluated an Atlantic Salmon SAS program operating concurrently with a captive-bred juvenile release program on the Tobique River, New Brunswick, Canada. Three cohorts of potential spawners and five years of returning adults were sampled. Parentage analysis was used to determine spawning success, reproductive success, and mating patterns. SAS fish spawned successfully in the river and mated with other SAS adults, sea-run salmon, and unsampled spawners, likely precocial male parr. However, SAS adults exhibited lower reproductive success than both sea-run and broodstock-origin spawners, while broodstock-origin fish had the highest lifetime reproductive success. Consequently, SAS adults contributed fewer returning adult recruits and had a reduced demographic impact on the population.
papers.summary_cn: 加拿大Tobique河大西洋鲑smolt-to-adult supplementation（SAS）项目将洄游smolt捕起、养至性成熟后放流，与放流人工繁育幼鲑的项目并行运行；对3个潜在产卵群体和5年回归成鱼采样，用亲缘分析评估产卵成功率、繁殖成功率与交配模式。SAS成鱼能在河中成功产卵，并与SAS成鱼、海河洄游鲑及未采样产卵者（可能为早熟雄性parr）交配，但其繁殖成功率低于海河洄游鲑和broodstock来源个体，broodstock来源鱼终生繁殖成功率最高。因此SAS成鱼贡献的回归成鱼补充量较少，对种群的数量统计影响较低。

papers.title: Recent Advances in Multimodal Dissolved Oxygen Forecasting in Aquaculture: A Review
papers.authors: Li, Daoliang; Mo, Henghui; Liu, Sitao; Liu, Jianhui; Li, Zhenwei
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Dissolved oxygen (DO) affects respiration, feeding, growth and welfare in aquaculture. DO forecasting can provide early warning of hypoxia and inform aeration decisions. Most aquaculture forecasts use time series from fixed monitoring locations; these describe temporal variation but contain limited information on biological oxygen demand, management activity and spatial distribution. This review traces the transition from single-point time-series prediction to multimodal DO forecasting. Environmental and operational variables capture external forcing and interventions associated with DO dynamics. Biological, behavioural and physiological observations provide information on oxygen demand and animal responses, whereas spatial and hydroacoustic observations characterise fish distribution and biomass across locations and depths. The review covers spatiotemporal alignment, missing-value reconstruction, multimodal fusion, and temporal, spatiotemporal, multimodal and hybrid forecasting models. Applications include hypoxia warning, DO-field forecasting and reconstruction, and forecast-informed oxygen management. Across the literature, DO and physicochemical measurements form the observational basis and are supplemented by biological, spatial and operational information selected for each forecasting task. Asynchronous observations, missing data and variable sensor reliability complicate multimodal fusion, while differing forecast horizons and evaluation settings affect comparisons across studies. Field deployment is further affected by sensor drift, biofouling and differences among production sites. Priorities for future research include quality-aware and mechanism-data fusion, transferable models evaluated under comparable horizons and event definitions, and prospective studies linking prediction error to warning lead time, spatial risk and management outcomes. In brief, this review aims to help researchers and practitioners understand multimodal DO forecasting and its potential to guide oxygen management in aquaculture.
papers.summary_cn: 溶解氧（DO）影响水产养殖动物的呼吸、摄食、生长与福利，DO 预报可预警低氧并指导增氧决策。综述梳理了从固定监测点单点时间序列预测向多模态 DO 预报的转变：环境与操作变量反映外部驱动和管理干预，生物、行为与生理观测提供需氧量和动物响应信息，空间与声学观测刻画鱼类分布与生物量。文章覆盖时空对齐、缺失值重建、多模态融合及时间、时空、多模态与混合预报模型，应用包括低氧预警、DO 场预报与重建以及预报驱动的氧气管理；指出异步观测、数据缺失和传感器可靠性差异使融合复杂化，预报时效与评估设置不同妨碍研究间比较，现场部署还受传感器漂移、生物污损和场点差异影响，未来需发展质量感知与机理—数据融合、在可比时效和事件定义下评估的可迁移模型，以及将预测误差与预警提前量、空间风险和管理效果关联的前瞻性研究。

papers.title: Improvement in Nutrient Utilization, Gut Health, and Microbiota Modulation in Nile Tilapia Supplemented with a Blend of Sodium Butyrate, Hydrolyzed Yeast, Zinc Proteinate, and a Lactobacillus acidophilus Fermentation Product
papers.authors: de Oliveira, Vitória Daitx; Schleder, Delano Dias; Ascoli, Bruna Gabrieli; Duarte, Isabella Gonçalves; Mussoi, Luis Felipe; Brutti, Virian Coradini; Miguel, Keyla de Oliveira Ribeiro; Silva, Maria Fernanda Oliveira da; Pettigrew, James Eugene; Valente, Luísa Maria Pinheiro
papers.abstract: This study investigated the growth performance, gut microbiota, and intestinal histology of juvenile Nile tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) fed a functional additive blend containing sodium butyrate, dehydrated hydrolyzed yeast, zinc proteinate, and a fermentation product of Lactobacillus acidophilus. Three doses (0.30, 0.60, and 2.40 g kg-1) were added to a basal diet, and treatments were randomly assigned to 24 experimental units, with six replicates per treatment. Fish were fed a restricted ration twice daily for 55 days. Dietary supplementation significantly improved the feed conversion ratio and protein retention and reduced voluntary feed intake and nitrogen loss. Fish supplemented with 0.30 and 0.60 g kg-1 had a greater intestinal absorptive area. At 0.60 g kg-1, muscular layer thickness increased compared with the control. Diet significantly affected intestinal microbial community structure, with more pronounced taxonomic changes at 2.40 g kg-1. Spearman correlations showed that higher daily weight gain was associated with lower feed conversion ratio (r = -0.845), while greater intestinal absorptive area was associated with lower voluntary feed intake (r = -0.526). Overall, the most consistent results were at 0.30 and 0.60 g kg-1, indicating that these inclusion levels improved nutrient utilization and gut health parameters in juvenile Nile tilapia.
papers.summary_cn: 在尼罗罗非鱼幼鱼基础饲料中添加含丁酸钠、水解酵母、蛋白锌及嗜酸乳杆菌发酵产物的复合功能添加剂（0.30、0.60、2.40 g/kg），限饲55天后评估生长、肠道组织与菌群。添加组饲料转化率和蛋白质保留显著改善，自愿摄食量与氮损失降低；0.30和0.60 g/kg组肠道吸收面积增大，0.60 g/kg组肌层厚度增加。日粮显著改变肠道微生物群落结构，2.40 g/kg组分类学变化最明显；日增重与饲料转化率（r=−0.845）、肠道吸收面积与自愿摄食量（r=−0.526）均呈负相关。0.30和0.60 g/kg添加水平效果最稳定，可改善幼鱼营养利用与肠道健康。

papers.title: Diversifying the northern Neotropics: phylogenomics and evolutionary history of the early-diverging herichthyine cichlids Thorichthys and Trichromis
papers.authors: Elías, Diego J.; Alda, Fernando; Betancourt-Resendes, Isaí; Díaz-Flores, Alejandro; Domínguez-Domínguez, Omar; Rodríguez-Machado, Sheila; Velázquez-Velázquez, Ernesto; Piller, Kyle R.; Matamoros, Wilfredo A.; Mochel, Susan F.
papers.abstract: Among Neotropical cichlids the tribe Heroini exhibits substantial ecological diversity and is one of the dominant fish groups across northern Neotropical riverscapes. The majority of studies on heroine cichlids have focused on macroevolutionary patterns but the role of geological and climatic factors shaping lineage diversification within the tribe remains poorly understood. Here we used ultraconserved elements (UCEs) to infer a taxonomically complete and geographically comprehensive phylogenomic framework of the early-diverging herichthyine sister genera Thorichthys and Trichromis and to comparatively investigate their evolutionary and biogeographic histories. All our phylogenomic hypotheses support the monophyly of both genera and two species subgroups within Thorichthys . Our results provide evidence of (a) unrecognized diversity within Trichromis salvini , (b) uncertainty in species boundaries in Thorichthys , and (c) the first report of ghost introgression in fishes of the northern Neotropics. Additionally, our results demonstrate the importance of the Papaloapan and Coatzacoalcos watersheds for fish diversification in the region. Finally, we show patterns consistent with ecological divergence during the evolution of this group, particularly among sympatric non-closely related species. Altogether, these patterns suggest that lineage diversification in northern Neotropical cichlids has been driven by the interaction of geological restructuring, climatic and sea-level oscillations, and heterogeneous ecological pressures.
papers.summary_cn: 基于超保守元件（UCE）构建了早期分化慈鲷姐妹属 Thorichthys 与 Trichromis 的分类学完整、地理覆盖全面的系统发育基因组框架，两属单系性均获支持，Thorichthys 内识别出两个物种亚群。结果显示 Trichromis salvini 存在未被识别的多样性、Thorichthys 物种边界不确定，并首次在北美热带鱼类中报道了 ghost introgression。Papaloapan 与 Coatzacoalcos 流域对该区域鱼类分化具有重要意义，同域非近缘种间存在与生态分化一致的模式，提示地质重构、气候与海平面波动及异质性生态压力的交互作用驱动了该区域慈鲷谱系分化。

papers.title: Should I stay or should I go: Hypoxia thresholds of the three-spined stickleback ( Gasterosteus aculeatus )
papers.authors: Andreasen, Magnus Heide; Behrens, Jane W.; Gorbacovs, Sergejs; Kühnemann, Leo; Brooks, Mollie Elizabeth; Norin, Tommy; Svendsen, Jon C.; Nielsen, Torkel Gissel
papers.abstract: Abstract We established hypoxia avoidance thresholds of three-spined stickleback ( Gasterosteus aculeatus ) using a customized choice-flume system. Stickleback is an opportunistic species, increasing in abundance in several aquatic systems. We show that sticklebacks avoid oxygen levels commonly reported in many coastal areas. When prey was available in severe hypoxia (10% O 2 sat), fish still spent 50.9% of the 30-min feeding period in the hypoxic side, compared with 78.5% in the prey side under normoxia. These findings provide a prey-dependent estimate of hypoxia sensitivity in an abundant northern-temperate coastal fish and highlight the need to test whether laboratory thresholds predict field distributions.
papers.summary_cn: 用定制选择水槽系统测定三刺鱼（Gasterosteus aculeatus）的低氧回避阈值，发现其回避许多沿海水域常见的低氧水平。在严重低氧（10% O₂饱和度）但有饵料时，鱼在30分钟摄食期内仍有50.9%时间停留在低氧侧，而常氧下为78.5%。结果提供了这种丰度较高的北温带沿海鱼类依赖饵料的低氧敏感性估计，并提示需检验实验室阈值能否预测野外分布。

papers.title: Updated estimates of somatic growth patterns and sex ratios in albacore ( T hunnus alalunga ) from the North Pacific Ocean
papers.authors: Snodgrass, Owyn E.; James, Kelsey C.; Skelton, Zachary R.; Craig, Matthew T.; Dewar, Heidi; Erisman, Brad E.
papers.abstract: Abstract Stock assessments for Albacore ( Thunnus alalunga ) in the North Pacific Ocean use an integrated, sex-specific model based on the hypothesis that growth and longevity are sexually dimorphic. However, the paucity of sex-specific data available to model somatic growth and understand spatial population structure was a continual source of uncertainty among past studies. We engaged in a geographically expansive sampling effort to obtain recent age, length and sex data from fisheries sources across its North Pacific range and provide an updated growth model and regional estimates of sex ratios more representative of the entire stock of North Pacific albacore. With a more complete sample distribution by sex, a combined sexes model was favoured over a sex-specific model based on both Akaike Information Criterion (AICc) and Bayesian Information Criterion (BIC). The von Bertalanffy growth parameters for combined sexes were L ∞ = 124.4 cm in fork length ( L F ), K = 0.168 years -1 and t 0 = -2.100 years. Regional (west, central and east Pacific Ocean), fishery-dependent, sample sex ratios ranged from 1.2 to 1.6 males per female for size classes up to 90 cm L F . Individuals 100 cm L F and larger were predominantly males, but large females were collected for all size classes, and males were larger than females in only one age class. In contrast with previous growth studies, our results support the use of a single model to describe growth and longevity of both male and female North Pacific albacore. The convergence of sex-specific growth curves associated with a more complete sample distribution combined with studies from other albacore populations suggests that male-skewed sex ratios among adult North Pacific albacore are likely due to sex-specific migration patterns, habitat preferences, or behaviours that impact their vulnerability to capture.
papers.summary_cn: 北太平洋长鳍金枪鱼（Thunnus alalunga）stock assessment 长期采用性别分异的整合模型，但缺乏性别特异性生长数据是不确定性的主要来源。该研究在西北太平洋全域渔业中广泛采样，获取年龄、叉长和性别数据，更新生长模型并估算区域性别比。基于更完整的性别样本分布，AICc 和 BIC 均支持合并性别的 von Bertalanffy 生长模型（L∞=124.4 cm LF，K=0.168 yr⁻¹，t₀=−2.100 yr），而非性别特异模型；西部、中部和东部太平洋渔业依赖样本在≤90 cm LF 体长组的性别比为每雌1.2–1.6雄，≥100 cm LF 个体以雄性为主，但各体长组均采集到大型雌鱼，仅一个年龄组雄性大于雌性。结果表明北太平洋长鳍金枪鱼雌雄可采用单一生长与寿命模型，成鱼雄性偏多的性别比更可能源于性别特异性洄游、栖息地偏好或影响捕获易感性的行为，而非生长差异。

papers.title: Seasonal changes in fish production in annual and perennial eelgrass ( Z ostera marina ) beds of the western North Pacific
papers.authors: Shoji, Jun; Iseki, Kanata; Kawamoto, Hotaka
papers.abstract: Abstract Eelgrass ( Zostera marina ) beds form essential ecosystems that provide significant ecosystem services through carbon fixation and as nurseries for aquatic living resources. The period during which vegetation is in decline or has disappeared in annual eelgrass beds is longer than in perennial eelgrass beds. There have been no comparative studies of fish production in eelgrass beds with the different life cycles, although quantitative evaluation of fish production within habitats is an essential process for assessing the contribution of each habitat to fisheries resources. We conducted field surveys at two eelgrass beds (annual eelgrass in 2023-2024 and perennial eelgrass in 2008-2009) in temperate coastal waters of the western North Pacific to evaluate how the difference in eelgrass life cycle affects seasonal change and annual amount of fish production. Fish production was estimated by monthly seines that enabled species-specific estimates of biomass increase. The results showed that monthly fish production in the perennial eelgrass bed remained at higher levels for a longer period than in the annual eelgrass bed, and annual fish production in the perennial eelgrass bed was approximately twice that in the annual eelgrass bed. Because the increase in sea water temperature and changes in other environmental conditions under global warming are expected to shift eelgrass towards an annual life cycle, this could affect ecosystem services of eelgrass bed through changes in fish community structure and production.
papers.summary_cn: 在西北太平洋温带沿岸，比较一年生与多年生大叶藻（Zostera marina）床中鱼类生产的季节变化与年产量，采用月度围网调查按物种估算生物量增长。多年生床的月度鱼类生产在更长时间内维持较高水平，年产量约为一年生床的两倍。由于全球变暖下海水升温等环境变化预计将使大叶藻转向一年生生活史，这可能通过改变鱼类群落结构与生产影响大叶藻床的生态系统服务。

papers.title: Evaluating Fish Assemblage Turnover in Relation to Hydrologic Extremes Across the United States
papers.authors: Lewis, Samuel T.; Kanno, Yoichiro; Carlisle, Daren M.; Franssen, Nathan R.; Freeman, Mary C.; Gido, Keith B.; Luce, Charles; Mims, Meryl C.; Olden, Julian D.; Poff, N. LeRoy
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Stream flows are widely regarded as a master variable affecting fish assemblages, with extreme events (e.g., floods, droughts) reorganising assemblages. Although assemblage turnover (temporal beta diversity) is common following hydrologic extremes, we have limited knowledge on how hydrologic extremes influence assemblage turnover across a broad spatial extent. In this study, we analysed time-series counts of stream fish assemblages at 34 sites in the conterminous US to characterise the relationship between assemblage turnover with high- and low-flow anomalies. We found that flow anomalies were equally important in explaining fish assemblage turnover when analysed across study sites. One-year lag effects of flow extremes were equally important to current-year effects. Temporal changes in relative abundance were a stronger factor of fish assemblage turnover than assemblage composition (i.e., species loss and gain). Species with the greatest contributions to assemblage turnover tended to be fluvial species that were locally abundant. Our study showed that neither high nor low flows influence stream fish assemblage turnover consistently across sites, suggesting context dependence. Further research with additional sites across ecoregions could identify factors determining this context dependency, which will help stream fish management under climate-change-induced hydrologic uncertainty and increasing human demand for water.
papers.summary_cn: 研究基于美国本土34个站点的溪流鱼类群落时间序列数据，分析群落周转（temporal beta diversity）与高、低流量异常的关系。结果表明，流量异常对群落周转的解释力与站点尺度相当，滞后一年的极端流量效应与当年效应同等重要；相对丰度的时序变化比物种组成变化（物种得失）更能驱动群落周转，贡献最大的多为当地丰度较高的流水性物种。高流量与低流量对群落周转的影响在不同站点间并不一致，呈现明显的环境依赖性，需跨生态区扩展站点研究以识别其决定因素，为气候变化下水文不确定性及人类用水需求增加背景下的溪流鱼类管理提供依据。

papers.title: Safeguarding the Eastern Himalayan Freshwater Ecosystems: An Integrated Biosecurity, Policy, and Community-Led Framework to Prevent Invasive Fish Introductions in Northeast India
papers.authors: Inaotombi, Shaikhom
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Freshwater ecosystems in the Eastern Himalayan Region of India-a global biodiversity hotspot-are threatened by invasive alien fish species perhaps facilitated by exotic aquaculture, the aquarium trade, climate change, and inadequate regulation. The invasion of alien species disrupts native biodiversity, causes ecological imbalances, and threatens livelihoods dependent on freshwater resources. To address this, the present study develops an integrated management framework by synthesizing and adapting global biosecurity protocols, policy tools, and community-led conservation. The framework integrates three pillars: (1) advanced biosecurity, with real-time monitoring and predictive modeling for early detection; (2) strengthened, context-sensitive policies to regulate high-risk species trade and aquaculture while respecting local economies; and (3) community empowerment through stewardship programs using traditional knowledge, sustainable livelihoods, and awareness. Recognizing the region's unique geological history and the convergence of two biodiversity hotspots in Northeast India, the framework's strength lies in its tailored design, which explicitly leverages local communities and their traditional practices to provide culturally grounded, sustainable solutions. By fostering regional collaboration, using technology, and engaging communities, this approach aims to disrupt invasion pathways, protect biodiversity, and enhance ecosystem resilience, thereby contributing to global conservation goals.
papers.summary_cn: 研究旨在应对印度东北部东喜马拉雅地区淡水生态系统面临的外来入侵鱼类威胁（由外来水产养殖、水族贸易、气候变化及监管不足等因素驱动）。作者综合全球生物安全协议、政策工具与社区主导保护经验，构建了整合三大支柱的管理框架：实时监测与预测建模的先进biosecurity体系、针对高风险物种贸易和水产养殖的情境敏感政策、以及基于传统知识的社区赋权与可持续生计项目。该框架强调利用当地社区及传统实践，通过区域协作与技术应用阻断invasion pathways，保护生物多样性并提升生态系统韧性。

papers.title: An assessment of technical efficiency in U.S. aquaculture production
papers.authors: He, Qingxin; Lee, Jonathan
papers.journal: Journal of the Agricultural and Applied Economics Association
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT A four-component stochastic frontier model is applied separately to nine broadly classified species group panels of U.S. aquaculture farms covering the years 2007 to 2017 to identify both time-varying and persistent inefficiencies for catfish, trout, “other” food fish, bait fish, ornamental fish, sport fish, crustaceans, mollusks, and “other” aquaculture products. We find considerable efficiency gaps in aquaculture production driven primarily by growers' persistent inefficiencies; average overall technical efficiency ranges from 43.8% to 53.7% for “other” aquaculture products and trout, respectively. This finding suggests that increased extension efforts promoting best planning practices for potential entrants can significantly improve U.S. aquaculture efficiency.
papers.summary_cn: 研究采用四分量随机前沿模型，分别对美国水产养殖场2007—2017年九大类物种面板数据（鲶鱼、鳟鱼、其他食用鱼、饵料鱼、观赏鱼、游钓鱼、甲壳类、软体类及其他水产品）进行技术效率评估，以识别时变性与持续性低效。结果显示，养殖生产者持续性低效是效率缺口的主要来源，总体平均技术效率介于43.8%（其他水产品）至53.7%（鳟鱼）之间。研究表明，针对潜在进入者加强最佳规划实践的技术推广可显著提升美国水产养殖效率。

papers.title: Seasonal Variability in Nutrient Sources and Phytoplankton Primary Productivity in a Shellfish Culture Area of Miyazu Bay, Sea of Japan
papers.authors: Kuragano, Mao; Nakajima, Toshimi; Sugimoto, Ryo
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Phytoplankton primary production is essential to coastal food webs. However, the roles of different nutrient sources in semienclosed bays characterized by strong seasonal variability in physical conditions and nutrient availability are not well understood. We investigated seasonal variations in phytoplankton biomass and primary productivity over 2 years (June 2021-November 2023) at a shellfish aquaculture site in Miyazu Bay, Japan, where nutrients are supplied via offshore seawater intrusion and river discharge as well as submarine groundwater discharge (SGD). Vertically integrated chlorophyll a (Chl-a) and electron transport rate-based primary production were highest in winter, coinciding with elevated dissolved inorganic nutrient concentrations associated with offshore water inputs. However, Chl-a-specific productivity and photosynthetic activity declined in winter due to reduced solar radiation, indicating that phytoplankton biomass accumulated under nutrient-rich conditions despite light limitation. Photosynthetically active radiation (PAR) within the water column was governed primarily by surface PAR rather than by the light attenuation coefficient, which was low and showed no seasonality. In contrast, Chl-a-specific productivity and photosynthetic activity peaked in summer, when surface nutrient concentrations were low but solar radiation was high. Geochemical tracers ( 222 Rn and 224 Ra) revealed continuous inputs of nutrient-rich groundwater near the seabed, suggesting that SGD may supplement nutrient availability during nutrient-depleted summer conditions. Size-fractionated analyses revealed that small phytoplankton (< 20 μm) dominated biomass and production throughout the year. These results also highlight SGD as a relatively persistent nutrient pathway that may supplement nutrient availability under light-rich but nutrient-poor summer conditions.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在明确日本宫津湾贝类养殖区不同营养盐来源对浮游植物初级生产的贡献及其季节变化。作者于2021年6月至2023年11月开展了为期两年的季节性观测，结合叶绿素a、基于电子传递速率的初级生产力测定以及222Rn和224Ra地球化学示踪，解析了外海水入侵、河流输入与海底地下水排放（SGD）的作用。结果表明，水柱积分叶绿素a和初级生产力在冬季最高，与外海水输入带来的高溶解无机营养盐浓度一致，但光限制使单位叶绿素a生产力下降；夏季表层营养盐低而光照充足，单位叶绿素a生产力和光合活性达到峰值。SGD在近海底持续输入富营养地下水，可能在夏季营养盐匮乏时补充营养盐供应；小型浮游植物（<20 μm）全年主导生物量和生产力。

papers.title: Sustainable Cold Chain Logistics for Fisheries: A Systematic Review of Facility Location-Allocation and Coastal Spatial Planning
papers.authors: Siregar, Afri Yudatama; Supriyanto, Agus; Beami, Waroka; Bakhtiar, Arfan; Ulkhaq, Muhammad Mujiya; Nawipa, Olinda; Noor, Huriyatul Fitriyah; Rahardyandini, Meiliana
papers.abstract: Abstract* Fishery products are prone to quality deterioration during post-harvest handling and distribution. Therefore, the development of a sustainable cold chain requires the integration of facility planning, distribution efficiency, coastal zone management, and socio-ecological considerations. This study aims to synthesize these approaches and identify gaps in their integration. A systematic review was conducted through a literature search in the Scopus database, with reporting guided by PRISMA 2020. The initial search yielded 396 records; 222 records were retained after applying the publication year restriction of 2016-2026. Screening for document type, language, and access resulted in 134 records for title and abstract evaluation. A total of 37 publications proceeded to the eligibility assessment stage, and 12 publications were reported in a qualitative-thematic synthesis based on four research questions. The synthesis identified four main themes: location-allocation optimization and low-emission distribution; coastal spatial-ecological planning; facility accessibility and socioeconomic resilience; and carbon traceability and accountability. The results show that technical, ecological, and social approaches make complementary contributions, but their integration into a single fisheries cold chain planning model has not been comprehensively demonstrated in the reviewed literature. This study proposes a Coastal Cold Chain Integration Triad Framework that links spatial-ecological suitability, facility location-allocation optimization, and socio-ecological resilience and supply chain integrity. This framework provides a conceptual basis for research and planning in sustainable fisheries logistics, with a need for further empirical testing.
papers.summary_cn: 针对渔获后处理与流通环节的品质劣变问题，通过Scopus数据库系统检索（PRISMA 2020，初检396条，最终纳入12篇文献做定性主题综合），梳理渔业冷链可持续规划中设施选址-分配、沿海空间生态规划、设施可达性与社会经济韧性、碳追溯与问责四条主线。结果显示技术、生态与社会路径互补，但尚未有文献将其整合为统一的渔业冷链规划模型。据此提出“沿海冷链整合三元框架”（Coastal Cold Chain Integration Triad Framework），耦合空间生态适宜性、设施选址-分配优化与社会生态韧性及供应链完整性，为后续实证检验提供概念基础。

papers.title: Transforming Fisheries AID Policy through Risk Classification and Priority Scoring using Fishery Reporting Application Data
papers.authors: Karyaningsih, Dentik; Susandi, Diki; Anharudin, Anharudin; Fernando, Donny; Sugiyarta, Ahmad; Hadi, Irfan
papers.journal: Jurnal ELTIKOM : Jurnal Teknik Elektro, Teknologi Informasi dan Komputer
papers.abstract: Current government aid programs in the fisheries sector often rely on reactive and uniform approaches, which may result in inefficient resource allocation. This study proposes an integrated dual-model machine learning framework to support more targeted fisheries aid allocation. The framework addresses two policy needs: predicting future vulnerability risk among capture fishers and estimating the success potential of aquaculture farmers. Data were obtained from the Integrated Fishery Reporting Application, comprising 625 aquaculture farmer records and 437 fisher records across 28 sub-districts in Lebak Regency, Banten, Indonesia. A Random Forest classifier was employed to classify fisher vulnerability into three categories: Low, Mid, and High Risk, while a Gradient Boosting Machine (GBM) regression model was used to predict survival rate as a proxy for farmer success potential. The optimized Random Forest model achieved a weighted F1-score of 0.8862, with recall values of 0.9268 for Mid Risk and 0.8889 for High Risk. The GBM model achieved an R-squared (R²) of 0.7585 and an RMSE of 6.0033 on the test data. These results indicate the potential of the framework to provide quantitative support for risk identification and aid prioritization. However, the findings are limited to data from a single regency and have not been evaluated through direct field implementation or policy intervention. Therefore, the framework should be considered an empirically evaluated decision-support approach rather than a fully validated policy tool.
papers.summary_cn: 研究基于印尼万丹省Lebak县综合渔业报告应用数据（625条养殖户记录、437条渔民记录，覆盖28个街道），构建双模型机器学习框架以支持更精准的渔业援助分配：用Random Forest将捕捞渔民脆弱性分为低、中、高三类，用Gradient Boosting Machine（GBM）回归预测养殖户存活率作为成功潜力代理指标。优化后Random Forest加权F1为0.8862（中风险召回率0.9268、高风险0.8889），GBM测试集R²为0.7585、RMSE为6.0033，显示该框架可为风险识别与援助优先级评分提供定量支持。作者指出结果仅限单县数据、未经实地实施或政策干预验证，应视为经实证评估的决策支持方法而非完全验证的政策工具。

papers.title: A Review of Rice-Field Fisheries, Aquatic Animal Production, and Pollution Governance in the Lower Mekong Basin: Evidence from the Vietnamese Mekong Delta
papers.authors: Da, Chau Thi; Lan, Thai Huynh Phuong; Tam, Nguyen Thanh; Berg, Hakan
papers.abstract: The Mekong Delta of Vietnam is one of Southeast Asia’s most important food-producing regions, supporting intensive rice cultivation, globally significant aquaculture, and diverse inland and rice-field fisheries that contribute to food security, rural livelihoods, and ecosystem functioning. However, hydraulic engineering, agricultural intensification, aquaculture expansion, urbanization, upstream river development, and climate-related pressures have progressively altered the hydrological and ecological processes sustaining these interconnected systems. This review synthesizes evidence on the transformation of rice-field fisheries and aquatic animal production in the Lower Mekong Basin, with particular emphasis on the Mekong Delta, and evaluates how effectively pollution governance addresses cumulative pressures on aquatic ecosystems. Peer-reviewed studies, official statistics, policy and legal documents, Mekong River Commission reports, and international institutional publications were assessed through a systematic critical review combining evidence mapping with structured narrative synthesis. The synthesis reveals a marked transition from hydrologically connected, multispecies production landscapes toward increasingly specialized rice and aquaculture systems. In the Mekong Delta region, recorded inland wild-fish catch declined from approximately 165,000 tonnes in 1995 to 30,000 tonnes in 2024, while aquaculture production increased more than eightfold, from approximately 78,000 to 650,000 tonnes, and rice production more than doubled, from 3.5 to 7.6 million tonnes. These contrasting trends coincided with high-dyke development, reduced floodplain connectivity, altered sediment and flow regimes, habitat modification, and greater agrochemical dependence. Major pollution pressures include nutrient and organic enrichment, pesticides, pharmaceuticals, domestic and industrial wastewater, micro-plastics, and acid-sulfate-soil drainage. Nevertheless, fishery decline cannot be attributed to pollution alone, because hydropower development, migration barriers, fishing pressure, habitat fragmentation, altered flood pulses, sediment deficits, and interact across spatial and temporal scales. Although Vietnam has established increasingly comprehensive fisheries, environment, water-resource, regional-planning, and climate-adaptation frameworks, implementation remains fragmented. Priority actions include integrated basin-to-field monitoring, cumulative-risk assessment, pollution prevention at source, stronger discharge controls, restoration of seasonal floodplain connectivity, protection of aquatic refuges, community co-management, and wider adoption of context-appropriate floating-rice, rice-fish, and rice-shrimp systems in this Delta region.
papers.summary_cn: 越南湄公河三角洲稻田渔业与水生动物生产正从水文连通的多物种体系转向专业化水稻与水产养殖体系：内陆野生鱼捕捞量由1995年约16.5万吨降至2024年3万吨，水产养殖产量由约7.8万吨增至65万吨（逾8倍），稻米产量由350万吨增至760万吨。污染压力包括营养盐与有机富集、农药、药物、生活与工业废水、微塑料及酸性硫酸盐土排水，但渔业衰退不能仅归因于污染，水坝开发、洄游阻隔、捕捞压力、生境破碎化、洪泛脉冲改变与泥沙亏缺在多时空尺度交互作用。越南虽已建立较全面的渔业、环境、水资源、区域规划与气候适应政策框架，但实施仍呈碎片化；优先行动包括流域到田块一体化监测、累积风险评估、源头污染预防、排放管控、恢复季节性洪泛连通性、保护水生庇护所、社区共管及因地制宜推广浮稻、稻鱼与稻虾系统。

papers.title: A genomic future for fisheries assessments
papers.authors: Weber, D. Nick; Monroe, Alison A.; Fields, Andrew T.; Swift, Dominic G.; Anderson, Eric C.; Hollenbeck, Christopher M.; Chagaris, David D.; Patterson, William F.; Portnoy, David S.
papers.abstract: Abstract Traditional fisheries stock assessments incorporate life history data (e.g., mortality, growth, maturity), indices of abundance, and catch data into models to determine stock status and estimate biological reference points. However, obtaining these data in an accurate and timely manner can be challenging. While genetic techniques have been used for over 50 years to identify independent stocks, recent genomic innovations now allow for the generation of multiple stock assessment data inputs. Specifically, DNA extracted from non-lethally sampled tissue (e.g., fin clips) can be analyzed to monitor population structure and levels of connectivity, to estimate absolute abundance, to assess the age composition of landed or discarded catch, and to estimate sex ratios. Through standardized, adaptable, and minimally invasive methods to collect data necessary for robust stock assessments, genomic tools have the potential to provide a relatively comprehensive and cost-effective approach for long-term monitoring. The enhanced integration of next-generation genomic data into stock assessments will improve the accuracy and efficiency of fisheries assessment and management, ultimately supporting the sustainable use of marine resources.
papers.summary_cn: 传统渔业资源评估依赖生活史参数、丰度指数与渔获数据，但这类数据获取的准确性与时效性常受限。从非致死取样组织（如鳍条）提取DNA，可用于监测种群结构与连通性、估算绝对丰度、判定渔获或抛弃物的年龄组成及性比。将下一代基因组数据整合进 stock assessment，有望以标准化、微创且相对低成本的方式提升评估的准确性与效率，支撑海洋资源的可持续利用。

papers.title: Tracking the Science-Policy Interface in Fisheries Management: A Comparative Assessment of Trawl Selectivity Research and Turkish Fisheries Regulations
papers.authors: Şimşek, Emrah
papers.abstract: Trawl size selectivity constitutes a critical link between fisheries science, fishing technology, and fisheries governance. This study comparatively examines the development of scientific knowledge on trawl size selectivity and the evolution of corresponding fisheries regulations in Türkiye, with particular attention to the degree of correspondence between these two trajectories. A four-stage methodological framework was applied. First, the global literature on trawl selectivity was examined through a bibliometric analysis of 1940 publications indexed in the Web of Science Core Collection between 1980 and 2026. Network analyses including keyword co-occurrence, co-authorship, citation analysis, and bibliographic coupling were conducted using VOSviewer software to identify the structural characteristics of the field. Second, publication trends were evaluated using forecasting approaches, including ARIMA, ETS, Holt-Winters, Theta, Naive, and Polynomial Regression models. Third, a systematic screening was conducted using the Turkish Council of Higher Education National Thesis Center, where 29 postgraduate theses addressing trawl size selectivity were identified. Fourth, fisheries communiqués were analyzed to examine the evolution of trawl selectivity regulations in Türkiye. The results indicate that Türkiye possesses substantial scientific research capacity on trawl size selectivity, reflected in international scientific publications and in postgraduate research. Forecasting analyses further suggest that scientific production on trawl selectivity will continue to increase through 2030, indicating sustained international interest in selective fishing technologies and bycatch reduction measures. However, codend mesh-size regulations in Turkish bottom trawl fisheries have remained largely unchanged since 2007. These findings indicate a persistent mismatch between the expanding scientific knowledge base on trawl selectivity and the limited evolution of corresponding regulatory provisions in Türkiye. The study highlights the importance of strengthening science-policy interactions and promoting evidence-based fisheries governance to improve the adaptive management of trawl fisheries.
papers.summary_cn: 以Web of Science核心合集1980–2026年1940篇拖网选择性文献为对象，结合VOSviewer关键词共现、合著与文献耦合网络分析及ARIMA、ETS、Holt-Winters、Theta等预测模型，并系统梳理土耳其高等教育委员会国家论文中心的29篇研究生论文与渔业公报，比较拖网尺寸选择性科研产出与土耳其相关法规的演进轨迹。结果显示土耳其在该领域具备较强科研能力，预测至2030年科研产出将持续增长；但土耳其底拖网网囊网目尺寸法规自2007年以来基本未变。研究表明拖网选择性科学知识快速积累与监管条款演进滞后之间存在持续错配，凸显强化科学—政策互动与基于证据的渔业治理对拖网渔业适应性管理的重要性。

papers.title: Smart Costing Education Using Activity-Based Costing for Fish-Processing MSMEs
papers.authors: Tambunan, Rupianna; Fauzi, Muchamad Rizky; Sofa, Irma; Muamanah; Nurjanah, Siti
papers.abstract: Purpose: This community engagement activity aimed to introduce Smart Costing based on Activity-Based Costing (ABC) to the Fish-Processing MSME Group in Domas Village, Pontang District, Serang Regency, and to improve participants’ understanding of financial recordkeeping and production cost calculation. Method: The activity took place on 22 October 2026 and included educational sessions and practical exercises on calculating production costs. Evaluation was qualitative, based on the implementation information provided by the community engagement team. Numerical pre-test and post-test scores and the exact number of individual participants were not available. Practical Applications: The activity introduced participants to more structured production-cost calculation. Follow-up collaboration is planned to support more orderly financial records, consistent production-cost calculations, and business development. Conclusion: The activity was reported to have run smoothly, with a reported change in participants’ understanding before and after the education. Since detailed evaluation records were unavailable, the magnitude of the change cannot be quantified. Continued mentoring is proposed to support application of the learning in daily business practices.
papers.summary_cn: 面向Domas村（Serang县Pontang区）鱼糜加工MSME群体开展基于作业成本法（ABC）的"Smart Costing"培训，内容涵盖财务记录与生产成本核算的讲解及实操练习。活动于2026年10月22日实施，采用定性评估，缺少前后测分数与参与人数等定量记录，因此理解程度变化幅度无法量化。参与者初步接触了更结构化的成本核算方法，后续计划通过持续辅导推动财务记录规范化和成本核算的日常应用。

papers.title: Social deprivation versus social recovery: food availability modulates growth, personality, stress, and immunity in a social fish
papers.authors: Li, Wu-Xin; Sun, Chun-Yan; Chen, Li-Xue; Chen, Rong; Fu, Shi-Jian; Zeng, Ling-Qing
papers.abstract: Social isolation can induce stress responses in group-living animals, with consequences for growth, behavior, and health. In social fish species, whether and how these effects are modulated by food availability, and whether they can be reversed by subsequent return to group rearing, remain poorly understood. Using mirror carp (Cyprinus carpio var. specularis) as a model, we investigated the interactive effects of social conditions (isolation-rearing vs group-rearing, including a transition from isolation to group-rearing) and food availability (low: one satiation meal every 2 days; high: two satiation meals per day) on growth, behavioral traits, stress (cortisol), immunity (immunoglobulin M, lysozyme), and oxidative stress (superoxide dismutase) over a 6-week experiment comprising two 3-week phases. High food availability consistently promoted greater growth, while the effect of social conditions on growth depended on food availability and developmental stage. Among behavioral traits, activity was influenced by social conditions, boldness by food availability, and sociability remained stable. Physiologically, social isolation was associated with elevated serum cortisol levels irrespective of food availability, reflecting enhanced acute stress responsiveness, and the elevated cortisol response observed in isolated fish was not evident after return to group rearing. Immune parameters (IgM and lysozyme) were suppressed by social isolation, while food availability enhanced IgM and SOD activity; however, post-hoc comparisons did not provide direct statistical support for recovery of IgM or lysozyme after return to group rearing, and the reversibility of these effects therefore remains uncertain. By simultaneously assessing growth, behavior, and multiple physiological systems, this study provides novel insights into the adaptive capacity of social fish species facing changes in both social environment and resource abundance.
papers.summary_cn: 以镜鲤（Cyprinus carpio var. specularis）为模型，开展为期6周、分两个3周阶段的实验，考察社会条件（隔离饲养、群体饲养及隔离后转入群体）与食物可获得性（低：每2天一次饱食；高：每天两次饱食）对生长、行为、皮质醇、免疫（IgM、溶菌酶）及氧化应激（SOD）的交互影响。高食物可获得性持续促进生长，而社会条件对生长的影响取决于食物水平与发育阶段；活动性受社会条件影响，胆量受食物可获得性影响，社会性保持稳定。社会隔离伴随血清皮质醇升高且不受食物水平影响，返回群体饲养后该升高消失；隔离抑制IgM与溶菌酶，食物可获得性提升IgM与SOD活性，但事后比较未对返回群体后IgM或溶菌酶的恢复提供直接统计支持，其可逆性仍不确定。

papers.title: Anthropogenic Contaminants in Commercial Fish from Brazil and Mozambique: µ-Raman Characterization and Market-Associated Distribution Patterns
papers.authors: Taque, Manuel; Greco, Roberto; Macarringue, Lucrêncio Silvestre; Cossa, Isabel; Ribeiro, Maria Carolina Hernandez; Siegle, Eduardo; Silva, Ana Caroline Moura da; Freitas, Anderson Zanardi de; Ferreira, Anderson Targino da Silva; Wetter, Niklaus Ursus
papers.abstract: Contaminants in commercially important fish provide relevant information on environmental exposure in coastal urban systems. This study investigated materials detected in the gastrointestinal tracts of croaker (Micropogonias furnieri) and horse mackerel (Trachurus trachurus) marketed in Santos, Brazil, and Maputo, Mozambique, integrating microscopy combined with Raman spectroscopy (µ-Raman), frequency analysis, and correspondence analysis with market categories and market-associated socioeconomic profiles. µ-Raman analysis included 68 spectral acquisitions, yielding 124 component assignments, including carbonaceous materials, synthetic polymers, cellulosic materials, pigments, dyes, and other chemical signatures. Carbon and graphite were the most frequent components, while polyethylene terephthalate (PET) and polyester-related materials predominated among synthetic polymers. Both study areas showed comparable spectral-occurrence patterns, particularly for PET, graphite, and cellulosic materials. Global chi-square tests showed no statistically significant dependence between material occurrence and either market categories or socioeconomic profiles. However, adjusted standardized residuals and correspondence analysis revealed localized distributional patterns involving specific materials and market categories, which should be interpreted as exploratory rather than causal relationships. Integrating µ-Raman spectroscopy and multivariate analysis provides a useful framework for characterizing chemically diverse materials associated with gastrointestinal exposure in commercially important fish. Nevertheless, their occurrence in gastrointestinal tissues provides evidence of environmental exposure and may be relevant to ecological risk, which requires dedicated toxicological assessment. Because we analyzed only gastrointestinal tissues, the findings do not demonstrate contamination of edible muscle tissues, human dietary exposure, or health risk.
papers.summary_cn: 对巴西桑托斯与莫桑比克马普托市售白姑鱼（Micropogonias furnieri）和竹荚鱼（Trachurus trachurus）胃肠道内容物，以显微观察结合µ-Raman光谱（68次光谱采集、124个组分归属）、频率分析和对应分析，考察污染物组成及其与市场类别、社会经济特征的关联。检出组分包括碳质材料、合成聚合物、纤维素类、颜料和染料等，碳与石墨最常见，合成聚合物中以PET和聚酯类为主，两地区光谱出现模式相近。卡方检验未发现材料出现与市场类别或社会经济特征存在显著依赖，但调整标准化残差与对应分析提示局部关联，属探索性结果；胃肠道检出仅反映环境暴露，不能证明可食肌肉污染或人群膳食风险。

papers.title: Comparative quality assessment and consumer acceptance of farmed and wild Indian Major Carps: implications for aquaculture management
papers.authors: Haider, Muhammad Zeshan; Iqbal, Khalid Javed; Bilal Malik, Hafiz Muhammad; Atta, Ayesha; Majeed, Hamid; Iqbal, Khalid Jamshed; Ishaq, Muhammad; Abaid-Ullah, Muhammad
papers.abstract: Aquaculture and inland capture fisheries both contribute substantially to food security, yet market acceptance is frequently constrained by consumer perceptions favoring wild-caught fish. This study evaluated the comparative proximate composition, sensory profiles, and consumer preferences for three commercially important Indian Major Carps ( Labeo rohita , Catla catla , and Cirrhinus mrigala ) sourced from wild-capture and pond-aquaculture systems to provide empirical evidence for product quality management. Thirty adult carps ( N = 30; n = 5 biological replicates per species per source) were analyzed for proximate composition (crude protein, crude fat, ash, and moisture) using standard analytical protocols and evaluated via two-way factorial ANOVA. Sensory attributes (color, flavor, juiciness, tenderness, oiliness, and overall acceptability) were assessed by 15 trained assessors (8 M:7 F) using a double-blind, randomized 9-point Hedonic scale and analyzed via non-parametric tests (Kruskal-Wallis H and Mann-Whitney U). A cross-sectional survey of 200 respondents (100 common consumers and 100 fishers) evaluated market preferences using Pearson’s Chi-Square (χ²) tests of independence. Two-way ANOVA revealed significant main effects of production source and species, along with a significant interaction for crude protein ( p = 0.001) and crude fat ( p < 0.001). Farmed carps exhibited pronounced lipid accumulation compared to wild fish, whereas wild carps deposited significantly higher protein and ash. Non-parametric sensory evaluation showed that wild-caught fish achieved significantly higher mean ranks across all attributes ( p < 0.05), with wild L. rohita scoring highest in flavor (8.46 ± 0.64) and overall acceptability (8.20 ± 0.95). Survey analysis indicated a predominant consumer preference for wild fish (61%) and identified L. rohita as the most preferred table species across both cohorts (χ² = 11.449, p = 0.010). Fishers reported significantly higher taste discrimination capacity than consumers (χ² = 6.490, p = 0.011). Wild-caught carps exhibited superior sensory palatability and leaner muscle profiles than farmed counterparts. These findings indicate that commercial aquaculture must optimize dietary formulations, minimize excessive lipid deposition, and manage pond water quality to bridge the sensory quality gap and enhance consumer acceptance of cultured carps.
papers.summary_cn: 比较了野生捕捞与池塘养殖的三种印度主要鲤（Labeo rohita、Catla catla、Cirrhinus mrigala）在近似组成、感官特征与消费者偏好上的差异，每种每来源5个生物学重复，并结合200人问卷调查。双因素方差分析显示，养殖鱼脂质蓄积显著更高，野生鱼蛋白质与灰分沉积更多，粗蛋白与粗脂肪存在显著来源×物种交互作用；非参数感官评价中野生鱼各属性排名均显著更优，野生L. rohita风味（8.46±0.64）与总体可接受度（8.20±0.95）最高。调查显示61%消费者偏好野生鱼，L. rohita为最受欢迎食用种，渔民较普通消费者的味觉辨别力显著更强。结果表明养殖鲤鱼需优化饲料配方、抑制过度脂质沉积并改善池塘水质，以缩小感官品质差距、提升养殖鱼市场接受度。

papers.title: Emerging Technologies for Sustainable Aquaculture: Resource Efficiency, Biological Resilience and Implementation Trade-offs
papers.authors: Precious, NWACHUKWU Ozoemena; Esther, KADIENE Uzoma; Samuel, EJOH Akpoyovware
papers.abstract: Aquaculture is central to aquatic-food supply, yet expansion can intensify pressures associated with feed ingredients, energy consumption, nutrient discharge, disease, biodiversity and unequal access to technology. Contemporary innovation encompasses recirculating aquaculture systems, biofloc and integrated multi-trophic production, precision sensing and artificial intelligence, alternative feeds, molecular health tools, and environmentally informed siting. Their sustainability implications cannot be established from technological novelty or production efficiency alone. This critical narrative review evaluates these approaches across biological performance, resource accounting, commercial feasibility, welfare, environmental effects and governance. Peer-reviewed literature and authoritative institutional evidence published principally from 2015 to 12 September 2026 were examined, alongside influential earlier work. The synthesis finds comparatively strong mechanistic evidence for controlled water treatment, nutrient transformation, selective breeding and established vaccination programmes, but greater uncertainty about their net benefits across complete production chains. Recirculation can reduce water withdrawals and permit effluent capture while increasing dependence on reliable electricity and treatment infrastructure. Biofloc and extractive co-culture can retain or recover nutrients, although their effects depend on suspended solids, microbial stability, species compatibility, harvesting and system boundaries. Digital methods improve observation and predictive capability, yet farm-scale prospective validation, transferability and independent cost-benefit assessments remain limited. Novel feed ingredients may ease pressure on forage fish without necessarily reducing land use, processing energy or nutrient competition. Evidence on seaweed-based carbon benefits and broad ecosystem services is particularly context dependent. The review proposes a decision framework in which technologies are compared against a realistic baseline using life-cycle impacts, nutrient budgets, health and welfare outcomes, economic resilience and distributive effects. Priority research involves multi-cycle commercial comparisons, interoperable monitoring, causal field evaluation and integrated environmental-economic appraisal. Sustainable aquaculture is therefore best advanced through context-specific combinations of technologies, rather than a universal ranking of ‘smart’ solutions.
papers.summary_cn: 综述评估循环水养殖、生物絮团、多营养层级综合养殖、精准传感与AI、替代饲料、分子健康工具及环境导向选址等技术在生物性能、资源核算、商业可行性、福利、环境效应与治理维度的表现，证据主要来自2015年至2026年9月的同行评审文献与权威机构报告。受控水处理、营养转化、选择育种和成熟疫苗接种方案的机制证据较强，但全产业链净效益不确定性大；循环水可减少取水并捕获尾水，却增加对电力与处理设施的依赖，生物絮团与提取性共养的营养保留效果取决于悬浮物、微生物稳定性、物种兼容性及系统边界。数字方法提升观测与预测能力，但农场尺度前瞻验证、可迁移性和独立成本效益评估仍有限，新型饲料原料可缓解鱼粉鱼油压力却未必降低土地利用、加工能耗或营养竞争。提出以生命周期影响、营养收支、健康福利、经济韧性与分配效应为维度的决策框架，强调可持续水产养殖应依赖情境化技术组合而非普适的“智能”方案排序。

papers.title: Empowering Rural Aquaculture Security: A Participatory CCTV Optimization and Capacity Building Strategy in BUMDes Marga Jaya, East Lampung
papers.authors: Liansyah, Afry; Aldayanti, Dania; Setyawan, Fauzan Dwi; Nurhasanah; Antoro, Damas Dwi
papers.abstract: Purpose: Rural Village-Owned Enterprises (BUMDes) operating aquaculture units often face severe financial vulnerabilities and loss of Village Native Income (PADes) due to recurring night-time fish poaching and asset theft. This study evaluates and optimizes the existing CCTV infrastructure at BUMDes Marga Jaya, East Lampung, through a participatory community empowerment framework. Method: Executed under a 40-day Thematic Community Service (KKN-T) program by ITS NU Lampung, this project combined descriptive qualitative case study methods with a 4-stage community engagement strategy involving socialization, participatory technical auditing, hands-on training for four primary BUMDes operators/guards, and SOP formalization. Practical Applications: The program successfully upgraded network configurations, eliminated blind spots, conducted mobile app training, established bi-weekly maintenance SOPs, and integrated off-grid UPS/solar planning approved through village development deliberations. Conclusion: Combining optimized real-time CCTV technology with intensive community capacity building achieved zero theft incidents, enhanced internal labor discipline, and established a scalable model demonstrating how higher education partnerships bridge the digital divide for rural enterprise sustainability.
papers.summary_cn: 针对东楠榜BUMDes Marga Jaya养殖单元夜间盗鱼与资产失窃导致村级收入损失的问题，通过40天KKN-T项目开展参与式案例研究，实施社会化、技术审计、四名操作人员实操培训与SOP制度化四阶段介入。项目优化了网络配置、消除监控盲区、完成手机端应用培训并建立双周维护SOP，同时将离网UPS/太阳能方案纳入村级发展规划审议。优化后的实时CCTV与社区能力建设相结合实现零盗损事件，并强化了内部劳动纪律，为高校合作弥合农村企业数字鸿沟提供了可推广模式。

papers.title: ISOLATION AND CHARACTERIZATION OF A POTENTIAL PROBIOTIC Bacillus thuringiensis FROM AN INTEGRATED AQUAPONIC SYSTEM FOR SUSTAINABLE AQUACULTURE
papers.authors: Terziev, Neven; Ürkü, Çiğdem
papers.abstract: The increasing demand for sustainable aquaculture has accelerated the search for probiotic microorganisms capable of improving fish health and reducing dependence on antibiotics. This study aimed to isolate, identify, and characterize potential probiotic bacteria from an integrated aquaponic system used for Nile tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) production. Bacterial isolates obtained from aquaponic water samples were identified using matrix-assisted laser desorption/ionization time-of-flight mass spectrometry (MALDI-TOF MS), and their probiotic potential was evaluated through assessment of antagonistic activity against fish pathogens, hemolytic activity, antibiotic susceptibility, biofilm formation, pH tolerance, bile salt tolerance, and extracellular enzyme production. Four bacterial species, namely Bacillus mycoides, Bacillus marisflavi, Bacillus thuringiensis, and Lactococcus lactis, were identified. Among these isolates, B. thuringiensis exhibited the most promising probiotic characteristics, showing strong antibacterial activity against Lactococcus garvieae with an inhibition zone of 2.32 ± 0.012 cm, while no inhibitory effect was observed against Aeromonas hydrophila or Aeromonas caviae. The isolate displayed γ-hemolytic (non-hemolytic) activity was susceptible to all tested antibiotics except intermediate susceptibility to kanamycin and showed no biofilm formation. In addition, B. thuringiensis demonstrated optimal growth at pH 5.0 (P
papers.summary_cn: 从循环水鱼菜共生系统（尼罗罗非鱼养殖）水样中经MALDI-TOF MS鉴定出4株细菌（Bacillus mycoides、B. marisflavi、B. thuringiensis、Lactococcus lactis），并评估其拮抗病原、溶血、药敏、生物膜形成、pH与胆盐耐受及胞外酶产生等益生潜力。B. thuringiensis表现最优：对Lactococcus garvieae抑菌圈达2.32±0.012 cm，对Aeromonas hydrophila和A. caviae无抑制作用；呈γ-溶血，除卡那霉素中度敏感外对所用抗生素均敏感，不形成生物膜，最适生长pH为5.0。

papers.title: Plastic Flows and Footprints in Norway’s Sea-Based Aquaculture Sector: A Material Flow Perspective
papers.authors: Deshpande, Paritosh C.; Ashaolu, Toluse Priscilla; Klingsheim, Karl
papers.abstract: Abstract Marine plastic pollution is an increasing environmental concern, yet aquaculture’s contribution remains poorly quantified despite its rapid expansion and reliance on plastic infrastructure. Limited data on plastic stocks, flows, losses, and end-of-life (EOL) management constrain effective mitigation and circularity strategies. This study presents a system-wide assessment of plastic use and management in Norway’s sea-based Atlantic salmon aquaculture industry. A static Material Flow Analysis (MFA), informed by data from equipment manufacturers, suppliers, operators, and waste-management stakeholders, quantifies plastic stocks and flows across equipment deployment, use, repair, replacement, environmental losses, and end-of-life treatment. The results indicate annual marine plastic losses of approximately 2737 t, corresponding to 1.2-1.7 kg per tonne of salmon produced. Feed pipes, walkway components, and consumable ropes dominate leakage. Approximately 37,400 t of end-of-life plastics are collected annually, with 42% directed to incineration with energy recovery, 22% landfilled, and limited recovery through recycling. These findings highlight substantial opportunities to strengthen collection, recycling, and resource recovery. This first comprehensive national-scale assessment establishes a quantitative baseline for monitoring and policy development. It demonstrates MFA’s utility for identifying leakage hotspots and supporting Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) and circular economy strategies to reduce plastic pollution from aquaculture.
papers.summary_cn: 挪威海基大西洋鲑养殖塑料物质流分析显示，年海洋塑料流失约2737 t，相当于每吨鲑鱼产量1.2–1.7 kg，饲料管道、走道部件和消耗性绳索为主要泄漏源；年收集废弃塑料约37,400 t，其中42%焚烧回收能量、22%填埋，回收再利用率有限。研究基于设备制造商、供应商、运营商及废弃物管理方数据构建静态MFA，首次建立国家尺度定量基线，识别泄漏热点，为EPR和循环经济策略提供依据。

papers.title: Morphological Traits of Rice Varieties with Low Methane Emission in Aquaculture Ponds
papers.authors: Wang, Mengjie; Yang, Tong; Bao, Ting; Li, Fengbo; Feng, Jinfei; Huang, Jianliang; Fang, Fuping
papers.abstract: Aquaculture ponds are an important anthropogenic source of CH4, and rice-fish co-culture has been proposed as a mitigation strategy; but the performance of different rice varieties in mitigating the CH4 emission from the ponds and the morphological traits of low-emission varieties remain unclear. A two-year (2024-2025) field experiment was conducted with three replicate ponds per treatment, each pond containing one plot of each variety; the plot served as the experimental unit. The six rice varieties were then compared for their effect on CH4 emission from aquaculture ponds. The results showed that co-culturing with different rice varieties significantly reduced CH4 emissions by 24.2-43.9% and 25.1-41.8% respectively in 2024 and 2025, compared with fish monoculture. Co-culturing with different rice varieties showed varying effects on CH4 emissions, and the rice variety ZGY1578 (Zhegengyou 1578) consistently showed the lowest CH4 emissions among the six varieties across both years. Accumulated CH4 emissions showed a negative correlation with the abundance of pmoA in the sediment and the radial oxygen loss (ROL) rate of rice roots and a positive correlation with plant-mediated CH4 emission, indicating that the variation among rice varieties was associated with methanotrophic abundance, root oxygen release and plant-mediated transport. Random forest analysis showed the highest variable importance of root number for predicting pmoA abundance, and root weight and root length were positively associated with ROL. Tiller number positively affected plant-mediated CH4 emission, whereas root number and root weight decreased it. Rice varieties with well-developed root systems showed strong rhizospheric CH4 oxidation and low plant-mediated CH4 emission, while excessive tillering promoted plant-mediated CH4 emission. High ROL, dense root systems, and moderate tillering were associated with low-emission rice varieties. These findings provide a basis for breeding low-emission rice varieties to reduce CH4 emission from aquaculture ponds by constructing rice-fish co-culture systems.
papers.summary_cn: 稻鱼共作可降低养殖塘CH4排放，但不同水稻品种的减排效果及其形态性状基础尚不明确。两年田间试验比较6个水稻品种，发现共作较单养鱼塘减排24.2%–43.9%（2024）和25.1%–41.8%（2025），其中浙粳优1578两年均为最低排放品种。CH4累积排放与沉积物pmoA丰度及根系径向氧损失（ROL）负相关、与植株介导传输正相关；随机森林表明根数对pmoA丰度预测重要性最高，根重和根长与ROL正相关，分蘖数促进而根数和根重降低植株介导传输。根系发达、ROL高、分蘖适中的品种兼具强根际甲烷氧化和低植株传输，是低排放品种的关键形态特征。

papers.title: Sporothrix brasiliensis in Coastal and Marine Fishes: Implications for Marine-Terrestrial Spillover
papers.authors: Esperon, Bruna Muradás; Guerra Tenório, Bernardo; Poester, Vanice Rodrigues; Alarcão Bernardes, João Paulo Romualdo; Munhoz, Lívia Silveira; Bauer, Amanda; Gowert, Yan; Garcia, Alexandre Miranda; Rodrigues, Lucas; Virginia Marquez Marquez, Raquel
papers.abstract: Abstract Sporothrix brasiliensis is an emerging zoonotic fungal pathogen that has transformed sporotrichosis in Brazil from a sapronotic ‘gardener’s disease’ into a major zoonotic epidemic in South America. Here, ITS metabarcoding of 989 fish from coastal southern Brazil detected S. brasiliensis-compatible reads in 67.3% of pooled samples, and culture recovered viable isolates from selected samples. Genome typing placed fish-and bird-derived isolates within S. brasiliensis clinical Brazilian lineages, implicating aquatic-coastal interfaces in the ecology of this expanding pathogen.
papers.summary_cn: 对巴西南部沿海989尾鱼进行ITS宏条形码检测，67.3%的混合样本中检出与Sporothrix brasiliensis匹配的序列，并从部分样本中培养出活菌。基因组分型显示鱼源和鸟源分离株归属于巴西临床相关的S. brasiliensis谱系，提示水生—海岸界面可能参与该新兴人兽共患真菌病原体的生态循环与陆海溢出风险。

papers.title: Satellite-derived mesoscale fronts improve habitat modelling and explain neon flying squid distribution and abundance under decadal variability
papers.authors: Yang, Fuwei; Xing, Qinwang; Ito, Shin-ichi; Zhou, Jinxin; Yu, Haiqing; Yu, Wei; Chen, Xinjun
papers.journal: Reviews in Fish Biology and Fisheries
papers.abstract: Mesoscale fronts are ubiquitous oceanographic features that shape pelagic habitats through complex biophysical interactions, yet quantitative frontal indicators capturing front-induced biological hotspot and ecological barrier effects remain rarely incorporated into habitat models. We combined a satellite-based front-detection algorithm with a machine-learning approach to develop a “front-accounted habitat model” that integrates a suite of satellite-derived frontal indicators into conventional habitat modelling (only accounting for background environmental conditions). Using the neon flying squid, a commercially and ecologically important fishery stock in the western North Pacific, as a case study, the front-accounted habitat models increased $${\text{R}}^{2}$$ from 0.33 to 0.42-0.52 with relative increases of 27.5-58.4% and significantly reduced prediction errors by 2.3-15.3% relative to the conventional habitat models. Historical reconstructions of suitable habitat (areas with catches > 3 t) linked recent catch declines to habitat contraction and northward shifts, potentially associated with the post-2017 northward shift of intensified Western Oyashio Extension fronts that may have restricted productive subarctic water transport into the fishing grounds. During 1998-2023, the reconstructed habitat centroid shifted northward at 18.7 km decade-1, compared with 34.5 km decade-1 for the conventional model, highlighting the potential role of fronts in modulating habitat shifts under climate variability. These findings inform international squid management and offer a transferable framework for integrating frontal indicators into habitat models to improve habitat prediction and ecological interpretation.
papers.summary_cn: 将卫星中尺度锋面指标（热点效应与生态屏障效应）纳入传统栖息地模型，构建“锋面纳入型栖息地模型”，以西北太平洋重要经济头足类柔鱼为案例，结合卫星锋面检测算法与机器学习开展模拟。纳入锋面指标后模型 R² 由 0.33 提升至 0.42–0.52（相对提高 27.5–58.4%），预测误差较传统模型降低 2.3–15.3%。基于产量 >3 t 区域重建的适宜栖息地显示，近年渔获下降与栖息地收缩及北移相关，可能与 2017 年后 Western Oyashio Extension 锋面增强北移、限制亚寒带高生产力水体向渔场输送有关；1998–2023 年重建栖息地质心北移 18.7 km/十年，传统模型为 34.5 km/十年，提示锋面在气候变异下调节栖息地移动的作用。

papers.title: Laying Performance, Selected Yolk Fatty Acids, and Cholesterol in Hens Fed Diets Partially Replacing Soybean Meal and Fish Meal with Fermented Pangasius By-Product Extract
papers.authors: Abun, Abun; Haetami, Kiki; Mulki, Munir Alinu; Ramdhan, Rahmad Fani; Saefulhadjar, Deny; Rusmana, Denny
papers.abstract: Fermented Pangasius by-products may replace conventional feed ingredients, but such substitutions alter several dietary nutrients simultaneously. We compared laying performance, egg quality, yolk cholesterol, selected fatty acids, and hematology in 150 Hisex Brown hens allocated to 30 cages (five replicate cages per diet) during a 60-day trial. Diets comprised a basal control (P0), four formulations containing 0.5-2.0% fermented Pangasius by-product extract with sugar-palm starch as partial replacement for soybean meal and fish meal (P1-P4), and a pigment-reference diet (P5). Cage-level outcomes were assessed by one-way ANOVA and Tukey comparisons. Hen-day egg production differed among diets (p = 0.0053): P3 (79.76%) and P4 (80.36%) exceeded P0 (61.91%). Feed conversion did not differ significantly (p = 0.294). Mean yolk cholesterol was 1384.1 mg/100 g dry matter in P0 and 995.6 mg/100 g in P4. The final worksheet identified EPA, DHA, linoleic acid, and oleic acid as measured; ALA and arachidonic acid were estimated and excluded from measured outcomes. Derived group omega totals and yolk n-6: n-3 ratios were withdrawn. Because the substitution changed multiple diet components, findings describe complete-diet associations, not an isolated ingredient effect or an optimal inclusion level.
papers.summary_cn: 用发酵巴沙鱼副产物提取物（0.5%–2.0%）配合糖棕淀粉部分替代豆粕和鱼粕，饲喂150只Hisex Brown蛋鸡60天，比较产蛋性能、蛋品质、蛋黄胆固醇、脂肪酸及血液指标。P3、P4组产蛋率（79.76%、80.36%）显著高于对照组P0（61.91%，p=0.0053），饲料转化率无显著差异；P4组蛋黄胆固醇（995.6 mg/100 g DM）低于P0（1384.1 mg/100 g DM）。由于替代同时改变多种日粮组分，结果仅反映全日粮关联，不能归因于单一成分效应或确定最佳添加水平。

papers.title: Catch performance of biodegradable PLA gillnets in a mixed-species fishery in the Yellow Sea, China
papers.authors: Yu, Mengjie; Herrmann, Bent; Zhang, Hanfei; Tang, Yanli
papers.journal: Reviews in Fish Biology and Fisheries
papers.abstract: Derelict gillnets have received increasing attention worldwide due to ghost fishing and marine plastic pollution. Biodegradable gillnets have been proposed as a promising technical approach to mitigate these impacts, but their fishing performance must be fully evaluated before practical application in commercial fisheries. In this study, we systematically assessed the performance of biodegradable polylactic acid (PLA) gillnets relative to conventional polyamide (PA) gillnets in a mixed-species fishery in the Yellow Sea of China, by evaluating length-dependent catch efficiency, capture mode probability, capture-mode-specific catch efficiency, catch composition, and catch value. Overall, PLA gillnets showed significantly lower catch efficiency than PA gillnets for target species, with length-integrated catch ratios of 71.83% for silver croaker (Pennahia argentata), 73.13% for flower croaker (Nibea albiflora), and 60.34% for swimming crab (Portunus trituberculatus). For the two fish species, gilling and wedging were the dominant capture modes, whereas all swimming crabs were captured by entangling. Mode-specific analysis showed that reductions in catch efficiency of PLA gillnets were smaller under gilling and wedging than under snagging and entangling, indicating the important role of capture mode in influencing fishing performance. Catch composition was broadly similar between PLA and PA gillnets; however, the gross catch value of PLA gillnets was approximately two-thirds of that of PA gillnets, mainly due to reduced catches of high-value target species, particularly swimming crab. These results demonstrated that PLA gillnets did not achieve equivalent catch performance under the tested configuration and conditions. However, broader spatiotemporal testing should be made before concluding on their catch performance.
papers.summary_cn: 在中国黄海混合种类渔场中，以长度相关捕捞效率、捕获方式概率、特定捕获方式效率、渔获组成和渔获价值为指标，系统比较了可生物降解聚乳酸（PLA）刺网与常规聚酰胺（PA）刺网的捕捞性能。PLA刺网对目标种类的捕捞效率显著低于PA刺网，长度整合捕捞比分别为银姑鱼（Pennahia argentata）71.83%、白姑鱼（Nibea albiflora）73.13%和三疣梭子蟹（Portunus trituberculatus）60.34%；两种鱼类以刺挂（gilling）和楔夹（wedging）为主要捕获方式，梭子蟹则全部为缠绕（entangling）捕获，且PLA刺网在刺挂和楔夹方式下的效率降幅小于缠绕和挂刺（snagging），表明捕获方式对捕捞性能有重要影响。两网具渔获组成大体相似，但PLA刺网总渔获价值约为PA刺网的三分之二，主要因高价值目标种类（尤其梭子蟹）渔获减少。结果表明，在受试配置和条件下PLA刺网未能达到与PA刺网同等的捕捞性能，但在对其捕捞性能下结论前仍需更广泛的时空验证。

papers.title: Cats in the dark: A review of our current knowledge of the deep-sea catshark genus Apristurus
papers.authors: Moore, Daniel M.; McNamara-Langton, Molly; Owen, Rachel
papers.abstract: Abstract The deep-sea catsharks in the genus Apristurus (Pentanchidae) constitute one of the most species-rich yet least resolved elasmobranch lineages. Herein, we utilised a systematic literature search to synthesise current knowledge on their diversity, morphology, phylogeny, distribution, ecology, reproduction and threats, and outline priorities for research aligned with the UN Decade of Ocean Science. The genus currently comprises 43 described extant species and three extinct taxa. Morphologically, Apristurus species share cephalic dorso-ventral compression, broad spatulate snouts and diagnostic labial-furrow states; meristics (including vertebral counts) and egg-capsule morphology provide additional taxonomic signal. Morphological ratios and fin shapes are also valuable for identification. Phylogenetic evidence generally supports monophyly of the genus and recovery of three species groups ( brunneus, spongiceps, longicephalus ), although some recent morphology-led hypotheses warrant further genomic testing. Apristurus is circumglobal (excluding polar seas and the Mediterranean), occupies depths ca. 24-2652 m and functions primarily as a generalist mesopredator, with region- and species-specific trophic specialisation. Reproductive ecology is oviparous; egg capsules commonly aggregate on structurally complex substrates (e.g., sponges and corals) where local hydrodynamics likely enhance embryonic ventilation. Fossil egg cases at cold seeps indicate long-standing associations with complex deep-sea habitats. Major threats to the genus arise from deep-sea trawl bycatch and emerging seabed industries. Threats are exacerbated by genus life-history traits (prolonged development, low fecundity) which imply high sensitivity, though many species remain listed as Least Concern owing to a paucity of data due to the depths at which the genus lives. Key research gaps identified include the need for a robust, integrative taxonomy; publicly accessible genetic reference libraries; in situ behavioural and life-history observations; quantification of bycatch and post-release mortality; and assessment of climate and mining impacts on nursery habitats. We provide a consolidated baseline of information to assist with accelerated discovery, identification and conservation of Apristurus across its global range.
papers.summary_cn: 深海猫鲨属 Apristurus 是物种最丰富却分类最混乱的板鳃类之一，现生种43个、灭绝种3个。该属全球分布（不含极地和地中海），栖息深度约24–2652 m，形态上以头部背腹扁平和铲状吻部为特征，系统发育证据支持其单系性及brunneus、spongiceps、longicephalus三个种组。该属为卵生，卵囊常聚集于海绵、珊瑚等复杂基质上，主要威胁来自深海拖网兼捕和海底新兴产业，其长发育期、低繁殖力等生活史特征加剧了敏感性，但因数据匮乏多数种仍列为Least Concern。研究缺口包括整合分类学、公开遗传参考库、原位行为观察、兼捕与放归死亡率量化及气候与采矿对育幼生境影响的评估。

papers.title: Genetic Basis of Feeding Habit Domestication Difficulty in Mandarin Fish (Siniperca chuatsi) Revealed by Brain Transcriptome and Whole-Genome Resequencing
papers.authors: Tang, Shoujie; Yue, Yichao; Cao, Lu; Zhang, Minbo; Chen, Jiahe; Zhao, Jinliang
papers.abstract: Mandarin fish (Siniperca chuatsi) refuse artificial diets, but some individuals can be domesticated. To identify candidate molecular pathways and preliminary genomic loci associated with feed domestication difficulty, we compared easily domesticable (group T) and difficult-to-domesticate (group W) mandarin fish using brain transcriptome sequencing (n = 15 per group) and whole-genome resequencing (n = 30 per group). Transcriptome analysis identified 761 differentially expressed genes (DEGs), with down-regulated genes predominating in group T. Gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) revealed nominally significant positive enrichment of neurotransmitter transporter activity, sodium symporter activity, and Wnt signaling in group T, while cytokine-cytokine receptor interaction was down-regulated. Weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA) identified the MEtan module as negatively correlated with growth-performance traits associated with domestication outcome and enriched in nucleosome, chromatin, and protein-DNA complex. Resequencing yielded 2,650,994 high-quality single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs), with intergroup differential SNPs annotated to 14,956 genes. Multi-omics integration prioritized 32 candidate genes across neural signaling/transport, chromatin/nucleosome, immune/inflammation, steroid/lipid metabolism, and cell structure/other; core candidates included slc1a5, gpr84, olfml2bb, and histone family genes. Notably, SNPs in gpr84 and olfml2bb showed nominal differences between groups. These findings suggest that enhanced neurotransmitter recycling and synaptic plasticity, lower neuroimmune activation, and chromatin regulation are associated with feed domestication success, providing preliminary candidate loci that require validation in larger, independent populations and should not yet be regarded as established markers for marker-assisted selection in easily domesticable mandarin fish.
papers.summary_cn: 鳜（Siniperca chuatsi）拒食人工饲料但部分个体可被驯化，该研究以易驯化组（T）与难驯化组（W）为对象，分别进行脑转录组测序（每组n=15）和全基因组重测序（每组n=30），以筛选与摄食驯化难度相关的候选分子通路和基因组位点。转录组鉴定出761个差异表达基因（DEG），T组以下调基因为主；GSEA显示T组神经递质转运体活性、钠同向转运体活性及Wnt信号呈名义显著正富集，而细胞因子-细胞因子受体互作下调；WGCNA识别出MEtan模块与驯化相关生长性能性状负相关，富集于核小体、染色质和蛋白-DNA复合物。重测序获得2,650,994个高质量SNP，组间差异SNP注释到14,956个基因，多组学整合优先筛选出32个候选基因，涉及神经信号/转运、染色质/核小体、免疫/炎症、类固醇/脂质代谢及细胞结构等，核心候选包括slc1a5、gpr84、olfml2bb和组蛋白家族基因，其中gpr84和olfml2bb的SNP在组间呈名义差异。结果提示神经递质再循环与突触可塑性增强、神经免疫激活降低及染色质调控与摄食驯化成功相关，

papers.title: Muscle Transcriptome Analysis Identifies Eno3 as a Candidate Gene Associated with Rapid Growth in Foxface Rabbitfish (Siganus vulpinus)
papers.authors: Ren, Yuanhao; Yue, Yanfeng; Liu, Chuang; Zhai, Xinfeng; Li, Saishuai; Jia, Xiaojuan; Ye, Bingcong; Shen, Fengyuan; Wei, Cun; Jiang, Keji
papers.abstract: Growth rate represents a core economic trait that determines both aquaculture production performance and market value of the foxface rabbitfish (Siganus vulpinus). However, the molecular mechanisms underlying growth variation in this species remain largely uncharacterized. In this study, full-sibling S. vulpinus individuals reared under identical controlled conditions were stratified into a rapid-growth (RG) and a slow-growth (SG) group based on growth performance, and skeletal muscle transcriptome sequencing was conducted to identify growth-related candidate genes. A total of 24,036 expressed genes were detected across both groups, with 13,663 genes co-expressed in the two groups. Differential expression analysis revealed 707 differentially expressed genes (DEGs), including 329 upregulated and 378 downregulated genes in the RG group relative to the SG group. GO and KEGG enrichment analyses showed that these DEGs were primarily enriched in biological processes associated with energy metabolism, protein turnover, amino acid metabolism, cytoskeletal organization, and muscle structural maintenance. Notably, the glycolysis/gluconeogenesis pathway was significantly overrepresented, implying that carbohydrate metabolism and ATP provision are key contributors to muscle growth variation in S. vulpinus. Within the DEG set, S. vulpinus Eno3 was significantly upregulated in the RG group and identified as a core gene implicated in the glycolysis/gluconeogenesis pathway. Bioinformatic characterization demonstrated that S. vulpinus Eno3 harbors a 1305 bp open reading frame (ORF) encoding 435 amino acids, and possesses the canonical conserved structural features of the enolase protein family. Phylogenetic analysis, conserved motif identification, functional domain annotation, and multiple sequence alignment collectively confirmed that S. vulpinus Eno3 is evolutionarily conserved and likely functions as a β-enolase isoform involved in glycolytic regulation. These findings indicate that S. vulpinus Eno3 may contribute to rapid muscle growth by modulating glycolytic flux, ATP generation, and metabolic intermediate availability. Collectively, this study provides valuable candidate gene resources and a theoretical foundation for deciphering the molecular mechanisms underlying growth variation, and supports the future development of molecular breeding programs for S. vulpinus.
papers.summary_cn: 以同父同母、相同养殖条件下的狐篮子鱼（Siganus vulpinus）为材料，按生长性能分为快长组（RG）与慢长组（SG），对骨骼肌进行转录组测序以筛选生长相关候选基因。共检测到24,036个表达基因，两组共表达13,663个，差异表达基因707个（RG组上调329个、下调378个），主要富集于能量代谢、蛋白质周转、氨基酸代谢、细胞骨架组织及肌肉结构维持等通路，其中糖酵解/糖异生通路显著富集。Eno3在RG组显著上调并为该通路核心基因，其ORF长1305 bp、编码435个氨基酸，具烯醇化酶家族保守结构特征，系统发育与序列比对支持其为参与糖酵解调控的β-烯醇化酶同源体。结果提示Eno3可能通过调节糖酵解通量、ATP生成及代谢中间产物供给促进肌肉快速生长，为狐篮子鱼生长性状分子机制解析与分子育种提供了候选基因资源。

papers.title: Evaluating Direct Marking Methods for Gillnets Under South Korea’s Fishing Gear Deposit System: A Multi-Criteria Decision Framework
papers.authors: Shin, Chae-eun; Park, Subong
papers.abstract: Abandoned, lost, or otherwise discarded fishing gear (ALDFG) poses persistent environmental and management challenges. This study evaluated six direct gillnet marking methods and four gear-accounting units for South Korea’s fishing gear deposit system. The marking-type assessment combined previously derived AHP weights, preferences from 145 fishers and eight gear companies, and detachment observations from 1856 markings on nine net panels. At a common two-cycle endpoint, the textile double-sided tape fiber label ranked first (0.829), followed by the ultrasonic-welded (0.823) and gel-type tape labels (0.817). Using each gillnet’s last available observation changed the leading method to ultrasonic welding (0.718), while excluding swimming crab observations changed it to the gel-type label. For marking units, net-panel ranked first under equal expert-stakeholder weighting, whereas expert AHP alone favored weight. The results identify context-specific candidates for further field testing, not universally superior technologies or evidence of deposit-system effectiveness.
papers.summary_cn: 研究评估韩国渔具押金制度下6种刺网直接标记方法与4种渔具核算单元，综合AHP权重、145名渔民和8家渔具企业偏好，以及9块网片1856个标记的脱落观测。在统一两周期终点下，纺织双面胶纤维标签得分最高（0.829），其次为超声波焊接（0.823）和凝胶型胶带标签（0.817）；改用各网最后可得观测后超声波焊接居首（0.718），剔除三疣梭子蟹观测后凝胶型标签领先。标记单元在专家—利益相关者等权下网片居首，仅用专家AHP则重量优先；结果为情境特异的候选方案，需进一步野外测试，并非普适最优技术或押金制度有效性的证据。

papers.title: Combinatorial Regulation of cyp19a1 Transcription by Ad4bp/Sf-1, Foxl2 and Foxl3 Paralogs and Fsh Signaling in Japanese Eel (Anguilla japonica)
papers.authors: Nakase, Hidefumi; Horiuchi, Moemi; Kazeto, Yukinori; Ijiri, Shigeho
papers.abstract: Aromatase (Cyp19a1), which converts testosterone to 17β-estradiol, plays a critical role in ovarian differentiation in teleosts. However, the transcriptional mechanisms regulating cyp19a1 during gonadal sex differentiation in Japanese eel (Anguilla japonica) remain unclear. We investigated the effects of Adrenal 4 binding protein/Steroidogenic factor 1 (Ad4bp/Sf-1) and Forkhead box L2 (Foxl2) and Foxl3 paralogs, and follicle-stimulating hormone (Fsh) signaling on cyp19a1 transcription using luciferase reporter assays in HEK293T and JTC-35 cells. Ad4bp/Sf-1, Foxl2a, or Fsh signaling alone did not activate the full-length (-5292/+38) cyp19a1 5′-flanking region, whereas combinations of these factors increased transcriptional activity. The simultaneous presence of Ad4bp/Sf-1, Foxl2a, and Fsh signaling produced the highest transcriptional activity in HEK293T cells. Co-transfection of Foxl2b with Foxl2a tended to reduce relative luciferase luminescence compared with Foxl2a alone, whereas Foxl3a and Foxl3b showed transcriptional activation potential under the experimental conditions used. Foxl3a, in particular, exhibited markedly high transcriptional activity in both cell lines despite the testis-biased expression of foxl3a and foxl3b in vivo. Deletion analysis showed that factor-dependent activation was markedly reduced by deletion to -847/+38 and abolished when the -847/+38 region was removed. Putative Ad4bp/Sf-1 and Foxl2 binding sites and a cAMP-responsive element were identified within this proximal region, suggesting that it may contribute to transcriptional responses to multiple regulatory factors.
