These findings provide insights into the potential combinatorial regulation of the Japanese eel cyp19a1 promoter and the distinct transcriptional regulatory properties of Foxl2 and Foxl3 paralogs under heterologous reporter assay conditions.
papers.summary_cn: 日本鳗鲡性腺分化中芳香化酶基因cyp19a1的转录调控机制尚不清楚，该研究用荧光素酶报告基因法在HEK293T和JTC-35细胞中检测Ad4bp/Sf-1、Foxl2a/b、Foxl3a/b及Fsh信号对cyp19a1启动子（-5292/+38）的单独与组合作用。单因子均不能激活全长启动子，而Ad4bp/Sf-1、Foxl2a与Fsh信号联合转录活性最高；Foxl3a在两种细胞中均表现强激活潜力，尽管foxl3a/b在体内呈精巢偏向表达。缺失分析显示-847/+38近端区域含Ad4bp/Sf-1、Foxl2结合位点及CRE，是多重调控因子响应的关键区。

papers.title: Hepatic Lipid Profiles, Elongase Expression and Gut Microbiota in Rainbow Trout Fed Marine and Plant Oils
papers.authors: Azcuy, Rosendo L.; Villasante, Alejandro; Ramírez, Carolina; Casaretto, Matías E.; Morales, Gabriel A.; Dantagnan, Patricio; Romero, Jaime
papers.abstract: Replacing fish oil (FO) in salmonid feeds alters long-chain polyunsaturated fatty acid (LC-PUFA) supply, but the combined effects on hepatic fatty acids, elongase expression and gut microbiota are poorly known when the lipid source is the only dietary variable. Juvenile rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss) were fed for 60 days on six low-fishmeal (10%) diets with FO, shrimp by-product oil (SH), camelina oil (CO), canola oil (CA), or blends SHCA (25% SH + 75% CA) and COCA (25% CO + 75% CA), with three tanks per diet. Hepatic fatty acids, elovl2 and elovl5 expression and distal intestinal microbiota were analyzed; growth and fillet lipid data from the same fish and tanks were reported separately. Hepatic DHA was highest with SH and FO, whereas CA raised oleic and arachidonic acids. elovl5 expression differed among diets (p
papers.summary_cn: 以低鱼粉（10%）饲料投喂幼虹鳟60天，比较鱼油、虾副产物油、亚麻荠油、菜籽油及其混合油（SHCA、COCA）作为唯一脂肪源变量时对肝脏脂肪酸、延长酶表达和肠道菌群的影响。虾油和鱼油组肝脏DHA最高，菜籽油提高油酸和花生四烯酸；elovl5表达在饲料间存在差异。

papers.title: Bryophyte substrates and environmental filtering in structuring epibryophytic diatom communities of karst springs
papers.authors: Șuteu, Anca-Mihaela; Goia, Irina; Pușcaș, Mihai
papers.abstract: The aim of this study was to evaluate whether bryophyte host identity and growth form influence epibryophytic diatom assemblages beyond the effect of environmental filtering in karst springs. We hypothesized that environmental variables would remain the primary drivers of community structure, while bryophyte-related effects would be detectable at finer taxonomic or functional levels. Epibryophytic diatom assemblages from karst springs in the Apuseni Mountains (Romania) were analysed using taxonomic, diversity and functional approaches. Oven-dried material from whole bryophyte tufts was processed to obtain cleaned diatom samples. Bryophyte identity accounted for part of the compositional variation, but no consistent effects were detected when analyses were restricted to adequately replicated hosts or when permutations were constrained within springs. Similarly, bryophyte growth form did not significantly influence diatom community composition or ecological guild structure. However, environmental variables significantly structured diatom assemblages at the spring level, with water temperature and canopy cover emerging as the main predictors. Assemblages were consistently dominated by low-profile guild taxa, suggesting adaptation to hydrodynamic stress and continuously flowing conditions. Overall, the results indicate that environmental filtering represents the primary driver of epibryophytic diatoms in karst springs, whereas bryophyte host identity exerts a limited detectable influence under relatively homogeneous carbonate conditions.
papers.summary_cn: 在罗马尼亚Apuseni山区喀斯特泉中，以分类学、多样性和功能性状方法分析苔藓附生硅藻群落，检验苔藓宿主身份与生长型是否在环境过滤之外影响群落结构。结果显示苔藓身份仅解释部分组成变异，在限制于重复充分的宿主或泉内置换检验时效应不一致，生长型对群落组成和生态功能群结构均无显著影响；而水温与林冠盖度是泉尺度群落结构的主要预测因子，群落始终以低矮型（low-profile）功能群为主，反映对水动力胁迫和持续流条件的适应。结论认为环境过滤是喀斯特泉苔藓附生硅藻群落的首要驱动因素，在相对均一的碳酸盐条件下苔藓宿主身份的 detectable 影响有限。

papers.title: A qPCR-based environmental DNA monitoring protocol for the multi-species detection of freshwater endangered and alien species
papers.authors: Giovacchini, Simone; Mirone, Enrico; Bruno, Antonia; Ramazzotti, Fausto; Caprotti, Luca; Monaco, Pamela; Belluardo, Francesco; Di Febbraro, Mirko; Jamwal, Pushpinder S.; Manfrin, Chiara
papers.abstract: Environmental DNA (eDNA) is a sensitive tool to detect rare and elusive species, including both endangered species and invasive alien species (IAS) at early stages of colonization. We aimed to i) design and test a quantitative PCR eDNA protocol for the detection of 22 freshwater species of conservation concern belonging to five phyla, ii) identify environmental factors influencing species detection, and iii) assess the cost-effectiveness of eDNA-based monitoring versus traditional survey methods. Target species included 14 endangered species listed in the Habitats Directive 92/43/EEC and eight IAS listed under the EU Regulation 1143/2014 potentially occurring in Central Italy. Thirteen assays were newly developed. Water samples were collected at 53 sampling sites. Relationships between eDNA species detection and 25 fine- and large-scale environmental variables were explored through principal component analysis. We detected 18 of the 22 target species, with highest detection rates for fish, amphibians, molluscs, and mammals. For four species, detection was significantly associated with environmental factors. Compared with traditional methods, eDNA monitoring was faster ( < 46% of time), more cost-effective ( < 88% of costs), and more accurate ( + 49 new occurrences). Our results demonstrate the high potential of qPCR-based eDNA for large-scale freshwater biodiversity monitoring.
papers.summary_cn: 针对中意大利可能出现的22种淡水物种（14种Habitats Directive保护濒危种、8种EU Regulation 1143/2014外来入侵种，涵盖5个门），设计并测试了qPCR eDNA检测方案，其中13个检测体系为新开发，在53个采样点采集水样，并用主成分分析探讨eDNA检出与25个不同尺度环境变量的关系。22种目标物种中检出18种，鱼类、两栖类、软体动物和哺乳类检出率最高，4个物种的检出与环境因子显著相关。与传统的调查方法相比，eDNA监测用时不足其46%、成本不足其88%，且多记录49个新分布点，准确性更高，表明qPCR-based eDNA在大尺度淡水生物多样性监测中潜力很大。

papers.title: Numerical Investigation of Hydrodynamic Separation Performance for Low-Density-Differential Solid Waste in Recirculating Aquaculture Wastewater
papers.authors: Rahman, Aulia; Habiburrahman, Novan; Rahmawati, Aulia
papers.journal: Journal of Mechanical Engineering Science and Technology (JMEST)
papers.abstract: The escalation of production capacity within the aquaculture sector triggers an accumulation of solid waste that degrades water quality, a condition establishing fundamental operational constraints for conventional mechanical filtration systems in recirculating aquaculture systems. Hydrocyclone separators emerge as a promising economically viable technological alternative; however, investigations regarding their specific optimization for managing fishery particulates with low density margins remain profoundly limited. This computational investigation implements a computational fluid dynamics framework, coupling the Reynolds stress model with the discrete phase model, to quantify the separation performance of a modified hydrocyclone design across ten variations of inlet flow rates. Through validation against benchmark data, the simulation outputs reveal that the degree of vortex maturity is absolutely governed by the fluid injection velocity. The minimum flow rate proves inadequate to construct a coherent forced vortex core, whereas the maximum flow condition conversely generates a dual peak Rankine vortex structure manifesting spatial asymmetry. In stark contrast to fundamental theoretical probabilities, the cumulative separation efficacy exhibits a negative correlation with increasing flow rates, characterized by an efficiency degradation from 72% to 64%. This physical reality confirms that an inlet momentum exceeding the optimal threshold escalates local turbulence and reduces particle retention duration, which in turn comprehensively disrupts the effectiveness of the centrifugal separation mechanism.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究采用CFD方法（Reynolds应力模型耦合离散相模型）模拟改良型旋流分离器在10种进水流量下对循环水养殖废水中低密度差固体废弃物的分离性能。结果表明，涡流成熟度受进水流速控制，最低流量无法形成连贯强制涡核，最高流量则产生空间不对称的双峰Rankine涡结构。与理论预期相反，分离效率随流量增加呈负相关，从72%降至64%，原因在于过高的入口动量加剧局部湍流并缩短颗粒滞留时间，从而破坏离心分离机制。

papers.title: eDNA Metabarcoding and Population Genomics of Commercially Important Marine Fish for Biodiversity Assessment and Sustainable Fisheries Management Along the Pakistan Coast
papers.authors: Khan, Ilman; Mairaj, Mushaiyada; Shaikh, Wajiha
papers.journal: Kashmir Journal of Academic Research and Development
papers.abstract: The northern Arabian Sea along Pakistan's 1,001 km coastline represents a biologically productive yet increasingly threatened marine ecosystem, supporting over 500 cataloged fish species of substantial commercial and ecological importance. Escalating anthropogenic pressures, including overfishing, illegal, unreported, and unregulated (IUU) fishing, habitat degradation, and the intensifying Arabian Sea Oxygen Minimum Zone (OMZ), have severely altered fish community structures and precipitated declines in key commercial stocks. Traditional monitoring approaches, reliant on catch landings, net trawling, and morphological taxonomy, are constrained by phenotypic plasticity, cryptic speciation, specimen damage, and an inability to identify early life stages or processed products. This review synthesizes the transformative potential of two complementary molecular technologies environmental DNA (eDNA) metabarcoding and population genomics for biodiversity assessment and sustainable fisheries management along the Pakistan coast. eDNA metabarcoding enables non-invasive, high-throughput, multi-taxa community profiling through mitochondrial markers (COI, Cyt b, 12S/16S rRNA), facilitating detection of elusive, endangered, and cryptic species, including remnant sawfish populations and coral-associated assemblages in Astola Island MPA. Population genomics, leveraging SNPs and mitochondrial sequencing, resolves stock boundaries, genetic diversity, and demographic histories, revealing distinct Evolutionary Significant Units in silver pomfret (Pampus argenteus) and genetic connectivity patterns in Spanish mackerel (Scomberomorus commerson). Integrated applications extend to seafood traceability via DNA-based QR codes, IUU fishing detection, and Blue Economy policy alignment with SDG 14. Key challenges include eDNA degradation under high temperatures, PCR bias, incomplete regional reference databases, and infrastructural capacity gaps. Strategic multi-institutional partnerships and sustained investment are essential for operational implementation, offering a paradigm shift toward resilient, evidence-based fisheries governance in Pakistan.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述旨在评估eDNA metabarcoding与population genomics两种互补分子技术在巴基斯坦海岸生物多样性评估和可持续渔业管理中的应用潜力。eDNA metabarcoding通过线粒体标记（COI、Cyt b、12S/16S rRNA）实现非侵入性、高通量群落分析，可检测隐存种和濒危物种；population genomics利用SNPs解析stock boundaries和遗传多样性，在银鲳（Pampus argenteus）中识别出独立进化显著单元，在康氏马鲛（Scomberomorus commerson）中揭示遗传连通性。整合应用可延伸至海产品溯源、IUU fishing检测及蓝色经济政策对接，但面临eDNA高温降解、PCR偏差和区域参考数据库不完整等挑战。

papers.title: Size-Related Patterns of Hyperostosis in the Carangid Fish OLIGOPLITES PALOMETA (Cuvier, 1832)
papers.authors: Henriques, Alice Barbosa; de Sá, Alice Miranda Cardoso; Ferreira, Camila Vitória Gonçalves; dos Santos, Davi Abrahão Lettieri; D’Almeida Lima, Ana Júlia Araújo Rosa; de Oliveira, Maykon Victor Rezende; Santana, Angélica Pereira Palace; Salomão, Márcia Carolina; Lavrado, Helena Passeri; Moreira, Cristiano Rangel
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Hyperostosis in wild fishes remains poorly documented and quantitative information on its size-related onset and anatomical distribution in Oligoplites palometa (Cuvier, 1832) is limited. We quantified hyperostosis prevalence and described its skeletal distribution across size classes in O. palometa from two estuarine systems on the coast of Rio de Janeiro, Brazil (Guanabara Bay and Sepetiba Bay). A total of 31 specimens ranging from 45 to 510 mm TL were examined by radiography, followed by excision and morphometric analysis of the unaffected and affected bones. Hyperostosis was observed in all examined individuals ≥ 315 mm TL, whereas none was detected in specimens ≤ 82 mm. No individuals between 82 and 315 mm total length (TL) were available, limiting the assessment of the onset and progression of hyperostosis within this size range. Hyperostoses were detected in the cranium, cleithrum, dorsal pterygiophores and anal pterygiophores, with the cleithrum showing the highest prevalence (80.64%), followed by dorsal pterygiophores (77.41%), anal pterygiophores (67.7%) and cranium (61.29%). These findings indicate a consistent size-related pattern of skeletal involvement, highlighting the importance of population size structure when evaluating hyperostosis in wild fish populations.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在量化巴西里约热内卢沿岸两个河口系统中革鲹科鱼类 *Oligoplites palometa* 的骨质增生（hyperostosis）流行率及其与体长的关系。对31尾标本（45–510 mm TL）进行X射线检查及骨骼形态计量分析，发现所有≥315 mm TL个体均存在骨质增生，而≤82 mm个体均未检出。骨质增生见于颅骨、匙骨（cleithrum）、背鳍支鳍骨和臀鳍支鳍骨，以匙骨流行率最高（80.64%）。结果表明骨质增生具有明显的体长相关模式，评估野生鱼类种群骨质增生时需考虑种群规格结构。

papers.title: Increased Sodium Chloride Concentration Enhances Piscirickettsia salmonis Epithelial Translocation by Modulating Immune and Osmoregulatory Gene Expression in RTgutGC Cells
papers.authors: Suárez, Raibel; Pérez, Juan; Cárcamo, Diego; Santibáñez, Natacha; Escalona, Carla; Pérez, Tatiana; Vega, Matías; Oliver, Cristian; Romero, Alex
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Climate change is expected to increase seawater salinity, potentially altering the physiological responses of marine organisms. In salmonids, elevated salinity has been associated with outbreaks of infectious diseases; however, the mechanisms linking salinity with intestinal epithelial dysfunction and bacterial invasion remain poorly understood. This study evaluated the effects of increased sodium chloride concentrations on the integrity of the rainbow trout intestinal epithelial cell line RTgutGC and its relationship with P. salmonis translocation. Cells cultured under control (8 g/L NaCl) or hyperosmotic conditions (16 and 20 g/L NaCl) were assessed for cytotoxicity, epithelial integrity, permeability, bacterial translocation, and gene expression. Hyperosmotic conditions significantly increased epithelial permeability and reduced barrier integrity, as evidenced by altered paracellular permeability to Dextran FITC and modulation of tight junction-related genes, including cld-3 and zo-1 . Salinity also induced the expression of osmoregulatory ( tsc22 and nka ) and immune-related genes ( il-1β and il-10 ), indicating activation of response to osmotic stress. Importantly, elevated salinity significantly enhanced the translocation of P. salmonis across the epithelial monolayer, whereas no bacterial translocation was detected under control conditions. Moreover, high salinity increased infection-associated cytotoxicity, mainly at 20 g/L NaCl. Together, these findings demonstrate that increased sodium chloride concentration compromises intestinal epithelial barrier function while promoting P. salmonis translocation. These results provide mechanistic evidence linking climate-driven changes in seawater salinity with increased epithelial susceptibility to bacterial pathogens and suggest that osmotic stress may represent an important environmental factor influencing the pathogenesis of piscirickettsiosis in salmonids.
papers.summary_cn: 高盐度（16、20 g/L NaCl）显著增加虹鳟肠道上皮细胞系RTgutGC的通透性、破坏紧密连接屏障（cld-3、zo-1表达改变），并激活渗透调节（tsc22、nka）与免疫相关基因（il-1β、il-10）表达。对照条件（8 g/L NaCl）下未检出细菌跨上皮转运，而高盐度显著促进Piscirickettsia salmonis跨单层上皮转运，并在20 g/L时加重感染相关细胞毒性。结果提示气候驱动的海水盐度升高可损害肠道屏障功能并增强上皮对细菌病原的易感性，为盐度影响鲑科鱼类piscirickettsiosis发病机制提供了机制证据。

papers.title: Procyanidin Suppresses Tilapia Lake Virus Replication and Confers Challenge Protection in Nile Tilapia Accompanied by Modulation of Innate Antiviral Gene Expression
papers.authors: Sutthakiet, Onprang; Khang, Luu Tang Phuc; Wisetkaeo, Suwanna; Phetduang, Kritsada; Nuisiri, Apinan; Permpoonpattana, Patima; Linh, Nguyen Vu
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Tilapia lake virus is a major constraint to sustainable Nile tilapia ( Oreochromis niloticus ) production, yet effective antiviral interventions remain limited. We evaluated the antiviral potential of procyanidin against tilapia lake virus (TiLV) using complementary cell-based and in vivo challenge models involving 300 Nile tilapia. Procyanidin displayed a concentration-dependent safety profile, with a non-cytotoxic concentration of 0.0128 mg/mL in E-11 cells and an estimated LC 10 of 0.6528 mg/mL in fish. At the selected cellular concentration, procyanidin prevented virus-associated cytopathic effects and reduced TiLV RNA in culture supernatants to below the RT-qPCR detection limit. In vivo, procyanidin administration 24 h before or after viral challenge increased survival from 43.33% in untreated infected fish to 80.00% and 73.33%, respectively, corresponding to relative percent survival values of 64.44% and 52.22%. Treatment also reduced brain viral load by up to 3.12 log 10 units and was associated with qualitatively better-preserved brain and liver histoarchitecture. Hepatic transcriptional profiling revealed distinct treatment-associated expression patterns across inflammatory, innate immune recognition, antigen presentation, cellular immunity and antiviral interferon signalling pathways, with pre-treatment producing the strongest induction of several antiviral genes. Together, these findings identify procyanidin as a candidate antiviral compound against tilapia lake virus, with in vitro antiviral activity accompanied in vivo by improved survival, reduced brain viral load and treatment-associated changes in hepatic immune-gene expression, although the underlying protective mechanism remains to be established.
papers.summary_cn: 原花青素在E-11细胞中对罗非鱼湖病毒（TiLV）呈浓度依赖性抗病毒活性，0.0128 mg/mL非细胞毒性浓度下可阻止细胞病变并将上清TiLV RNA降至RT-qPCR检出限以下。300尾尼罗罗非鱼体内攻毒试验中，感染前24 h或感染后给药分别将存活率由未处理组的43.33%提升至80.00%和73.33%（相对存活率64.44%和52.22%），脑组织病毒载量最多下降3.12 log10，脑与肝组织形态保存更好。肝脏转录谱显示炎症、先天免疫识别、抗原呈递、细胞免疫及干扰素信号通路表达模式随处理改变，预处理对抗病毒基因的诱导最强；保护机制尚待阐明。

papers.title: New Revision of China’s Fisheries Law
papers.authors: He, Hai-Rong; Deng, Yun-Cheng
papers.journal: The International Journal of Marine and Coastal Law
papers.abstract: Abstract The Chinese Fisheries Law was adopted in January 1986 and came into force on 1 July 1986. Four amendments and one revision have been made to the document since then. A revision in 2025 reflects China’s commitment to enhancing fisheries quality, efficiency, and green development. Initially, this article provides a brief overview of the Law, and then it evaluates some key changes in the revision of 2025. It concludes by pointing out some concerns that remain in the Law following the recent revision.
papers.summary_cn: 本文概述中国《渔业法》自1986年颁布以来的四次修正和一次修订，重点评析2025年修订中的关键变化，认为该修订体现了中国提升渔业质量、效率和绿色发展的承诺，同时指出修订后法律仍存在的若干问题。

papers.title: Integrating asymmetry, geography and timescale analyses to uncover fish population synchrony patterns in a tropical reservoir
papers.authors: Cararo, Emanuel Rampanelli; da Silva, Nelson Jorge; Cintra, Carlos Eduardo Domingos; Granzotti, Rafaela Vendrametto; Bini, Luis Mauricio
papers.abstract: Abstract Spatial population synchrony, broadly defined as the correlated temporal dynamics of a population metric (e.g. abundance, biomass or growth rates) across sampled areas, is a central theme in ecology. Here, we investigated spatial synchrony in the abundance of 38 fish species from the Jirau Reservoir, a large impoundment in the Amazonian basin, over a decade. We combined cross-correlation at zero lag, tail dependence, synchrony networks, species traits and wavelets to investigate asymmetry, geography and the temporal structure of spatial synchrony. We found that 12 species exhibited significant river-wide synchrony, with no asymmetrical or spatial patterns of within-river synchrony. Water level synchrony, dispersal difficulty and density dependence explained little of the variation in within-river synchrony. However, wavelet analyses showed that the strength of river-wide synchrony varied across temporal scales, and some species also shifted in the dominant timescale of synchrony over time. Furthermore, key species traits such as migratory strategy, body size and trophic level were not significantly correlated with river-wide synchrony levels. These findings underscore the necessity of using multifaceted analytical approaches to understand and manage fish populations in human-altered aquatic ecosystems, where local factors may override broad-scale drivers.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究以亚马逊流域Jirau水库为对象，基于十年监测数据分析了38种鱼类的空间种群同步性（spatial synchrony），综合运用零滞后互相关、尾部依赖、同步性网络、物种性状及小波分析等方法，考察同步性的不对称性、地理格局与时间尺度结构。结果显示12种鱼类表现出显著的库区尺度同步性，但河内同步性无不对称或空间格局，水位同步性、扩散难度和密度依赖对其解释力有限。小波分析揭示同步性强度随尺度变化，部分物种的主导时间尺度亦随时间偏移，而洄游策略、体型和营养级等关键性状与同步性无显著相关。研究强调需采用多层面分析途径以理解和管理受人类活动影响水体中的鱼类种群。

papers.title: Microplastic contamination in spotted babylon (Babylonia areolata) from the artisanal fisheries along the eastern coast of Thailand
papers.authors: Phaksopa, Jitraporn; Worachananant, Suchai; Jendanklang, Poratape
papers.abstract: Microplastics (MPs) are a serious global concern due to their potential risks to the environment, wildlife, and human health. The ingestion of MPs by organisms, such as marine invertebrates, can lead to their transfer through the trophic food chain, ultimately impacting human health. The present study investigates the quantity, shape, color, and polymer type of microplastics found in both the whole soft tissues and external surfaces of the spotted babylon (Babylonia areolata) collected in January (Northeast monsoon), April (transition period), and August (Southwest monsoon) 2024 from four sampling sites along the coast of Rayong Province, Thailand. The results revealed a total microplastic detection rate of 73.9% from the external body, with 1.14 ± 0.40 particles/individual, and 61.9% from the internal body contained at least one MP particle, with 1.01 ± 0.47 particles/individual. The overall MP contamination showed significant seasonal differences, with the highest contamination observed in August. The study also demonstrated a significant positive correlation between microplastic contamination and shellfish size. The most abundant MP shape was fiber, primarily in blue, followed by fragments and films. FT-IR analysis identified several plastic polymers, with the most common being PET, PES, and PP. Fibers were the predominant MP shape, followed by fragments and films, while PET, PES, and PP were the major polymer types identified by FT-IR. The predominance of PET-fibers suggests a potential contribution from textile-related sources. Nevertheless, MP levels in spotted babylon from Rayong Province were lower than those reported in previous studies. Our findings highlight the potential for MP transfer to humans through seafood consumption, raising concerns for food safety, and emphasize the need for regular monitoring of edible marine organisms and effective plastic waste management policies in the region.
papers.summary_cn: 对泰国罗勇府沿岸手工渔业采集的斑点凤螺（Babylonia areolata）软组织和体表微塑料（MPs）进行数量、形状、颜色及聚合物类型分析，样品于2024年1月（东北季风）、4月（过渡期）和8月（西南季风）取自4个站点。体表MP检出率73.9%（1.14 ± 0.40 个/个体），体内61.9%含至少1个MP（1.01 ± 0.47 个/个体），污染呈显著季节差异，8月最高，且与个体大小呈显著正相关。纤维为最主要形状（以蓝色为主），其次为碎片和薄膜；FT-IR鉴定主要聚合物为PET、PES和PP，PET纤维占优提示纺织来源贡献。该区域斑点凤螺MP水平低于既往报道，但结果提示海产品消费存在MP向人体转移的食品安全风险，需加强食用海洋生物常规监测与塑料废物管理。

papers.title: Analysis of Fishers' Compliance With And Perceptions of Licensing Documents At The Marine and Fisheries Resources Surveillance Office (PSDKP), Takalar Station
papers.authors: Faifsan, Sutrisno; Wulandari, Sri
papers.journal: J-SH: Journal of Social Sciences and Humanities
papers.abstract: This study analyzes fishers' compliance with and perceptions of licensing documents at the Marine and Fisheries Resources Surveillance Office (PSDKP), Takalar Station, which operates within the working area of PSDKP Bitung. The objectives were: (1) to describe fishers' compliance with the procedures for issuing licensing documents and (2) to describe fishers' perceptions of licensing documents through an assessment of service quality. The study employed a descriptive design with a survey approach. A purposive sample of 30 adult fishers (aged 18-59 years) who were applying for or had previously applied for licenses was selected. The instrument was a four-point Likert-scale questionnaire. Compliance was measured using 20 statements representing 10 indicators of public service compliance assessment based on Ombudsman Regulation of the Republic of Indonesia Number 22 of 2016. Perceived service quality was measured using 16 statements representing the eight elements of the Service Quality Perception Survey (SPKP) (Constitutional Court of the Republic of Indonesia, 2023). Data were analyzed descriptively through frequency and percentage tabulation. The results show that fishers' compliance is very high; variation appeared only in the habit of reading written information on notice boards or service media (27 always; 3 rarely). Fishers' perceptions were also predominantly positive: information was easy to understand, requirements and procedures were clear, the service flow was easy to follow, completion time matched the estimate and was relatively short, facilities were comfortable and adequate, and officers were responsive in consultations and complaint handling. Regarding costs, all respondents considered the fees to be in accordance with regulations, yet seven respondents sometimes felt that the cost of processing was quite burdensome. It is concluded that licensing services at PSDKP Takalar are effective in fostering compliance and positive perceptions, with recommendations to strengthen the dissemination of written information and to mitigate indirect cost burdens so that services become more inclusive. These findings are relevant to improving licensing governance.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在分析Takalar站PSDKP（海洋与渔业资源监督办公室）渔民对许可文件的合规行为与服务感知，采用描述性问卷调查设计，对30名成年渔民进行Likert量表测评。结果显示渔民合规水平总体很高，仅在阅读公告栏书面信息方面存在差异；服务感知以正面为主，信息易懂、流程清晰、办理时限合理、设施与人员响应良好。多数受访者认为收费符合规定，但部分渔民反映办理成本仍构成一定负担。研究建议加强书面信息公开并缓解间接费用压力，以提升许可治理的包容性。

papers.title: CNN Architectures for Fish Disease Classification in Aquaculture
papers.authors: Basumatary, Jyotirmoy; Siva, G. J. Venkata; Harijan, Raj Kumar; Bhattacharjee, Abhishek; Laskar, Mariam Jabali
papers.journal: Asian Journal of Research in Computer Science
papers.abstract: Fish diseases can compromise aquaculture production through reduced growth, deteriorating fish quality and increased mortality. Conventional disease identification often depends on time-consuming manual inspection. This study compared convolutional neural network (CNN) architectures containing two, three and four convolutional layers for classifying five fish disease categories and healthy fish. A dataset of 1,600 images was assembled from existing repositories and selected websites. The images were resized to 224 × 224 pixels and divided into training, validation and testing subsets at an 80:10:10 ratio. The models were trained for 100 epochs using a batch size of 32, with rotation and contrast augmentation applied to the training images. Model performance was assessed through classification accuracy, training and validation curves, and class-level evaluation measures. Across five executions, average test accuracies were 91.13%, 95.73% and 95.27% for the two-, three- and four-layer CNNs, respectively. The three-layer CNN showed comparatively stable training and validation behaviour, whereas the other architectures displayed less stable generalisation or indications of overfitting. Two additional baseline models were evaluated on the same dataset: fine-tuned VGG16 achieved 96.41% accuracy, and a VGG16-Random Forest hybrid achieved 93.56%. Among the three CNN architectures examined, the three-layer model provided the highest average accuracy and a favourable balance between classification performance and architectural depth on the dataset used.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究比较了含2、3、4个卷积层的CNN架构在五类鱼病及健康鱼分类中的表现，使用1,600张图像（224×224像素，按80:10:10划分训练/验证/测试集），训练100个epoch并采用旋转与对比度增强。五次运行的平均测试准确率分别为91.13%、95.73%和95.27%，三层CNN训练与验证行为最稳定，其余架构泛化较差或存在过拟合迹象。在相同数据集上，微调VGG16达96.41%，VGG16–Random Forest混合模型达93.56%。综合而言，三层CNN在所测三种架构中平均准确率最高，且在分类性能与架构深度间取得较好平衡。

papers.title: Sector-field inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry offers enhanced insights for the accumulation of toxic metals in microplastics extracted from fish and sediments
papers.authors: Kuznetsova, Olga V.
papers.abstract: One significant ecological concern regarding plastic pollution is the ability of microplastics (MPs) to adsorb and concentrate heavy metals in the marine environment. The sector-field inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry (SF-ICP-MS) technique was applied to determine heavy metal concentrations in MPs from beach sediments, in fish muscle, and in the gastrointestinal tract (GIT) of fish from the Caspian Sea. First, metal determination in sediment and biological matrices was validated by analyzing the marine sediment certified reference material (IAEA-158) and DORM-4 fish protein certified reference material. For metals that pose greater risks to the marine environment and may come from multiple anthropogenic sources, the concentration factors (CF), namely, the heavy metal concentration ratio from MPs in sediment to sediment (CMPs/s), reach 3 (Cd), 7.7 (Pb), and 30 (Zn). The average amount of MPs was 55 items/kg, with the minimum and maximum values ranging from 14 to 155 items/kg. The same methodology was employed to quantify metals in MPs extracted from the fish gastrointestinal tract. The developed method holds promise as a potentially useful analytical tool for marine monitoring and precise assessment of MPs with regard to heavy metal contamination and impact on marine ecosystems.
papers.summary_cn: 采用SF-ICP-MS测定里海海滩沉积物、鱼肌肉及鱼胃肠道中微塑料（MPs）的重金属浓度，并以IAEA-158海洋沉积物和DORM-4鱼蛋白标准物质验证沉积物与生物基质的金属测定。沉积物中MPs的重金属浓度与沉积物浓度比（CF，C_MPs/s）分别达Cd 3、Pb 7.7、Zn 30；MPs平均丰度为55 items/kg（范围14–155 items/kg）。同一方法用于定量鱼胃肠道MPs中的金属，所建方法有望用于海洋监测及MPs重金属污染与生态影响的精准评估。

papers.title: Implementation of The Policy On The Utilization of Lonrae Fish Landing Base (PPI) in Bone Regency
papers.authors: Mirnawati, Mirnawati; Ikramullah, Muh; Suprianto, Suprianto; Wulandari, Sri
papers.journal: J-SH: Journal of Social Sciences and Humanities
papers.abstract: Fish Landing Bases (PPI) play a strategic role in supporting capture fisheries, improving fishers' livelihoods, and strengthening coastal economic development. This study aimed to analyze the implementation of the policy on the utilization of the Lonrae Fish Landing Base (PPI) in Bone Regency using the policy implementation framework proposed by Van Meter and Van Horn. A qualitative descriptive approach was employed through in-depth interviews, field observations, documentation, and secondary data analysis. Informants consisted of representatives from the Provincial Marine and Fisheries Office, the Bone Regency Fisheries Office, PPI management, fishers, and local community members. The findings indicate that the implementation of the policy has generally progressed in accordance with its intended objectives, particularly in improving fisheries services and supporting local economic activities. The policy benefits from clear objectives, positive implementer commitment, supportive social conditions, and relatively effective inter-agency coordination. However, its effectiveness is constrained by limited financial resources, insufficient human resources, inadequate supporting facilities, suboptimal communication with fishers, and operational management challenges. These constraints have prevented the full optimization of PPI functions, particularly regarding fish auction services, infrastructure utilization, and service delivery. Strengthening institutional coordination, increasing infrastructure investment, enhancing human resource capacity, improving stakeholder communication, and expanding operational budgets are therefore essential to maximize the role of Lonrae Fish Landing Base as a sustainable fisheries infrastructure that contributes to fisheries governance and the welfare of coastal communities.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于Van Meter与Van Horn政策执行框架，采用定性描述方法（深度访谈、实地观察、文献与二手数据分析），评估印度尼西亚Bone县Lonrae渔获上岸基地（PPI）利用政策的实施效果。结果显示政策总体朝预期目标推进，在改善渔业服务和支持地方经济活动方面成效明显，得益于目标清晰、执行者承诺积极、社会条件支持及机构间协调较有效。但财政与人力资源不足、配套设施欠缺、与渔民沟通不畅及运营管理问题制约了PPI在鱼品拍卖服务、基础设施利用和服务供给等方面的功能发挥。建议加强机构协调、增加基础设施投资、提升人力资源能力、改善利益相关方沟通并扩大运营预算，以充分发挥Lonrae PPI作为可持续渔业基础设施的作用。

papers.title: Fish Protein Hydrolysate and Gelatin from Tuna Processing By-Products Using Freeze-Drying and Oven-Drying Methods
papers.authors: Sundari, Yuyun; Yuniarti, Tatty; Nurhayati, Tati
papers.abstract: Tuna processing industries generate a significant amount of by-products, including dark muscle and skin, which are potential sources of functional proteins such as fish protein hydrolysate (FPH) and gelatin. This study aimed to characterize FPH from tuna dark muscle and gelatin from tuna skin, while evaluating the effects of freeze-drying (FD) and oven-drying (OV) on their physicochemical and antioxidant properties. The results indicated that the yield and proximate composition of FPH-FD and FPH-OV did not differ significantly (p>0.05). In contrast, antioxidant activity showed a significant effect (p<0.05), with FPH-OV exhibiting a stronger radical-scavenging capacity than FPH-FD, as indicated by its lower IC50 value, namely 152.75 µg/mL and 647.68 µg/mL, respectively. Unlike FPH, the drying methods for gelatin significantly influenced moisture content, ash content, gel strength, and antioxidant activity (p<0.05). The freeze-dried gelatin had higher gel strength (399.7 g) than oven-dried gelatin (372.7 g), although both values exceeded the typical high-Bloom range of 200-300 g. Under the tested laboratory conditions, oven-drying at 60 °C produced FPH with yield and proximate composition comparable to those of freeze-drying and with higher antioxidant activity, whereas it increased moisture and ash contents of gelatin and reduced its gel strength.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以金枪鱼暗色肌肉和鱼皮为原料，分别制备 fish protein hydrolysate (FPH) 和 gelatin，并比较 freeze-drying (FD) 与 oven-drying (OV) 对其理化性质及抗氧化活性的影响。FPH-FD 与 FPH-OV 的得率和近似组成无显著差异，但 OV 干燥 FPH 的抗氧化活性显著更强（IC50 分别为 152.75 和 647.68 µg/mL）。干燥方式显著影响 gelatin 的水分、灰分、凝胶强度和抗氧化活性，冻干 gelatin 凝胶强度（399.7 g）高于烘干（372.7 g），两者均超过典型高 Bloom 范围（200–300 g）。在实验条件下，60 °C 烘干可在保持 FPH 得率和组成的同时提升其抗氧化活性，但会提高 gelatin 水分和灰分含量并降低凝胶强度。

papers.title: Consumer motivational segments and their potential implications for freshwater aquaculture commercialization in Hungary
papers.authors: Mihály, Tamás; Mihály-Karnai, Laura; Soós, Mihály
papers.abstract: Abstract Fish and fishery products are increasingly recognized as important components of healthy and sustainable diets, yet consumption remains low and seasonal in several inland European markets. This study examines motivational heterogeneity in fish and fishery product consumption in Hungary and explores its potential implications for freshwater aquaculture commercialization. The total sample comprised 576 respondents, of whom 463 reported consuming fish or fishery products. Exploratory factor analysis and Gaussian Mixture Modelling were conducted on the subsample of 314 fish-consuming respondents who provided complete valid responses to all motivational items. Exploratory factor analysis based on polychoric correlations identified two latent motivational dimensions: convenience and accessibility, and health and product characteristics. Gaussian Mixture Modelling distinguished three consumer segments: health-oriented, moderately practical consumers; low-motivation consumers; and convenience-dominated consumers. Taste and perceived health benefits emerged as the strongest general motivations, while convenience, accessibility and ready-to-cook formats contributed more strongly to differentiating between consumer profiles. The findings indicate that motivational heterogeneity may be relevant when considering the commercialization of freshwater aquaculture products in a low-consumption inland market. However, the survey measured motivations toward fish and fishery products in general rather than attitudes toward farmed fish specifically. Therefore, the aquaculture-related conclusions should be interpreted as sectoral implications rather than as direct empirical evidence of attitudes toward aquaculture. Interpreted in the light of previous literature, the identified consumer profiles suggest that transparent product information, trust-building and convenient product formats may support the development of more differentiated commercialization approaches for freshwater aquaculture value chains.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于匈牙利576名受访者（其中463人消费鱼类产品）的调查数据，采用探索性因子分析和Gaussian Mixture Modelling，考察鱼类及渔产品消费动机的异质性及其对淡水水产养殖商业化的潜在启示。因子分析识别出“便利性与可及性”和“健康与产品特性”两个潜在动机维度，GMM进一步区分出三类消费群体：健康导向型、低动机型和便利主导型。口味和感知健康益处是最普遍的消费动机，而便利性、可及性和即烹形式在区分消费群体方面作用更强。研究指出，在低消费内陆市场推进淡水养殖产品商业化时需考虑消费动机异质性，但鉴于调查测量的是对鱼类产品的总体动机而非对养殖鱼的具体态度，相关结论应视为行业层面的启示而非直接实证证据。

papers.title: A tailored ecological carrying capacity model for mariculture zoning in multi-use marine protected areas
papers.authors: Albasri, Hatim; Sammut, Jesmond
papers.abstract: Mariculture is recognised as a sustainable livelihood in multi-use marine protected areas (MPAs). Surprisingly, specific carrying capacity (CC) models are unavailable in the literature to manage the development of mariculture. This study proposed a specific CC model for designating mariculture zoning in multi-use small-island MPAs, using a modified Modelling-Ongrowing fish farm-Monitoring (MOM) approach. The study was applied in the Anambas MPA to represent a common type of multi-use small-island MPA in most developing countries. To develop the model, three simulated finfish net cages were placed in different locations to collect field data and support model simulations. The results show that the three geographical areas within the MPA have CC limited by oxygen concentration, rather than by other variables. The levels of CC ranged from 49.93 to 119.9 kg/m3 in the wet season when using trash fish and from 7.14 to 116.41 kg/m3 in the dry season when using commercial feed. Because the CC model proposed here is based on the lowest MOM module values and farming seasons, the typical CC/holding density for finfish mariculture in the Anambas Archipelago MPA is 27.76 kg/m3 in the wet season and 7.14 kg/m3 in the dry season. These findings highlight that each location (mariculture zone) within an MPA has a distinct CC, influenced by fish farming practices and environmental characteristics. Therefore, mariculture development in MPAs should be limited through site-specific CCs based on established mariculture zones, with site selection and CC estimation for each site, taking into account the different feeds used, cultured fish species, and seasonality.
papers.summary_cn: 针对多用途海洋保护区内海水养殖缺乏专用承载力（CC）模型的问题，采用改进的 Modelling–Ongrowing fish farm–Monitoring（MOM）方法构建了适用于多用途小岛屿 MPA 的海水养殖分区 CC 模型，并以 Anambas MPA 为案例、通过布设三个模拟网箱采集现场数据支持模型模拟。结果显示该 MPA 内三个海区的 CC 均受氧浓度限制，湿季使用杂鱼时 CC 为 49.93–119.9 kg/m³，干季使用商业饲料时为 7.14–116.41 kg/m³；基于最低 MOM 模块值与养殖季节，该海域 finfish 养殖的典型 CC/养殖密度为湿季 27.76 kg/m³、干季 7.14 kg/m³。各养殖区 CC 因养殖方式与环境特征而异，MPA 内海水养殖开发应按已划定的养殖区实施基于站点的 CC 管理，并在选址与 CC 估算中考虑饲料类型、养殖鱼种和季节性。

papers.title: Spawning aggregation of bristletooth surgeonfish (Ctenochaetus striatus) in an Okinawan coral reef: lunar phase and tidal rhythm periodicities of aggregation by using non-lethal methods
papers.authors: Nanami, Atsushi
papers.abstract: Surgeonfishes are a common group of fishes in coral reefs, and their spawning aggregations have been reported from various regions. This study aimed to examine the ecological characteristics of the aggregation of Ctenochaetus striatus in an Okinawan coral reef. These include (1) the lunar phase and tidal rhythm periodicities of aggregation formation and (2) the difference in fish density between inside and outside the aggregation site by using time-lapse still photography and underwater observations. The 87-day time-lapse still photography survey and time-series analysis using a correlogram revealed a significant semi-lunar rhythm in aggregation formation. Fish aggregations were generally observed during several consecutive days after the first quarter and last quarter moons, although some exceptions were observed. The aggregations were observed primarily during ebb tide in the neap and middle tide phases, but they were sometimes observed at high tide or during flood tide. The aggregations were observed for several hours, during which fish abundance increased rapidly before spawning and decreased rapidly afterward, respectively. The maximum fish density at the aggregation site (240 m2) was 1050 individuals (equivalent to 4.38 individuals per 1 m2). Since the fish density inside the aggregation site during spawning was 704.7-fold higher than that outside the aggregation site, and group spawning events were observed during when aggregation formed, the aggregation of C. striatus on this Okinawan coral reef can be regarded as a spawning aggregation.
papers.summary_cn: 在冲绳珊瑚礁用87天延时摄影与水下观察结合时间序列（相关图）分析刺尾鱼（Ctenochaetus striatus）聚集的月相与潮汐周期性：聚集形成呈显著半太阴节律，多在上弦和下弦后连续数天出现，主要见于小潮和中潮的退潮期，偶见于高潮或涨潮。聚集持续数小时，产卵前鱼数快速增加、产卵后快速减少；240 m²聚集点最大密度1050尾（4.38尾/m²），产卵时聚集点内密度为点外的704.7倍，并观察到群体产卵事件，表明该聚集属于产卵聚集（spawning aggregation）。

papers.title: Integrating fish biology, population genomics, and fishery policies for informed management of interjurisdictional multispecies fisheries
papers.authors: Gangal, Mayuresh; Arthur, Rohan; Suri, Venkatachalam; Pandit, Awsadhesh; Tyagi, Abhinav; Prakash, Praveen; Sule, Mihir; Majgaonkar, Iravatee; Krishnaswamy, Jagdish; Ramakrishnan, Uma
papers.abstract: Abstract Coastal fisheries are typically managed within bounds set by political jurisdictions of nations and their provinces. This approach often results in multiple states/provinces managing a single genetically distinct fish population autonomously and typically without coordination. In multispecies, decentralized, and data-poor fisheries, this can lead to inadequate assessments and fisheries overharvests. We developed an integrative risk indicator for interjurisdictional stocks (IRIIS) to assess the overexploitation risk to interjurisdictional populations. IRIIS incorporates species-specific vulnerability, distribution of genetically distinct populations with respect to jurisdictional boundaries, and differences in management practices across jurisdictions. As a case study, we used genetic tools and policy analysis to evaluate nine common target species spanning multiple jurisdictions along India's western coast. We showed that distinct populations of a species differed greatly in how they are managed by respective fisheries, and management disparities across jurisdictions can strongly influence the overexploitation risk for a population. IRIIS clearly identified these differences and helped determine specific fisheries policies that need reconciling across jurisdictions to reduce the risk of overexploitation. As a comprehensive management instrument, IRIIS is dynamic and sensitive to periodic revisions in fishery policy and could guide managers across jurisdictions in lowering the overexploitation risks to multispecies coastal fisheries.
papers.summary_cn: 研究针对跨行政辖区多物种沿海渔业管理碎片化问题，构建了跨辖区种群过度捕捞风险综合指标（IRIIS），整合物种脆弱性、遗传独立种群分布与辖区管理差异。以印度西海岸九种主要目标物种为案例，结合遗传工具与政策分析评估各辖区管理实践。结果表明同一物种不同种群的管理方式差异显著，辖区间管理不均衡强烈影响种群过度捕捞风险，IRIIS可识别需跨辖区协调的具体渔业政策以降低风险。

papers.title: YOLOv12-Based Fish Lesion Detection for Complex Underwater Scenes
papers.authors: Jiang, Haibo; Dai, Mingyun; Qian, Weiguo
papers.abstract: Underwater fish disease detection is a vital visual perception task for health monitoring, disease early warning and precision breeding management in aquaculture. In complicated underwater environments, fish lesions suffer from faint boundaries and tiny sizes, while cross-scale fused features of detection models are contaminated by mixed degradation interference. To tackle the above issues, this paper proposes a YOLOv12-based detection method for fish lesions under complex underwater conditions. Firstly, an underwater spatial context receptive field module named CRB is designed. It expands the receptive range of shallow features through two-stage depthwise separable dilated convolution, establishes spatial correlations between local lesion responses and surrounding neighborhood structures and enhances the local structural representation of lesions with faint boundaries and small scales. Secondly, an underwater degradation-aware channel enhancement module DCE is presented. Degradation priors are constructed from image intensity, gradient and local contrast. Combined with mixed pooling to generate channel weights, the module recalibrates lesion-related responses and degradation interference responses after cross-scale feature fusion, so as to suppress the propagation of degradation noise within fused features. Lastly, the experiments are conducted on a self-built underwater largemouth bass lesion detection dataset. The experimental results show that the proposed model achieves Precision of 87.4%, Recall of 81.3%, F1-score of 84.2% and mAP@50 of 85.8%, which outperforms the baseline model by 3.3, 3.7, 3.5 and 3.6 percentage points, respectively. The proposed method serve as an effective visual perception solution for fish lesion detection in complex underwater environments.
papers.summary_cn: 针对复杂水下环境中鱼体病灶边界模糊、尺寸微小及跨尺度融合特征受退化干扰的问题，提出基于YOLOv12的鱼体病灶检测方法，设计了水下空间上下文感受野模块CRB和退化感知通道增强模块DCE，分别增强弱小病灶的局部结构表征并抑制融合特征中的退化噪声传播。在自建大口黑鲈病灶检测数据集上，模型取得Precision 87.4%、Recall 81.3%、F1-score 84.2%和mAP@50 85.8%，较基线模型分别提升3.3、3.7、3.5和3.6个百分点，为复杂水下环境的鱼体病灶检测提供了有效的视觉感知方案。

papers.title: Using resource selection functions (RSFs) to model the movement ecology of invasive predators in the last remaining habitat of the endangered Atlantic whitefish
papers.authors: Sergio, Ava J. A.; Broome, Jeremy E.; Piczak, Morgan L.; Lennox, Robert J.
papers.abstract: Abstract Aquatic invasive species are among the top threats to freshwater fishes globally, causing declines in freshwater biodiversity and altering ecosystem functioning. Within Nova Scotia, Canada, invasive chain pickerel ( Esox niger ) and smallmouth bass ( Micropterus dolomieu ) have been found to reduce the abundance and diversity of native fishes. The invasive range of both species threatens and overlaps with the critical habitat of one of Canada's most endangered fishes, the Atlantic whitefish ( Coregonus huntsmani ). Here, we examine the seasonal space and depth use of adult chain pickerel and smallmouth bass using acoustic telemetry in Milipsigate Lake, Nova Scotia. High-resolution positions were calculated and analyzed using resource selection functions (RSFs) and generalized additive models (GAMs) to determine the relative space use and predicted depth of both species within the lake. Areas with the highest relative probability of use (>0.7) differed between species, and seasonal changes in space use were only significant for smallmouth bass ( p < 0.001). Chain pickerel had the highest relative probability of space use in shallow areas of Milipsigate Lake (<4 m), whereas areas with the highest relative probability of space use for smallmouth bass were concentrated around four distinct overwintering sites. Chain pickerel were predicted to occupy a narrow range (~2 m) of relatively shallow depths year-round. Smallmouth bass were predicted to occupy depths that were on average three times deeper than chain pickerel, including a broad range of depths from spring to fall (0-15 m) that contracted during the winter months (2-6 m). Here, we showed that the combined occupancy of the lake by both species is extensive, with limited overlap in space or depth use year-round. Ultimately, the methodologies and results presented in this study could help inform the development of management strategies for invasive freshwater fish species.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用声学遥测技术，结合 resource selection functions (RSFs) 和 generalized additive models (GAMs)，分析了加拿大新斯科舍省 Milipsigate 湖中入侵性 chain pickerel（Esox niger）与 smallmouth bass（Micropterus dolomieu）的季节性空间与深度利用特征，以评估二者对濒危 Atlantic whitefish（Coregonus huntsmani）关键栖息地的重叠威胁。结果显示，chain pickerel 全年偏好浅水区（<4 m）且深度范围狭窄（约2 m），而 smallmouth bass 利用深度平均为前者三倍，春秋季可达0–15 m，冬季收缩至2–6 m，并集中于四个越冬位点。两物种在湖中的占据范围广泛但空间与深度重叠有限，seasonal 变化仅对 smallmouth bass 显著。研究为入侵淡水鱼类的管理策略制定提供了方法学与数据支持。

papers.title: Tracing Gotlandic Fisheries: Multi-period fish-teeth provenancing based on strontium isotope ratios
papers.authors: Krooks, Beatrice; D´Agata, Chiara; Boethius, Adam
papers.abstract: Abstract Euryhaline fish pose a challenge when interpreting the fishing habitats utilised in areas where both fresh and saline waters would have been accessible. One such example is the island of Gotland, central Baltic Sea, where archaeological fishbone assemblages often contain euryhaline fish species that could have originated from different habitats. To understand which waterbodies were used for fishing in the past, 87 Sr/ 86 Sr ratios of 41 fish teeth from the Mesolithic, Neolithic and Viking Age - Middle Ages were analysed using laser ablation-multi collector-inductively coupled plasma-mass spectrometry and correlated with a bioavailable baseline of water sources. We identify several shifts in the origin of euryhaline fish and discuss them in relation to environmental and cultural shifts. Using modern ecological knowledge, we discuss the likely habitat structures in the now drained lakes of Gotland. The results enhance our understanding of prehistoric and historic fishing practices and shed light on the broader socio-economic and environmental dynamics on the island of Gotland.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用锶同位素比值（87Sr/86Sr）对瑞典哥特兰岛中石器时代至中世纪维京时期的41枚鱼牙进行激光剥蚀多接收电感耦合等离子体质谱分析，并与水体生物可利用基线对比，追溯广盐性鱼类的捕捞栖息地来源。研究发现广盐性鱼类的来源地存在多次转变，反映了环境变化与人类文化变迁的关联。结合现代生态学知识，探讨了哥特兰岛现已干涸湖泊的栖息地结构，增进了对史前及历史时期捕捞实践及该岛社会经济与环境动态的理解。

papers.title: Effective Communication and Sustainability of Women's Small-Scale Fisheries: Implications for Livelihoods and Community Development in Homa Bay, Kenya
papers.authors: Okanga, Patrick Asango
papers.abstract: The purpose of this study was to analyse the influence of effective communication on the sustainability of women’s small-scale fisheries in Homa Bay County, Kenya. The sustainability of women-led small-scale fisheries enterprises is often constrained by inadequate communication and information-sharing mechanisms, which limit women's ability to access timely market information, share enterprise-related challenges, participate in collective decision-making, and identify solutions to emerging operational constraints. These communication barriers stand to undermine enterprise resilience, compromise the quality and nutritional value of fish products, and ultimately threaten the livelihood security of fishers' households. The study is anchored on the Magic Bullet Theory (Hypodermic Needle Model). Applying the mixed-methods approach, the study analysed quantitative and qualitative data collected from a sample of 330 small-scale women fishers with a ninety-six per cent response rate. The results from both data sources were triangulated and became the basis of the study findings and conclusions. Fisher’s effective communication had a moderate and significant relationship with the sustainability of small-scale fisheries. The findings revealed that r=0.342, R2= 0.117, F (1,341) =45.597, at P=0.000<0.05, confirming that fishers' effective communication had a statistically significant contribution to the sustainability of small-scale fisheries. The coefficient of determination, R2= 0.117, indicates that fishers' effective communication activities explain 11.7 per cent of the variation in the sustainability of fisheries by women. The paper contributes to the literature on the role of effective communication in the sustainability of small-scale enterprises, poverty reduction among small-scale fishers, and nutritional value among families of women fishers. Furthermore, it adds to the importance of fishers engaging in a dialogue with the market and community.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在分析有效沟通对肯尼亚Homa Bay县女性小型渔业可持续性的影响，采用混合方法对330名女性小规模渔民进行调查（有效回收率96%），并以Magic Bullet Theory为理论框架。结果表明，渔民有效沟通与小型渔业可持续性呈中度显著正相关（r=0.342，R²=0.117，P<0.05），可解释可持续性变异的11.7%。沟通不畅限制了女性获取市场信息、参与集体决策和应对运营挑战的能力，进而威胁渔户生计安全与鱼品营养品质。

papers.title: Mobilization of Inuit traditional knowledge and western science in co-management of Arctic char fisheries in Ulukhaktok, Inuvialuit Settlement Region: A 30-year review
papers.authors: Lea, Ellen V.; Committee, Olokhaktomiut Hunters and Trappers; Gallagher, Colin P.; Pearce, Tristan David; Scanlon, Halena; Harwood, Lois
papers.abstract: In this paper, we describe how Inuit traditional knowledge and western science have been mobilized over three decades to support the co-management of Arctic char (iqalukpik) (Salvelinus alpinus) fisheries in the waters near Ulukhaktok in the Inuvialuit Settlement Region (ISR), Canada. Fisheries within the ISR are co-managed under the provisions of the Inuvialuit Final Agreement, with support from the Inuvialuit-Canada Fisheries Joint Management Committee (FJMC) as the designated co-management board. In response to community concerns of declines in one of its most important subsistence fisheries, the FJMC worked with Inuit from Ulukhaktok to establish a community-based Working Group focused on Arctic char in the area in 1993. Through the efforts and leadership of the Ulukhaktok Char Working Group (UCWG), co-management partners have mobilized traditional knowledge and western science continually over the past three decades through opportunities for information-sharing both within the UCWG and the broader community, harvest data collection, fisheries monitoring, and additional community-driven research programs. These activities have informed the UCWG in the development, implementation, and ongoing annual reviews of its community Fishing Plan, which describes the current knowledge of the fishery and management measures that support conservation, sustainable use, and stewardship.
papers.summary_cn: 本文回顾了加拿大Inuvialuit Settlement Region的Ulukhaktok地区30年来因纽特传统知识与西方科学在Arctic char（Salvelinus alpinus）渔业co-management中的整合实践。1993年因社区对重要自给渔业资源下降的担忧，FJMC与当地因纽特人合作成立了Ulukhaktok Char Working Group（UCWG），通过信息共享、渔获数据收集、渔业监测及社区驱动研究项目，持续动员传统知识与西方科学。这些活动支撑了社区Fishing Plan的制定、实施和年度审查，促进了资源保护、可持续利用与 stewardship。

papers.title: Length-weight relationships of 13 elasmobranch species (Elasmobranchii) from coastal waters near Nishiki, Taiki Town, Mie Prefecture: Analysis based on long-term surveys in set-net fisheries
papers.authors: Kato, Mio; Kawano, Yutaro; Kanaiwa, Minoru
papers.abstract: Elasmobranchs are ecologically and commercially important, but biological information remains limited for many species. This study investigated length-weight relationships (LWRs) of elasmobranchs caught as bycatch in a set-net fishery at Nishiki, Mie Prefecture, Japan, during 2018-2025. A total of 739 individuals representing 21 species were collected during 284 fishing operations, and 15 species with at least five individuals remaining after exclusion of damaged specimens and Cook’s distance outliers were analyzed. LWR parameters were estimated, for groups with at least ten specimens, in 13 species: Cephaloscyllium umbratile Jordan et Fowler, 1903; Sphyrna zygaena (Linnaeus, 1758); Hemitriakis japanica (Müller et Henle, 1839); Mustelus manazo Bleeker, 1854; Triakis scyllium Müller et Henle, 1839; Heterodontus japonicus Maclay et Macleay, 1884; Bathytoshia brevicaudata (Hutton, 1875); Hemitrygon akajei (Müller et Henle, 1841); Hemitrygon izuensis (Nishida et Nakaya, 1988); Gymnura japonica (Temminck et Schlegel, 1850); Myliobatis tobijei Bleeker, 1854; Urolophus aurantiacus Müller et Henle, 1841; and Okamejei schmidti (Ishiyama, 1958). Of the 15 species analyzed, 11 are classified as threatened on the IUCN Red List and two Near Threatened. For batoids, both disc width (DW) and total length (TL) were evaluated, and DW gave higher coefficients of determination than TL in all six ray species with sufficient data. Sex-combined LWR exponents ( b ) ranged from 1.659 to 4.168. BIC-based model selection indicated sex-specific intercepts with a common slope for four species-measurement combinations. These LWRs provide baseline biometric information for biomass estimation, bycatch assessment, and fisheries management.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于日本三重县锦町定置网渔业2018–2025年的长期调查，采集21种739尾板鳃类，对其中13种（每種≥10尾）估计了length–weight relationships (LWRs)。结果显示，6种鳐类中盘宽（DW）的拟合优度均高于全长（TL）；性别合并的LWR指数b为1.659–4.168，BIC模型选择支持4个物种–测量组合采用性别特异截距与共同斜率。所分析15种中11种被IUCN列为受威胁、2种近危，这些LWRs为biomass estimation、bycatch assessment和渔业管理提供了基础生物学参数。

papers.title: Occurrence, distribution, and risk assessment of antibiotics in water, sediment, and fish from aquaculture environments in the Karst Plateau of southern China
papers.authors: Yangbo, He; Jianlin, Luo; Kaizhuo, Wang; Zhiyin, Jian; Wencong, Shang; Ting, Ye; Qin, Yin; Can, Li
papers.abstract: This study investigated the spatiotemporal distribution, ecological risks, and health hazards of antibiotics in aquaculture environments of the Karst Plateau, southern China. In total, 37 antibiotics were detected in water and sediment, and 34 in fish muscle, with sulfonamides and quinolones predominating. Significant seasonal variations (p < 0.05) occurred: sulfonamides and macrolides peaked in autumn, while quinolones and tetracyclines prevailed in winter. Spatially, Guanling was a contamination hotspot with highest sulfonamides in autumn and quinolones in winter; Ziyun showed strong seasonal contrasts, and Kaiyang had the lowest levels but unique fish markers (Chlortetracycline, Anisomycin, Sulfadiazine, Enoxacin). Water chemistry was Ca 2+ -Mg 2+ -SO 4 2- type, and antibiotic sources correlated with agricultural and domestic discharges. Sediments accumulated 8 antibiotics (Trimethoprim, Sulfacetamide, Cinoxacin, Enoxacin, Enrofloxacin, Flumequine, Ofloxacin, Oxolinic acid), warranting resistance gene monitoring. Most quinolones posed moderate-to-high ecological risks in water and sediment, while fish antibiotics presented low health risks. This study provides baseline data and supports One Health management in karst plateau aquaculture.
papers.summary_cn: 喀斯特高原养殖水体与沉积物中检出37种抗生素、鱼肌肉中检出34种，以磺胺类和喹诺酮类为主，磺胺类和大环内酯类秋季高、喹诺酮类和四环素类冬季高，关岭为污染热点。水化学类型为Ca²⁺–Mg²⁺–SO₄²⁻型，抗生素来源与农业及生活排放相关；沉积物累积8种抗生素，需开展抗性基因监测。多数喹诺酮类在水和沉积物中呈中—高生态风险，鱼体抗生素健康风险低。

papers.title: Environmental Assessment of Heavy Metals Levels in Sediment and Fish of Lake Geriyo
papers.authors: Babayi, Abbas A.
papers.journal: INTERNATIONAL JOURNAL OF CHEMISTRY AND CHEMICAL PROCESSES
papers.abstract: Monitoring of contamination level in Lake Geriyo was coordinated by evaluating the concentrations of metals (Zn, Cu, Pb, & Cd) in sediment and fish samples of the lake in two seasons. The order of the concentrations of the metals in the sediment were Zn > Cu > Pb > Cd. The results showed that the metals exhibited lower values than sediment quality guideline (SQG). Thus, Lake Geriyo sediment can be categorized as unpolluted. Metal levels were within the set limit of TEL, PEL, ERL, and ERM which indicated that the sediment did not pose any danger to local fauna and flora. Zn and Cd were below the background values (Hakanson, 1980) nevertheless Pb and Cu exceeded. Metal Bioaccumulation were determined in the liver, gills and flesh from benthic and pelagic fish species obtained from the lake. The levels of the heavy metals differ remarkably amid fish species and organs. Flesh have the lowest concentration of all the metals. Liver was the choose organ for Zn, Cu and Pb accumulations. Cd nevertheless exhibited higher concentration in the gills. The metals bio concentration in fish flesh were acceptable by the international legislation limits for Cu, Zn, and Cd but however Pb go beyond in Clarias and Tilapia for wet season and Heterotis both seasons , consequently risky for human consumption and a danger to public health. These levels might be likely due to anthropogenic inputs as there is no industrial activity around the lake.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了Geriyo湖沉积物和鱼类中重金属（Zn、Cu、Pb、Cd）在两个季节的污染水平。沉积物中金属浓度顺序为Zn>Cu>Pb>Cd，均低于沉积物质量指南（SQG）及TEL、PEL、ERL、ERM限值，表明沉积物未受污染。鱼类不同物种和组织间重金属蓄积差异显著，肌肉浓度最低，肝脏是Zn、Cu、Pb的主要蓄积器官，Cd在鳃中浓度较高。鱼肉中Cu、Zn、Cd符合国际法规限值，但Pb在雨季的Clarias和Tilapia及两季的Heterotis中超标，对人类消费构成公共卫生风险，可能源于人为输入。

papers.title: Green technology adoption and management performance among freshwater aquaculture operators: technology pathways and the moderating role of labor endowment
papers.authors: Jiang, Qijun; Yin, Xiaotong; Li, Chao
papers.abstract: The green transformation of aquaculture involves not only adjustments in production inputs and pollution control practices but also changes in farm management. Using survey data from 311 freshwater aquaculture operators across 18 provinces in China, this study examines the relationship between green technology adoption and management performance, with particular attention to technology pathways and labor endowment. The results show that green technology adoption is positively and conditionally associated with management performance after controlling for operator characteristics, farm resources, and observable regional conditions. Process input and end-of-pipe green technologies show some differentiated association patterns across management performance dimensions: end-of-pipe technologies have relatively higher point estimates for innovation and development, business decision-making, and social contribution, whereas process input technologies show a relatively stronger association with risk control performance. Labor endowment also plays a differential moderating role. Higher labor endowment, reflected in labor quantity and labor quality, significantly strengthens the positive association between process input technologies and management performance, while no comparable labor complementarity is observed for end-of-pipe technologies. Further analyses indicate pathway differences across production modes and between digitally enabled and non-digital management performance. These findings suggest that the managerial value of green technologies depends not only on adoption itself but also on technology pathways and implementation capacity. Policy should therefore strengthen the fit between technology types and labor capacity through production training, stable labor allocation, and regional technical services to support sustained implementation and the green transformation of aquaculture.
papers.summary_cn: 基于中国18个省份311份淡水养殖户调查数据，考察绿色技术采用与管理绩效的关系及劳动力禀赋的调节作用。控制养殖户特征、养殖场资源和区域条件后，绿色技术采用与管理绩效呈正向条件关联；末端治理技术在创新发展、经营决策和社会贡献维度点估计较高，而过程投入技术与风险控制绩效关联更强。劳动力数量与质量显著强化过程投入技术与管理绩效的正向关联，但对末端治理技术无类似互补效应，且不同生产模式和数字化管理绩效间存在路径差异。绿色技术的管理价值不仅取决于采用本身，还取决于技术路径与实施能力，政策应通过生产培训、稳定劳动力配置和区域技术服务提升技术类型与劳动力能力的匹配。

papers.title: Nano-enabled environmental management in aquaculture: a scoping review of remediation, monitoring, biosecurity, and ecotoxicological risks
papers.authors: Lembang, Miska Sanda; Amanda, Putri
papers.abstract: Aquaculture intensification increases pressure on water quality, disease control, contaminant surveillance, and environmental safety. This scoping review maps nano-enabled remediation, monitoring, biosecurity, and ecotoxicological evidence alongside material recovery and practical validation. A Scopus search on 16 June 2026 identified 695 records; the evidence inventory comprises 57 unique English-language original research articles. Overlapping domains include remediation (14 articles), monitoring (15), biosecurity (17), antifouling (3) and ecotoxicology (17), with one natural-particle fate study. Reported settings comprise laboratory proof of concept (29), real-matrix bench testing (17), controlled stocked-system interventions (9), and a semi-field net test (1); the observational study is not assigned an intervention-maturity category. Six articles report reuse or regeneration, and one reports operational energy demand; these findings do not establish general economic viability. Performance depends on the tested material, matrix and endpoint, and high removal percentages require matched controls. Verification used full texts for 32 articles and indexed abstracts for 25. Unretained search-field settings, individual exclusion decisions, single-author screening, and incomplete source-level information constrain reproducibility and prevalence estimates. Laboratory sensitivity and short-term efficacy cannot establish environmental safety or commercial readiness. Translation requires verified residual exposure, chronic and early-life-stage testing, comparative life-cycle assessment and use-specific regulatory review.
papers.summary_cn: 该范围综述以Scopus检索（2026年6月16日，695条记录）为基础，纳入57篇英文原创研究，梳理纳米技术在水产养殖修复（14篇）、监测（15篇）、生物安全（17篇）、防污（3篇）及生态毒理（17篇）等领域的证据分布。研究场景以实验室概念验证（29篇）和真实基质台架测试（17篇）为主，受控养殖系统干预仅9篇、半野外网箱试验1篇；仅6篇报告材料回用或再生、1篇报告运行能耗，不足以确立普遍经济可行性。性能取决于受试材料、基质与终点，高去除率需匹配对照；实验室灵敏度与短期效力无法证明环境安全性或商业成熟度，转化应用尚需残留暴露验证、慢性及早期生命阶段测试、比较性生命周期评价及按用途的法规审查。

papers.title: Aquaculture development in Nigeria: growth trends, policy constraints, and transferable lessons from China
papers.authors: Ogbuagu, Samuel Ifeanyi; Wang, Wen; Lu, Siqi; Dong, Yalun; Tao, Yifan; Qiang, Jun
papers.abstract: Nigeria, Sub-Saharan Africa’s largest aquaculture producer, faces a substantial fish supply deficit despite rapid sectoral growth, with annual import expenditures at USD 0.6-1 billion. This study synthesizes evidence from a systematic review of 74 peer-reviewed studies from Web of Science, ScienceDirect, and Google Scholar, plus FAO and government reports, to analyze fisheries and aquaculture trends (2000-2024) using CAGR and OLS regression in R. The search yielded 2436 records; 74 met inclusion criteria after PRISMA-guided screening. Nigeria’s aquaculture expanded at a CAGR of 10.09%, surpassing China’s 4.18%. Regression shows a strong temporal trend (+13,044 tonnes/year, R2 = 0.773, p 300,000 t in 2014-2015, aligning with policy milestones (2000, 2008, 2013, 2016, 2024). However, the post-2015 plateau and multicollinearity (VIF=12.74) preclude definitive causal attribution to policies. Persistent constraints include high feed costs, input dependence, weak infrastructure, limited finance, and climate vulnerabilities. A targeted search for China comparative literature yielded no eligible studies for direct comparison; therefore, transferable lessons were drawn from policy documents, FAO reports, and peer-reviewed literature on Chinese aquaculture. Compared with China’s diversified systems, Nigeria remains heavily reliant on inland catfish and tilapia, with underdeveloped mariculture. Sustainable transformation requires investments in breeding, domestic feed production, digital technologies, responsible mariculture, and data-driven spatial planning. Adapting these transferable lessons from China offers a pathway to improve productivity, reduce import dependence, strengthen food security, and accelerate Nigeria’s blue economy development.
papers.summary_cn: 尼日利亚是撒哈拉以南非洲最大水产养殖生产国，但每年仍进口鱼类支出6–10亿美元。研究基于PRISMA流程从2436条记录中筛出74篇同行评审文献及FAO和政府报告，用CAGR与OLS回归分析2000–2024年趋势：尼日利亚水产养殖CAGR达10.09%，高于中国的4.18%，产量随时间呈强趋势（+13044吨/年，R²=0.773，p<0.001），并与政策强度相关（每分值70542吨，R²=0.768，p<0.001），2014–2015年产量峰值超30万吨，但2015年后停滞且存在多重共线性（VIF=12.74），无法确证政策因果。制约因素包括饲料成本高、投入品依赖、基础设施薄弱、融资有限和气候脆弱性；因缺乏可纳入的中国比较研究，转鉴经验取自中国水产养殖政策文件与文献。与中国多元化养殖体系相比，尼日利亚仍高度依赖内陆鲶鱼和罗非鱼，海水养殖欠发达，需在育种、本土饲料生产、数字技术、负责任海水养殖和数据驱动空间规划上投资。

papers.title: Potential Integration of Sesuvium portulacastrum (L.) L. and Perinereis aibuhitensis (Grube, 1878) for Water-Sediment Remediation in Marine Aquaculture: A Narrative Review
papers.authors: Wang, Yu; Zheng, Ying; Ma, Fei; Liu, Qi; Tang, Longjiang; Wang, Mei; Guo, Zhiqiang
papers.journal: Journal of Marine Science and Engineering
papers.abstract: Marine aquaculture wastes move among water, particles, sediments, and biomass. Evaluating system-wide benefits requires accounting for elemental stocks, discharge loads, and the fate of harvested biomass. This narrative review examines species-specific evidence for sea purslane (Sesuvium portulacastrum) and the polychaete Perinereis aibuhitensis, alongside evidence from other halophytes, macroalgae, and polychaetes. Sea purslane assimilates dissolved nitrogen and produces harvestable biomass. The polychaete consumes deposited particles and ventilates burrows. These activities can affect assimilation, organic matter mineralization, and particle movement. In one experiment, sediment nitrogen and phosphorus fractions changed. Final nutrient concentrations in the overlying water exceeded control values, and polychaete biomass fell. One field study documented natural co-occurrence. It manipulated only the plant and used one pond per condition. We found no independently replicated experiment that manipulated both species and could estimate their interaction. Combined performance may depend on whether plant uptake keeps pace with sediment release. Near-bottom oxygen levels and the fate of resuspended particles may also matter. We propose three testable predictions, compare in-pond and separate configurations, and illustrate how to evaluate interaction and approximate additivity. Further validation should account for carbon, nitrogen, and phosphorus within a common boundary and assess discharge peaks, harvest safety, seasonal stability, and operating costs.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述探讨将海马齿（Sesuvium portulacastrum）与多毛类Perinereis aibuhitensis整合用于海水养殖水体-沉积物修复的潜力，综合分析了盐生植物、大型藻类和多毛类的物种特异性证据。海马齿吸收溶解态氮并产生可收获生物量，多毛类消耗沉积颗粒并通气洞穴，二者可影响同化、有机质矿化及颗粒迁移。作者未发现独立重复的雙物种操控实验，无法估计其交互作用，提出三个可检验预测并比较池塘内与分离配置的评估方法。后续验证需在统一边界内核算碳氮磷收支，并评估排放峰值、收获安全性、季节稳定性及运营成本。

papers.title: Simulation-based assessment of parental contributions and genetic merit using in-silico pooled DNA genotyping in aquaculture
papers.authors: Liang, Bing; Jerry, Dean R.; Massault, Cecile; Nguyen, Vu; Shen, Xueyan; Loo, Grace; Vij, Shubha; Domingos, Jose A.
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Pooled DNA genotyping has gained increasing attention in recent decades due to its potential to substantially reduce genotyping costs and its applications in identifying trait-associated DNA markers and estimating parental contributions to pooled offspring samples. However, accurately estimating parental contributions from pooled offspring genotype data remains a major challenge in selective breeding. This study presents a novel approach based on a differential evolution (DE) algorithm to estimate individual parental contributions to pooled offspring samples and assesses its accuracy across a wide range of simulated scenarios. Results Parental contributions were estimated with up to 100% accuracy by genotyping both in-silico pooled offspring and individual parents across various conditions, including different parental combinations (20 males × 20 females, 8 males × 8 females, and 5 males × 5 females), SNP densities (10-3981 markers), and pool sizes (2-1000 individuals), with or without knowledge of parental sex. In a simulated progeny testing scenario involving five males and five females that produced six full-sib families with 200 offspring each, 1200 offspring were ranked by body weight and grouped into 10 in-silico pools based on fixed weight intervals. Parental contributions to each pool were accurately estimated, enabling reliable calculation of genetic merit, defined as the mean body weight of all offspring from each parent. Genetic merit estimates obtained from pooled genotyping showed a perfect correlation with those derived from individual genotyping, with a root mean squared error of 1.4 g relative to a mean offspring weight of 674 g. Only 10 in-silico pools were genotyped instead of 1200 individuals, substantially reducing genotyping effort. The method was implemented as an open-source R package, DNApooling , and validation using empirical genotyping data demonstrated reliable estimation of parental contributions and genetic merit under real-world conditions. Conclusions The method provides a robust, scalable, and cost-effective approach for estimating parental genetic merit through progeny testing, analysing mating patterns in mass-spawning species, and assessing genetic diversity within pooled samples. Its practical utility is particularly relevant to genetic evaluation in aquaculture breeding programs.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对水产选择育种中混合子代基因型数据估计亲本贡献的难题，提出基于差分进化（DE）算法的估计方法，并通过大规模模拟评估其准确性。在多种亲本组合（如20雄×20雌）、SNP密度（10–3981个标记）和混合规模（2–1000尾）条件下，亲本贡献估计准确率最高可达100%。在后代测验模拟中，仅对10个按体重分组的混合池进行基因分型即可准确估计各亲本贡献及遗传 merit（平均体重），与个体基因分型结果完全相关（RMSE 1.4 g，均值674 g），显著降低了基因分型工作量。该方法已开发为开源R包DNApooling，适用于水产育种遗传评估、批量产卵物种交配模式分析及混合样本遗传多样性评估。

papers.title: Performance assessment of an automated recirculating aquaculture system for rainbow trout production
papers.authors: Wu, Hongye; Wang, Ying; Lu, Guofeng; Gao, Yanghui; Feng, Siyu; Liu, Wei; He, Hehe; Gao, Kun; Chen, Ning; Deng, Xiangyuan
papers.abstract: Recirculating aquaculture systems (RAS) are intensively designed aquaculture models that rely on various water treatment technologies to maintain optimal water quality, ensuring the production of safe, healthy, and high-quality aquatic products. This work presented the design, construction, and evaluation of an automated land-based RAS platform, with a total volume of 3.6 m3, and a 130-day breeding trial using rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss). During the trial, water quality parameters in the RAS culture tanks were monitored. Results showed that average concentrations of ammonia nitrogen (NH4+-N), total nitrogen (TN), total phosphorus (TP), chemical oxygen demand (COD), and suspended solids (SS) were 0.41 mg/L, 4.12 mg/L, 0.22 mg/L, 13.59 mg/L, and 4.91 mg/L, respectively, with dissolved oxygen (DO) maintained at approximately 10 mg/L and pH fluctuating between 6.5 and 8.0. During the first 40 days, the system exhibited excellent water treatment performance, after which some water quality parameters showed a gradual increase, though these changes did not negatively impact the welfare of rainbow trout. Fillet nutritional composition and texture characteristics were compared between rainbow trout reared in the RAS and those sampled from an independently operated traditional flow-through pond system. These systems were not established as simultaneous or equivalent experimental treatments; therefore, any observed differences should be interpreted as descriptive differences between independent culture systems rather than causal effects of the rearing system. Results showed that no significant differences (p > 0.05) were observed in the crude protein and crude fat content between the two aquaculture methods; however, the RAS-cultured fish had significantly higher moisture content (p < 0.05) and lower ash content (p < 0.05) than those raised in flowing ponds. Texture profile analysis (TPA) revealed that the hardness, adhesiveness, springiness, and chewiness of the fillets from RAS-cultured fish were significantly lower (p < 0.05) relative to those from flowing ponds. Overall, the results demonstrated the operational feasibility of evaluated automated land-based RAS for rainbow trout culture under the tested conditions during the 130-day trial. The system maintained water quality within the observed ranges, and no statistically significant differences were detected in the measured nutritional composition of fillets from RAS-reared fish and fish obtained from an independently operated flow-through pond. The findings provided a basis for further controlled evaluations of RAS performance relative to conventional aquaculture systems, such as fish welfare, system stability, production efficiency, environmental impacts, and economic feasibility.
papers.summary_cn: 构建并评估了一套总水体3.6 m³的自动化陆基RAS平台，开展130天虹鳟（Oncorhynchus mykiss）养殖试验并监测水质。养殖期间NH4+-N、TN、TP、COD和SS平均浓度分别为0.41、4.12、0.22、13.59和4.91 mg/L，DO维持在约10 mg/L，pH在6.5~8.0波动；前40天处理性能优良，之后部分指标逐渐升高但未对虹鳟福利造成负面影响。与独立运行的流水池塘系统相比（非同步或等效处理，差异仅作描述性解读），RAS鱼片粗蛋白和粗脂肪无显著差异（p>0.05），水分显著较高、灰分显著较低（p<0.05），TPA硬度、黏附性、弹性和咀嚼性均显著较低（p<0.05）。结果表明该自动化陆基RAS在试验条件下用于虹鳟养殖运行可行，水质维持在观测范围内，并为后续RAS与传统养殖系统在鱼类福利、系统稳定性、生产效率、环境影响及经济可行性等方面的受控比较评估提供了基础。

papers.title: Application of petroleum hydrocarbons as an environmental quality marker for marine aquaculture areas in Lombok Island, Indonesia: Occurrence, spatio-temporal distribution, and risk assessment
papers.authors: Yogaswara, Deny; Arifin, Zainal; Yu, Ren-cheng; Shofarudin, Ukis; Dirhamsyah, Dirhamsyah; Falahudin, Dede
papers.abstract: The southern coast of Lombok Island, Indonesia, is home to ecologically significant environments, including mangroves, seagrass meadows, and coral reefs, which coexist with traditional seaweed and shellfish farming systems. Even though they are vital, there is a lack of comprehensive data regarding baseline environmental conditions. This study investigated the concentrations, spatio-temporal distributions, and ecological risks of petroleum hydrocarbons (PHCs) in 28 surface sediment samples collected from Awang, Paremas, and Seriwe Bays during the 2022 and 2023 southeast and northwest monsoon seasons. Each sample contained trace amounts of PHCs, ranging from 1.1 to 11 mg/kg dry weight; nevertheless, concentrations remained well below established ecotoxicological thresholds, indicating a low risk to benthic organisms. Furthermore, although the differences were not statistically significant, PHC concentrations were generally higher during the southeast monsoon than during the northwest monsoon, except in Paremas Bay. This study provides baseline information on bulk petroleum hydrocarbon contamination in the coastal sediments of southern Lombok Island, which can serve as an environmental quality marker for aquaculture-dominated coastal systems. Although ecological risks were low under current conditions, continued monitoring is recommended to detect potential future changes associated with increasing coastal and maritime activities.
papers.summary_cn: 2022—2023年东南季风与西北季风期间，在印尼龙目岛南部Awang、Paremas和Seriwe三处海湾采集28个表层沉积物样品，测定石油烃（PHCs）浓度并分析其时空分布与生态风险。所有样品PHCs为1.1—11 mg/kg干重，远低于已有生态毒理阈值，对底栖生物风险低；除Paremas湾外，东南季风期浓度总体高于西北季风期，但差异不显著。研究为以水产养殖为主的南部海岸提供了PHCs基线数据，可作为养殖区环境质量标志物，并建议持续监测以捕捉海岸与海上活动增强带来的变化。

papers.title: Salinity shapes contrasting growth and antioxidant responses in the edible sea grape Caulerpa racemosa: implications for aquaculture
papers.authors: Windarto, Seto; Putri, Diwyacitta Antya; Ihtifazhuddin, Muhammad Ikhwan; Fitriadi, Ren; Rachmawati, Diana; Amalia, Rosa
papers.abstract: This study evaluated the effects of salinity on growth, biochemical composition, sensory quality, and extract radical scavenging activity of the edible sea grape Caulerpa racemosa under controlled culture conditions. Thalli were cultivated for 43 days at 24, 27, 30, 33, or 36 ppt in three independent aquaria per treatment; the aquarium was the experimental unit (n = 3), and within-aquarium measurements were treated as subsamples. Compared with the 30-ppt reference treatment, thalli cultured at 27 ppt had greater absolute growth (141.11 ± 8.13 vs. 72.91 ± 6.73 g) and specific growth rate (3.12 ± 0.10 vs. 2.09 ± 0.13% day⁻1; p < 0.05). The 27-ppt treatment also produced the highest numerical overall sensory-acceptance score (4.43 ± 0.78 on a five-point scale), whereas the 36-ppt treatment produced the lowest numerical score (2.00 ± 0.57). Conversely, extracts prepared from aquarium-derived biomass cultured at 36 ppt showed greater DPPH radical scavenging activity than extracts from the 27-ppt treatment (21.63 ± 0.04 vs. 10.00 ± 0.04%; p < 0.05) and the lowest IC50 (234.94 ± 0.85 ppm).
