Under the conditions tested, 27 ppt was most suitable for fresh-biomass production, whereas 33-36 ppt increased extract radical scavenging activity but reduced biomass production and sensory acceptance.
papers.summary_cn: 在受控培养条件下将食用海葡萄Caulerpa racemosa于24–36 ppt盐度养殖43天，以27 ppt的绝对生长量（141.11 g）和特定生长率（3.12% day⁻¹）显著高于30 ppt对照（72.91 g、2.09% day⁻¹），感官总体接受度评分也最高（4.43/5），而36 ppt评分最低（2.00/5）。36 ppt培养生物量提取物的DPPH自由基清除活性显著高于27 ppt（21.63% vs. 10.00%），IC50最低（234.94 ppm）。结果表明27 ppt最适合鲜生物量生产，33–36 ppt虽提高提取物抗氧化活性但降低生物量产量与感官接受度。

papers.title: VESTED INTERESTS AND THE WILL TO IMPROVE FISH FOR FOOD: A HIGH-VALUE FISH BIAS AND ITS LOCAL EFFECTS IN INDONESIA.
papers.authors: Schut, Thijs; Nugrohowardhani, Rambu L. K. R.; Kutanegara, Pande Made; Nooteboom, Gerben
papers.abstract: This paper writes against productivist tendencies in ‘fish for food’ policies, showing how they - in contrast to their aims - challenge people’s access to healthy and nutritious food. Using Indonesia as a case, it argues that a historically shaped modernist agenda, fuelled by economic interests and paternalistic ideas of wellbeing, informs a ‘high-value fish bias’: a governance focus on aquatic foods intended for export or middle-class consumption, and/or products that are discursively framed as an outcome of technological innovation. The paper unpacks the high-value fish bias, giving clues as to why fish for food are governed the way they are. Using empirical data from the East Indonesian island of Sumba, it also describes the local effects of this bias on local small fish value chains, giving specificity to often generalised claims about small fish as a policy blind spot. The paper argues that well-meant local fisheries- and food-related policies cannot shake off their discursive roots. As a result, relatively well-functioning small fish value chains are rendered anachronistic and pushed to the margin, due to which small fish for food are underutilized in (local) policies.
papers.summary_cn: 印尼“食用鱼”政策存在生产主义倾向，治理重心偏向出口或中产消费的高值水产品及被话语建构为技术创新的产品，形成“高值鱼偏好”，反而削弱人们获取健康营养食物的可及性。基于东印尼松巴岛的实证数据，该偏好使当地运转尚可的小型鱼类价值链被视为过时并边缘化，导致食用小鱼在地方政策中利用不足；善意的地方渔业与食物政策难以摆脱其话语根源。

papers.title: Concordant genetic diversity trends and discordant functional signatures of selection in geographically distant non-native Carassius auratus populations
papers.authors: Wang, Xiaoling; Zhu, Ren; Jia, Yintao; Qiao, Zhixian; Chen, Yifeng; Feng, Xiu; Sui, Xiaoyun
papers.journal: Reviews in Fish Biology and Fisheries
papers.abstract: Elucidating the response mechanisms of non-native populations following their introduction to different geographical locations provides a foundation for the prevention and management of invasive species. Using whole-genome resequencing data from 190 Carassius auratus individuals (92 diploids and 98 triploids) across native and non-native ranges, this study compared the genetic responses of two non-native populations introduced to the Golmud River and Lhasa River on the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau (QTP). The results showed that the two geographically distant populations likely originated from admixture of multiple native sources. Compared with their source populations, the two non-native diploid populations each formed independent genetic clusters and exhibited comparable levels of heterozygosity loss (16.63 and 19.91%), increases in nucleotide diversity (9.0 and 8.1%), and proportions of individuals showing inbreeding signals (33.3 and 30.0%). In contrast, the two non-native triploid populations, which reproduce via gynogenesis, showed no independent genetic clustering and maintained genetic diversity comparable to their sources. However, selective sweep analyses revealed limited overlap between the two non-native populations within each ploidy level, with only sharing one outlier region, two candidate genes and two enriched GO terms in diploids, and one outlier region and one candidate gene in triploids. These findings revealed similar patterns of genetic diversity changes but divergent selection-associated genes and functional signatures between geographically distant non-native C. auratus populations on the QTP in both diploids and triploids.
papers.summary_cn: 基于190尾二倍体与三倍体鲫（Carassius auratus）全基因组重测序数据，比较了青藏高原格尔木河与拉萨河两个远离原产地的外来种群及源种群的遗传响应。两外来种群均源于多个原生源的混合，二倍体种群各自形成独立遗传簇，杂合度下降16.63%与19.91%、核苷酸多样性上升9.0%与8.1%、近交信号个体占比33.3%与30.0%；以雌核发育繁殖的三倍体种群则无独立遗传聚类，遗传多样性维持与源种群相当。选择性清除分析显示，同一倍性水平下两外来种群间重叠极少（二倍体仅共享1个离群区域、2个候选基因和2个富集GO条目，三倍体仅1个离群区域和1个候选基因），即遗传多样性变化趋势一致而选择相关基因与功能特征分化。

papers.title: From density to bioenergetics: approaches for estimating fish rearing capacity in freshwater streams
papers.authors: Bond, Morgan H.; Copeland, Timothy; Naman, Sean M.; Benjamin, Joseph R.; Bellmore, J. Ryan; See, Kevin E.; Beechie, Tim; Greene, Correigh; Bayer, Jennifer M.; Dethloff, Meg
papers.journal: Reviews in Fish Biology and Fisheries
papers.abstract: Abstract Fish ecologists and managers have an interest in estimating the efficacy of freshwater habitat restoration, comparing among restoration options and basins. This often boils down to the question: How many fish can this habitat support? The number of fish a habitat can support, termed capacity, has increasingly become the currency for comparing habitats, restoration options, management policies, and is the backbone of many life cycle models. Underlying this focus is the assumption that capacity is determined from a factor or factors that limit abundance, and that improving these factors will promote an increase in population abundance. Researchers have a number of methods to estimate capacity, each with different benefits and drawbacks that vary by situation. Broadly, these methods fall into five categories: habitat expansion -applying high percentile observed fish densities to estimates of habitat area or volume; stock-recruit -fitting statistical relationships to time series of paired adult and progeny abundance; quantile regression -fitting high percentile regressions to local estimates of fish abundance and habitat features; microhabitat-scale models -scaling up statistical microhabitat suitability or individual bioenergetic requirements to reach and population levels; and food web models -estimating the energy flow from the primary and secondary production in a stream environment up through food webs to fish. The appropriate method in each situation will be determined by the available data, what management questions are being evaluated, the urgency and cost of producing estimates, and the temporal and spatial scales of estimates required.
papers.summary_cn: 淡水溪流鱼类养殖容量（capacity）估算方法可归为五类：栖息地扩展法（将观测鱼类密度高分位数外推至栖息地面积或体积）、stock-recruit 关系拟合、分位数回归、微栖息地尺度模型（将统计适宜性或个体生物能量学需求上推至种群水平）以及食物网模型（估算初级与次级生产经食物网流向鱼类的能量）。方法选择取决于可用数据、管理问题、估算的紧迫性与成本以及所需时空尺度。容量作为栖息地比较、修复方案评估与生命周期模型的通用指标，其核心假设是容量由限制丰度的因子决定，改善这些因子可提升种群丰度。

papers.title: Integrative Approach to Cephalopod Health Management
papers.authors: Zoral, Mehmet Arif; Lajbner, Zdeněk; Zifcakova, Lucia; Alves, Alexandra; Purkayastha, Abhijeet; Gestal, Camino; Costa, María M.; González-Alonso, Andrea; Abbo, Lisa; Azad, Kamrun Naher
papers.abstract: Cephalopods are emerging as important model organisms in diverse scientific fields, including neuroscience, behavior, ecology, and aquaculture, driving increased interest in their care under artificial environments such as laboratories, aquaria, and aquaculture facilities. With this rise in captive use comes a critical need for systematic, science-based approaches to cephalopod health management. In controlled settings, health outcomes are often shaped by interactions in the form of complex infections involving multiple etiological agents, such as bacteria, viruses, fungi, protozoan and metazoan parasites aggravated by environmental and husbandry factors. These interactions directly influence host susceptibility, pathogen transmission, and disease severity, underscoring the importance of pathogen identification and traceability for sustaining captive populations. Beyond disease control, maintenance of cephalopod welfare requires vigilant monitoring of clinical signs, accurate diagnostics, and timely intervention. These practices also enhance research reproducibility and ethical stewardship. This review synthesizes recent advances in cephalopod health, covering key areas such as pathogen-associated diseases, immunology, nutrition, and biosecurity measures relevant to aquaculture and research settings. By integrating insights across these domains, the aim is to contribute to understanding the main stressors as well as to describing specific methodologies for assessing and managing the health and welfare of cephalopods, critical pillars to sustainable aquaculture and the reliability of the scientific studies in which they play a vital role.
papers.summary_cn: 头足类在实验室、水族馆与养殖设施中的饲养日益增多，其健康管理亟需系统化、科学化方法。受环境与饲养因素加剧，细菌、病毒、真菌及原虫和后生动物寄生虫等多病原复杂感染直接影响宿主易感性、病原传播与疾病严重程度，凸显病原鉴定与溯源对维持养殖种群的重要性。综述整合了头足类病原相关疾病、免疫学、营养与生物安全措施的最新进展，强调临床体征监测、准确诊断与及时干预对福利、研究可重复性及可持续水产养殖的支撑作用。

papers.title: Estimating Atlantic Salmon ( Salmo salar ) Smolt Outmigration Timing: A Method Comparison
papers.authors: Bjerck, Helge Bostwick; Irgens, Christian; Urke, Henning Andre; Sægrov, Harald; Haugen, Thrond Oddvar; Hellen, Bjart Are; Imsland, Albert Kjartan Dagbjartson; Kristensen, Torstein
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Estimates of outmigration timing of Atlantic salmon smolt ( Salmo salar ) have become crucial inputs for predictive models that quantify effects of anthropogenic impacts. Recent reviews indicate that choice of method may impact estimates of migration timing, demanding an evaluation of the various monitoring tools in tandem. Here, we compared the migration behavior of smolts tagged with PIT tags or acoustic telemetry tags with smolts monitored with river transects of underwater video systems in two rivers in western Norway for three consecutive migration seasons (2019-2021). Despite discrepancies in the quantiles of migration, the methods often observed many of the same local peaks in migration distributions. Choice of tagging location had the largest observed effect on the migration timing of tagged individuals, with smolts from upstream of lakes arriving to the fjord 13.4 days later on average. Smolt length and morphological smolt index had negligible effects on migration timing.
papers.summary_cn: 在挪威西部两条河流连续三个洄游季（2019–2021）对比了PIT标记、声学遥测标记与水下视频断面监测三种方法估算大西洋鲑降海银鲑（smolt）洄游时序的差异；各方法虽在洄游分位数上存在偏差，但常捕捉到相同的局部洄游峰；标记位置影响最大，湖泊上游个体抵达峡湾平均晚13.4天，而银鲑体长与形态银鲑指数对时序影响可忽略。

papers.title: Two new loaches of the genus Mesonoemacheilus from the Western Ghats (Teleostei: Nemacheilidae)
papers.authors: Anoop, Vasudevan Komalavally; Dahanukar, Neelesh; Freyhof, Jörg; Raghavan, Rajeev
papers.abstract: Abstract Two new species of the ‘ Mesonoemacheilus guentheri ’ group are described from the Western Ghats Hotspot, based on morphological and multi-locus molecular data (mitochondrial cytochrome oxidase subunit 1, cytochrome b and nuclear Recombination-Activating Gene 1 sequences). Mesonoemacheilus mannanorum , new species, from a headwater stream of the Periyar River, is distinguished by a unique colour pattern of three series of whitish blotches on a brown background, and 8-9 branched pectoral-fin rays. Mesonoemacheilus sabariensis , new species, from a headwater stream of the Pamba River, is distinguished by a unique colour pattern comprising midlateral series of regularly or irregularly set and shaped whitish blotches with a wide brown margin, and pointed, elongated nasal flap-bars. Mesonoemacheilus now comprises 11 species, all of which are endemic to the rivers draining the Western Ghats Biodiversity Hotspot.
papers.summary_cn: 基于形态学与多基因分子数据（线粒体COI、cyt b及核基因RAG1），描述西高止山脉热点区“Mesonoemacheilus guentheri”种组两新种：Mesonoemacheilus mannanorum（Periyar河源头溪流，棕色背景上三列白色斑块，8–9根分枝胸鳍鳍条）与M. sabariensis（Pamba河源头溪流，中侧列排列规则的白色斑块具宽棕色边缘，鼻瓣条尖长）。该属现含11种，均为西高止山脉生物多样性热点区河流特有种。

papers.title: Growth and Physiological Responses of Juvenile Piaractus brachypomus Fed Two Commercial Diets in RAS and BFT
papers.authors: da Silva, Nárcia Carolina Santos; Magalhães, Thamara Bentivole; Silva, Sidney dos Santos; Souza, Rafael José Furtado; Martins, Wagner Junio de Freitas; Finamor, Isabela Andres; Baldisserotto, Bernardo; Pavanato, Maria Amalia; Nakayama, Cintia Labussière; Favero, Gisele Cristina
papers.abstract: This study compared biofloc technology (BFT) and recirculating aquaculture systems (RAS) for juvenile Piaractus brachypomus and tested whether responses depended on commercial feed. Fish (174.71 ± 2.80 g) received feeds labeled 24% or 32% crude protein (CP) for 90 days in a 2 × 2 factorial (three tanks per treatment). Water quality, growth, and physiological responses were analyzed by tank. Final weight (444.96 ± 37.37 vs. 444.19 ± 50.07 g, p = 0.9758) and survival (95.55% vs. 91.11%, p = 0.4082) did not differ between BFT and RAS. During days 45-90, fish fed 24% CP feed had greater weight gain (126.06 vs. 91.96 g, p = 0.0385) and specific growth rate (0.69 vs. 0.54% day-1, p = 0.0496). Higher apparent feed intake with 24% CP feed (3.86 vs. 2.14 g fish-1 day-1) may have contributed to this gain. Hepatic thiobarbituric acid-reactive substances (TBARS, nmol g-1 tissue) were higher in BFT than RAS (5.80 ± 1.27 vs. 3.39 ± 0.82, p = 0.0010) and with 32% CP feed (5.23 ± 1.84 vs. 3.96 ± 1.18, p = 0.0295). Both systems supported juvenile grow-out. Among the feeds tested, the 24% CP product combined greater growth with lower hepatic TBARS.
papers.summary_cn: 90 天 2×2 析因试验比较 BFT 与 RAS 养殖规格约 175 g 的 Piaractus brachypomus 幼鱼，投喂标示 24% 或 32% 粗蛋白（CP）的两种商品饲料。BFT 与 RAS 的终末体重（约 444 g）和存活率（95.6% vs 91.1%）无显著差异；24% CP 组在 45–90 天增重（126.06 vs 91.96 g）和特定生长率（0.69 vs 0.54% day⁻¹）更高，可能与摄食量较大（3.86 vs 2.14 g fish⁻¹ day⁻¹）有关。BFT 组及 32% CP 组的肝脏 TBARS 分别高于 RAS 组和 24% CP 组。两种系统均可支持该鱼幼鱼养成，所试饲料中 24% CP 产品兼具较高生长与较低肝脏脂质过氧化。

papers.title: Evaluation of a VP24-Targeted SYBR Green qPCR Assay and Species Differences in White Spot Syndrome Virus (WSSV) Detection in Wild Shrimp from Coastal Mozambique
papers.authors: Machaieie, Célio Arlindo; Gamil, Amr Ahmed Adelrahim; Gislefoss, Elisabeth; Mondlane-Milisse, Amélia; Pondja, Alberto; Hoguane, António; Fafetine, José; Mutoloki, Stephen
papers.abstract: The present study optimized and evaluated a lower-cost SYBR Green qPCR assay for White Spot Syndrome Virus (WSSV) detection and applied it to wild Penaeus monodon and Penaeus indicus from coastal Mozambique. Primer sets targeting VP19, VP24, VP26, and VP28 were compared with VP24_I showing favourable analytical performance (efficiency, 95.0%; R2 = 0.9988), good inter-run precision, no detectable cross-amplification with Infectious Hypodermal and Hematopoietic Necrosis Virus (IHHNV) or Decapod Iridescent Virus 1 (DIV1), and sequence confirmation of WSSV amplicons. Its dilution endpoint was comparable to that of the commercial MAXDETECT qPCR kit under the conditions tested, while reagent costs were reduced by 85% (USD 1.88 versus USD 12.55 per reaction). The assay was applied to 330 shrimp, and these individual-level results were combined with previously generated one-step PCR results from 300 shrimp from the same survey. After adjustment for geographic region, detection method, and site-level clustering, P. indicus had higher odds of WSSV detection than P. monodon, although this difference was not statistically significant (OR = 1.60; 95% CI: 0.86-2.98; p = 0.139). A similar trend was observed when the qPCR and one-step PCR datasets were analyzed separately. VP24_I represents a promising lower-cost candidate assay for WSSV surveillance, while the observed species association should be interpreted cautiously.
papers.summary_cn: 以VP19、VP24、VP26和VP28为靶标比较引物组，优化并评估了低成本SYBR Green qPCR法检测WSSV，其中VP24_I分析性能良好（扩增效率95.0%，R²=0.9988），与IHHNV和DIV1无交叉扩增，试剂成本较商业化MAXDETECT试剂盒降低85%（每反应1.88 vs 12.55美元）。对莫桑比克沿海330尾野生斑节对虾和印度明对虾进行检测，并结合同次调查300尾虾的一步法PCR结果，校正地理区域、检测方法和站点聚类后，印度明对虾WSSV检出 odds 高于斑节对虾但差异不显著（OR=1.60，95% CI 0.86–2.98，p=0.139），两个数据集单独分析时趋势一致。VP24_I可作为WSSV监测的低成本候选方法，物种间差异需谨慎解读。

papers.title: Patterns linking phytoplankton chemotaxonomy with zooplankton abundance and biomass in the Gulf of California during January and July 2007
papers.authors: Mendoza-Portillo, Francisco J; Gómez-Gutiérrez, Jaime; García-Fernández, Franklin; Martínez-Lopez, Aída; Ambriz-Arreola, Israel; De Silva-Dávila, Roxana; Palomares-García, Ricardo J; Aceves-Medina, Gerardo; Angulo-Campillo, Orso; Robinson, Carlos J
papers.abstract: Single-group approaches provide limited understanding of plankton organisation and variation between contrasting sampling periods in the Gulf of California. We integrated phytoplankton chemotaxonomic markers with zooplankton group-level and species-level data for eight focal taxa to compare assemblage structure between January and July 2007 and assess covariation with environmental conditions. This approach revealed features not detected when phytoplankton and zooplankton groups were examined independently. HPLC/CHEMTAX indicated that Chlorophytes, diatoms, and Prymnesiophytes dominated the January phytoplankton assemblage, whereas diatoms predominated in July, with substantial contributions from cyanobacteria and other nanophytoplankton under strong stratification. Zooplankton comprised 28 taxonomic groups and 215 species within the focal taxa, with higher abundance in January. Biomass was concentrated among the copepods Rhincalanus nasutus , Pleuromamma gracilis and Labidocera acuta and the euphausiids Nyctiphanes simplex and Hansarsia difficilis , which together accounted for 64.59% of the mean biomass represented by the 42 species evaluated. Canonical ordination separated January and July assemblages, identifying temperature, mixed-layer depth and accessory pigments as structuring gradients, although the first two axes explained only 19.6% of the variability. Despite marked January and July turnover in species composition and size spectra, species richness was similar between cruises, indicating changes in community structure without corresponding changes in regional diversity. Integrating pigment-derived phytoplankton contributions with species-level estimates of zooplankton abundance and biomass provides a framework for examining variation in plankton assemblage structure under contrasting environmental conditions and identifies taxa relevant to improving trophic models and estimates of secondary production in this productive tropical-subtropical ecosystem.
papers.summary_cn: 2007年1月与7月加利福尼亚湾的浮游植物化学分类标志与浮游动物丰度、生物量之间存在关联。研究将HPLC/CHEMTAX色素数据与8个重点类群的浮游动物群落及物种级数据整合，比较两个航次的群落结构及其与环境条件的协变。1月浮游植物以绿藻、硅藻和定鞭藻为主，7月硅藻占优并在强层化下伴有蓝细菌和微型浮游植物贡献；浮游动物共记录28个类群、215种，1月丰度更高，生物量集中于桡足类Rhincalanus nasutus、Pleuromamma gracilis、Labidocera acuta及磷虾Nyctiphanes simplex、Hansarsia difficilis，这5种占所评估42种平均生物量的64.59%。典范排序可区分1月与7月群落，温度、混合层深度和辅助色素为结构化梯度，但前两轴仅解释19.6%的变异；两航次物种组成和粒径谱更替明显，而物种丰富度相近，表明群落结构变化未伴随区域多样性改变。

papers.title: Significance of thermal microclimates in shaping the responses of eelgrass to experimental long-term warming
papers.authors: Wolf, Fabian; Pansch, Christian; Hattich, Giannina Saskia Isabelle; Weinberger, Florian
papers.abstract: Global climate change, particularly ocean warming, can affect coastal benthic ecosystems worldwide. However, in the marine realm, little is known about how thermal variability may pre-select populations for their resilience to future warming. We conducted a pan-seasonal mesocosm experiment on the foundation macrophyte, the eelgrass Zostera marina . We contrasted specimens originating from coastal sandy habitats with variable microclimates (thermal history), both under natural temperature conditions and under a 3 °C warming scenario reflecting near-future conditions, for a total of 1.5 years. Warming reduced the number of leaves and shoots, as well as relative eelgrass height, and resulted in a 22-day earlier summer peak in biomass compared with ambient conditions. Individuals from the more variable microclimate tended to grow more under both ambient and future temperature conditions, with greater shoot and leaf numbers, and relative height than those from the less variable microclimate. Such individuals also exhibited greater response plasticity under both the natural conditions and the warming scenario. This experimental study enhances our general understanding of the negative impacts of global warming on seagrass ecosystems and shows that not only cooler microclimates (i.e., thermal refugia) can benefit a species, but that variable microclimates may also facilitate individuals with greater thermal tolerances. These findings are central for a better understanding and implementation of protection measures for ecosystem engineers, such as seagrass, under future climate conditions.
papers.summary_cn: 1.5年全季节中尺度实验显示，3 ℃增温使鳗草（Zostera marina）叶片数、分株数和相对株高下降，生物量夏季峰值较自然条件提前22天。来自热微气候更可变生境的个体在自然与增温条件下均生长更好（分株和叶片更多、相对株高更大），且表型响应可塑性更高。结果表明，可变热微气候可能筛选出耐热性更强的个体，其保护价值不亚于较冷的热避难所，对未来海草生态系统保护措施的设计具有重要意义。

papers.title: A narrative review of the causes of mass mortality events in seabirds
papers.authors: Fayet, Annette L.; Scott, Samantha Luise; Layton-Matthews, Kate; Buckingham, Lila; Singsaas, Frode Thomassen; Christensen-Dalsgaard, Signe
papers.abstract: Seabird mass mortality events (MMEs) are acute episodes of unusually high mortality with potentially serious demographic impacts, projected to become more frequent or exacerbated under ongoing climate change. This review synthesises knowledge on the causes of seabird MMEs, focusing on how outcomes of MMEs were measured, their likely drivers, and the extent to which these drivers have been tested empirically. Seabird MMEs appear to be driven by climatic and human factors, predominantly ocean warming and severe storms, with food limitation consistently emerging as the main proximate mechanism linking environmental drivers to mortality. Many drivers are ultimately anthropogenic, either arising directly from human activities or through climate change increasing their frequency and intensity. Temporal trends in reported drivers reflect shifting pressures on seabirds, with fewer recent studies on MMEs driven by oils spills and more implicating marine heatwaves and severe storms. Critically, we reveal a lack of quantitative studies that statistically model the effects of potential drivers of MMEs, fundamentally limiting our mechanistic understanding of these events. We highlight key knowledge gaps, including understudied drivers of MMEs, and emphasise the need for more rigorous analytical approaches and better baseline data collection, both demographic monitoring at breeding colonies and from standardised beached bird surveys. This requires coordinated monitoring at national and international scales, ideally integrating data beyond carcass counts (e.g. necropsies, or diagnostic sampling). Such approaches are essential for developing a mechanistic understanding of MME drivers, assessing population-level consequences, and improving our ability to detect and predict this increasing pressure to globally threatened seabirds.
papers.summary_cn: 海鸟大规模死亡事件（MME）是死亡率异常升高的急性事件，可能对种群产生严重影响，且在气候变化下预计将更频繁或加剧。该综述聚焦MME结局的测量方式、可能驱动因素及其被实证检验的程度，指出气候与人为因素（主要为海洋变暖和强风暴）驱动MME，食物限制是连接环境驱动与死亡的主要近因机制。近期研究趋势显示溢油相关MME减少，而海洋热浪和强风暴的作用增多；但统计建模潜在驱动因素的定量研究匮乏，根本限制了对MME机制的理解。需加强繁殖地种群监测与标准化海滩死鸟调查等基线数据收集，并在国家与国际尺度协调监测、整合尸体计数之外的数据（如剖检、诊断采样），以提升对全球受威胁海鸟这一日益增长压力的检测与预测能力。

papers.title: Changes in distribution and biomass of yellow goosefish Lophius litulon under environmental changes in Fukushima Prefecture, Japan
papers.authors: Kakehi, Shigeho; Teramoto, Wataru; Nemoto, Yoshiharu; Shirato, Haruki; Niizeki, Kouji; Kurita, Yutaka
papers.abstract: Rapid changes in fish species composition, distribution, and abundance because of global warming are emerging as important issues in Fukushima Prefecture, Japan. Such changes influence the ongoing recovery of the prefecture's fisheries, as fishing effort has gradually recovered year by year since the Great East Japan Earthquake in 2011. We analyzed bottom trawl fishery data collected from the prefecture, focusing on the recent increase in yellow goosefish Lophius litulon catches, to clarify changes in its distribution and the mechanism underlying the recent increase in abundance. A generalized additive model revealed significant effects of bottom depth and bottom temperature on the occurrence probability and catch per unit effort of L. litulon . We used a depth-temperature (D-T) diagram to examine the differences in L. litulon distribution during the periods 2006-2008 and 2019-2021. The recent increase in catch reflected both the expansion of their distribution and increased biomass. The expansion of the distribution was related to bottom temperature warming, which likely enabled the species to inhabit deeper waters (180-220 m) throughout the year. The increase in biomass was driven by increases in both body weight and population density. The increase was also likely promoted by the temporary reduction in fishing pressure after the 2011 disaster; a decline in competing carnivorous fish in recent years may also be a contributing factor. Prey abundance and distribution also differed between two periods, and these changes may have contributed to the expansion of the distribution and increase in biomass of L. litulon .
papers.summary_cn: 基于福岛县底拖网渔业数据，用广义可加模型（GAM）解析底层深度与底层温度对黄鮟鱇（Lophius litulon）出现概率和CPUE的显著影响，并通过深度—温度（D-T）图比较2006—2008年与2019—2021年的分布差异。近年渔获增加源于分布扩张与生物量上升：分布扩张与底层增温有关，使其全年可栖息于180—220 m深水；生物量增加则由个体体重和种群密度共同驱动。2011年灾害后捕捞压力暂时下降可能促进了这一增长，近年竞争性肉食性鱼类减少及饵料丰度与分布变化亦可能是贡献因素。

papers.title: Marine ecological responses to thermal discharge from nuclear and coal-fired power plants: a review focusing on seawater quality, plankton, and microorganisms
papers.authors: Wang, Bingkun; Zhang, Miming; Chen, Zhongwei
papers.abstract: With the rapid expansion of coastal nuclear and coal-fired power plants, the environmental impacts of thermal discharge on adjacent marine ecosystems have become a major concern in environmental science. Unlike previous reviews focusing on a single biological group or isolated water-quality parameter, this review integrates physicochemical and biological responses, microbial functional ecology and the microbial loop, identifies candidate indicator taxa and functional traits, compares nuclear and coal-fired effluents, and synthesizes effects on seawater physicochemical properties, plankton community structure, and microbial diversity and function. We distinguish two impact pathways, which are direct entrainment/impingement within once-through cooling systems and in situ warming experienced by organisms in the discharged plume. Chlorination by-products, nutrient enrichment and discharge-modified hydrodynamics are considered because they confound field-derived signals; thus many field patterns are mixed-stressor responses and cannot be attributed to warming alone. Nuclear and coal-fired plants differ in effluent composition, in that nuclear once-through discharges during normal operation are dominated by heated seawater and biocide residues. Many field-observed patterns represent mixed-stressor responses and cannot be attributed to warming alone. Thermal discharge reduces dissolved oxygen and pH, accelerates nutrient cycling, increases pollutant bioavailability, and alters phytoplankton, zooplankton, and microbial communities, thereby affecting food-web stability and biogeochemical processes. The review also discusses current controversies and knowledge gaps. The main contribution of this review is to integrate seawater chemistry, plankton dynamics and microbial functional ecology within a single attribution framework, to identify candidate indicator taxa and functional traits. This synthesis provides a scientific basis for environmental monitoring, ecological risk assessment and adaptive management of thermal discharge in coastal marine ecosystems.
papers.summary_cn: 综述整合海水理化性质、浮游生物群落与微生物功能生态，区分两类影响路径：冷却系统取水导致的卷载/撞击，以及排放羽流中的原位升温；并比较核电厂与燃煤电厂排放差异。指出氯化副产物、营养盐富集与排放改变的水动力会混淆现场信号，许多野外格局属多胁迫叠加响应，不能单独归因于升温。热排放降低溶解氧与pH、加速营养盐循环、提高污染物生物可利用性，改变浮游植物、浮游动物与微生物群落，进而影响食物网稳定性和生物地球化学过程，并提出候选指示类群与功能性状及监测管理建议。

papers.title: Divergent temporal variability in calcification and primary production of central Red Sea calcifying macroalgae
papers.authors: Yan, Huajing; Saderne, Vincent; Alshareef, Ethraa; Cortada Galvao, Abel; Giorgi, Aurora; Johnson, Maggie D.
papers.abstract: Calcifying macroalgae play critical roles in coral reef ecosystem functioning and carbonate dynamics. However, the metabolic responses underpinning several of their ecological functions remain poorly characterized, particularly in the Red Sea. To evaluate how macroalgal metabolism varies over time under naturally fluctuating conditions, we conducted in situ metabolic assays in the spring and fall over three years (2022-2024) using two ecologically important calcifying reef taxa: the green macroalga Halimeda opuntia and the crustose coralline alga Lithophyllum sp. We quantified rates of light and dark calcification, net photosynthesis, and respiration under natural light and temperature regimes in shallow nearshore habitats of the central Red Sea. Halimeda opuntia metabolism varied significantly across time points in both lagoonal and reef habitats, whereas Lithophyllum sp. showed more stable light calcification rates, though its dark calcification, respiration, and net photosynthesis varied. This variation did not follow a consistent seasonal pattern. Notably, light calcification rates in H. opuntia were more than twice those of Lithophyllum sp., consistent with their roles as fast-growing sediment producers versus slower-growing reef framework stabilizers, respectively. These results provide essential species-resolved in situ metabolic baselines for dominant calcifying macroalgae in the central Red Sea and highlight how divergent macroalgal functional groups contribute to carbonate production and reef stability in a region that regularly experiences environmental extremes.
papers.summary_cn: 红海中部两种钙化大型海藻的代谢速率存在明显时间变异：绿藻 Halimeda opuntia 在潟湖与礁区生境的代谢均随时间显著波动，而壳状珊瑚藻 Lithophyllum sp. 的明期钙化较稳定，暗期钙化、呼吸与净光合仍变化，且整体不呈一致季节性。H. opuntia 明期钙化速率超过 Lithophyllum sp. 两倍，与其快速生长、产沙功能及礁体稳定者角色相符。基于2022–2024年春秋两季原位测定，结果为该极端环境海域优势钙化海藻提供了物种分辨的代谢基线。

papers.title: Exploratory Assessment of Biochemical and Behavioral Profiles in a Tropical Freshwater Fish ( Astyanax sp.) Exposed to Fire-Derived Microplastics
papers.authors: Estrada, Teresa de Jesús Monserrat López; Mejía, Nancy Priscila Ayala; Sierra, Ana Marlen Acosta; Acevedo, Nayeli Leticia Cortés; de Lima Rodrigues, Aline Sueli; Santiago, Omar Cruz; de Brito, Rafaela Ribeiro; Soares, Wesley Rodrigues; Dias, Herbert Junior; da Luz, Thiarlen Marinho
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Incomplete combustion of plastic waste is an emerging pathway for forming thermally transformed microplastics (MPs), whose physicochemical identity and ecotoxicological potential in aquatic vertebrates remain poorly understood, as available evidence has focused primarily on the toxicity of their leachates and extracts. Accordingly, we conducted an exploratory investigation of biochemical and behavioral profiles in juvenile Astyanax sp. exposed to MPs derived from the burning of expanded polystyrene (B-EPSMPs) and polyethylene terephthalate (B-PETMPs), integrating physicochemical characterization, behavioral responses, and biochemical biomarkers. Fish were allocated to Control, B-EPSMP, and B-PETMP groups, with 20 individuals maintained in one exposure aquarium per group for 10 days at a nominal B-MP concentration of 4 mg/L. Although the materials exhibited high morphometric similarity, Raman and UV-Vis analyses revealed distinct structural and spectroscopic profiles in the combustion-derived materials. No mortality was observed, but the exposed groups exhibited distinct sublethal response profiles. In the gastrointestinal tract, fish from both B-MP groups showed higher ROS and MDA levels and higher CAT and MPO-like activities relative to the Control group. Encephalic biochemical differences were more pronounced in the B-EPSMP group, including higher nitrite and dopamine levels, enhanced AChE activity, and lower BChE activity. Basal locomotor behavior remained largely preserved, whereas behavioral paradigms involving novelty and social interaction revealed differences among the observed groups. Fish from the B-EPSMP group exhibited greater locomotor reactivity to novelty and reduced interspecific social responsiveness toward Hyphessobrycon eques , whereas fish from the B-PETMP group mainly showed differences in novel-object exploration. Multiblock integration identified distinct biochemical-behavioral patterns among the sampled groups, with greater separation associated with the B-EPSMP group. Because each treatment was represented by a single exposure aquarium, these findings describe exploratory, tank-confounded associations rather than independently replicated treatment effects. Overall, the study provides preliminary evidence of distinct biological response patterns in fish exposed to fire-derived MPs and establishes a basis for future investigations using independently replicated exposure units.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨了塑料垃圾不完全燃烧产生的热转化微塑料（MPs）对热带淡水鱼 Astyanax sp. 幼鱼的生化与行为影响，整合了理化表征、行为响应和生化标志物分析。暴露于燃烧来源的 EPS 和 PET 微塑料10天后虽无死亡，但暴露组出现亚致死响应：肠道 ROS、MDA 水平及 CAT、MPO 样活性升高，B-EPSMP 组脑部亚硝酸盐和多巴胺水平升高、AChE 活性增强而 BChE 活性降低。基础运动行为基本保持，但新异环境和社会互动相关行为出现组间差异，B-EPSMP 组对新异环境运动反应性更强且对 Hyphessobrycon eques 的种间社会响应降低。由于各处理仅设单一暴露水族箱，结果为探索性、受缸体混杂的关联，需独立重复暴露单元进一步验证。

papers.title: Disentangling intrinsic and extrinsic drivers of gill ectoparasitism in an endemic North African leuciscid
papers.authors: Salhi, Selma; Mellal, Mohammed Khalil; Chelli, Abdelmadjid; Attir, Badreddine; Chaibi, Rachid; Zebsa, Rabah; Khelifa, Rassim
papers.abstract: Abstract Seasonal variation in fish parasite burden reflects the interplay between parasite transmission, environmental conditions and host characteristics, yet the relative contributions of these factors remain incompletely understood in many wild freshwater fishes. We investigated gill ectoparasitism in the Maghrebian Bleak ( Tropidophoxinellus callensis ), a freshwater fish endemic to Algeria and Tunisia, examining variation in parasite burden in relation to season, host age, physiological condition and dietary breadth. Three ectoparasite taxa were identified, Gyrodactylus barbi , Trichodina sp. and Dactylogyrus fraternus , providing the first characterisation of the gill ectoparasite assemblage of this species. Parasite burden peaked in summer, and season remained significantly associated with ectoparasitism after accounting for host characteristics, although much of the explained variation was shared among predictors. Parasite abundance increased with host age in unadjusted analyses, but the relationship reversed after accounting for hepatic condition and other predictors. Furthermore, parasite burden exhibited a nonlinear relationship with hepatic condition, reaching its highest values at intermediate hepatosomatic indices. These findings demonstrate that seasonal variation in ectoparasitism is closely intertwined with host ontogeny and physiological condition, highlighting the importance of considering intrinsic and extrinsic factors jointly when investigating host-parasite relationships.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究首次描述了阿尔及利亚与突尼斯特有种Maghrebian Bleak（Tropidophoxinellus callensis）的鳃部体外寄生虫群落，共鉴定出Gyrodactylus barbi、Trichodina sp.和Dactylogyrus fraternus三个类群。通过分析季节、宿主年龄、生理状况与食性宽度对寄生虫负荷的影响，发现寄生虫负荷在夏季达到峰值，季节在控制宿主特征后仍与体外寄生显著相关。寄生虫丰度随年龄的未校正正相关在纳入肝脏状况等预测因子后发生反转，且与肝体指数呈非线性关系，中等肝体指数时负荷最高，表明季节变化与宿主个体发育及生理状况紧密交织。

papers.title: Population Characteristics of Two Queen Conch (Aliger gigas) Fisheries in Southern Belize
papers.authors: Williams, Sophie C.; Steinberg, Michael K.; Cissell, Jordan R.
papers.abstract: Queen conch (Aliger gigas) are gastropod mollusks whose fishery is economically, culturally, and ecologically significant to the Caribbean region. Their populations have been in decline since the 1960s due to many stressors acting at numerous spatial and temporal scales. In Belize, this decline persists despite national and international conservation measures, including habitat conservation and fishery regulations. This study examines how the Belizean queen conch fishery has affected conch population health and conservation in two marine reserves between 2018 and 2022. Conch population surveys were conducted in the Conservation and General Use Zones of the Sapodilla Cayes Marine Reserve (SCMR) and the South Water Caye Marine Reserve (SWCMR) in 2018, 2019, and 2022. Demographic metrics related to the fishery and reproductive maturity were measured, including siphonal length, shell lip thickness, legal harvest status, and illegal poaching. Results show strong evidence of conch poaching. 1,098 conch were surveyed in 2018, 2019, and 2022. Of the total conch surveyed, 604 (55.01%) were alive at the time of survey, 149 (13.57%) had been legally harvested in compliance with Belize's fishery regulations, and 324 (29.51%) had been poached. However, poaching levels differed between marine reserves. In the SWCMR, 287 (51.99%) of the surveyed conch had been poached, and 37 (6.78%) of the conch surveyed in the SCMR had been poached. Sustained poaching activity at these levels, especially in the SWCMR, will have negative long-term effects on conch survival and population recruitment. These trends should urge managers, researchers, and community leaders to explore local causes, effects, and attitudes around the conch fishery and conch conservation.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估伯利兹南部两个海洋保护区（Sapodilla Cayes Marine Reserve 和 South Water Caye Marine Reserve）2018–2022年间 queen conch（Aliger gigas）渔业对种群健康与保护的影响，通过保护区内外种群调查测定 siphon 长度、壳唇厚度、合法采捕状态及非法偷捕等指标。共调查1,098只 conch，其中55.01%存活、13.57%为合法采捕、29.51%遭偷捕，且偷捕程度在保护区之间存在明显差异（SWCMR 偷捕率达51.99%，SCMR 仅6.78%）。持续高强度的偷捕，尤其在 SWCMR，将对 conch 的存活与种群补充产生长期负面影响，作者呼吁管理者、研究者与社区领袖探究当地 conch 渔业与保护问题的成因、影响及态度。

papers.title: Oceanographic Drivers of Atlantic Bluefin Tuna Stock Dynamics: Implications for Assessment and Management
papers.authors: Carrano, C.; Cadrin, S.X; Hansell, A.C; Walter, J.; Lauretta, M.; Golet, W.; Whitener, Z.; Kerr, L.A
papers.abstract: Oceanographic conditions can drive fish population dynamics, foraging, and distribution. Atlantic bluefin tuna (Thunnus thynnus) are a highly migratory and commercially valuable species, distributed throughout the North Atlantic Ocean that select optimal foraging and breeding habitats, and undergo extensive, and often trans-oceanic migrations between these areas. Much of the species’ suitable habitat, including their primary spawning sites, is shaped by natural environmental variability and, more recently, direct anthropogenic climate change, both of which drive ocean warming and circulation shifts that alter ecosystem productivity. While environmental drivers are increasingly recognized as important for population dynamics and distribution, conventional stock assessment and management often account for these impacts indirectly or assume biological rates to be stationary. We conducted a literature review to summarize observed and predicted effects of habitat changes on Atlantic bluefin tuna biology, movement, and distribution. Results indicate that temperature is a key driver of Atlantic bluefin tuna survival and distribution across different life stages. We detail current implementations of climate information in Atlantic bluefin tuna management, evaluate the advantages and risks of incorporating this information, and outline approaches for integrating environmental drivers into future assessment and management processes.
papers.summary_cn: 温度是影响大西洋蓝鳍金枪鱼（Thunnus thynnus）各生活阶段存活与分布的关键环境因子；海温升高与环流变化改变饵料场与产卵场等适宜栖息地，进而影响其生物学过程、移动与分布。常规 stock assessment 与管理多间接处理环境效应或假定生物学参数平稳，未充分纳入环境驱动。综述梳理了将气候信息纳入评估与管理的现有做法、利弊及整合路径。

papers.title: Reliability and Robustness of Multimodal Deep Learning for Fish Feeding Assessment in Aquaculture: A Critical Review
papers.authors: Bhat, Showkat Ahmad; Sofi, Ishfaq Bashir; Huang, Nen-Fu
papers.abstract: Reliable fish feeding assessment is essential for intelligent aquaculture, yet classification accuracy alone does not establish operational reliability. This structured critical review examines multimodal deep learning approaches, including selected unimodal deployment comparators, through five appraisal dimensions: label validity, data independence and adaptation, robustness to degraded or unavailable sensing, predictive reliability and calibration, and deployment and feeding-management evidence. A key concern is feature-label coupling, where motion-derived labels and model inputs share optical-flow representations, potentially limiting the biological interpretation of classification performance. Reviewed studies demonstrate advances in multimodal fusion, corruption testing, missing-modality handling, knowledge distillation, domain adaptation, and computational efficiency. However, inconsistent dataset provenance, evaluation protocols, and measurement boundaries constrain cross-study comparisons and generalization claims. Uncertainty-informed training does not establish calibrated inference-time confidence, while embedded inference benchmarks may exclude preprocessing and other operational costs. Research priorities include acquisition-independent evaluation, robustness testing under sensing failures and distribution shifts, confidence calibration, selective prediction, and end-to-end deployment assessment. Prospective feeding trials with predefined control policies and independently measured production outcomes are needed to establish operational benefits. By distinguishing demonstrated capabilities from insufficiently verified claims, this review provides an evidence-oriented foundation for developing dependable fish feeding-assessment systems.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述从标签有效性、数据独立性与适应性、传感退化或缺失下的鲁棒性、预测可靠性与校准、部署与投喂管理证据五个维度，系统评估了水产养殖中多模态深度学习鱼类摄食评估的可靠性与稳健性。核心关切是特征—标签耦合问题，即运动衍生标签与模型输入共享光流表示，可能削弱分类性能的生物学解释力。综述指出多模态融合、缺失模态处理、知识蒸馏与域适应等已有进展，但数据集来源、评估协议与测量边界不一致限制了跨研究比较与泛化结论。研究优先方向包括采集独立评估、传感故障与分布偏移下的鲁棒性测试、置信度校准、选择性预测及端到端部署评估，并需通过预定义控制策略与独立测产的前瞻性投喂试验验证实际效益。

papers.title: Estimates for solutions in a predator-prey model describing plankton-fish interaction
papers.authors: Skvortsova, M. A.
papers.abstract: In the paper we consider a system of differential equations with two delays describing plankton-fish interaction. We study stability of the equilibrium point corresponding to the presence of phytoplankton and zooplankton in the system and the absence of fish. In the case of asymptotic stability, we indicate conditions for the initial data under which solutions stabilize to this equilibrium point and establish estimates for solutions characterizing the stabilization rate at infinity. The results are obtained using Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional. The obtained theoretical results can be used for numerical study of behavior of solutions to the considered model.
papers.summary_cn: 构建含两个时滞的浮游生物-鱼类捕食者-猎物微分方程模型，分析无鱼时浮游植物与浮游动物共存平衡点的稳定性；在渐近稳定情形下，给出初值条件使解收敛至该平衡点，并基于Lyapunov-Krasovskii泛函建立刻画无穷远处稳定速率的解的估计；理论结果可用于该模型的数值研究。

papers.title: Applied research trends in selected macroalgal genera relevant to aquaculture development in Costa Rica
papers.authors: Herrera-Vásquez, Pablo José; Fernández-García, Cindy; Pérez-Molina, Junior Pastor
papers.abstract: Abstract Marine macroalgae are increasingly investigated as sources of food ingredients, hydrocolloids, biomaterials, bioactive compounds, animal-feed additives, biostimulants, and other applied products. Although global bibliometric studies have provided overviews of macroalgal research, an integrated bibliometric and text-mining synthesis comparing applied research across genera selected for their relevance to aquaculture planning in Costa Rica remains lacking. We analyzed 2,996 Scopus-indexed articles published from 2000 to April 2024 on 16 genera relevant to Costa Rican aquaculture. The analysis combined manual screening, supervised AI-assisted classification, and bibliometric mapping of publication trends, industrial sectors, countries, journals, institutions, authors, and keywords. Publication output increased after 2010 and accelerated from 2018 to 2023, especially in the health, agri-livestock, food, manufacturing, and biotechnology sectors. Sargassum , Ulva , and Gracilaria had the largest publication volumes, while India, China, and South Korea accounted for approximately 30% of the records. Keyword networks centered on antioxidant and antimicrobial activity, polysaccharides, extraction, nanoparticles, methane mitigation, and biomaterials, indicating that much of the literature remains focused on exploratory biochemical characterization and in vitro bioactivity studies. These patterns provide evidence-based insights for preliminary research prioritization. Sargassum , Ulva , Gracilaria , and Asparagopsis appear to be promising candidates for further evaluation, followed by Padina , Codium , Cladophora , Gracilariopsis , and Hypnea . However, bibliometric evidence alone cannot determine their suitability for aquaculture development and specific applications. Their potential use in Costa Rica should be evaluated through local cultivation trials, strain selection, seasonal biochemical profiling, contaminant screening, supply-chain assessment, regulatory evaluation, and techno-economic feasibility.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究通过文献计量与文本挖掘，分析了2000年至2024年4月Scopus收录的2996篇涉及16个与哥斯达黎加水产养殖相关的海藻属论文，旨在为研究优先序提供依据。发文量自2010年后增长，2018—2023年加速，集中于健康、农牧、食品、制造和生物技术领域；Sargassum、Ulva和Gracilaria发文量最大，印度、中国和韩国约占30%。关键词网络聚焦抗氧化与抗菌活性、多糖、提取、纳米颗粒、甲烷减排和生物材料，表明多数文献仍停留在生化表征和体外活性研究阶段。Sargassum、Ulva、Gracilaria和Asparagopsis为较有前景的候选属，但需通过本地栽培试验、品系筛选、季节性生化谱、污染物筛查、供应链评估、法规评估和技术经济可行性加以验证。

papers.title: Ecotoxicological effects of antifouling coatings on freshwater organisms: acute, chronic and sublethal responses relevant to aquaculture
papers.authors: Paolucci, Esteban Marcelo; Pereira, Lilian Paula Faria; de Farias, Natália Oliveira; Braga, Esther Faria; Lopes, Claudio Cerqueira; Lopes, Rosangela Sabbatini Capella; De Aragão Umbuzeiro, Gisela; de Rezende Ayroza, Daercy Maria Monteiro
papers.abstract: Biofouling control in freshwater systems often relies on antifouling coatings that may act as sources of chemical exposure to aquatic environments. While these technologies are widely applied, their potential impacts on non-target organisms remain insufficiently understood. In this study, we conducted an integrated ecotoxicological assessment of two antifouling coatings with contrasting modes of action: a biocide-containing formulation incorporating lysoglycerophosphocholine (LGPC) and a biocide-free hybrid silicone-epoxy resin (HYRE). Acute and chronic toxicity assays were performed using the freshwater microcrustaceans Daphnia similis and Ceriodaphnia dubia , while sublethal physiological responses were evaluated through standard metabolic rate (SMR). Metabolic responses were also assessed in the invasive mussel Limnoperna fortunei . Acute toxicity tests revealed immobilization effects in D. similis exposed to LGPC-containing coating formulation at the highest coated surface area-to-medium volume ratio, whereas no effects were observed for HYRE-containing coating formulation. Chronic exposure reduced reproductive output in C. dubia exposed to both coatings, while no statistically significant differences in survival were detected. Although SMR values were numerically higher in D. similis exposed to the LGPC and HYRE-containing coating formulation than in the INOX treatment, the overall treatment effect was not statistically significant. No statistically supported treatment effect on SMR was therefore demonstrated under the tested conditions. No significant differences in SMR were detected among treatments in L. fortunei . These results highlight the importance of incorporating chronic and sublethal endpoints into ecotoxicological assessments of antifouling technologies and underscore the need to evaluate their potential implications for freshwater organisms.
papers.summary_cn: 以含杀生物剂（lyso-glycerophosphocholine, LGPC）与无杀生物剂的杂化硅氧烷-环氧树脂（HYRE）两种防污涂层为对象，采用大型溞（Daphnia similis）和网纹溞（Ceriodaphnia dubia）进行急性和慢性毒性试验，并以标准代谢率（SMR）评估亚致死生理响应，同时测试入侵贻贝Limnoperna fortunei的代谢反应。急性试验中，仅LGPC涂层在最高涂覆面积/介质体积比下引起D. similis固定效应，HYRE涂层未见急性效应。慢性暴露下两种涂层均降低C. dubia繁殖输出，但存活率无显著差异；各处理组间D. similis与L. fortunei的SMR均无统计学显著差异。结果表明防污涂层评估需纳入慢性与亚致死终点。

papers.title: Anticipating the Future of European Aquaculture: A Conceptual Framework Linking Science Anticipation, the EU Taxonomy, Circular Bioeconomy and Aquatic Animal Welfare
papers.authors: Fernández Carrasco, Pedro; Matutano-Molina, Clara
papers.abstract: Aquaculture supplied 53% of global aquatic animal production in 2024, while 37.6% of assessed marine stocks remained outside biologically sustainable levels. The growth of aquaculture has not been matched by an equivalent development of the criteria that should guide it. This narrative review with framework synthesis examines that gap for European aquaculture, with capture fisheries considered only as context. Policy documents, technical standards, and the peer-reviewed literature were analysed around four axes: the science anticipation approach of the Geneva Science and Diplomacy Anticipator (GESDA), with its 5-, 10- and 25-year horizons; the EU Taxonomy for Sustainable Activities; circular side-stream valorisation and workforce training; and operational welfare indicators supported by precision aquaculture. The review finds that no technical screening criteria for aquaculture have yet been adopted under the Taxonomy, although the sector remains subject to EU environmental, animal health and welfare legislation; that circularity and welfare are rarely measured in ways that demonstrate environmental outcomes; and that the move offshore raises structural design questions for which aquaculture-specific evidence is still limited. A conceptual and illustrative horizon matrix is proposed, built with explicit allocation criteria and decision rules, that links technology clusters to Taxonomy objectives, candidate indicators and governance challenges. The matrix reflects the authors’ interpretation of the literature and has not been empirically validated; an implementation and validation pathway, including structured expert consultation, is outlined to test it.
papers.summary_cn: 欧洲水产养殖产量持续增长，但指导其发展的标准体系尚未同步完善。本文通过叙述性综述与框架综合，围绕GESDA科学预判方法（5/10/25年视野）、EU Taxonomy、循环副产物增值与劳动力培训、精准养殖支持的operational welfare indicators四条轴线分析政策文件与技术标准。研究发现EU Taxonomy尚未采纳水产养殖技术筛选标准，循环性与福利指标鲜少以可验证环境产出的方式测量，离岸转型的结构设计证据有限。作者提出一个概念性horizon matrix，将技术集群与Taxonomy目标、候选指标及治理挑战相连接，但尚待实证验证。

papers.title: Base editing in livestock and aquaculture: from tool development to breeding application
papers.authors: Liu, Lily; Zhang, Qin; Su, Baofeng; Wang, Jinhai
papers.abstract: Abstract The growing recognition of base editing as a precise genome-engineering strategy for single-nucleotide conversions without double-strand breaks has increased interest in its application to animal agriculture, where many economically important traits are influenced by single nucleotide variants. Although recent engineering efforts have broadened the targeting scope, improved editing precision, and reduced off-target activity, major challenges remain in translating these tools to livestock and aquaculture species, particularly with respect to delivery, mosaicism, germline transmission, and breeding-scale deployment. In this review, we outline the development of cytosine, adenine, dual, and mitochondrial base editors, and discuss their advances in livestock and fish, including trait-oriented editing in pigs and cattle, rapid functional validation in model fish, and early proof-of-concept studies in aquaculture species. We further discuss the emerging potential of mitochondrial DNA base editing for animal breeding and evaluate the extent to which current advances support the broader goal of precision breeding and sustainable animal production.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述聚焦碱基编辑（base editing）技术从工具开发到畜禽与水产育种应用的转化。文章梳理了胞嘧啶、腺嘌呤、双碱基及线粒体碱基编辑器的演进，并总结其在家畜（猪、牛）经济性状定向编辑、模式鱼快速功能验证及水产养殖物种概念验证中的进展。作者指出，递送、嵌合体、生殖系传递及育种规模部署仍是制约水产与畜禽应用的关键瓶颈，并评估了线粒体DNA碱基编辑在精准育种与可持续动物生产中的潜力。

papers.title: Advances in broodstock maturity assessment and reproductive technologies for sustainable rainbow trout aquaculture
papers.authors: Rather, Mohd Ashraf; Ghara, Suvadip; Mangral, Zahid Ahmed; Meghana, Jadi; Bhat, Irfan Ahmad; Khan, Irfan Ahmad
papers.abstract: Rainbow trout ( Oncorhynchus mykiss ) is an important freshwater aquaculture species with high economic globally. Sustainable production depends on effective broodstock management and reliable artificial reproduction practices. Conventional assessment methods are increasingly supported by non-invasive imaging, biochemical markers and molecular approaches for improved evaluation of reproductive status. Advances in gamete collection, fertilization and incubation have further improved reproductive management in hatchery production. Genomic selection, surrogate broodstock technology and CRISPR/Cas9 gene editing provide new opportunities for genetic improvement and reproductive control. However, important challenges remain in protocol standardization, environmental stress management, disease control and conservation of genetic resources. Omics-based approaches and molecular biomarkers can improve the understanding of reproductive processes and support more accurate broodstock assessment. Advanced cryopreservation methods may further improve the long-term conservation of valuable genetic material. Nutritional programming and epigenetic regulation are also gaining attention because of their potential effects on gamete quality and offspring performance. Sustainable approaches such as integrated multi-trophic aquaculture (IMTA), improved feed efficiency and AI-based monitoring can support efficient resource use and reduce environmental impacts. Overall, advances in reproductive biotechnology and precision aquaculture provide useful approaches for improving broodstock management and sustainable production in rainbow trout and other cultured fish species.
papers.summary_cn: 虹鳟（Oncorhynchus mykiss）养殖的可持续生产依赖有效的亲鱼管理与可靠的人工繁殖。传统亲鱼成熟度评估正日益结合非侵入性成像、生化标志物和分子手段，配子采集、受精与孵化技术的进步也改善了孵化场繁殖管理；基因组选择、代孕亲鱼技术和CRISPR/Cas9基因编辑为遗传改良与繁殖控制提供新途径，但协议标准化、环境应激、疾病防控与遗传资源保护仍存挑战。组学方法与分子生物标志物有助于更准确评估亲鱼繁殖状态，先进冷冻保存技术可促进优质遗传材料长期保存，营养编程与表观遗传调控因对配子质量及子代性能的潜在影响受到关注。IMTA、饲料效率提升和AI监测等可持续手段有助于提高资源利用效率并减少环境影响，繁殖生物技术与精准水产养殖为虹鳟及其他养殖鱼类的亲鱼管理和可持续生产提供了可行路径。

papers.title: AI-Driven Environmental Monitoring for Aquaculture
papers.authors: Wang, Junjie; Liu, Feng; Liu, Chun’e; Xiao, Xinqing
papers.abstract: This narrative review examines where artificial intelligence (AI) improves aquaculture environmental monitoring relative to conventional methods, how validation designs shape the interpretation of reported gains, and what evidence is needed for routine farm use. A thematic synthesis, supplemented by a targeted OpenAlex literature update, compares baselines, validation designs, and measured outcomes across water-quality monitoring, harmful algal bloom surveillance, contaminant sensing, and environmental management. In a flow-through farm, a neural time-series model improved imputation of influent dissolved oxygen (DO), while linear interpolation performed best for tank DO. In a separate six-pond evaluation within one farm, physics-guided transfer learning reduced the mean absolute error of nighttime DO forecasts by 35.5% relative to a standard long short-term memory model. In a 45-day pilot in one koi pond, integrated predictive control used 26.86% less energy than manual operation. These findings support task-specific use of AI for monitoring and decision support. Broader deployment of automated control requires independent farm validation and prospective assessment of water quality and resource use.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述探讨人工智能（AI）在水产养殖环境监测中相较传统方法的改进之处、验证设计对结果解读的影响，以及常规养殖应用所需的证据。通过主题综合与OpenAlex文献更新，比较了水质监测、有害藻华监测、污染物传感和环境管理中的基线、验证设计与实测效果。个案显示，神经网络时序模型改善了流水养殖场进水溶解氧（DO）的插补，而线性插值对池内DO最优； physics-guided transfer learning使夜间DO预测MAE较标准LSTM降低35.5%；45天锦鲤池试验中预测控制节能26.86%。结果表明AI适于任务特定的监测与决策支持，但自动化控制的推广仍需独立养殖场验证及水质与资源利用的前瞻性评估。

papers.title: FCS-UNet: A Dual Hybrid Attention and Multi-Scale Feature Refinement Network for Coastal Aquaculture Facility Extraction from Remote Sensing Imagery
papers.authors: Wang, Can; Liao, Naiyu; Zhang, Tingting; Que, Pengrong; Gao, Yu; Chen, Xin; Kong, Xiangzeng; Wu, Chuanyu
papers.abstract: Accurate extraction of coastal aquaculture facilities from remote sensing imagery remains challenging because these facilities exhibit irregular spatial distributions, substantial scale variations, and weak contrast against complex marine backgrounds, often with indistinct boundaries. To address these challenges, this study proposes FCS-UNet, an enhanced U-Net framework incorporating three components: Dual Hybrid Attention (DHA), Multi-Scale Convolutional Attention Module (MSCAM), and Progressive Stacked Feature Refinement (PSFR). The contribution of this study is the integration of adapted attention and multi-scale modules with a bottleneck block of stacked depthwise-separable convolutions, evaluated by facility type on a new dataset. Experimental results show that FCS-UNet achieves an Accuracy of 93.64 ± 0.42%, a Dice coefficient of 95.25 ± 0.24%, and an IoU of 91.01 ± 0.47%, improving the U-Net baseline by 3.68, 2.75, and 5.02 percentage points, respectively. Dongwuyang experiments and ablation studies further evaluate the model’s performance. Furthermore, facility-type-stratified evaluations demonstrate that FCS-UNet achieves the highest Dice and IoU for both raft and cage facilities in both study areas. Under a random image-level split within a single coastal region, these results demonstrate the effectiveness of FCS-UNet for coastal aquaculture facility extraction.
papers.summary_cn: 针对遥感影像中沿海养殖设施空间分布不规则、尺度差异大、与复杂海洋背景对比度低且边界模糊导致提取困难的问题，提出融合双混合注意力（DHA）、多尺度卷积注意力模块（MSCAM）和渐进堆叠特征细化（PSFR）的改进U-Net框架FCS-UNet。在新数据集上按设施类型评估，模型总体Accuracy达93.64±0.42%、Dice系数95.25±0.24%、IoU为91.01±0.47%，较U-Net基线分别提升3.68、2.75和5.02个百分点。东吾洋实验与消融研究进一步验证模型性能，分类型评估显示FCS-UNet在两类研究区的筏式和网箱设施均取得最高Dice与IoU，表明其在单沿海区域随机图像级划分下对沿海养殖设施提取有效。

papers.title: Review of Chum Salmon run timing, spawner aggregations, and spawning habitat in the Yukon River drainage
papers.authors: Ransbury, Shane R; Borba, Bonnie M; Milligan, Marina; Flannery, Blair G; O’Dell, Adam; Smith, James D; Arcilla, Bailey; Padilla, Andrew J; Clinton, Morag
papers.journal: North American Journal of Fisheries Management
papers.abstract: Abstract Objective Chum Salmon Oncorhynchus keta migrate annually to spawn in the Yukon River drainage at sites within both the United States and Canada, providing a rich subsistence and commercial fishing culture for communities along the river. Yukon River Chum Salmon runs have been roughly cyclical, though overall they have declined over the past 47 years. Beginning in 2020, abrupt declines in their populations resulted in complete fisheries closures and hardship for the remote villages that rely on them. We present a review of the known extent of Chum Salmon spawning habitat in the Yukon River drainage to facilitate research and management discussions as we rebuild the fisheries and the runs that sustain them. Methods Following extensive review of peer-reviewed journals, reports, and gray literature spanning roughly 160 years, spawning sites were differentiated as either summer or fall stocks and were classified as major or minor spawning systems based on maximum escapement estimates or, if unavailable, maximum relative abundance estimates. To place these data in context, we explored trends in reconstructed runs, escapement, and relative abundance and included descriptions of known threats to the long-term viability of production in relevant tributaries within the overall Yukon River drainage. Threats to spawning systems were collated. Results A total of 192 systems in the study area were identified to have Chum Salmon spawning via review of available peer-reviewed manuscripts, reports, and unpublished study findings, of which eight were major spawning areas for summer stock and seven were major areas for fall stock. Abundance estimates were located for the 1950s through 2024, and early discourse related to Chum Salmon, principally from non-Native expeditions or later discussion with Native elders, was located back to 1866. A dendrogram for Chum Salmon populations was updated through 2024 based on the 48 systems with genetic samples, and gaps in our understanding of Yukon River Chum Salmon genetic composition were described. Although all populations of Chum Salmon in the Yukon River are depressed, the Canadian component, especially from the White River drainage, has diminished considerably more compared with the others. Conclusions Habitat degradation issues in freshwater are generally regional and do not appear substantial enough to cause the recent, widespread, and temporally acute decline of Chum Salmon throughout the drainage. However, the combination of regional issues alongside broader factors such as climate change may lead to a prolonged recovery, and an understanding of regional freshwater stressors is important.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述系统梳理了育空河流域 Chum Salmon（Oncorhynchus keta）的产卵分布、洄游时间及种群趋势，基于约160年的同行评议文献、报告和灰色文献，识别出192个产卵系统，其中夏季种群主要产卵区8个、秋季种群7个。研究整合了1950年代至2024年的丰度估算及1866年以来的早期记录，更新了基于48个遗传样本系统的种群聚类分析。尽管全流域 Chum Salmon 种群均处于低迷状态，加拿大境内种群（尤其 White River 流域）下降幅度显著大于其他区域；淡水栖息地退化多为区域性且不足以单独解释近期全流域的急剧衰退，但区域胁迫与气候变化等因素叠加可能延长恢复周期。

papers.title: Recurrent sublethal RNA viral challenges drive common and virus-specific microbiota shifts in fish: zebrafish (Danio rerio) and turbot (Scophthalmus maximus) as model species
papers.authors: Martínez-López, Nieves; Pereiro, Patricia; Saco, Amaro; Rey-Campos, Magalí; Figueras, Antonio; Novoa, Beatriz
papers.abstract: Background Host-associated microbiota play a central role in maintaining physiological homeostasis and regulating host immune responses. In aquatic organisms, this relationship is particularly dynamic due to continuous exposure to the surrounding environment. While acute viral infections are known to induce dysbiosis, the effects of recurrent sublethal exposures, which better reflect conditions in aquaculture and natural environments, remain poorly understood. Methods Here, we investigated how recurrent exposure to viral particles shifts the whole-body microbiota of the freshwater zebrafish ( Danio rerio ) and the intestinal microbiota of the marine turbot ( Scophthalmus maximus ). Fish were subjected to recurrent exposure to sublethal doses of four RNA viruses belonging to three different viral families of aquaculture relevance: the rhabdoviruses spring viremia of carp virus (SVCV) or viral hemorrhagic septicemia virus (VHSV) in zebrafish and turbot, respectively, the birnavirus infectious pancreatic necrosis virus (IPNV), and the nodavirus red-spotted grouper nervous necrosis virus (RGNNV) in both species. Microbial communities were characterized using 16S rRNA gene sequencing, and diversity, co-occurrence networks, and predicted functional profiles were analyzed. Results Our results demonstrate that recurrent sublethal viral exposure in fish induces microbiota alterations that combine both conserved and virus-specific alterations. In zebrafish, Ralstonia was consistently enriched across viral exposures, whereas in turbot, changes in bacterial taxa varied among virus-exposed groups. Nevertheless, some genera showed a shared pattern of enrichment, including Polaribacter 4 and Aestuariicella in both VHSV- and IPNV-exposed groups. In contrast, RGNNV-exposed groups exhibited the most pronounced dysbiosis, including the virus-specific near disappearance of Plesiomonas , the most abundant taxa in the zebrafish control group. Discussion This underscores the importance of host-virus interplay in shaping microbiota dynamics, accompanied by changes in predicted metabolic functions. Together, these results emphasize the need to consider microbiota dynamics in disease progression and support the potential of microbial indicators as tools for monitoring fish health.
papers.summary_cn: 研究以斑马鱼（Danio rerio）和大菱鲆（Scophthalmus maximus）为模型，探究反复亚致死剂量RNA病毒暴露对宿主微生物群的影响，所用病毒包括SVCV、VHSV、IPNV和RGNNV。采用16S rRNA基因测序分析微生物多样性、共现网络及预测功能谱。结果表明，反复亚致死病毒暴露诱导的微生物群改变兼具保守性与病毒特异性：斑马鱼中Ralstonia在各病毒暴露组一致富集，大菱鲆中VHSV与IPNV组共享Polaribacter 4和Aestuariicella富集模式，而RGNNV组菌群失调最显著。研究提示宿主-病毒互作驱动微生物群动态，微生物指标可作为鱼类健康监测工具。

papers.title: Using AFS’s new standard sampling data webtool to help evaluate freshwater fish populations
papers.authors: Bonar, Scott A; Tracy, Erin; Riemer, Kristina
papers.abstract: Abstract The American Fisheries Society’s (AFS’s) second edition of Standard Methods for Sampling North American Freshwater Fishes, which was published fall 2024, contains summaries of standard sampling comparison data that fisheries professionals can use to help diagnose problems in their fish populations. These summaries are based on a database containing records from almost 15,000 surveys of 52 fish species in 54 states and Canadian provinces sampled with the AFS standard gear types. Here, we demonstrate a webtool that allows users to upload data from an individual fish population collected using the standard methods reported in the book, and compare their data with existing North American, ecoregion, and within-state summaries of common fish assessment metrics from standard data collected in similar water body types. User input is simply fish species, water body type, standard gear type, and a data spreadsheet containing fish lengths, weights, and sampling effort from your survey. Output includes visualizations of CPUE, length frequency, and relative weight, and data tables that allow for rapid fishery diagnoses, similar to how short summaries of standard laboratory results from an individual compared to a larger population are important for physicians diagnosing health problems in human patients.
papers.summary_cn: 美国渔业学会（AFS）于2024年秋季发布《北美淡水鱼类标准采样方法》第二版，其配套数据库涵盖54个州和省、52种鱼类的近15,000次标准采样调查记录。本文介绍一款基于该数据库的网页工具，用户仅需输入鱼种、水体类型、标准渔具类型及包含体长、体重和采样努力量的数据表，即可将本地种群数据与北美、生态区及州内标准汇总数据进行对比。输出包括CPUE、体长频率和相对体重的可视化图表及数据表，辅助渔业人员快速诊断种群状况。

papers.title: Climate-anomaly-driven reproductive compromise in Neotropical fish: ENSO impairs seminal quality across reproductive peaks in captive Prochilodus magdalenae
papers.authors: Cogollo-Bohórquez, Danilo; Martínez, José Gregorio; Medina-Robles, Victor; Mira-López, Tatiana; Espinosa-Araujo, José; Atencio-García, Víctor
papers.abstract: The bocachico Prochilodus magdalenae, Colombia’s most ecologically and economically important native freshwater fish, has declined sharply under compounding anthropogenic pressures, yet whether climate anomalies compromise its gamete quality remains unexplored. This species shows two annual reproductive peaks (May-July and October-December), offering a natural model for comparing reproductive performance under contrasting climatic conditions. We assessed semen quality in captive males across both peaks, one coinciding with the influence of a strong El Niño-Southern Oscillation (ENSO) event (>90% probability) and the other with neutral conditions. Seminal pH, osmolality, volume, CASA-derived sperm kinematics, and total antioxidant capacity (TAC) of seminal plasma were analyzed alongside water temperature, precipitation, and ENSO status using Boruta selection, Random Forest/SHAP, and redundancy analysis. Semen quality differed significantly between peaks: the ENSO-neutral second peak showed higher TAC (312.4 ± 162.4 vs. 200.7 ± 25.0 µmol TE/100 g), total motility (97.8 ± 3.4% vs. 96.2 ± 4.4%), and sperm concentration (28,956.4 ± 2,238.1 × 10⁶ vs. 17,430.7 ± 1,849.6 × 10⁶ spz/mL) than the El Niño-affected first peak (p < 0.05). ENSO occurrence and water temperature emerged as the strongest predictors of TAC across Boruta and Random Forest/SHAP analyses, ranking above pH and sperm kinematics, and a composite Integrated Composite Conservation Score built from the five most discriminant seminal traits was likewise significantly lower under El Niño (0.440 vs. 0.495, p < 0.001). Seminal TAC declined significantly with increasing water temperature (β = -33.5, p < 0.001), falling below values recorded at the El Niño-associated critical threshold (30.4°C), projecting this relationship onto IPCC AR6 regional warming scenarios for Colombia forecasts a 32-41% decline in TAC by 2050. These findings show that ENSO-driven anomalies substantially compromise seminal quality in P. magdalenae , expose its antioxidant system as a key vulnerability under future warming, and underscore the need for environmental monitoring in conservation and breeding programs for this and other Neotropical Characiformes.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以哥伦比亚重要本土淡水鱼bocachico（Prochilodus magdalenae）为对象，比较其两个年度繁殖高峰（其一受强ENSO事件影响、其一为中性条件）下圈养雄鱼的精液质量，结合CASA精子运动学、精浆总抗氧化能力（TAC）及水温、降水与ENSO状态进行Boruta、Random Forest/SHAP和冗余分析。结果显示，受El Niño影响的高峰期精液TAC、总 motility 和精子浓度均显著低于中性高峰期，ENSO发生与水温是TAC的最强预测因子，且TAC随水温升高显著下降。将该关系投射至IPCC AR6区域增温情景，预测2050年TAC将下降32–41%，表明ENSO驱动的气候异常显著损害该种精液质量，其抗氧化系统是未来升温下的关键脆弱环节。

papers.title: Color pattern evolution in the threespine stickleback (Gasterosteus aculeatus): a review
papers.authors: Anderson, C. M.; Yong, L.; Brown, C. E.; Varnell, D. T.; McKinnon, J. S.
papers.journal: Reviews in Fish Biology and Fisheries
papers.abstract: Abstract Studies of animal color patterns have provided important insights into evolution, particularly the genetic and developmental bases of adaptation, natural selection’s role in molding both nuptial and nonbreeding traits, and sexual/social selection’s role in ornament evolution. Here we review these topics for the threespine stickleback, a leading evolutionary model. Concerning genetics, we find that melanic characters are the best elucidated, with one to multiple genes indicated. Red coloration appears polygenic and candidate genes include ttc39b, but manipulations using CRISPR-Cas9 are needed. When red is present in females as well as males, shared QTL are involved, but red-correlated gene expression can also be sex-specific. Plasticity is important for both conspicuous and cryptic color patches, with light environment critical. Regarding selection, lateral barring appears adaptive against predation, but opportunities for experimental evolution studies need to be pursued-also for nuptial color. For males, red intensity is often correlated with condition, aggression and dominance, as well as successful offspring rearing, but contrary results have also been obtained. Further, there is no direct evidence that benefits resulting from choice of mate drive preference evolution. Sensory drive, however, is increasingly supported. Genetic correlations, for example between the expression and perception of color, may be important yet their underpinnings are largely unknown. Comparative data from related species bolster observations of threespine stickleback social behavior which suggest, first, that spine color merits additional research attention; and second, that a comparative approach based in current sensory ecology methods and considering multiple color patches is likely to provide valuable insights.
papers.summary_cn: 本文综述了三刺鱼（Gasterosteus aculeatus）体色图案进化的遗传、发育与选择机制。黑色素性状的遗传基础最为清晰，红色性状呈多基因遗传且候选基因包括ttc39b；表型可塑性对显著色斑和隐蔽色斑均重要，光环境是关键因素。侧条纹在捕食压力下具适应性，雄性红色强度常与体质、攻击性和 dominance 相关，但配偶选择偏好进化的直接证据不足，sensory drive 假说获得越来越多支持。作者建议关注棘刺颜色并采用基于感官生态学的多色斑比较研究途径。

papers.title: Hierarchical pattern of community assembly and management implications for fishery invertebrates in estuarine waters
papers.authors: Cao, Wenzhuo; Liang, Cui; Zhang, Zhaopeng; Sun, Xu; Xian, Weiwei
papers.journal: Reviews in Fish Biology and Fisheries
papers.abstract: With the decline of traditional large-size fishery resources, invertebrates have become increasingly important in estuarine fisheries. However, they now face multiple pressures from habitat degradation and anthropogenic factors, which have reshaped resource distribution patterns and presented serious challenges to fishery management. Based on 15 years of survey data, this study applied joint species distribution models to the occurrence and biomass data of important fishery invertebrates in offshore waters of the Yangtze River Estuary (YRE). We aimed to systematically analyze the driving mechanisms of resource dynamics at the community level. The results showed a hierarchical pattern of community assembly in the YRE. Habitat variables accounted for the majority of relative contribution to the explained variance in the occurrence model (~ 74%), with total suspended matter, chlorophyll-a, and bottom temperature as primary drivers. The further refinement of community structure-reflected in biomass-was more often explained by spatio-temporal structuring factors, which accounted for 58% of the model-explained variance. The strong temporal effects indicated pronounced interannual variation in community structure. Based on different response patterns, invertebrates in the YRE can be classified into several groups, for which we propose diverse management strategies: annually updated resource surveys and adaptive management strategies are more suitable for interannually fluctuating species; habitat and spatial structure-driven species require priority maintenance of overall habitat quality and implementing spatially targeted management in biomass hotspots and areas with high vulnerability. This study offers a theoretical basis for scientific conservation of invertebrate resources in the YRE.
papers.summary_cn: 基于长江口15年调查数据，采用联合物种分布模型分析重要渔业无脊椎动物的出现与生物量，揭示群落构建的层级性格局。栖息地变量解释出现模型约74%的相对贡献，总悬浮物、叶绿素a和底层水温为主要驱动因子；生物量反映的群落结构细化更多由时空结构因子解释（占模型解释方差的58%），时间效应显著表明群落结构年际波动明显。据此将长江口无脊椎动物按响应模式分组，提出差异化管理的建议：年际波动物种适用年度更新的资源调查与适应性管理，栖息地与空间结构驱动物种需优先维持整体栖息地质量，并在生物量热点和高脆弱区实施空间针对性管理。
