papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于印尼廖内省Kampar县的渔业养殖村项目，采用定性方法对15名相关方进行半结构化访谈，运用NVivo 12 Plus进行主题分析，考察政策网络实施中的关系维度与解释维度。研究发现，项目实施涉及差异化的行动者角色、信息流动、联络与中介功能、信任关系及跨组织资源互依，行动者对饲料/原料、市场准入和资本等实施问题的界定存在不同程度的相似性，并识别出技术指导、机构强化、市场准入与下游化及基础设施改善等解决方案领域。研究提出关系—解释视角，将网络位置、信任、互依与共享问题界定视为政策网络组织、体验与解释的分析特征，而非实施效果的指标。

papers.title: Economic paradoxes and strategic determinants of sustainable aquaculture technology adoption: Empirical evidence from a logistic model
papers.authors: Tran, Quoc-Toan; Pham, Duy-Minh
papers.abstract: The adoption of sustainable aquaculture standards is promoted as a pathway toward food safety, environmental protection, and market upgrading, yet smallholder uptake often remains limited because compliance costs are immediate while market rewards are uncertain. This study examines that tension using a 2016-2017 survey of 240 aquaculture households in coastal Nam Dinh Province, Vietnam, comprising all 120 Vietnamese Good Agricultural Practices (VietGAP) households identified as actively implementing or preparing for VietGAP in the survey frame and 120 conventional households randomly selected from the same localities. Farm-level economic accounting is combined with a binary logistic model. VietGAP farms generated higher output values but also incurred substantially higher costs, producing lower mixed-income-to-intermediate-cost ratios than conventional farms. The original model estimates show strong associations between VietGAP participation, public technical training, and intensive or semi-intensive farming systems. Because the analytical sample was deliberately balanced by adoption status, these model outputs are interpreted as within-sample associations rather than population adoption probabilities. The study also draws on direct questionnaires with 45 market actors and 30 local officials to contextualize market coordination and policy conditions. The findings are presented as historical, mechanism-focused evidence from the early implementation phase of VietGAP rather than as a description of current prevalence. They suggest that sustainable aquaculture standards are more likely to scale when technical capability, market coordination, and compliance finance develop together.
papers.summary_cn: 基于越南南定省2016–2017年240户水产养殖户调查（120户VietGAP户与120户常规户），结合农场经济核算与二元logistic模型，分析了可持续水产养殖标准采纳的经济悖论与策略决定因素。VietGAP养殖户产值更高但成本显著增加，混合收入与中间成本之比低于常规户；模型显示VietGAP参与、公共技术培训与集约化/半集约化养殖系统存在强关联，但因样本按采纳状态平衡设计，结果仅解释为样本内关联。研究还结合45个市场主体和30名地方官员问卷，指出可持续养殖标准的推广有赖于技术能力、市场协调与合规融资的协同发展。

papers.title: Prevalence and abundance of pathogens in biofilters of freshwater recirculating aquaculture systems for Atlantic salmon (Salmo salar)
papers.authors: Fernando, Fernando; Krishna, Dhiraj; Petersen, Petra Elisabeth; Dahl, Maria Marjunardóttir; Vadstein, Olav; Christiansen, Debes Hammershaimb; Bakke, Ingrid
papers.abstract: The extent to which recirculating aquaculture system (RAS) biofilters contain pathogenic microorganisms is poorly understood. Previous studies have been limited to single facilities, offering little insight into pathogen prevalence across different systems. This study quantified the occurrence of three bacterial and four viral pathogens in 50 freshwater biofilters from 36 commercial RAS across 11 facilities in Norway and the Faroe Islands for Atlantic salmon using quantitative PCR (qPCR). We also characterized the bacterial community structure using 16S rRNA gene amplicon sequencing. Overall, pathogens were present at low abundance. Flavobacterium psychrophilum was detected in 35 of 50 biofilters (70%). Its highest abundance was estimated at 18.6 copies per ng template DNA or 0.015% relative to 16S rRNA gene copies. Yersinia ruckeri and Candidatus Branchiomonas cysticola were rare, detected in 4 (8%) and 1 (2%) biofilters, respectively. Infectious pancreatic necrosis virus (IPNV) was detected in 16 biofilters (32%). Avirulent infectious salmon anemia virus (ISAV-HPR0), Orthoreovirus piscis -1 (PRV-1), and salmon gill poxvirus (SGPV) were detected in 11 (22%), 6 (12%), and 3 (6%) biofilters, respectively. Microbial community analysis showed that heterotrophic bacterial genera, e.g., Flavobacterium , Aeromonas , Pseudomonas , and Mycobacterium , were commonly found in RAS biofilters.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在明确大西洋鲑（Salmo salar）淡水RAS生物滤器中病原微生物的污染状况，采用qPCR对挪威和法罗群岛11个设施36套商业RAS的50个生物滤器进行3种细菌和4种病毒定量检测，并结合16S rRNA基因扩增子测序分析细菌群落结构。结果显示病原体总体丰度较低，Flavobacterium psychrophilum检出率最高（70%，35/50），Yersinia ruckeri和Candidatus Branchiomonas cysticola罕见；IPNV检出率为32%，ISAV-HPR0、PRV-1和SGPV分别为22%、12%和6%。微生物群落以Flavobacterium、Aeromonas、Pseudomonas和Mycobacterium等异养菌属为主。

papers.title: Smart aquaculture: an IoT-based monitoring and automation system for fish farming powered by solar energy
papers.authors: Ferdiansyah, Muhammad; Sari, Marlia; Damsir; Mariya, Lika; Arifin, Zaenal
papers.journal: Journal of Electrical Systems and Information Technology
papers.abstract: Abstract The growing demand for animal protein highlights aquaculture’s importance for food security, yet conventional practices face challenges in water-quality monitoring, operational efficiency, and energy sustainability. This study develops a solar-powered Internet of Things (IoT)-based Smart Aquaculture system integrating real-time water-quality monitoring, automated pumps, aerators, and feeders, and renewable energy supplied by a 300 Wp photovoltaic module and a 100 Ah battery. The system was evaluated through technical performance assessments and a 60-day cultivation experiment comparing conventional and IoT + solar ponds. Sensor measurements exhibited deviations of ≤ 5% from laboratory references, while data transmission achieved an average latency of 180 ms and a packet loss rate of 0.8%. Daily energy consumption averaged approximately 850 Wh/day, compared with photovoltaic generation of 1,200 Wh/day, resulting in a 70.8% load-to-generation ratio and an average energy surplus of 350 Wh/day under observed solar conditions. The IoT + solar pond demonstrated a 29.2% increase in average daily fish growth, a 10-percentage-point improvement in survival rate (82% to 92%), and a 17.1% reduction in feed conversion ratio (1.75 to 1.45). One-way analysis of variance (ANOVA) revealed a substantial difference in sampled final fish weights between groups (F(1,58) = 2417.16, p < 0.001). However, the absence of independent pond-level replication limits causal inference and broader generalizability. These findings demonstrate the technical feasibility of integrating IoT-based automation with photovoltaic energy for aquaculture operations, while indicating potential improvements in productivity and energy management. The proposed system provides a practical foundation for developing adaptive, energy-efficient, and sustainable aquaculture technologies, warranting further validation through independently replicated field trials.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究开发了一套太阳能供电的物联网（IoT）智能水产养殖系统，集成实时水质监测、自动水泵、增氧机和投饵机，由300 Wp光伏组件和100 Ah电池供能，并通过技术性能评估与60天养殖对比实验进行验证。传感器测量值与实验室参考值偏差≤5%，数据传输平均延迟180 ms、丢包率0.8%；日均能耗约850 Wh，光伏发电约1,200 Wh/d，负载发电比70.8%。与常规池塘相比，IoT+太阳能组鱼类日均生长提高29.2%，存活率由82%升至92%，饲料转化率由1.75降至1.45（单因素ANOVA，F(1,58)=2417.16，p<0.001），但缺乏独立池塘水平重复限制了因果推断与推广性。结果表明IoT自动化与光伏能源集成的技术可行性，并在生产力与能源管理方面具有提升潜力。

papers.title: Live bass, fish heads, and bacalao: ethnic supermarkets increase seafood access and strengthen food system resilience in a US urban system
papers.authors: Young, Talia; Yin, Feini; Dubik, Bradford; Kim, Jeannette; Provost, Mikaela M; Chen, C. J.; Jiang, Rachel; Lin, Zoe; Lhanyitsang, Sherab C; Acquafredda, Michael
papers.abstract: Ethnic supermarkets serving specific cultural communities have long provided alternatives to mainstream food retail systems; however, their role in seafood diversity and supply chain structure is poorly understood. To characterize product diversity and pricing, we surveyed non-frozen seafood products at supermarkets serving Asian, Black/Latin American/Caribbean, Eastern European, and “mainstream” communities in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, USA, and conducted interviews with store staff to elucidate seafood procurement systems at different stores. The four types of stores offered significantly different product compositions from each other (i.e., different mixes of live organisms, whole finfish, fillets, and processed and packaged products). Asian supermarkets offered significantly greater diversity in seafood species (including higher proportions of wild-caught and domestic species) at significantly lower prices than other stores. Interviews suggested that seafood supply chains at the large chain businesses were typically highly centralized, while smaller and ethnic businesses tended to work with multiple and culturally specific providers, and in many cases put considerable effort into building a complex network of suppliers in order to obtain their desired seafood products. These results indicate that ethnic supermarkets provide critical access to culturally specific seafood products for a wide range of communities, in stark contrast to an increasingly homogenized mainstream seafood retail system. These ethnic markets further function as an established but in some ways underrecognized market for domestic seafood. They also provide an example of a non-corporate, alternative food system resilient to perturbations. Small-scale seafood harvesters and local seafood advocates could benefit from recognizing and building on these successful existing networks.
papers.summary_cn: 研究调查了美国费城服务亚裔、黑人/拉美/加勒比、东欧及主流社区的超市海产品多样性、定价与采购体系。亚裔超市的海产品种类多样性显著更高（野生及本土物种比例更高）且价格更低，四类超市产品构成差异显著。访谈显示大型连锁企业供应链高度集中，而小型及族裔企业多与文化特定供应商合作并构建复杂供应网络。族裔超市为多元社区提供了关键的文化特定海产品获取渠道，构成具有韧性的非企业化替代食物系统。

papers.title: Genome Evolution in Diploid Aegilops Species Assessed Using FISH with pTa-713, pTa-k566 and Oligo-45 Satellite DNA Families
papers.authors: Badaeva, Ekaterina D.; Ulyanov, Daniil S.; Razumova, Olga V.; Kotseruba, Violetta V.; Yurkina, Anna I.; Maida Jazmin, González Franco; Kuznetsova, Viktoria M.; Belousova, Maria Kh.; Chikida, Nadezhda N.; Tereshchenko, Nadezhda A.
papers.abstract: Repetitive DNAs are key drivers of genome evolution, but their dynamics accompanying the divergence of Aegilops genomes remain incompletely understood. Tandem repeats often serve as FISH markers in phylogenetic studies, however, few families have been used for evaluating relationships among Aegilops species. In this study, we employed three recently discovered satellite repeats, pTa-713, pTa-k566 and oligo-45, to analyze diploid Aegilops taxa to gain a deeper insight into the chromosomal mechanisms of genome evolution. We analyzed 121 accessions representing 11 diploid Aegilops species using these three probes and showed that they are effective for chromosome and genome identification in Aegilops. For each species, we established a generalized karyotype and assessed intra- and interspecific polymorphisms. Diploid genomes varied in repeat content and distribution; Ae. speltoides had the highest pTa-713 content, whereas D-, M- and N-genomes were highly abundant in oligo-45. The specific labelling patterns allowed us to subdivide Aegilops into six groups, mostly consistent with the taxonomic classification of the genus. FISH results showed that Ae. tauschii is karyotypically distinct from species of the Sitopsis group, which contradicts the affinity established via the analysis of low-copy DNA sequences. This controversy could be due to different evolutionary pathways between coding- and non-coding DNA fractions, introgressive hybridization and incomplete lineage sorting.
papers.summary_cn: 以FISH技术结合pTa-713、pTa-k566和oligo-45三个卫星重复序列探针，分析11个二倍体Aegilops物种共121份材料的基因组演化特征。各物种重复序列含量与分布存在差异，Ae. speltoides的pTa-713含量最高，D、M和N基因组富含oligo-45，标记模式可将Aegilops划分为6个类群，基本符合传统分类。Ae. tauschii与Sitopsis组物种的核型明显不同，与低拷贝DNA序列分析结果矛盾，可能源于编码与非编码DNA演化路径差异、渐渗杂交和不完全谱系分选。

papers.title: Study on Retained Bycatch in a Traditional Small-Scale Sero Trap Fishery in Bone Bay, Indonesia
papers.authors: Patangngari, Fijwal; Musbir, Musbir; Najamuddin; Sangeamwong, Thanakorn
papers.journal: New Zealand Journal of Marine and Freshwater Research
papers.abstract: Traditional sero fisheries support coastal livelihoods in Indonesia, yet their retained bycatch remains poorly documented. This case study quantified retained-bycatch composition, catch per unit effort (CPUE) and assemblage structure in four sero units, a small-scale stationary trap operating in seaweed-farming, coral-associated, mangrove and river-mouth settings in Bone Bay. Over 120 hauls (February-May 2024), retained non-target catch was classified as commercial bycatch (CB) or low-value retained bycatch (LVB). Retained bycatch comprised 20,877 individuals and 476.0 kg from 85 taxa, and fishes contributed 97.4% of individuals. LVB made up 70.4% of individuals but 35.3% of biomass and was concentrated at the river-mouth unit (90.8% of LVB individuals), where Ambassis vachellii dominated and salinity and water transparency were lowest. Generalised linear models showed significant station effects on CPUE for both fractions (all p < 0.001). CB abundance was highest at the mangrove unit (45.6 individuals 100 m -1 haul -1 ), whereas CB biomass was highest at the coral-associated unit (2.86 kg 100 m -1 haul -1 ), reflecting mean individual weights of 18.5 and 126.0 g, respectively. PERMANOVA showed that assemblage structure differed among all stations ( R 2 = 0.36-0.48), although for LVB and total retained bycatch, dispersion also differed. These findings should be interpreted as a case study of four gear units rather than as generalisable habitat effects: each station was represented by a single sero unit, sampling covered only 4 months, habitat was confounded with mesh size and the fishing intensity of other gears around the stations was not quantified. Recording CB and LVB separately, in both abundance and biomass, is recommended for monitoring small-scale fisheries, and replicated, longer-term studies are needed before the patterns can be generalised.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以印尼Bone Bay四个传统小型定置陷阱（sero）作业单元为对象，量化其保留性副渔获物（retained bycatch）的组成、CPUE及群落结构，区分商业性副渔获（CB）与低值保留副渔获（LVB）。120次作业共记录85个分类群、20,877尾、476.0 kg，鱼类占个体数97.4%；LVB占个体数70.4%但仅占生物量35.3%，集中于河口单元（以Ambassis vachellii为主）。GLM显示站点对两类CPUE均有显著影响，PERMANOVA表明各站点群落结构存在差异（R²=0.36–0.48）。作者建议小规模渔业监测应分别记录CB与LVB的数量和生物量，并指出该研究仅为四单元案例、生境与网目及捕捞强度混杂，需重复性长期研究方可推广。

papers.title: Trace element contamination and health risk assessment in coastal reef-associated fish from El-Khobar area, Arabian Gulf, Saudi Arabia
papers.authors: Younis, Alaa M.; Khairy, Mohamed; AL-Zbedy, Amnah S.; Elkady, Eman M.
papers.abstract: Aquatic organisms provide an important source of essential nutrients, but they are also known to bioaccumulate trace elements (TEs), which can cause health threats to human. The bioaccumulation of ten TEs, copper (Cu), cadmium (Cd), nickel (Ni), barium (Ba), iron (Fe), cobalt (Co), zinc (Zn), arsenic (As), lead (Pb) and chromium (Cr), in eight fish species (Johnius belangerii, Carangoides bajad, Lethrinus lentjan, Epinephelus malabaricus, Diagramma pictum, Scomberomorus guttatus, Lutjanus fulviflamma and Lutjanus malabaricus) from a tropical coastal area was analyzed in this work. Furthermore, pollution indexes and potential health risk were calculated. The concentration were as follows: Fe, 60.0-82.0 μg/g wet weight (ww); Zn, 49.0-58.0 μg/g ww; As, 1.08-1.48 μg/g ww; Cr, 0.24-0.32 μg/g ww; Ni, 0.25-0.34 μg/g ww. Specific bioaccumulation patterns were found, with the highest TE concentration being Fe in L. malabaricus (82.0 µg/g ww) and the lowest Ba in C. bajad (0.13 µg/g ww). The HQ values remained below the acceptable limit in both adults and children, whereas the HI values exceeded the recommended threshold (HI > 1) in children, indicating a potential non-carcinogenic health risk. The calculated CR values for Cd and Pb were below 1 × 10⁻4; carcinogenic risks for As, Cr, and Ni were not estimated because their relevant toxicological forms were not determined. Pollution indices showed that L. malabaricus and E. malabaricus were the species exhibiting the highest relative trace-element accumulation according to the applied indices, whereas multivariate analysis suggested that biologically essential metals (Zn, Fe, Ni, Cu) were the main factors explaining interspecies variability. These results highlight the importance of regular trace element surveillance in fish in order to protect the public health, particularly for at risk groups like children.
papers.summary_cn: 对阿拉伯湾El-Khobar沿岸8种礁区鱼类（包括Johnius belangerii、Lethrinus lentjan、Epinephelus malabaricus等）肌肉中Cu、Cd、Ni、Ba、Fe、Co、Zn、As、Pb、Cr共10种痕量元素进行测定，并计算污染指数与健康风险。Fe浓度最高（60.0–82.0 μg/g ww），Zn次之（49.0–58.0 μg/g ww），As为1.08–1.48 μg/g ww；L. malabaricus的Fe浓度最高（82.0 μg/g ww），C. bajad的Ba最低（0.13 μg/g ww）。成人与儿童HQ均低于可接受限值，但儿童HI超过阈值（HI>1），提示潜在非致癌健康风险；Cd、Pb的CR低于1×10⁻⁴，As、Cr、Ni因未确定相关毒性形态而未估算致癌风险。污染指数显示L. malabaricus与E. malabaricus相对累积最高，多变量分析表明Zn、Fe、Ni、Cu等生物必需金属是种间差异的主要解释因子。

papers.title: Skin and gut bacterial assemblages show differential responses to prolonged heat exposure and cooling in zebrafish ( Danio rerio )
papers.authors: Adzijovski, Monique; Schultz, Aaron G.; Wos-Oxley, Melissa L.; Oxley, Andrew P. A.; Afonso, Luis O.B.
papers.abstract: Abstract Rising water temperatures can disrupt host-associated microbial communities important to fish metabolism, immunity and pathogen defence; however, the effects of prolonged thermal exposure and subsequent recovery remain poorly understood. We examined skin and gut bacterial assemblages of juvenile zebrafish under four temperature regimes: T1 (28°C for 60 days), T2 (28°C for 30 days followed by 34°C for 30 days), T3 (34°C for 30 days followed by 28°C for 30 days) and T4 (34°C for 60 days). Bacterial assemblages were profiled on days 1, 30 and 60 using full-length 16S rRNA gene sequencing and analysis of resulting bacterial amplicon sequence variants. Gut community composition was comparatively stable across thermal treatments and showed limited overlap with water assemblages. In contrast, skin communities showed marked thermal sensitivity, with shifts in beta diversity, species richness and the relative abundance of commensal and potentially opportunistic taxa. Chronic heat exposure enriched Lysobacter , Rubrivivax , Gemmobacter and Pseudomonas and reduced Rhodobacter . Following cooling, T3 skin communities shifted towards control profiles, with increased overlap in core taxa, but did not fully return to the control state. These findings demonstrate tissue-specific responses to prolonged warming and identify the skin bacterial community as a potential non-invasive indicator of thermal perturbation and recovery.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以斑马鱼为对象，设置四种温度情景（持续28°C、28°C转34°C、34°C转28°C及持续34°C），结合16S rRNA基因全长测序分析皮肤与肠道细菌群落对长期热暴露及降温恢复的响应。结果显示肠道菌群组成在热处理间相对稳定，与水体菌群重叠有限；而皮肤菌群表现出显著热敏感性，beta多样性、物种丰富度及共生与潜在机会性类群相对丰度均发生明显变化。持续热暴露富集 Lysobacter、Rubrivivax、Gemmobacter 和 Pseudomonas，减少 Rhodobacter；降温后皮肤群落向对照组趋近但未完全恢复。研究表明鱼类宿主相关菌群对升温的响应具有组织特异性，皮肤细菌群落可作为热扰动及恢复的非侵入性指示指标。

papers.title: Short-term repeatability of standard and maximum metabolic rates in yellow perch ( Perca flavescens )
papers.authors: Smuk, Jessica A.; De Bonville, Jeremy; Bihun, Christian J.; Raby, Graham D.
papers.abstract: Abstract Metabolic rate is often assumed to be a trait that remains relatively consistent within individuals, with most variation attributed to environmental factors. However, few studies have quantified metabolic repeatability in fishes. We examined the short-term repeatability of standard metabolic rate (SMR), absolute aerobic scope (AAS) and maximum metabolic rate (MMR) in yellow perch ( Perca flavescens; n = 15). Repeatability was moderate for SMR ( R = 0.318), mild for AAS ( R = 0.243) and poor for MMR ( R = 0.080), indicating modest within-individual variability in metabolic measurements over a 32-day experiment. More data on metabolic repeatability across varying contexts are needed to help understand within- and among-individual variation.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估黄鲈（Perca flavescens）标准代谢率（SMR）、绝对有氧范围（AAS）和最大代谢率（MMR）的短期重复性（n=15，实验持续32天）。结果显示SMR重复性中等（R=0.318），AAS较弱（R=0.243），MMR极低（R=0.080），表明个体内代谢测定值存在一定变异。作者指出需在不同条件下积累更多代谢重复性数据，以理解个体内与个体间变异。

papers.title: Oxygen isotopes in Arctic cod ( Boreogadus saida ) otoliths confirm life stage-specific vertical migrations and reveal the life history implications of early ontogenetic temperature
papers.authors: Herbig, Jennifer; Loewen, Tracey; Fisher, Jonathan A. D.; Niemi, Andrea; Bouchard, Caroline; Else, Brent; Nickoloff, Gina; Walker, Zoe; Michel, Christine; Pućko, Monika
papers.abstract: Abstract As a key forage fish in the Arctic, Arctic cod ( Boreogadus saida ) plays a critical role in transferring energy in Arctic marine ecosystems. While understanding Arctic cod population dynamics within the context of a rapidly warming Arctic could provide essential information for regional conservation efforts, it remains elusive. Here, we postulate that the isotopic ratio of oxygen ( 18 O: 16 O, expressed as δ 18 O) in otoliths can be used to reconstruct both the thermal and spatial history of Arctic cod across the Canadian Arctic and provide insights into future population dynamics. Otoliths grow throughout the life of a fish and incorporate oxygen stable isotopes proportionate to ambient concentrations following a temperature-dependent fractionation, thereby reflecting the thermal habitats utilized by Arctic cod through their lifetime. Here, we measured δ 18 O in otoliths from 370 Arctic cod caught across the Canadian Arctic. We derived in-situ fractionation equations inclusive of an age component, compared these with available laboratory-derived equations, and estimated ambient temperature at larval stages of fish development. We further modelled the effects of ambient temperature experienced during otolith core formation on standard length-at-age using a generalized linear model to better understand the effects of warming temperatures on Arctic cod. The results of our study confirm ontogenetic vertical migration of Arctic cod from the epipelagic layer (0-100 m) to the deeper Atlantic water mass (>100 m) within the first year of life. However, the lack of regional small-scale variation in δ 18 O values within deeper Atlantic waters that fish used impeded the detection of regional horizontal movements at depth based solely on this tracer. Analyses of δ 18 O also showed that Arctic cod experiencing warmer temperatures during early life stages are smaller around age of maturity, suggesting applicability of the temperature-size rule. Thus, the effects of increasing surface water temperatures in the Canadian Arctic could propagate through the marine food web. While oxygen isotopes in otoliths are a promising way to monitor the effects of temperature on Arctic cod growth in the Canadian Arctic, work remains to realize the full potential of this tool to identify shifts in habitat use.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过测定加拿大北极地区370尾北极鳕（Boreogadus saida）耳石中的δ¹⁸O，重建其热经历与空间移动历史，并建立包含年龄组分的原位分馏方程以估算幼体阶段的环境温度。结果证实北极鳕在生命第一年内由表层（0–100 m）向深层大西洋水团（>100 m）进行个体发育垂直迁移，但深层水团中δ¹⁸O缺乏区域小尺度变异，限制了仅凭该指标检测深层水平移动的能力。耳石核心形成期经历较高温度的个体在成熟年龄时体型较小，符合温度-体型规则（temperature-size rule），表明加拿大北极表层水温升高可能通过食物网产生级联效应。

papers.title: Fish Species Diversity, Seasonal Dynamics and Land Use Land Cover Associations With Fish Assemblages in the Gulf of Lake Tana, Ethiopia
papers.authors: Tsegaye, Birtukan; Mingist, Minwyelet; Getahun, Abebe; Mengistu, Daniel; Aemro, Degsera; Erarto, Felegush; Zelalem, Wonde; Mequanent, Dagnew
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Lake Tana, Ethiopia, harbours the world's only remaining cyprinid species flock, making it globally significant for conservation. Yet, these resources face mounting anthropogenic pressures from overfishing and land use changes. We assessed fish assemblage structure and seasonal dynamics in the Gulf of Lake Tana from September 2024 to August 2025 and land use land cover (LULC) changes from 2000 to 2025 using Landsat and Sentinel imagery. Fish specimens were sampled monthly from fishers at landing sites employing gillnets of varying mesh sizes. The specimens were identified to species level and analysed using Shannon diversity ( H ′), evenness ( J ), dominance ( C ) and Index of Relative Importance (%IRI). Exploratory multivariate analyses (non-metric multidimensional scaling [NMDS] and principal component analysis [PCA] of four seasonal aggregates) were used to describe seasonal assemblage patterns. A total of 2764 specimens representing 18 species were recorded, dominated by endemic Labeobarbus spp. (81.8%), followed by Oreochromis niloticus (11.9%) and Clarias gariepinus (6.3%). Diversity was moderate ( H ′ = 2.60) and differed significantly among four hydrological seasons (individual-based permutation test, 9999 permutations: p = 0.0024), being highest in the dry season ( H ′ = 2.596). After Bonferroni correction, dry-season H ′ differed significantly from pre-rainy (Hutcheson t -test, t = 3.84, adjusted p = 0.0006) and post-rainy H ′ ( p = 0.036), but not from rainy-season H ′ (adjusted p = 0.066). Evenness was high in all seasons ( J = 0.87-0.95). Sex ratios were female-biased in the catches of 12 of 18 species ( χ 2 , p < 0.001). Between 2000 and 2025, cropland and settlements expanded to nearly 60% of the mapped area, whereas wetlands declined by 92.7%. Because, fish data cover a single year and no environmental covariates were measured, these LULC trends are presented only as landscape context that is associated with the current assemblage composition. The findings provide baseline data for further studies, testing these associations directly, and support the need for watershed rehabilitation, buffer zone protection and sustained fisheries monitoring to protect the lake's globally unique cyprinid flock.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了埃塞俄比亚塔纳湖湾鱼类群落结构、季节动态及2000—2025年土地利用/覆被（LULC）变化，基于2024年9月至2025年8月按月采集的2764尾标本（18种）及Landsat/Sentinel影像分析。群落以特有Labeobarbus spp.为主（81.8%），Shannon多样性中等（H′=2.60），四个水文季节间差异显著（p=0.0024），旱季最高；18种中12种性比偏雌。2000—2025年耕地与居民点扩张至约占60%，湿地减少92.7%，但鱼类数据仅覆盖一年且未测环境协变量，LULC趋势仅作景观背景关联呈现。

papers.title: Impact of Selected Monetary Policy Instruments on Fish Trade Flow in Nigeria For The Period 1970-2024
papers.authors: Jegede, R. O.; Coker, A. A. .A.; Baba, K. M.; Ojo, A. O.
papers.abstract: Purpose: This study therefore examines the impact of selected MP instruments on FISTR flow in Nigeria over the period 1970-2024. Design/Methodology/Approach: The study adopts an ex-post facto research design and relies on annual time-series secondary data covering the period 1970-2024 in Nigeria. The dataset comprises 55 annual observations for the study variables, sourced from official publications of the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) Statistical Bulletin and World Development Indicators (WDI) of the World Bank. The Autoregressive Distributed Lag (ARDL) model is employed to estimate the short-run and long-run relationships among the variables. To assess the robustness of the ARDL estimates, Fully Modified Ordinary Least Squares (FMOLS), Dynamic Ordinary Least Squares (DOLS), and Canonical Cointegrating Regression (CCR) estimators are also employed. Research Limitation: The study focuses exclusively on five monetary policy variables, excluding other potentially relevant factors such as trade openness, fuel prices, fisheries infrastructure, government expenditure, climate variability and institutional quality. Findings: The ARDL bounds test confirms the existence of a long-run equilibrium relationship among the variables. The long-run estimates reveal that EXR and interest rate (INTR) significantly promote FISTR, whereas inflation (INF) and foreign reserves (LFREV) exert significant adverse effects, while money supply (MS) has a positive but insignificant influence. In the short run, EXR and INF initially depress FISTR, whereas INTR and MS stimulate trade after short lags. The error correction term indicates that approximately 74.2% of short-run disequilibrium is corrected annually. The FMOLS, DOLS and CCR estimators largely validate the ARDL results, confirming the robustness of the findings. Practical Implication: Directing monetary expansion towards productive fisheries financing and strategically utilising foreign reserves for infrastructure development can strengthen cold-chain facilities, storage, processing capacity, transportation, and export infrastructure. Social Implication: It will improve the well-being of fishing and processing communities and the affordability of fish as a source of animal protein. Originality/Value: Beyond methodological novelty, it demonstrates that fisheries trade performance is shaped not only by sector-specific factors but also by broader macroeconomic conditions. These findings provide new insights for designing monetary policies that support fisheries financing, trade competitiveness, and sustainable industry development.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于1970–2024年尼日利亚年度时间序列数据，采用ARDL模型及FMOLS、DOLS、CCR等估计方法，考察货币政策工具对鱼类贸易流（fish trade flow）的短期与长期影响。ARDL边界检验确认变量间存在长期均衡关系；长期估计显示汇率（EXR）和利率（INTR）显著促进鱼类贸易，通胀（INF）和外汇储备（LFREV）则具显著抑制作用，货币供应（MS）影响为正但不显著；误差修正项表明每年约74.2%的短期失衡得到修正。研究建议将货币扩张导向渔业生产性融资，并战略性地运用外汇储备支持冷链、加工与出口基础设施建设。

papers.title: Interaction Mechanism Between Grass Carp (Ctenopharyngodon idella) Fish Maw Collagen and Heavy-Metal Ions
papers.authors: Feng, Qianqian; Xu, Wei; Yan, Xu; Ramaswamy, Hosahalli S.; Azarakhsh, Nima; Wang, Chao
papers.abstract: Heavy-metal residues in fish maw are closely associated with its collagen fraction, yet the binding behavior and molecular mechanism of grass carp (Ctenopharyngodon idella) fish maw collagen toward common metal ions remain poorly characterized. To address this, hot-water-soluble collagen (HSC) and acetic acid soluble collagen (ASC) were extracted and characterized via SDS-PAGE, UV spectroscopy, zeta-potential measurement and amino acid analysis. Adsorption isotherms, fluorescence, CD and SEM-EDX were used to probe binding with Cu(II), Hg(II), Cd(II), and Cr(III). Dried fish maw contained 56.907 ± 0.319 g/100 g of protein and 25.01% collagen. In the four-ion mixed competitive system containing Cu(II), Hg(II), Cd(II) and Cr(III), the Langmuir and Freundlich models were applied only as empirical fitting tools, and the fitted parameters are apparent values under competition. Cd(II) showed the highest apparent adsorption capacity, while Cu(II), Cr(III) and Hg(II) exhibited stronger apparent affinity; Cu(II), Hg(II) and Cd(II) were better described by the Langmuir model, whereas Cr(III) was better described by the Freundlich model. Cu(II), Cr(III), and Hg(II) triggered static fluorescence quenching. The binding of Cr(III) and Hg(II) may involve hydrophobic interactions, while the binding of Cu(II) may involve hydrogen bonds and van der Waals forces, and it may also result from the non-specific intermolecular aggregation of collagen induced by Cu(II). Low-concentration Cr(III) disrupted collagen ellipticity bands and induced disordered conformations. This work deepens the mechanistic understanding of heavy-metal binding to fish maw collagen and offers fundamental insights for future relevant research.
papers.summary_cn: 以草鱼鱼鳔为原料提取热水溶性胶原（HSC）和酸溶性胶原（ASC），结合吸附等温模型、荧光猝灭、CD及SEM-EDX等手段，研究其对Cu(II)、Hg(II)、Cd(II)、Cr(III)的吸附行为与分子机制。在四离子竞争体系中，Cd(II)表观吸附容量最高，而Cu(II)、Cr(III)、Hg(II)表观亲和力更强；Cu(II)、Hg(II)、Cd(II)符合Langmuir模型，Cr(III)符合Freundlich模型。Cu(II)、Cr(III)、Hg(II)均引起静态荧光猝灭，Cr(III)和Hg(II)结合可能涉及疏水相互作用，Cu(II)结合可能涉及氢键与范德华力；低浓度Cr(III)可破坏胶原椭圆率谱带并诱导无序构象。

papers.title: Fished to the Edge: Severe Overfishing Threatens Fish Stocks in Tanzania's Saline Rift Valley Lakes
papers.authors: Said, Hadija Hussein; Mwandya, Augustine W.; Mwakosya, Catherine A.; Materu, Silvia F.; Rumisha, Cyrus
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The Saline Rift Valley Lakes (SRVLs) of Tanzania support important inland fisheries, but increasing fishing pressure threatens their sustainability. This study assessed the status of fish stocks in two Tanzanian SRVLs: Lakes Kitangiri and Singida. Data on catches, species composition, catch per unit effort, maturity stages, and length-based indicators were collected from May to September 2023. Results indicate strong evidence of overfishing, reflected in declining catches and high exploitation rates. The endemic Oreochromis amphimelas (Manyara tilapia) was the most affected species, with exploitation rates (> 0.9) and fishing mortality 13-18 times above sustainable reference points. Length-frequency data showed that most individuals were captured before reaching optimal size. All sampled O. amphimelas exhibited small body depths relative to the legal 7.62 cm gill-net mesh size, and a high proportion of individuals were immature or early maturing. Interviews revealed widespread use of small-mesh nets, contributing to the capture of undersized fish. However, some individuals matured at relatively small sizes, suggesting possible shifts in population structure linked to environmental stressors. These findings reveal a mismatch between current mesh size regulations and the biological characteristics of target species. Revising gear regulations and adopting species-specific management measures are recommended to improve fisheries sustainability in SRVL.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了坦桑尼亚Kitangiri和Singida两个盐碱裂谷湖的鱼类种群状况，基于2023年5–9月的渔获量、物种组成、CPUE、性成熟阶段及体长指标数据。结果显示过度捕捞证据充分，特有种Oreochromis amphimelas受害最重，开发率超过0.9，捕捞死亡率达可持续参考点的13–18倍，多数个体在达到适宜规格前即被捕获。小网目网具的广泛使用是导致幼鱼捕获的主因，现行网目法规与目标种的生物学特征不匹配，建议修订渔具规定并实施物种特异性管理措施。

papers.title: A new species of P imelodella ( H eptapteridae: R hamdiinae) from the upper B ermejo basin, northwestern L a P lata basin
papers.authors: Cortés-Hernández, Miguel Ángel; Alonso, Felipe; Slobodian, Veronica; Márquez-Fernández, Edna Judith; Terán, Guillermo Enrique; Pierre, Veida; Aguilera, Gastón
papers.abstract: Abstract A new species of Pimelodella occurring in the upper Bermejo basin is described using morphological and genetic data. The new species is distinguished from most congeners by having fewer total vertebrae (37-39), short adipose-fin base (20.3%-25.2% of L S ), maxillary barbel almost reaching or reaching the origin of the adipose fin, subequal lobes of caudal fin or upper lobe slightly longer, supraoccipital process articulating with the anterior nuchal plate and epiphyseal branch of supraorbital canal on the head ending in a single sensory pore (s6 + s6). The type locality of the new species is situated in the transition zone between the Yunga and Dry Chaco terrestrial ecoregions near the area of influence of Parque Nacional El Rey. Considering the high anthropogenic impact resulting from agricultural activities in the region and the high level of endemism present in the upper Bermejo basin, the new species could be categorized as Endangered (EN) in a future formal assessment, following the IUCN criteria.
papers.summary_cn: 描述阿根廷西北部La Plata盆地上Bermejo流域发现的Pimelodella属新种，基于形态与遗传数据将其与同属多数物种区分，主要鉴别特征为总椎骨数较少（37–39）、短脂鳍基及上颌须几乎达脂鳍起点等。模式产地处于Yunga与Dry Chaco生态区过渡带、El Rey国家公园影响范围内，鉴于该区域农业活动的人为干扰及高特有性，作者建议未来按IUCN标准将其评估为濒危（EN）。

papers.title: Ageing imprecision compounds the effects of fishing selectivity, increasing bias in estimates of growth parameters
papers.authors: Chamberlin, Derek W.
papers.abstract: Abstract Accurately estimating fish growth is critical for fisheries management, but growth parameter estimates are often affected by multiple sources of error. While the independent effects of ageing error and fishing selectivity are well documented, their combined effects remain unknown. This study used a simulation approach to determine how ageing imprecision and selectivity (logistic and dome-shaped) compound when estimating growth parameters across four rockfish ( Sebastes spp.) life histories. Results demonstrated that ageing imprecision and selectivity exacerbate biases in growth parameter estimates that exceed the error caused by selectivity alone, while selectivity was the primary driver in estimating size-at-age. The magnitude of this compounded bias was heavily dependent on the species' life history and the shape of the selectivity curve. Because growth parameters are frequently used as proxies for critical stock benchmarks like natural mortality and stock depletion, these compounded errors could distort population models. Current growth models fail to account for both sources of error simultaneously, highlighting the critical need to develop integrated frameworks that account for both ageing imprecision and selectivity.
papers.summary_cn: 研究采用模拟方法，评估年龄鉴定不精确性与渔业选择性（logistic与dome-shaped）对四种岩鱼（Sebastes spp.）生活史类型生长参数估计的复合影响。结果表明，年龄鉴定误差与选择性共同加剧了生长参数估计偏差，其幅度超过选择性单独作用，且复合偏差大小高度依赖物种生活史与选择性曲线形状；选择性则是size-at-age估计的主要驱动因素。由于生长参数常被用作自然死亡率和资源衰退等关键stock benchmarks的替代指标，这种复合误差可能扭曲种群模型。现有生长模型未能同时纳入两类误差来源，亟需构建整合年龄鉴定不精确性与选择性的综合框架。

papers.title: A systematic scoping review and conceptual framework for climate smart decision support systems in inland small scale fisheries in Zimbabwe and the SADC region
papers.authors: Chisadza, Bright; Muchuweti, Maud
papers.abstract: Small-scale inland fisheries support food security, nutrition and rural livelihoods but are increasingly affected by climate variability and changing hydrological conditions. This systematic scoping review examines climate vulnerability and decision-support systems (DSS) in inland small-scale fisheries in Zimbabwe and the wider Southern African Development Community (SADC). Following PRISMA-ScR guidance, 26 records published or available online between 2010 and 2025 were identified, appraised with the Mixed Methods Appraisal Tool and Joanna Briggs Institute checklists, and synthesised qualitatively. The evidence indicates changes in rainfall variability, water levels, water temperature and fisheries productivity, but it is geographically uneven, of variable methodological quality and concentrated in a few systems, notably Lake Kariba and the Zambezi Basin. Gender-disaggregated evidence is scarce, so gender is treated as an evidence gap rather than an established regional pattern. Existing DSS approaches are fragmented: most emphasise environmental conditions and give limited attention to livelihoods, governance and stakeholder participation. Building on these gaps, the study proposes a conceptual socio-technical DSS architecture that links environmental monitoring, differentiated vulnerability assessment, sequential hybrid modelling, participatory GIS and adaptive governance. In the hybrid component, a process-based hydrological model generates physically interpretable system states that a tree-based machine-learning model uses for residual correction or prediction. The framework has not yet been implemented or validated; its predictive performance, usability, stakeholder acceptance and transferability remain to be tested.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述按PRISMA-ScR流程检索2010—2025年26条记录，评估津巴布韦及SADC内陆小规模渔业的气候脆弱性与决策支持系统（DSS）证据。结果显示降雨变率、水位、水温和渔业生产力变化证据地理分布不均、方法质量参差且集中于Kariba湖和Zambezi流域，性别分列证据稀缺，现有DSS多侧重环境条件而忽视生计、治理与利益相关方参与。据此提出一种社会—技术DSS概念架构，整合环境监测、差异化脆弱性评估、序贯混合建模（过程水文模型生成系统状态、树基机器学习做残差校正或预测）、参与式GIS与适应性治理；该框架尚未实施或验证，其预测性能、可用性、利益相关方接受度与可迁移性仍待检验。

papers.title: Water Quality Parameters, Freshwater Fish Assemblages and Anthropogenic Disturbances in Looc Lake, Castillejos, Zambales, Philippines
papers.authors: Ventura, Mikey B.; Corpuz, Mark Nell C.
papers.abstract: Background: Looc Lake in Castillejos, Zambales, Philippines, supports local fisheries, but baseline information on its fish assemblages, water quality and anthropogenic pressures remains limited. Aims: The study provided a preliminary assessment of freshwater fish assemblages, evaluated water quality parameters, and identified potential anthropogenic threats in Looc Lake, Castillejos, Zambales, Philippines. Study Design: Spatial rapid bioassessment and environmental monitoring across five designated sampling stations covering the eastern, western, northern, southern and central regions of a shallow tropical floodplain lake. Place and Duration of Study: Looc Lake, Castillejos, Zambales, Luzon Island, Philippines. Sampling was conducted during daytime hours (06:00-10:00 h). Methodology: Fish specimens were collected using gill nets (mesh size 7-10 cm), cast nets, and fish traps deployed for four hours per station. Species were identified, counted, and analysed for relative abundance, diversity, dominance, evenness, catch per unit effort, and Bray-Curtis similarity. In-situ water quality parameters (pH, dissolved oxygen, water temperature, and Secchi disk visibility depth) were recorded alongside colourimetric tests for ammonia and nitrates. Anthropogenic activities were documented through observational assessments. Results: Water quality parameters indicated slightly alkaline, well-oxygenated, and temperatures within the reported range. A total of 1,611 individuals belonging to six families and eight non-native fish species were recorded, of which the fish assemblages were heavily dominated by the invasive black-chin tilapia (Sarotherodon melanotheron). All fish species were classified as non-native. Diversity indices revealed low species richness and high dominance. Based on the Bray-Curtis similarity analysis, fish assemblages exhibited high spatial homogeneity and minimal turnover across the lake stations, with similarity indices ranging from 0.60 to 0.89. However, the studied floodplain lake faces ecological pressures from solid waste dumping, macrophyte overgrowth, quarrying-induced siltation, and seasonal desiccation. Conclusion: Looc Lake exhibits low fish biodiversity dominated by invasive exotic cichlids, alongside environmental pressures from solid waste and nearby quarrying. Sustainable management policies and continuous monitoring are essential to conserve the lake's ecological integrity and local fishing livelihoods.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究对菲律宾Zambales省Looc湖的淡水鱼类群落、水质参数及人为干扰进行了初步评估，在五个采样站开展空间快速生物评价与环境监测。共记录8种非本地鱼类（隶属6科）1611尾，群落由入侵种黑颏罗非鱼（Sarotherodon melanotheron）高度主导，物种丰富度低、优势度高，各站间Bray-Curtis相似性为0.60–0.89，空间同质性明显。水质呈弱碱性、溶氧良好，但湖泊面临固废倾倒、大型水生植物过度生长、采石导致的淤积及季节性干涸等生态压力。研究建议制定可持续管理政策并持续监测，以维护湖泊生态完整性与当地渔业生计。

papers.title: Habitat segregation of endemic and invasive fish species across interconnected lentic and lotic ecosystems in an urban aquatic system: insight from environmental DNA analysis
papers.authors: Won, Suyeon; Kang, Yujin; Song, Youngkeun
papers.abstract: Understanding how invasive and endemic species partition habitats is essential for biodiversity management in urban freshwater ecosystems. We applied environmental DNA (eDNA) metabarcoding to assess spatial and seasonal distributions of two invasive species (Micropterus salmoides, Lepomis macrochirus) and one endemic species (Odontobutis interrupta) in interconnected lentic (reservoirs) and lotic (streams) habitats within an urban park in Korea. Water samples were collected from 21 sites at dense intervals (50-100 m) in May and October. eDNA metabarcoding detected 93% of species identified by traditional capture surveys and demonstrated greater sensitivity in detecting target species across complex microhabitats. NMDS ordinations showed clear spatial separation between lentic and lotic communities (R2 = 0.53-0.74, p < 0.001). Invasive species were predominantly concentrated in the anthropogenically altered Woncheon Reservoir (WR), while the endemic O. interrupta primarily inhabited the lotic stream and the Sindae Reservoir-Woncheonri Stream (SR-WS) corridor, where invasive species were largely absent. Environmental drivers such as pH, TDS, salinity, temperature, and land-cover composition significantly influenced these distributions, with elevated eDNA reads in May consistent with heightened spring biological activity, potentially including spawning-associated eDNA shedding. These findings emphasize the role of historical habitat disturbance in facilitating invasive dominance and highlight the potential of high-resolution eDNA monitoring to inform targeted management, such as targeted removal of invasive species during spawning peaks and the preservation of endemic refuges in urban freshwater networks.
papers.summary_cn: 利用eDNA宏条形码在韩国城市公园相连的静水（水库）与流水（溪流）生境中，以50–100 m密集布点于5月和10月采样，解析入侵种大口黑鲈（Micropterus salmoides）、蓝鳃太阳鱼（Lepomis macrochirus）与特有种暗色沙塘鳢（Odontobutis interrupta）的时空分布。eDNA检出传统捕捞调查物种的93%，对复杂微生境中目标种的敏感性更高；NMDS显示静水与流水群落空间分异明显（R²=0.53–0.74，p<0.001）。入侵种主要集中于受人为改造的Woncheon水库，特有种O. interrupta主要栖息于溪流及入侵种稀少的Sindae水库—Woncheonri溪廊道，pH、TDS、盐度、温度及土地覆盖组成显著影响其分布，5月eDNA读数升高与春季生物活动增强（可能包括产卵相关eDNA释放）一致。结果表明历史生境扰动促进入侵种优势，高分辨率eDNA监测可支持在产卵高峰期定向清除入侵种并保护城市淡水网络中的特有种避难所。

papers.title: Fish Species Composition, Relative Abundance and Diversity of Nworie River, Imo State, Nigeria
papers.authors: Ukagwu, John I.; Nwosu, Chijioke Ralph; Nkulo, Uzoma U.; Ezekiel, Michael Ndako; Emeka-Ohia, Priscillia
papers.journal: Asian Journal of Fisheries and Aquatic Research
papers.abstract: This study assessed fish species composition, relative abundance and diversity in Nworie River, Imo State, Nigeria, using fish-catch records obtained between January and August 2026. The assessment aimed to establish a baseline for subsequent biodiversity monitoring and fisheries management. Records were drawn from three sampling stations representing the upstream (A), midstream (B) and downstream (C) sections of the river. Specimens were collected fortnightly using a gill net and a dugout canoe, and records were pooled across stations. Species abundance and relative abundance were summarised descriptively, while Simpson’s dominance, diversity and reciprocal indices were calculated to characterise the recorded assemblage. The dataset comprised 1,652 fish specimens assigned to 12 species across four families. Cichlidae accounted for 80.93% of the total catch. Haemichromis fasciatus was the most frequently recorded species (255 specimens; 15.44%), followed by Pelmatolapia marae (239; 14.47%), Oreochromis aureus (209; 12.65%), Sarotherodon galilaeus (187; 11.32%) and Oreochromis niloticus (179; 10.84%). Together, these five-species represented 64.71% of all recorded individuals. Haemichromis elongartus was the least abundant recorded species (13; 0.79%). Simpson’s dominance, diversity and reciprocal indices were 0.1075, 0.8925 and 9.30, respectively. The findings indicate unequal numerical representation among the recorded species and provide an initial fish assemblage inventory for Nworie River. Because the analysis concerns pooled catch records, the estimates should not be interpreted as absolute population abundances. Continued taxonomic verification and effort-standardised monitoring are recommended.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于2026年1—8月尼日利亚Nworie河上游、中游和下游三个采样站的渔获记录，分析鱼类物种组成、相对丰度和多样性，以建立生物多样性监测与渔业管理的基线。共记录4科12种1,652尾鱼，Cichlidae占总渔获的80.93%，其中Haemichromis fasciatus最多（15.44%），Haemichromis elongartus最少（0.79%）。Simpson优势度、多样性和倒数指数分别为0.1075、0.8925和9.30，表明物种数量分布不均。由于分析基于合并渔获记录，结果不应解释为绝对种群丰度，建议继续开展分类学验证和努力量标准化的监测。

papers.title: Medium stocking density of Labeo rohita optimizes fish growth, nutrient recycling, and rice productivity in an integrated rice-fish co-culture system
papers.authors: Arshad, Shamoona; Kamara, Abdulai Merry; Inayat, Muhammad; Shah, Tufail; Sherzada, Shahid; Hou, Mengna
papers.abstract: Rice-fish co-culture is a promising alternative culture system to monoculture. However, further studies are needed to find the optimum stocking density of Labeo rohita to provide maximum productivity, environmental health, and nutrient recycling. The aim of this study was to investigate the effect of different stocking densities of L. rohita on fish growth, hematological and biochemical parameters, soil and water quality, nutrient recycling efficiency and rice productivity. The experimental design used was completely randomized design (CRD), which was applied for 120 days in the Kharif season of 2024 in Punjab, Pakistan. Three stocking densities were used in triplicate: low (350 fish ha⁻1), medium (450 fish ha⁻1), and high (550 fish ha⁻1). Under medium stocking density, fish weight gain was 332.8 g, specific growth rate was 1.20%, gross yield was 23,739.5 kg ha⁻1, nitrogen and phosphorus recycling efficiencies were 72.93% and 69.17%, respectively, while rice grain yield and 1000-grain weight were 4101.33 kg ha⁻1 and 20.94 g, respectively. In contrast, metabolic stress was observed at the high stocking density as indicated by high levels of glucose, cholesterol, and AST. The lowest stocking density had the most soil organic matter. There were no significant differences (P > 0.05) among treatments in water temperature, pH, dissolved oxygen (DO), electrical conductivity (EC), and total dissolved solids (TDS). Finally, a medium stocking density (450 fish ha⁻1) seems to be the best option to take advantage of the synergistic effect of rice-fish co-culture, since it will provide maximum productivity and nutrient recycling without negatively affecting water quality. The study was conducted in only one season and location, and further long-term studies under varying ecological conditions are required to validate sustainability of the system.
papers.summary_cn: 在稻鱼共作系统中设置低（350 尾/公顷）、中（450 尾/公顷）、高（550 尾/公顷）三档南亚野鲮（Labeo rohita）放养密度，进行 120 天试验，比较鱼体生长、血液生化指标、水土质量、养分循环效率与水稻产量。中等密度下鱼增重 332.8 g、特定生长率 1.20%、毛产量 23,739.5 kg/公顷，氮、磷循环效率分别为 72.93% 和 69.17%，稻谷产量 4101.33 kg/公顷、千粒重 20.94 g；高密度组则出现血糖、胆固醇和 AST 升高的代谢应激，最低密度组土壤有机质最高。各处理间水温、pH、溶解氧、电导率和总溶解固体无显著差异（P > 0.05）。中等放养密度（450 尾/公顷）可在不影响水质的前提下兼顾产量与养分循环，但结果仅基于单季单点试验，尚需多生态条件长期验证。

papers.title: Circular Bioeconomy in Organic Waste Management: Maggot Cultivation from Organic Waste and its Utilization for Agriculture, Aquaculture and Livestock in Indonesia
papers.authors: Jupesta, Joni; Permana, Indra; Sahari, Bandung; Gheewala, Shabbir H.
papers.abstract: This study explores the use of black soldier fly (BSF) larvae as a biological agent for organic waste management and its by-products in agriculture, aquaculture, and livestock. BSF larvae were cultivated on different organic waste types: vegetable, fruit, restaurant, and mixed waste, to evaluate yield and nutritional content. The larvae were then used as fish and poultry feed, and BSF frass was applied as organic fertilizer to cucumber crops. Results showed that larvae reared on mixed waste had the highest protein content, whereas restaurant waste produced the highest larval yield and crude fat content.. Fish fed a diet containing 50% dried BSF larvae and 50% commercial pellet exhibited significantly greater body length and width than fish fed 100% dried larvae, while fish weight did not differ significantly among dietary treatments. The application of BSF frass, both alone or in combination with lower doses of Nitrogen-Phosphorus-Potassium (NPK) fertilizer, significantly enhanced growth, early flowering, root fresh weight and yield especially on cumulative fruit weight and fruit number in cucumber plants. BSF frass at a rate of 20 t ha-1 can replace the need for NPK 16:16:16 fertilizer up to 75% and even showed higher growth and yield compared to a single NPK treatment at a rate of 300 kg ha-1. These findings demonstrate the potential of a circular bioeconomy model in which organic waste is continuously transformed into valuable inputs for agriculture, aquaculture, and livestock production, while reducing reliance on inorganic fertilizers and commercial feeds while promoting environmental sustainability.
papers.summary_cn: 以黑水虻（BSF）幼虫处理蔬菜、水果、餐厨及混合有机废弃物，比较其产量与营养组成；混合废弃物饲养的幼虫蛋白含量最高，餐厨废弃物则产量与粗脂肪最高。以50%干燥BSF幼虫替代商品饲料养鱼，鱼体长宽显著优于100%幼虫组，但体重无显著差异。BSF虫粪单施或配施低量NPK显著促进黄瓜生长、早花、根鲜重及产量，20 t/ha虫粪可替代75%的NPK 16:16:16，效果优于单施300 kg/ha NPK。结果支持将有机废弃物转化为农业、水产和畜牧投入品的循环生物经济模式。

papers.title: UV-C Irradiation Modulates Carbon and Nitrogen Cycles in Nile Tilapia Recirculating Aquaculture Systems
papers.authors: Fadhilah, Iqbal Sulthon; Rahardjo, Seto Sugianto Prabowo; Supriatin, Febriyani Eka; Nuswantoro, Soko; Pratiwi, Arum; Fadjar, Mohamad; Yuwanita, Rani
papers.abstract: Recirculating aquaculture systems (RASs) continuously accumulate organic carbon and nitrogen, relying on microbial nutrient-reduction efficiency to support fish production performance. Previous UV-C studies in aquaculture have focused on disinfection and pathogen control, with limited research on carbon-nitrogen dynamics. This study evaluated continuous UV-C irradiation in a RAS for 30 days using Nile tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus), comparing conventional and UV-C-treated systems with three replicates each (n = 3). Water quality, carbon and nitrogen dynamics, bacterial abundance, plankton density, and fish production were monitored throughout the experimental period. UV-C was associated with 59.1% and 59.2% reductions in estimated organic carbon and the carbon accumulation rate, respectively. Bacterial abundance and plankton density decreased by 69.1% and 26.7%, coinciding with reduced capacity of microbial and planktonic nutrient sinks within the system. UV-C irradiation was able to reduce NH4+, and NO3- up to 22.0% and 10.6%, respectively. Higher NO2- in UV-C was increased to 1.08 mg/L due to shifts in carbon availability and microbial community structure. Residual nitrogen increased by 17.7% because nitrogen fluxes shifted toward assimilative pathways. Consequently, nitrogen utilization efficiency improved, as reflected by higher nitrogen efficiency factor, nitrification ratio, and nitrogen-carbon transformation ratio. UV-C treatment increased final biomass by 14.1%, achieved 100% survival, and reduced FCR by 24.3% compared with Ct, suggesting its potential to modify carbon-nitrogen dynamics and improve resource-use efficiency in RAS.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究在尼罗罗非鱼（Oreochromis niloticus）RAS中连续30天施加UV-C照射，比较常规系统与UV-C处理系统的水质、碳氮动态、细菌丰度、浮游生物密度及鱼类生产性能（各3重复）。UV-C使估算有机碳及碳积累速率分别降低59.1%和59.2%，细菌丰度与浮游生物密度分别下降69.1%和26.7%，NH4+和NO3−降低达22.0%和10.6%，但NO2−升至1.08 mg/L，残余氮增加17.7%。氮通量转向同化途径，氮利用效率提高，终末生物量增加14.1%，存活率达100%，FCR降低24.3%，表明UV-C可调控RAS碳氮动态并提升资源利用效率。

papers.title: Developmental locomotor regimes in Atlantic salmon: wild ontogeny and intensive aquaculture
papers.authors: Pérez-Lefimil, Francisco; Guzmán, Neftalí; Rojas, Eduardo; Márquez, José Luis
papers.abstract: Atlantic salmon (Salmo salar) pass through developmental transitions linking embryogenesis, freshwater growth, smoltification, marine migration, and adult return to freshwater. Across this life cycle, locomotion is not a uniform behavioral trait or a simple index of swimming capacity, but a developmental function shaped by body architecture, muscle growth, metabolic and cardiorespiratory support, environmental demand, and stage-specific ecological tasks. This review examines locomotor ontogeny in wild Atlantic salmon and contrasts it with the managed locomotor environment imposed by intensive aquaculture. In wild fish, movement is functionally heterogeneous. It begins as embryonic motor activity, remains locally constrained in yolk-sac alevins, becomes coupled to prey capture and dispersal in fry, is organized around hydraulic positioning in parr, and is redirected toward downstream migration, marine routing, and adult return. Experimental and production studies further show that locomotor history can influence muscle growth, oxidative capacity, cardiac responses, brain plasticity, stress markers, oxygen demand, spatial distribution, and welfare-related outcomes. However, aquaculture studies often operationalize swimming as imposed velocity, exercise intensity, growth response, metabolic cost, or welfare performance, which does not fully capture the ecological and developmental roles of locomotion in wild salmon. We therefore propose the developmental locomotor regime as a comparative framework integrating movement timing, swimming continuity, hydraulic context, environmental modulation, metabolic cost, social constraint, and ecological or productive function. From this perspective, intensive aquaculture represents a distinct biomechanical and temporal environment that may contribute to phenotype development during salmon growth.
papers.summary_cn: 大西洋鲑（Salmo salar）的运动能力并非均一的行为特征或简单的游泳能力指标，而是由身体结构、肌肉生长、代谢与心肺支持、环境需求和特定阶段生态任务共同塑造的发育功能。综述梳理了野生大西洋鲑从胚胎运动、卵黄囊仔鱼局部活动、仔鱼摄食与扩散、幼鲑水力定位，到降海洄游、海洋路由和成鱼回归淡水各阶段的运动发育异质性，并对比集约化养殖所施加的管理化运动环境。实验与生产研究表明，运动经历可影响肌肉生长、氧化能力、心脏反应、脑可塑性、应激标志、氧需求、空间分布及福利相关结果，但养殖研究常将游泳操作为 imposed velocity、运动强度、生长反应、代谢成本或福利表现，未能充分反映野生鲑运动在生态与发育中的角色。据此提出“发育运动机制（developmental locomotor regime）”比较框架，整合运动时序、游泳连续性、水力背景、环境调制、代谢成本、社会约束及生态或生产功能，认为集约化养殖构成一种独特的生物力学与时间环境，可能参与鲑生长过程中的表型发育。

papers.title: Upcycling Gelatin Capsule Waste into Lysozyme-Loaded Active Films: Characterization and Application for Preserving the Quality of Semi-Dried Striped Snakehead Fish
papers.authors: Woraprayote, Weerapong; Janyaphisan, Thitiphorn; Chinarak, Khanittha; Kumnerdsiri, Pudthaya; Uchuwittayakul, Anurak; Kaewprachu, Pimonpan; Pongsetkul, Jaksuma; Sai-ut, Samart; Rawdkuen, Saroat; Kingwascharapong, Passakorn
papers.abstract: Valorization of gelatin capsule waste as a functional packaging material could simultaneously reduce industrial by-products and dependence on petroleum-based plastics. In this study, gelatin capsule waste was converted into active films containing hen egg white lysozyme (HEWL; 0-3.0%, w/v), and the effects of HEWL incorporation on physicochemical, mechanical, barrier, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties were investigated. The films remained visually transparent and exhibited strong ultraviolet-shielding properties, with negligible transmittance in the 200-300 nm range. HEWL incorporation improved the films’ thermal and physicochemical properties, as evidenced by reductions in moisture content (21.79 to 20.68%), water solubility (50.17 to 43.50%), swelling (777 to 406%), and water vapor permeability (5.34 to 4.20 × 10-4 g·mm·m-2·h-1·Pa-1). Tensile strength increased from 29.65 MPa in the control film to a maximum of 35.55 MPa at 1.5% HEWL, whereas elongation at break remained unchanged (p ≥ 0.05). The glass transition temperature (Tg) progressively increased from 29.78 to 41.03 °C with increasing HEWL concentration. At 3.0% HEWL, the ABTS radical-scavenging capacity and ferric-reducing antioxidant power increased by 1.10-fold and 1.48-fold, respectively. Furthermore, HEWL-containing films exhibited antibacterial activity against the tested foodborne bacteria, with Gram-positive bacteria showing greater susceptibility than Gram-negative bacteria. The film formulation containing 2.0% HEWL was subsequently evaluated for preserving semi-dried striped snakehead fish during room-temperature storage. Compared with the HEWL-free gelatin film, the HEWL-containing film retarded microbial proliferation and lipid oxidation while maintaining product moisture over 3 days of storage. Overall, these findings demonstrate the potential of valorizing gelatin capsule waste into a bioactive packaging matrix and support the development of HEWL-loaded films for the short-term preservation of semi-dried aquatic products.
papers.summary_cn: 以明胶胶囊废弃物为基质制备含溶菌酶（HEWL）的活性膜，考察HEWL添加量（0–3.0%）对膜理化、机械、阻隔、抗氧化及抗菌性能的影响。HEWL提升了膜的拉伸强度（最高35.55 MPa）、热稳定性及抗氧化能力，并赋予其对食源性细菌的抗菌活性（对革兰氏阳性菌效果更强）。含2.0% HEWL的膜用于室温贮藏半干乌鳢，可延缓微生物增殖和脂质氧化，维持产品水分达3天。研究表明明胶胶囊废弃物可增值利用为活性包装基质，用于半干水产品的短期保鲜。

papers.title: Pathways for high-quality development of marine ranching in the Beibu Gulf urban agglomeration
papers.authors: Huang, Jinsui; Wang, Jiannan; Chen, Zhen
papers.abstract: The transition of marine ranching from scale-oriented expansion toward high-quality development requires the simultaneous improvement of production efficiency, ecological sustainability, and farmed-animal welfare. However, increasing stocking intensity and technological investment may generate trade-offs among economic output, ecological carrying capacity, animal health, and long-term production sustainability. Existing studies have mainly examined ecological efficiency, resource and environmental carrying capacity, technological innovation, and industrial performance, while farmed aquatic animal welfare and its systemic interactions with ecological and socioeconomic outcomes remain insufficiently addressed. To fill this gap, this study introduces the One Welfare framework and constructs a One Welfare High-Quality Development Index (OWHI) integrating animal welfare, ecological environment, and economic and social development. Based on marine-ranching policy texts and development practices in the Beibu Gulf urban agglomeration, fuzzy-set Qualitative Comparative Analysis (fsQCA) is employed to identify configurations associated with high-quality development, while System Dynamics (SD) is used to examine feedback mechanisms and the long-term effects of alternative policy combinations. The results reveal substantial conjunctural causation and equifinality, with no single condition constituting a necessary condition for high OWHI. Three major pathways are identified: technology-policy driven, ecology-market synergistic, and welfare-environment synergistic configurations. Smart technological empowerment and animal welfare management play important cross-path roles. Scenario simulations further show that isolated welfare, technological, or ecological interventions generate limited long-term improvements, whereas the coordinated integration of welfare standards, AI-enabled monitoring, IMTA, and cross-regional governance produces stronger and more persistent synergistic effects. These findings extend conventional ecological-economic-social assessments of marine ranching by explicitly incorporating animal welfare and provide a configurational and dynamic basis for improving marine ranching sustainability.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在弥补海洋牧场研究中养殖动物福利维度缺失的不足，引入One Welfare框架构建了整合动物福利、生态环境与经济社会发展的One Welfare高质量发展指数（OWHI）。基于北部湾城市群海洋牧场政策文本与发展实践，采用fsQCA识别高质量发展路径，并运用系统动力学（SD）模拟反馈机制与政策组合的长期效应。结果表明不存在单一必要条件，识别出技术-政策驱动、生态-市场协同、福利-环境协同三条路径，智能技术赋能与动物福利管理具有跨路径重要作用；情景模拟显示孤立干预效果有限，而福利标准、AI监测、IMTA与跨区域治理的协同整合产生更强且持久的协同效应。

papers.title: Beyond landings: seven decades of marine catch reconstruction reveal unreported catches, structural shifts, and reporting gaps in Uruguay
papers.authors: Licandro, Juan A.; Bausero-Jorcin, Sofía; Chocca, Julio; de Álava, Anita; Marín, Yamandú; Defeo, Omar
papers.abstract: Long-term fisheries statistics often underestimate total removals by overlooking small-scale, subsistence, recreational catches, and discards, thereby biasing assessments of fisheries trends and undermining management effectiveness and governance performance. Here, we reconstruct Uruguay’s marine fisheries catches over seven decades (1950-2022), integrating official statistics with expert-based estimates to quantify industrial, small-scale (SSF), subsistence, recreational, and discard components. Reconstructed total catches ranged from 5.0 to 5.14 million tonnes. Industrial fisheries dominated national landings until the mid-2000s, followed by a prolonged decline driven by overexploitation of key species, fleet contraction, and market constraints. In contrast, SSF have gained relative importance since 2007 and now contribute nearly one fifth of total marine landings, reflecting both structural shifts and improved statistical coverage. Subsistence and recreational fisheries remain low in volume but socially and culturally significant, yet largely absent from official datasets. These long-term trends reveal marked changes in species composition, fishing gears, and sectoral contributions, alongside critical data gaps, particularly in industrial discards and early SSF records. By correcting presentist bias and recovering unreported catches, this reconstruction provides a more complete perspective on the historical trajectory and current status of Uruguay’s marine fisheries. The findings highlight the need for more transparent and inclusive monitoring systems embedded within participatory governance frameworks. More broadly, they demonstrate how long-term reconstructions can expose structural transformations and persistent data blind spots in national fisheries, offering a transferable basis for comparative analyses and for strengthening evidence-based governance under chronic data limitation.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究重建了乌拉圭1950–2022年海洋渔业捕捞量，将官方统计与专家估算相结合，量化工业、小规模（SSF）、自给性、休闲渔业及丢弃部分。重建总捕捞量为500–514万吨，工业渔业在2000年代中期前主导上岸量，此后因关键种过度开发、船队收缩和市场制约持续下降；SSF自2007年起相对重要性上升，目前约占总上岸量的五分之一。研究揭示了物种组成、渔具和部门贡献的结构性变化，以及工业丢弃和早期SSF记录等关键数据缺口，强调需建立更透明包容的监测体系并纳入参与式治理框架。

papers.title: Atlantic salmon marine survival and distribution inferred from six decades of scale-derived growth: temporal trends and growth consistency among sea ages
papers.authors: Breau, Cindy; Chaput, Gérald J; Friedland, Kevin D.
papers.journal: Canadian Journal of Fisheries and Aquatic Sciences
papers.abstract: Across its range, the survival and maturation dynamics of Atlantic salmon (Salmo salar) are dependent on growth, energy reserves, and predation pressure. This study examined growth of one-sea-winter (1SW) and two-sea-winter (2SW) salmon using archived scales collected from the Miramichi River, Canada, spanning 59 smolt migration years (1958-2016). Fork length and nearly all scale-derived growth metrics exhibited significant long-term linear trends, however, no evidence was found for critical periods of reduced growth. Hence, growth during the post-smolt year showed no declines corresponding to periods of reduced marine survival, suggesting that variation in marine recruitment of North American Atlantic Salmon are not dependent on post-smolt growth. Growth patterns recorded on scales, including intercirculi spacing, were broadly similar between sea-age groups until the end of the first winter at sea, suggesting shared migration routes and overlapping marine distribution during this period. By identifying temporal shifts in growth and critical phases of growth similarity and divergence, this study improves understanding of salmon responses to environmental variability and refines inferences about the marine distribution of salmon from individual populations.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用加拿大Miramichi河1958–2016年共59个smolt迁移年的存档鳞片，分析1SW和2SW大西洋鲑（Salmo salar）的生长长期趋势及海龄间生长一致性。叉长和几乎所有鳞片衍生生长指标均呈显著线性长期趋势，但未发现生长下降的关键时期，表明post-smolt年生长变化与海洋存活率下降不对应，北美大西洋鲑海洋补充量变动不依赖post-smolt生长。两海龄组鳞片生长模式（含intercirculi间距）在海上第一个冬季结束前基本相似，提示该时期共享洄游路线和重叠的海洋分布。

papers.title: Uncovering tiger shark (Galeocerdo cuvier) habitat use in an eastern central Atlantic biodiversity hotspot (Boa Vista Island, Cabo Verde) through a stereo-baited remote underwater video system and local ecological knowledge
papers.authors: Saldanha-da-Gama, João; Vizeu-Pinheiro, Margarida; Varela, Jaquelino; Nunes, Emanuel; Rosa, Rui
papers.abstract: Tiger sharks ( Galeocerdo cuvier ) are apex predators with well-established ecological roles in tropical and subtropical marine ecosystems, yet their spatial ecology in the eastern Atlantic remains almost entirely unresolved. Here we provide the first systematic, comprehensive characterisation of tiger shark habitat use around Boa Vista Island, which hosts one of the Atlantic’s largest loggerhead turtle nesting aggregations, within the Cabo Verde archipelago, a priority area for elasmobranch conservation. To characterise tiger shark habitat use around the island, 526 stereo-baited remote underwater video (stereo-BRUV) deployments across four survey periods in 2025 were combined with 40 local ecological knowledge (LEK) interviews. Tiger sharks occurred on 5.5% of deployments (29 detections), with 86% of detections east of 22.80° W. Detection frequency peaked at 11.6% in June, coinciding with the onset of the loggerhead nesting season, compared with 1.9-2.8% in the remaining survey periods. Detection probability was negatively associated with sea surface temperature and positively associated with salinity, but both covariates varied almost entirely between sampling months, preventing these associations from being distinguished from temporal variation. Measured individuals ranged from 1,487 to 4,502 mm fork length, and 12 of 26 (46%) were juvenile-sized, indicating that multiple size classes use the shelf and that early-life habitat use in the region is a priority for future research. LEK identified a broader perceived occurrence footprint, including Baía de Sal Rei within the coastal survey domain and the offshore João Valente Bank beyond it-both IUCN-designated Important Shark and Ray Areas-as priority areas for targeted future surveys. Together, these findings shift the evidence base for tiger sharks in the eastern Atlantic from simple presence confirmation to the first systematic description of recurrent, seasonally structured habitat use, providing an initial empirical foundation for conservation planning of this apex predator in a data-poor yet ecologically significant region.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在填补东大西洋虎鲨（Galeocerdo cuvier）空间生态学研究的空白，采用526次立体诱饵远程水下视频（stereo-BRUV）调查结合40份当地生态知识（LEK）访谈，首次系统描述佛得角博阿维斯塔岛周边虎鲨的生境利用格局。虎鲨在5.5%的调查站位中被检出（29次），其中86%集中于22.80°W以东水域，6月检出率最高（11.6%），与蠵龟筑巢季开始时间吻合。检出个体叉长为1,487–4,502 mm，其中46%为幼体规格，表明该陆架区为多规格群体共用生境。LEK识别出Sal Rei湾和João Valente浅滩（均为IUCN认定的重要鲨鳐区域）为未来重点调查区域，研究将该区域虎鲨证据基础从单纯的存在确认提升至季节性生境利用的系统描述。

papers.title: Unraveling spatiotemporal heterogeneity of fish assemblages and algal control performance by silver and bighead carps in riverine reservoir ecosystems
papers.authors: Yin, Chengjie; Zhang, Rongzhen; Sun, Yuxin; Feng, Zewen; Shi, Xiaoning; Li, Renhui; Xiang, Miao; Zhang, He; Guo, Longgen
papers.abstract: :Deep-water reservoirs in China’s subtropical valley rivers serve as both urban drinking water sources and habitats for inland fisheries; however, quantitative studies on the spatiotemporal dynamics of their fish communities and the effectiveness of silver carp and bighead carp restocking programs remain relatively limited. Taking the typical large Shanxi Reservoir in Wenzhou, Zhejiang as the study area, we conducted complementary hydroacoustic surveys and multi-mesh gillnet samplings in October 2022 (fish fattening period) and April 2023 (fish spawning period). A total of 2513 fish specimens were collected, belonging to 21 species, 15 genera, 6 families and 4 orders, with Cypriniformes as the absolute dominant group. Five species including bighead carp and silver carp were identified as the reservoir’s dominant fish via the Index of Relative Importance. Hydroacoustic results show significant seasonal and spatial variations in fish density and body size: mean fish length is larger in spring than in autumn, and high-density aggregation zones shift from the reservoir center and northern tributaries in autumn to eastern and southern bay tributaries in spring. Feeding analysis showed Cyanobacteria was the main food source for both silver and bighead carps, with clear feeding niche differentiation between the two filter feeders. Redundancy Analysis confirmed that silver carp biomass could significantly alter phytoplankton community structure and suppress Chlorophyta abundance, while bighead carp showed no notable regulatory effect. This study validates hydroacoustics’ applicability in fish resource assessment for valley reservoirs, and provides scientific support for optimizing silver/bighead carp stock enhancement, cyanobacterial bloom control and aquatic biodiversity maintenance in drinking-water-source reservoirs.
papers.summary_cn: 以浙江温州珊溪水库为对象，于2022年10月（育肥期）和2023年4月（繁殖期）结合水声学调查与多网目刺网采样，共采集2513尾鱼，隶属4目6科15属21种，以鲤形目为绝对优势类群，并依据相对重要性指数确定鳙、鲢等5种优势种。水声学结果显示鱼类密度与体长呈显著时空差异：春季平均体长大于秋季，高密度聚集区由秋季的库中及北部支流转移至春季的东部与南部库湾支流。食性分析表明蓝藻为鲢、鳙主要食物来源且二者摄食生态位分化明显；冗余分析证实鲢生物量可显著改变浮游植物群落结构并抑制绿藻丰度，而鳙无明显调控作用。

papers.title: Conserving Colonial Order: A Review of Laws and Policies for Conserving Pacific Salmon in Canada
papers.authors: Connoy, Jared W. H.; Fisher, Aidan; Newell, Dianne; Ballantyne, Leah; Reid, Andrea J.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Since its emergence, conservation biology has been framed as a discipline focused on preserving biodiversity. Less often acknowledged is that conservation is shaped by cultural assumptions about how, why, when, where and by and for whom it is designed and applied. Failing to recognize these assumptions risks reinforcing unjust systems of power rooted in historical forces that continue to shape present-day realities. This is especially evident for Pacific salmon in Canada, where colonial management systems have disenfranchised Indigenous fishers for over a century. In this narrative review, we describe critical moments in this history, focusing on case studies from British Columbia and drawing parallels to the United States and Sápmi to illustrate the pervasiveness of colonialism in salmon fisheries management. We examine periods from pre-colonial times to the present, focusing on Indigenous fisheries governance, treaty processes, the criminalization and vilification of Indigenous fishers, Indigenous resistance and significant legal and legislative developments. Our analysis shows that states have frequently leveraged conservation needs to justify policies benefiting settler societies while disenfranchising Indigenous communities, legacies that continue to shape power dynamics within contemporary fisheries conservation. We write primarily to settler decision makers, fisheries scientists and managers and the legal community, who play critical roles in reconciliation with Indigenous Peoples. We highlight the need for Indigenous authority over conservation, state institutions directly accountable to Indigenous Peoples, sustained funding for Indigenous-led salmon restoration and management and the upholding of Indigenous laws as essential steps towards a more just fisheries conservation and governance.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述以加拿大太平洋鲑（Pacific salmon）管理为案例，梳理从殖民前至当代的原住民渔业治理、条约进程、原住民渔民被刑事化与污名化、原住民抵抗及重要立法发展，并与美国和Sápmi地区进行比较。分析表明，国家常以保护需求为由为有利于定居者社会的政策辩护，同时剥夺原住民社区权利，其遗留影响持续塑造当代渔业保护中的权力格局。作者呼吁承认原住民在保护中的权威、建立对原住民直接负责的国家机构、持续资助原住民主导的鲑鱼恢复与管理，并维护原住民法律，以实现更公正的渔业保护与治理。

papers.title: Monsoon, mixing, and nutrient enrichment regulate phytoplankton succession and biogeochemical cycling in the northern South China Sea
papers.authors: Nilajkar, Sujata Kallappa; Ma, Wei; Pujari, Laxman Ashok; Hu, Jianyu; Yang, Jin-Yu; Xu, Yanping; Sun, Jun
papers.abstract: Hydrographic structure and nutrient availability can influence phytoplankton distributions in marginal seas, but cruise-based observations may also integrate spatial and interannual variability. We compared temperature, salinity, dissolved nutrients, chlorophyll a , and microscopically enumerated phytoplankton at nominal depths of 5, 50, and 125 m during four cruises in the northern South China Sea (nSCS): summer 2009, winter and autumn 2010, and spring 2011. Because these cruises do not constitute a continuous or replicated annual time series, the results describe the sampled periods and stations. Temperature and salinity showed stronger vertical gradients during the spring and summer cruises and weaker gradients during winter. NOx, phosphate, and dissolved silicate generally increased toward 125 m, although their spatial distributions differed among cruises. Phytoplankton cell abundance and the cell-based relative composition of the microscopically resolved assemblage also differed among cruise-depth combinations. Separate redundancy analyses accounted for 7.0-13.5% of total community variation; adjusted R 2 values ranged from -0.033 to -0.006, and no environmental variable was retained by forward selection. The ordinations are therefore interpreted as exploratory summaries of community-environment covariation rather than evidence of independent environmental effects. Light microscopy did not comprehensively resolve pico- and nanophytoplankton, and nitrogen fixation, primary production, carbon export, upwelling, and anthropogenic nutrient sources were not measured. The study provides a depth-resolved historical comparison of hydrographic, nutrient, and microscopically enumerated phytoplankton patterns during four cruises conducted from 2009 to 2011.
papers.summary_cn: 2009—2011年南海北部四个航次（2009夏、2010冬与秋、2011春）在5、50、125 m层比较了温度、盐度、溶解态营养盐、叶绿素a及显微计数浮游植物。温盐垂直梯度在春夏较强、冬季较弱，NOx、磷酸盐和溶解硅酸盐总体向125 m增加但空间分布随航次而异，浮游植物细胞丰度及显微可辨群落的相对组成在不同航次—深度组合间存在差异。冗余分析仅解释总群落变异的7.0—13.5%，调整R²为负且前向选择未保留任何环境变量，故排序结果仅作群落—环境协变的探索性概括，不能作为独立环境效应的证据；显微计数未覆盖pico-和nanophytoplankton，且未测定固氮、初级生产、碳输出、上升流及人为营养盐来源。

papers.title: Diverse effects of coastal infrastructure and water column properties on current and future occurrence of gelatinous zooplankton species
papers.authors: Greene, Correigh M; Dominguez, Joshua H; Chamberlin, Joshua W; Hall, Jason E; Rhodes, Linda D
papers.abstract: Gelatinous zooplankton (jellyfish) are significant components of marine ecosystems and have diverse species assemblages. In the past 3 decades, increases in jellyfish blooms have been documented globally and attributed to both anthropogenic influences and climate-induced environmental variation. Here, we examine interspecific variation in species-specific response of adult life stages to environmental variation and anthropogenic influence and projected future changes in these parameters. We used data from a synoptic survey to predict the presence of 7 jellyfish species across 6 sub-basins of greater Puget Sound, a fjord in the Pacific Northwestern, USA. Using multimodel inference, we examined the probability of species presence as a function of site-specific parameters (geomorphic type, anthropogenic land use) and observation-specific variables (salinity, temperature, depth). Model results indicated strong interspecific variation in the relationships with environmental parameters such as temperature and geomorphic type, as well as varying associations with potential anthropogenic effects on marine shorelines. For example, individuals of the genus Aurelia were associated with large and small embayments rather than exposed shorelines, and anthropogenic development within these embayments were shown to decrease the probability of presence. Using the suite of possible models, we applied projections of models of land use and climate change to predict changes in species occurrence in the 2050s. Future climate and land use projections identified ecological winners (e.g. Aurelia) and losers (e.g. Phacellophora ). These findings reveal that both land use and climate impacts have strong potential to shift marine species occurrence now and in the future.
papers.summary_cn: 基于同步调查数据，采用多模型推断预测美国普吉特海湾6个子海盆中7种水母成体出现概率，解释变量包括地貌类型、人为土地利用及盐度、温度、水深等。结果显示各物种对温度、地貌类型及岸线人为开发的响应存在明显种间差异，如Aurelia属偏好大小海湾而非暴露岸线，且海湾内人为开发降低其出现概率。结合2050年代土地利用与气候变化情景投影，识别出未来潜在赢家（如Aurelia）与输家（如Phacellophora），表明土地利用与气候变化可能显著改变海洋物种分布格局。

papers.title: Coupling diet and foraging behavior of a surface-feeding seabird to map prey spatial distribution in the Gulf of Alaska
papers.authors: Depot, Katelyn Marie; Whelan, Shannon; Arimitsu, Mayumi L; Clucas, Gemma V; Elliott, Kyle Hamish
papers.abstract: Marine predators can serve as indicators of the abundance and distribution of their prey, including forage fish that are key to entire food webs yet can be otherwise difficult to monitor via conventional surveys. Furthermore, predator-derived preyscapes can track the spatial responses of forage fish to environmental change. We coupled diet and GPS tracking data from a surface-feeding seabird, the black-legged kittiwake Rissa tridactyla , at a breeding colony in the Gulf of Alaska (Middleton Island) to determine the approximate capture locations of prey and to map prey spatial distributions. We georeferenced 195 regurgitate samples in 2013-2024 and 160 fecal samples in 2023-2024. We also examined the influence of bottom depth and sun angle on prey availability. Foraging areas were segregated by prey type, including coastal foraging for eulachon Thaleichthys pacificus at a known spawning location (the Copper River Delta); neritic foraging over a wide area of the continental shelf for Pacific herring Clupea pallasii and Pacific capelin Mallotus catervarius ; nocturnal, oceanic foraging over the continental slope for lanternfishes (Myctophidae) and squid; and foraging over the upper continental slope for sablefish Anoplopoma fimbria .
