Prey distributions based on regurgitates and fecal DNA were consistent, suggesting that fecal DNA represents a viable source of dietary data for preyscape analyses. We highlight the potential of seabird preyscapes to provide insight about spawning locations, dispersal patterns of juvenile fish, diel patterns, and environmental conditions influencing prey availability.
papers.summary_cn: 以阿拉斯加湾 Middleton Island 繁殖的黑腿三趾鸥（Rissa tridactyla）为对象，耦合食性（2013–2024 年 195 份反刍物、2023–2024 年 160 份粪便 DNA）与 GPS 追踪数据，反推猎物大致捕获位置并绘制 prey spatial distribution。猎物类型对应明显分化的觅食区域：沿岸取食已知产卵地 Copper River Delta 的 eulachon（Thaleichthys pacificus），大陆架宽阔海域取食 Pacific herring（Clupea pallasii）与 Pacific capelin（Mallotus catervarius），大陆坡夜间大洋性取食 lanternfishes（Myctophidae）和鱿鱼，大陆坡上部取食 sablefish（Anoplopoma fimbria）；反刍物与粪便 DNA 所得猎物分布一致，支持粪便 DNA 作为 preyscape 分析的可行食性数据来源。底深与太阳角度影响猎物可获得性，海鸟 preyscape 可揭示产卵位置、幼鱼扩散格局、昼夜节律及环境条件对猎物可获得性的影响。

papers.title: Identification and Analysis of Fish Processing and Consumption Characteristics in Restaurants in the Bucharest-Ilfov Area
papers.authors: CRISTEA, Cristian; MARIN, Monica Paula; BAHACIU, Gratziela; POGURSCHI, Elena Narcisa; TOMA, Ionela Florentina; DOBROTĂ, Gheorghe; NICOLAE, Carmen Georgeta
papers.journal: Bulletin of University of Agricultural Sciences and Veterinary Medicine Cluj-Napoca. Animal Science and Biotechnologies
papers.abstract: Fish consumption in restaurants in Romania is a complex phenomenon, influenced by a number of economic, political, cultural and ecological factors. In the context of a growing demand for fish dishes, this report explores the characteristics of the fish processing and consumption market in Romanian restaurants, with a special focus on the Bucharest-Ilfov area. The purpose of this study is to identify and analyse the factors that influence the consumption of fish in restaurants and to provide recommendations for improving menus and increasing sustainability in this sector. The current research was conducted as a survey case analysis within restaurants order to gather quantitative and qualitative data on fish consumption patterns. The results indicate that diversifying menus by introducing more fish dishes can bring significant benefits to restaurants, both economically and operationally. Fish also proves to be a versatile and sustainable raw material, which, if used correctly, can attract new segments of consumers concerned about health and sustainability.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在识别和分析影响布加勒斯特-伊尔福夫地区餐馆鱼类消费的因素，并为进一步优化菜单和提升可持续性提供建议。研究采用问卷调查案例分析法，收集餐馆鱼类消费模式的定量与定性数据。结果表明，通过增加鱼类菜品实现菜单多样化可为餐馆带来显著的经济和运营效益，鱼类作为多功能且可持续的原材料，合理利用可吸引关注健康与可持续性的新消费群体。

papers.title: Uptake, application and impact of an open access platform for investigating global marine fishing activity
papers.authors: Kerry, Chris; Storer, Lauren; Metcalfe, Kristian; Miller, Nathan A.; Nuno, Ana; Sánchez-Tapia, Andrea; Godley, Brendan J.
papers.abstract: Abstract High-resolution datasets can transform understanding and management of human activities in the ocean, yet their real-world uptake and impact remains poorly quantified. Here, we assess the influence of Global Fishing Watch (GFW), an open access platform that monitors fishing activity globally, by combining a user questionnaire ( n = 467) with a structured review of peer-reviewed and grey literature ( n = 293). Questionnaire responses reveal frequent engagement across academia, NGOs and government, with the interactive map and download portal as main access points. Publications, however, are dominated by those from high-income countries, highlighting inequities in data use and publishing barriers. GFW datasets are applied across diverse thematic areas, with ecology, conservation, and monitoring of illegal, unreported and unregulated fishing emerging as dominant foci. Discrepancies between self-reported use and published outputs suggest that publication metrics underestimate the platform’s real-world impact in geographic scope, and areas such as applied policy, teaching and outreach. Despite its open-access nature, persistent barriers limit engagement, particularly in lower-income regions, leading to uneven global uptake. Overall, GFW enhances transparency and supports evidence-based management, targeted capacity-building, broader use of ancillary datasets and systematic tracking of societal outputs are needed to fully realise its potential for equitable ocean governance.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过467份用户问卷与293篇同行评议及灰色文献的结构化综述，评估了开放获取平台Global Fishing Watch（GFW）在监测全球捕捞活动中的实际使用与影响。问卷显示学术界、NGO和政府部门使用频繁，主要入口为交互地图与数据下载端口，但发表成果集中于高收入国家，暴露数据使用与发表壁垒的不平等。GFW数据主要应用于生态学、保护及IUU捕捞监测，自报使用与发表产出间的差距表明文献计量低估了其在政策应用、教学与推广等方面的实际影响。尽管平台开放获取，低收入地区仍面临持续使用障碍，全球采纳不均衡，需针对性能力建设与系统性社会产出追踪以支撑公平的海洋治理。

papers.title: Captive breeding and early life history of the near threatened red-finned catopra Pristolepis rubripinnis (Teleostei: Pristolepididae), an endemic fish from the Western Ghats
papers.authors: Varghese, Binu; Thiruvarasu, S.; George, Grace; Al Jalees, Anees; Kumar, Ajeth
papers.abstract: The red-finned catopra ( Pristolepis rubripinnis ) is a freshwater perciform endemic to the southern Western Ghats of India, where local populations have declined under the combined pressure of habitat alteration and climatic variability. Although the species carries both edible and ornamental value, its reproductive biology and the protocols needed to propagate it in captivity have remained undocumented. The present study was designed to develop, standardise and evaluate broodstock conditioning, spawning induction and larval-rearing strategies under controlled conditions, and to characterise the reproductive plasticity that the species expresses in captivity. Broodstock responded through both hormone-induced and spontaneous spawning pathways. A single intramuscular dose of a gonadotropin-releasing hormone analogue (GnRH-A; 1.0 mL kg⁻¹ body weight in females; 0.05 ml) induced ovulation, but latency was inconsistent-occasionally extending to seven days-and spawning success was variable. Mean fecundity reached 7,164 ± 284 eggs female⁻¹, with fertilisation and hatching rates of 80.6 ± 12.1% and 89.4 ± 3.9%, respectively. Buoyant, transparent eggs (1.16 ± 0.12 mm in diameter) hatched within 12-14 h at 28 ± 0.5 °C, comparatively short incubation period. Newly hatched larvae (3.8 ± 0.1 mm total length) showed a transient inverted buoyancy imposed by prominent yolk and oil reserves, and achieved normal orientation by 3 days post-hatch (dph). Mouth opening at 1 dph (gape ≈ 180 μm) marked the onset of exogenous feeding. The survival was constrained chiefly by lack of adequate livefeeds, cannibalistic nature and getting trapped in hideouts; however proper tank shading, feeding regimes, and systematic size grading helped achieve a survival rate of 80 ± 3%. Collectively, these preliminary results indicate reproductive plasticity in P. rubripinnis and provide baseline reproductive and developmental data to support future work on the captive propagation of this geographically restricted freshwater species. These observations offer a starting point for developing endocrine-induction, environmental-conditioning and larval-husbandry protocols within conservation-oriented aquaculture of endemic fishes.
papers.summary_cn: 针对印度西高止山南部特有种红鳍拟攀鲈（Pristolepis rubripinnis），在受控条件下标准化亲鱼培育、催产与幼体培育流程，并刻画其繁殖可塑性。亲鱼可经 GnRH-A 单次肌注（雌鱼 1.0 mL kg⁻¹）或自然产卵，但催产潜伏期不稳定（偶达7天）、产卵成功率变异大；平均怀卵量 7,164 ± 284 粒/尾，受精率 80.6 ± 12.1%、孵化率 89.4 ± 3.9%。浮性透明卵径 1.16 ± 0.12 mm，28 ± 0.5 °C 下 12–14 h 孵化；初孵仔鱼全长 3.8 ± 0.1 mm，因卵黄与油球呈短暂倒浮，3 dph 恢复正常姿态，1 dph 开口（口径约180 μm）进入外源营养。存活主要受活饵不足、同类相残及躲藏处困陷限制，通过遮光、投喂管理与系统分级使存活率达 80 ± 3%。

papers.title: Computer Vision Advances in Monitoring Multi-Species Invertebrate Fisheries in the Pacific
papers.authors: Shedrawi, George; Magron, Franck; Tiitii, Ulusapeti; Fepuleai, Faasulu; Papalii, Isaako; Mosile, Christina; Aiafi, Justin; Fatongiatau, Viliami; Molai, Chris; Jalam, Shivam
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Monitoring diverse, dispersed small-scale invertebrate fisheries remains challenging because taxonomic diversity, informal trade and dispersed harvesting limit sustained programs that can capture standardised data used for catch identification and measurement. Computer vision is increasingly being used to overcome these challenges, but most affordable and accessible single-camera systems face a trade-off: close-range imagery required for high fidelity species identification while increasing parallax error for three-dimensional specimens. We tested a hardware-agnostic calibration method to improve an automated fisheries-monitoring platform. Nationally standardised coins placed on specimens provided a local, distance-independent scale reference. Manual, coin-corrected and uncorrected computer-vision measurements of carapace length in spiny lobsters ( Panulirus penicillatus ) were compared using linear mixed-effects models. Coin correction removed systematic bias, reducing mean percentage error from 10.77% to 1.20% and mean absolute error from 8.6 to 2.3 mm. By contrast, linear-regression correction for Panulirus penicillatus under-corrected small lobsters and over-corrected large individuals, biasing Length-Based Spawning Potential Ratio estimates. Where remote observers could verify species-level labels, computer-vision classification exceeded 90% accuracy, with other performance metrics scoring above 80%. Performance on unfiltered operational data depended on image acquisition: close-range board imagery substantially outperformed greater-distance mat imagery for taxa requiring fine diagnostic detail, particularly bivalves and gastropods. Coplanar calibration is therefore necessary for 2D computer-vision systems to provide reliable species identification and morphometric data simultaneously, supporting scalable, field-appropriate monitoring of multi-species invertebrate fisheries in data-limited small-island developing states.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对太平洋小岛屿发展中国家多物种无脊椎动物小型渔业监测难题，测试了一种硬件无关的校准方法以改进自动渔业监测平台。通过在标本旁放置全国标准化硬币作为局部尺度参照，比较了人工测量、硬币校正和未校正计算机视觉测量对锦绣龙虾（Panulirus penicillatus）头胸甲长度的误差。硬币校正消除了系统偏差，将平均百分比误差从10.77%降至1.20%，平均绝对误差从8.6 mm降至2.3 mm；而线性回归校正会低估小型个体、高估大型个体，导致基于体长的产卵潜力比（Length-Based Spawning Potential Ratio）估算偏倚。在可验证物种标签的条件下，计算机视觉分类准确率超过90%，共面校准对2D计算机视觉系统同时提供可靠物种鉴定和形态测量数据至关重要。

papers.title: Tambaqui ( Colossoma macropomum ) Production in Recirculating Aquaculture Systems ( RAS ): Evidence, Management Requirements and Research Gaps
papers.authors: Luz, Ronald Kennedy; dos Santos, Fabio Aremil Costa; Favero, Gisele Cristina
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Tambaqui ( Colossoma macropomum ) is an important commercial fish species in Latin America and Asia, where its production primarily relies on pond farming and net cage culture. The need for more controlled and sustainable production systems has increased interest in recirculating aquaculture systems (RAS). This narrative review, based on a structured literature search, synthesizes current evidence on tambaqui production in RAS throughout its production cycle. Available studies demonstrate successful production from larviculture and juvenile rearing through fattening and broodstock development, including induced reproduction. The review also examines management practices involving stocking density, temperature, feeding and nutrition, behavioral management, feed restriction, and anesthetics during handling. Evidence is strongest for larviculture and juvenile rearing under controlled experimental conditions, whereas fattening and broodstock production are promising but require further commercial-scale validation. Despite these advances, further research is needed to validate the available findings across larger and commercial-scale systems, improve the reporting of engineering and operational parameters, and expand knowledge on carrying capacity, techno-economic performance, energy demand, long-term fish welfare, and genetic management. Overall, RAS represents a technically viable and promising strategy for tambaqui production. However, commercial expansion requires system-specific validation integrating biological performance, fish welfare, engineering efficiency, energy use, and economic viability.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述基于结构化文献检索，系统梳理了 tambaqui（*Colossoma macropomum*）在 RAS 中全生产周期的现有证据，涵盖 larviculture、幼鱼培育、育肥及 broodstock 开发（含诱导繁殖）。管理实践涉及 stocking density、温度、投饲与营养、行为管理、限饲及操作麻醉等。证据在受控实验条件下以 larviculture 和幼鱼阶段最强，育肥与 broodstock 生产具潜力但需商业规模验证；未来需在放大系统验证、工程与运行参数报告、carrying capacity、技术经济性能、能耗、长期福利及遗传管理等方面深化研究。

papers.title: Behavioural Diversity and Ecology of Cleaning Mutualisms in a Changing Ocean
papers.authors: Pereira, B. P.; Rosa, R.; Paula, J. R.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT One of the most pressing challenges confronting the scientific community today is understanding the consequences of global change on ecological communities and mitigating their impacts. Cleaning mutualisms are essential to the health and stability of coral reef ecosystems, influencing individual fitness, parasite dynamics, and community composition. However, these interactions are increasingly threatened by anthropogenic pressures. This review describes the behavioural diversity and ecology of dedicated cleaners, ranging from cognitively sophisticated wrasses and efficient, low-conflict gobies to visually signalling shrimps. We then review how the intricate interactions between cleaners and clients respond to environmental change, including chronic stressors (e.g., acidification), extreme events (e.g., marine heatwaves), and direct anthropogenic disturbances (e.g., underwater noise). Mounting evidence demonstrates that such stressors can disrupt cleaner and client dynamics, diminishing interaction motivation and quality, and altering underlying neurobiological mechanisms. Despite recent advances, significant gaps remain in our understanding of the long-term resilience and recovery of cleaning mutualisms across ecological, behavioural, cognitive and physiological pathways. As ocean climate-related drivers of change intensify and increasingly co-occur, it becomes urgent to investigate whether cleaners can continue to fulfil their ecological roles, or if reefs will face a future with compromised mutualistic services.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述聚焦珊瑚礁清洁共生（cleaning mutualism）的行为多样性与生态功能，涵盖裂唇鱼、虾虎鱼及清洁虾等主要清洁者类群，并系统梳理其对酸化、海洋热浪及水下噪声等环境胁迫的响应。现有证据表明，这些胁迫可削弱清洁者与客户鱼的互动动机与质量，并改变其神经生物学机制。作者指出，在多重海洋气候变化因子叠加背景下，清洁共生关系的长期恢复力及其生态服务能否维持仍存在显著认知缺口。

papers.title: Spatial Patterns of Lipid Composition and Trophic Biomarkers in the Argentine Anchovy ( Engraulis anchoita ) Across Contrasting Shelf Environments
papers.authors: Isla-Naveira, Rocío; Liebana, Clara; Parietti, Manuela; Arruebarrena Di Palma, Andrés; Buratti, Claudio; Macchi, Gustavo; Temperoni, Brenda
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT In continental shelf ecosystems, physical-biological coupling between hydrographic structures and bottom-up pathways can generate spatial gradients in prey availability and quality that may influence the lipid quality of small pelagic fish. The income-breeding Engraulis anchoita on the Northern Argentinean Continental Shelf (NACS) fuels reproduction through active feeding and makes tissue lipid quality closely linked to local oceanographic and dietary conditions. This study integrated stomach content and tissue-specific fatty acid (FA) analyses sampled in three zones of the NACS spawning ground under contrasting oceanographic conditions: Río de la Plata salinity front (RP), Mar del Plata shelf waters (MDP), and El Rincón thermohaline front (ER) during austral spring. Diet composition differed markedly among sampling zones, shifting from small euryhaline copepods in RP to almost exclusive consumption of the lipid-rich Calanoides carinatus in ER. These variations were accompanied by differences in tissue FA profiles: ER individuals showed the highest total lipid content, saturated FA, and polyunsaturated FA concentrations, while MDP muscle was dominated by monounsaturated FA, matching Calanidae copepod markers. The omega-3/omega-6 was highest in ER ovaries, indicating selective omega-3 enrichment. The DHA/EPA ratio decreased from RP to ER, reflecting a progressive shift toward diatom-based food webs at lower temperatures, while the EPA/ARA ratio increased from RP to ER in both tissues, suggesting that individuals inhabiting the productive ER frontal system were in a more advanced reproductive condition. Together, these results reveal spatial patterns in tissue lipid quality closely coupled to the physical heterogeneity of the NACS shelf, suggesting a potential bottom-up trophic pathway that may have implications upon anchovy egg viability, larval survival and fish conditions.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在探究阿根廷北部大陆架（NACS）不同海洋环境对阿根廷鳀（Engraulis anchoita）组织脂质组成及营养标志物的空间影响。研究整合胃含物与组织特异性脂肪酸分析，在产卵场的三个区域（Río de la Plata 盐度锋、Mar del Plata 陆架水域和 El Rincón 温盐锋）进行采样。结果显示各区域饵料组成差异显著，从 RP 的小型广盐性桡足类转向 ER 几乎专食富含脂质的 Calanoides carinatus，并伴随组织脂肪酸谱的相应变化：ER 个体总脂质、饱和及多不饱和脂肪酸含量最高，ER 卵巢 omega-3/omega-6 比值最高，DHA/EPA 比值从 RP 到 ER 递减而 EPA/ARA 比值递增。这些空间格局与 NACS 陆架物理异质性密切耦合，提示存在自下而上的营养通路，可能影响鳀鱼卵活力、仔鱼存活及鱼体状况。

papers.title: Fish Scale-Derived Collagen for Cosmetic, Nutricosmetic, and Biomedical Applications: Processing, Material Forms, and Evidence
papers.authors: Andriani, Yuli; Pratama, Rusky Intan
papers.abstract: Fish scales are a well-established source of type I collagen and represent a potential route for recovering higher-value materials from fish-processing by-products. However, fish-scale collagen is often treated as a single material even though processing can generate products with markedly different structures, functions, and levels of supporting evidence. This narrative review examines fish-scale-derived collagen across the source-processing-material form-property-application-evidence continuum, with emphasis on cosmetic, nutricosmetic, and biomedical uses. Four material categories are distinguished: purified collagen, collagen peptides or hydrolysates, collagen-containing composites, and retained whole-scale collagenous matrices. Available studies show that fish species, scale composition, demineralization, extraction, hydrolysis, and material modification influence collagen recovery, structural integrity, thermal behavior, fibril formation, and downstream performance. For skin-related applications, several controlled human studies support defined orally administered fish-scale collagen peptide preparations for selected hydration, elasticity, and wrinkle-related outcomes, whereas controlled human evidence for topical application remains limited. Biomedical evidence is most developed for wound-healing materials, while bone, oral, periodontal, and corneal applications have progressed through cell-based and animal studies. Many favorable outcomes, however, involve composite materials or retained scale matrices and cannot be attributed to collagen alone. Translation remains constrained by raw-material heterogeneity, inconsistent extraction and yield reporting, incomplete product-specific safety assessment, sterilization and manufacturing requirements, limited human biomedical evidence, and insufficient environmental and economic evaluation of scale-up. Fish-scale collagen should therefore be considered a family of application-dependent materials rather than a uniform alternative collagen source.
papers.summary_cn: 鱼鳞是I型胶原的成熟来源，可作为鱼品加工副产物高值化利用的途径。本文围绕来源—加工—材料形态—性质—应用—证据链，将鱼鳞胶原分为纯化胶原、胶原肽/水解物、含胶原复合材料和保留完整鱼鳞的胶原基质四类，综述其在化妆品、营养化妆品及生物医学领域的应用证据。研究表明，鱼种、鱼鳞组成、脱矿、提取、水解及材料改性均影响胶原回收率、结构完整性、热行为、纤维形成及下游性能；口服鱼鳞胶原肽对皮肤水合、弹性和皱纹的改善已有若干对照人体研究支持，而外用制剂的对照人体证据仍有限，生物医学证据以伤口愈合材料最为充分。鱼鳞胶原的转化仍受原料异质性、提取与产率报告不规范、产品特异性安全性评估不足、灭菌与生产要求、人体生物医学证据有限及规模化环境经济评价缺乏等制约，应将其视为一类依应用而异的材料家族而非统一的替代胶原来源。

papers.title: What the Amphorae Tell Us: Evidence for Roman Fish Production and Specialization at the Bay of Cádiz
papers.authors: Gleisner, Grace E.
papers.abstract: This research seeks to uncover spatial and temporal trends relating to the food contents of amphorae from Roman Gades, the modern Bay of Cádiz, from the second century BC through the second century AD. Earlier scholarship on amphorae from southern Spain has primarily focused on single sites and highlighted olive oil production. This research, however, uses a Microsoft Access database and Google Earth Pro to catalogue amphorae from 11 previous studies, produce detailed maps of their find spots, and analyze their dates, locations, and contexts to study the production and exports of the greater port area. Contextualizing individual amphora-find locations within the wider area, Roman economy, and ancient shorelines demonstrated evidence of a steady rise in the relative importance of fish products and of Puerto Real, one of the Bay’s neighborhoods, especially after the transition from the Roman Republic to the Roman Empire. Over time, the port increasingly specialized in fish products and separated the production of different commodities. Focusing on under-studied trade goods produced in the harbor’s immediate vicinity helps to fill a research gap created by the emphasis on olive oil and contributes to a more well-rounded understanding of Roman production and maritime trade in this area. More broadly, this study seeks to illustrate the potential for these types of amphora databases and maps to provide a more contextualized view of food production and transport, aid reconstructions of ancient food networks, and expand archaeology’s understanding of maritime trade.
papers.summary_cn: 基于对11项既往研究中的双耳瓶进行数据库编目与Google Earth Pro制图，分析其年代、出土地点与情境，重建罗马Gades（今加的斯湾）港区公元前2世纪至公元2世纪的生产与出口格局。结果显示鱼制品及Puerto Real地区的相对重要性稳步上升，尤其在罗马共和国向帝国过渡之后，港口日益专业化于鱼制品并实现不同商品生产的空间分离。研究弥补了以往偏重橄榄油、聚焦单一遗址的不足，并展示双耳瓶数据库与地图在重建古代食物网络与海上贸易中的潜力。

papers.title: Water level of East Dongting Lake affects the spawning habitat suitability of lacustrine fish
papers.authors: Li, Yunge; Zeng, Yuhong; Hu, Hongliang; Yang, Fan; Chang, Jianbo
papers.abstract: Determining ecologically suitable water levels is fundamental to fish habitat conservation and ecologic regulation. The optimal water level thresholds for lacustrine fish in East Dongting Lake and their underlying driving factors remain poorly understood. This study focused on lacustrine fish and constructed a habitat suitability model based on depth and velocity suitability curves, then quantitatively analyzed the response of weighted usable area (WUA) to water level fluctuations. Results indicate that WUA exhibits a distinct bimodal variation with changing water level, and two optimal ecological water level ranges of 22.74-23.90 and 25.18-26.98 m are therefore recommended. Further analysis revealed that the bimodal character originates from the multi-stage sandbars topography across East Dongting Lake, where water depth acted as the key hydraulic factor limiting spawning habitat suitability. Shallow, slow-flowing habitats distributed over sandbar zones such as the northwest branching shoals, Wuguangzhou, Lu Lake, and Chaixiazhou are essential for maintaining high-quality spawning grounds of lacustrine fish. Relevant management strategies should be proposed to prioritize conservation efforts in these shoal habitats to protect the fishery resources in East Dongting Lake.
papers.summary_cn: 基于水深与流速适宜性曲线构建栖息地适宜性模型，定量分析东洞庭湖湖沼型鱼类加权可利用面积（WUA）对水位波动的响应。WUA随水位呈明显双峰变化，推荐22.74–23.90 m与25.18–26.98 m两个最适生态水位区间。双峰特征源于湖区多级沙洲地形，水深是限制产卵栖息地适宜性的关键水力因子；西北分汊浅滩、五光洲、漉湖、柴下洲等沙洲区的浅水缓流生境对维持优质产卵场至关重要，管理上应优先保护这些浅滩生境以维护东洞庭湖渔业资源。

papers.title: Genomic characterization and efficacy of bacteriophages ST22 and ST231 in mitigating Desulfovibrio vulgaris and toxic gases in shrimp aquaculture models
papers.authors: Van, Truong Thi Bich; Anh, Nguyen Thi Loan; Dung, Le Viet; Khang, Do Tan; Men, Tran Thanh; Thi, Nguyen Pham Anh; Ngoc, Le Hoang Bao; Nga, Pham Thi Ngoc
papers.abstract: This study aims to address the urgent need for antibiotic alternatives in aquaculture by isolating and characterizing novel bacteriophages. The primary objective was to evaluate the efficacy of two newly identified phages, ST22 and ST231, in targeting the sulfate-reducing bacterium Desulfovibrio vulgaris and assessing their potential for environmental remediation and disease management. The researchers utilized Transmission Electron Microscopy (TEM) to determine morphological features and employed genomic sequencing to analyze the genetic profiles of both phages. Lytic activity was validated through lysis assays, while microcosm experiments were conducted to monitor the reduction of environmental pollutants, specifically H2S and NH3. Finally, in vivo trials with shrimp were performed to confirm biological safety and survival efficacy. Morphological analysis classified ST22 (genus Bruynoghevirus) and ST231 (genus Murrayvirus) as having double-stranded DNA genomes of 45,779 bp and 41,280 bp, respectively. Both phages exhibited potent lytic activity, significantly reducing D. vulgaris density and altering colony morphology. In microcosm settings, phage application effectively mitigated H2S and NH3 levels. Furthermore, a substantial increase in shrimp survival rates underscored their efficacy as safe biocontrol agents. Phages ST22 and ST231 represent promising candidates for sustainable disease management and environmental remediation in aquaculture. These findings validate the potential of phage therapy as a robust, eco-friendly alternative to traditional chemical treatments for bacterial pathogens.
papers.summary_cn: 分离并表征了两株靶向硫酸盐还原菌 Desulfovibrio vulgaris 的新噬菌体 ST22（Bruynoghevirus 属，dsDNA 45,779 bp）和 ST231（Murrayvirus 属，dsDNA 41,280 bp），经裂解实验验证均具强裂解活性，可显著降低 D. vulgaris 密度并改变菌落形态。微宇宙实验中噬菌体处理有效降低 H2S 与 NH3 水平，虾体试验显示存活率显著提升且生物安全性良好。结果表明两株噬菌体可作为替代化学药物的生态友好型生物防控手段，用于水产养殖的细菌病害管理与环境修复。

papers.title: Look-ahead genomic mating optimizes the trade-off between genetic gain and inbreeding in family-based aquaculture breeding programs
papers.authors: Kang, Ziyi; Luan, Sheng; Xu, Chengxun; Liu, Haijun; Li, Qi
papers.abstract: Family-based aquaculture breeding programs deliver rapid genetic gains but inevitably accelerate inbreeding. Advanced mating strategies aim to manage this trade-off, yet the optimal emphasis on the rate of genetic gain ( $$\Delta G$$ ) versus the rate of inbreeding ( $$\Delta F$$ ) depends on the breeding horizon (the timeframe of consecutive breeding cycles), which existing strategies do not explicitly account for. We developed a look-ahead genomic mating strategy (LAGM) that holistically optimizes the gain-inbreeding balance across the entire breeding horizon. LAGM was benchmarked against genomic optimal contribution selection (GOCS), truncation selection (TC), and random selection in a simulated breeding program across varying horizons. Both LAGM and GOCS outperformed TC by 72.8-332.3% in conversion efficiency ( $$\Delta G/\Delta F$$ ), with the largest improvements observed at longer horizons, where severe inbreeding constrained the selection response. Constant constraints favoring inbreeding control tended to achieve higher conversion efficiency across horizons but substantially sacrificed $$\Delta G$$ . In contrast, across horizons, LAGM with a dynamic look-ahead window achieved conversion efficiency comparable to, or only slightly below (9.2-15.4%), that of the highest-efficiency GOCS (65°), while delivering 15.4-69% greater $$\Delta G$$ . Furthermore, in early breeding stages, by targeting solutions with high marginal returns and exploiting locus-resolved complementarity, LAGM achieved 4.4-58.6% higher $$\Delta G$$ than all GOCS strategies at matched inbreeding levels, even under fixed look-ahead windows-each of which approximately corresponded to a specific GOCS trade-off angle once the population structure had stabilized. Overall, LAGM offers a generalized look-ahead framework, grounded in classical quantitative genetics and modern mate selection, for balancing genetic gain and inbreeding.
papers.summary_cn: 针对基于家系的水产育种中遗传进展与近交的权衡，开发了前瞻性基因组选配策略（LAGM），在整个育种周期内整体优化ΔG/ΔF，并在模拟育种群体中与GOCS、截断选择（TC）和随机选配比较。LAGM与GOCS的转化效率（ΔG/ΔF）均较TC提高72.8–332.3%，育种周期越长提升越大；固定偏近交控制的约束虽转化效率较高但明显牺牲ΔG。采用动态前瞻窗口的LAGM转化效率与最高效GOCS（65°）相当或仅低9.2–15.4%，而ΔG高15.4–69%；在育种早期，LAGM通过高边际回报解与位点互补，在同等近交水平下ΔG较所有GOCS策略高4.4–58.6%。

papers.title: Integrated genomic, biochemical, and molecular dynamics analyses identify Chromohalobacter sp. D23 as a promising quorum-quenching probiotic for sustainable aquaculture
papers.authors: Ghosh, Dhritishree; Alam, Sk Aftabul; Mukhopadhyay, Subhra Kanti
papers.abstract: Quorum sensing-driven biofilm formation is a key contributor to the persistence and multidrug resistance (MDR) of pathogenic bacteria, presenting a major challenge in combating infectious diseases. Probiotic quorum-quenching (QQ) bacteria represent a promising alternative to conventional antibiotics by suppressing quorum sensing-dependent virulence in MDR pathogens and simultaneously enhancing fish growth, immunity, and overall health. In this study, the probiotic and QQ attributes of Chromohalobacter sp. D23 were comprehensively investigated. The strain exhibited robust tolerance to gastrointestinal stress conditions, surviving bile salt (1.2%), phenol (0.75%), and acidic environments (pH 2.0-4.0). Additionally, it displayed pronounced antioxidant activity (> 69%), high auto-aggregation (72.0 ± 2.42%), and co-aggregation (> 73%) with fish pathogens, suggesting a high potential for gut colonization and pathogen exclusion. Genome mining also revealed presence of putative proteins involved in resistance to bile, phenol, acid, osmotic pressure along with adhesion and aggregation facilitating host gut colonization. Virtual screening of strain D23 also enabled to predict potential enzymes/proteins for biosynthesis of vitamins and amino acids. In spite of presence of very few antibiotic resistance genes, overall genome-wide analysis of the draft genome of strain D23 detected no putative virulence genes, plasmid, or transposable element-associated genes, suggesting a favorable safety profile. Whole-cell assay showed complete breakdown of synthetic N-acyl homoserine lactones (N-AHLs) as revealed by biosensor-based assay. Strain D23 also degraded natural N-AHLs of Aeromonas hydrophila within 12 h. Co-culture experiment revealed potent anti-biofilm activity against A. hydrophila ( p ≤ 0.0001). Genome mining identified putative metallo-beta lactamase enzyme (lactonase_D23) having conserved ‘ 66 HXHXDH 71 ’ motif. Molecular docking revealed moderate binding affinities of lactonase_D23 towards both C4-Homoserine lactone (C4-HSL) and C6-HSL, however, molecular dynamics simulations demonstrated that the C4-HSL-lactonase_D23 complex exhibited greater conformational stability, indicating highly persistent protein-ligand interaction. Later, in silico mutant enzymes exhibited higher binding affinity than wild-type lactonase_D23 to C4-HSL. This pioneer, integrated study suggests potentiality of strain D23 as safe, beneficial, autochthonous QQ probiotic candidate in aquaculture to improve overall fish health.
papers.summary_cn: 菌株 Chromohalobacter sp. D23 在胃肠道胁迫下存活良好（耐1.2%胆盐、0.75%酚、pH 2.0–4.0），抗氧化活性>69%，自聚集率72.0±2.42%，与鱼类病原体共聚集>73%。基因组分析显示其具有耐胆盐、酚、酸及渗透压和黏附聚集相关蛋白基因，可预测维生素与氨基酸合成酶，未检出毒力基因、质粒或转座元件相关基因，安全性良好。全细胞试验表明该菌能完全降解合成N-酰基高丝氨酸内酯（N-AHLs），12 h内降解嗜水气单胞菌（Aeromonas hydrophila）天然N-AHLs，共培养显著抑制其生物膜形成（p≤0.0001）；基因组挖掘鉴定出含保守“66HXHXDH71”基序的金属-β-内酰胺酶（lactonase_D23），分子对接显示其对C4-HSL和C6-HSL具中等结合亲和力，分子动力学模拟表明C4-HSL–lactonase_D23复合物构象更稳定，in silico突变体对C4-HSL亲和力高于野生型。综合表明D23可作为水产养殖中安全、有益的本土QQ益生菌候选菌株。

papers.title: The genome of basal-branching trypanosome, Trypanosoma carassii, an emerging pathogen in aquaculture
papers.authors: Wang, Ju-Feng; Zhang, Peng; Liu, Jie; Hammond, Michael; Tang, Hao-Tian; Wang, Xi; Zhang, Jin-Yong; Yin, Xiao-Ming; Lun, Zhao-Rong; Lukeš, Julius
papers.abstract: Trypanosoma carassii infects a range of fish species and is responsible for severe disease outbreaks in aquacultures. It is considered the causative agents of trypanosomiasis outbreaks in largemouth bass, tilapia, and blood parrot cichlids in South China. Here, we present a chromosome-level genome assembly of this trypanosome, combining long-read sequencing and Hi-C scaffolding to resolve 31 chromosomes of 42 Mb with a high level of completeness and structural continuity. Phylogenetic analysis identified T. carassii as a basal-branching lineage forming a sister clade to trypanosomes infecting terrestrial vertebrates. Hi-C mapping revealed 105 chromatin-folding domains, providing the first 3D genome architecture of T. carassii . Unlike the highly dynamic, antigenic subtelomeric regions of Trypanosoma brucei and T. cruzi , those of T. carassii have a remarkably stable architecture characterized by two variants of ∼3.9 kb conserved sequences, reflecting a static host-interaction strategy. The genome of T. carassii is gene-rich, carrying 11,366 protein-coding genes. A comprehensive prediction analysis identified 165 excretory/secretory proteins, 250 putative surface proteins, and 13 cytostome-cytopharynx complex components. These included GP63, cysteine peptidases, trans -sialidases, and a large number of T. carassii -specific hypothetical proteins, representing promising candidates for vaccine development, diagnostics, and chemotherapeutic targeting. As a basal-branching lineage of the genus Trypanosoma , this genomic resource provides a foundation for understanding piscine trypanosomiasis and informs about the evolution and fitness implications of retention of the cytostome-cytopharynx complex.
papers.summary_cn: 染色体水平基因组组装（长读长测序+Hi-C）解析了感染大口黑鲈、罗非鱼和血鹦鹉等养殖鱼类的基底分支锥虫 Trypanosoma carassii 的31条染色体（42 Mb），系统发育分析显示其形成感染陆生脊椎动物锥虫的姐妹支。Hi-C 图谱鉴定出105个染色质折叠域，首次揭示其三维基因组结构；与布氏锥虫和克氏锥虫高度动态的亚端粒抗原区不同，其亚端粒结构高度稳定，仅含两种约3.9 kb保守序列变体，反映静态的宿主互作策略。基因组含11,366个蛋白编码基因，预测出165个排泄/分泌蛋白、250个推定表面蛋白及13个胞口-胞咽复合体组分（含GP63、半胱氨酸肽酶、反式唾液酸酶及大量种特异性假定蛋白），为鱼源锥虫病的疫苗、诊断和药物靶点开发及胞口-胞咽复合体保留的进化适应意义提供了基因组基础。

papers.title: Redescription of the marbled stargazer Uranoscopus marmoratus Cuvier, 1829 (Labriformes, Uranoscopidae)
papers.authors: Ponnappan, Anjana; Vijayan, Aneesh Kumar Kannamkulathil; Nihal, Davood; Kinattumkara, Bineesh; Fricke, Ronald
papers.abstract: Abstract The Marbled Stargazer, Uranoscopus marmoratus, is redescribed based on five individuals collected from the southeastern Arabian Sea, India. This species is a poorly known fish which is distributed predominantly in the eastern Indian Ocean and belongs to the Uranoscopus japonicus species group. U. marmoratus is defined as having one pair of basipterygial processes; a simple posterior nostril and tubular anterior nostril; one internal supracleithral spine and one sharp humeral spine; 4-5 preopercular and 1 subopercular spines; no scales on the predorsal region; no supraocular cirri; 52-62 transverse rows of scales on the sides of the body; well-developed occipital lobes; occipital commissure with four posterior branches; head length 2.6-3.6 times in standard length; head large; head width 3.0-3.3 times in standard length; body depth 4.2-4.7 times in standard length; head depth 1.1-1.4 times its width; dorsal surface marbled, with pale spots on a brown background. Otolith morphological description of the fish was also provided for the first time. COI sequence generated herein represents the first genetic record of the species in GenBank, and Maximum-Likelihood (K2P) analysis recovered this species as a distinct lineage, offering additional support for its taxonomic distinctiveness.
papers.summary_cn: 基于印度东南阿拉伯海5尾标本对大理石瞻星鱼（Uranoscopus marmoratus）进行了再描述，该种隶属Uranoscopus japonicus种组，此前认知匮乏。研究明确了其鉴别特征（如一对基翼突、无前背鳞、52–62列侧鳞等），首次提供耳石形态描述，并生成COI序列作为GenBank首个遗传记录，ML分析支持其独立分类地位。

papers.title: Stock assessment of the shorthead anchovy Encrasicholina heteroloba in Tanzania’s coastal waters
papers.authors: Fransis, Changoma Marko; Matsuishi, Takashi Fritz
papers.abstract: The shorthead anchovy Encrasicholina heteroloba is a small pelagic species of significant economic and nutritional importance in Tanzania. However, reliable stock assessment remains challenging because of limited data. This study evaluated the status of E. heteroloba in Tanzania’s coastal waters. A total of 32,324 specimens were sampled between July 2023 and December 2024. Length-frequency data were cleaned, bootstrapped, and analyzed using electronic length-frequency analysis to estimate von Bertalanffy growth parameters and mortality coefficients, and stock biomass and abundance were estimated through virtual population analysis. Asymptotic length ( $${L}_{\infty }$$ ) was 8.42 cm total length, growth coefficient ( $$K$$ ) was 2.08 $${\text{y}\text{e}\text{a}\text{r}}^{-1}$$ , growth performance index ( $${\varnothing }{\prime}$$ ) was 2.19, current fishing mortality ( $${F}_{\text{c}\text{u}\text{r}\text{r}}$$ ) was 0.85 $${\text{y}\text{e}\text{a}\text{r}}^{-1}$$ , exploitation rate ( $${E}_{\text{c}\text{u}\text{r}\text{r}}$$ ) was 0.40, and length at first capture ( $${L}_{\text{c}\text{u}\text{r}\text{r}}$$ ) was 6.11 cm total length. Natural mortality ( $$M$$ ) was 1.25 $${\text{y}\text{e}\text{a}\text{r}}^{-1}$$ , and total mortality ( $$Z$$ ) was 2.10 $${\text{y}\text{e}\text{a}\text{r}}^{-1}$$ . Overall biomass and stock abundance were 70,725 metric tons and 4.37 × 1010 individuals, respectively. Biological reference points were $${F}_{0.1}$$ = 1.57 $${\text{y}\text{e}\text{a}\text{r}}^{-1}$$ , $${F}_{0.5}$$ = 1.06 $${\text{y}\text{e}\text{a}\text{r}}^{-1}$$ , and $${F}_{\text{m}\text{a}\text{x}}$$ = 3.34 $${\text{y}\text{e}\text{a}\text{r}}^{-1}$$ . The stock in this region is likely underexploited. These results support evidence-based fisheries management and contribute to sustainable utilization.
papers.summary_cn: 基于2023年7月至2024年12月采集的32,324尾样本长度频率数据，经电子长度频率分析（ELEFAN）估算短头侧带小公鱼（Encrasicholina heteroloba）的von Bertalanffy生长参数与死亡系数，并用虚拟种群分析（VPA）估算资源生物量与丰度。结果显示渐近全长L∞为8.42 cm、生长系数K为2.08 year⁻¹、生长性能指数Ø′为2.19，自然死亡系数M为1.25 year⁻¹、总死亡系数Z为2.10 year⁻¹、当前捕捞死亡系数Fcurr为0.85 year⁻¹、开发率Ecurr为0.40、首次捕获全长Lcurr为6.11 cm。总生物量与资源丰度分别为70,725 t和4.37×10¹⁰尾，生物学参考点F0.1=1.57、F0.5=1.06、Fmax=3.34 year⁻¹，表明该种群可能处于开发不足状态。

papers.title: Evaluating the sustainability of shrimp aquaculture in Vietnam: stakeholder perceptions across production intensification systems
papers.authors: Ngoc, Pham Thi Anh; Phan, Chung Thanh; Mai, Tien Dang; Hoang, Tung; Nguyen, Thai Binh; van den Burg, Sander; Mai, Kien Trung
papers.journal: Journal of Agribusiness in Developing and Emerging Economies
papers.abstract: Purpose This study examines stakeholder perceptions of the importance of 21 sustainability themes across 4 Vietnamese shrimp farming systems. It also assesses associations between respondent characteristics and a separate ranking of perceived system sustainability. Design/methodology/approach Using the Sustainability Assessment of Food and Agriculture Systems (SAFA) Guidelines, 94 respondents each rated 21 themes across 4 systems, yielding 84 ordinal ratings per respondent. Questionnaires were administered in person to 56 respondents and completed online by 38. Theme-specific Friedman tests accounted for repeated observations, with Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment across 21 omnibus tests and, separately, 126 paired Wilcoxon comparisons. Cumulative-link mixed models provided an ordinal sensitivity analysis. Ridge-penalised multinomial regression examined the separate ranking outcome. Findings Differences across systems were supported for 18 of the 21 themes after adjustment for multiple testing. Corporate ethics, rule of law and biodiversity showed no supported omnibus differences. Super-intensive farming generally received the highest ratings for the importance of addressing sustainability issues. These ratings concern perceived priorities rather than measured performance. First-rank counts were 27, 7, 5 and 55 for super-intensive, intensive, semi-intensive and extensive/improved extensive/integrated systems, respectively. Age and self-reported knowledge were positively associated with selected ranking contrasts. These associations provide secondary evidence because two outcome categories were small. Research limitations/implications The purposive sample comprised 52 consumers, 36 business stakeholders and 6 experts. Its size and composition limit generalisation. Survey mode, fixed question order, unmeasured familiarity with production systems, concentrated high ratings and seven uniform response profiles may have influenced the findings. Sparse ranking categories limit prediction and practical interpretation of the multinomial model. Social implications Promoting sustainable shrimp farming systems also aligns with MARD’s approved “Sustainable aquaculture development plan in the Mekong Delta to 2030” (Decision No. 3550/QÐ-BNN-TCTS, August 2021), which aims to develop regional aquaculture sustainably. Originality/value The study applies the SAFA themes to comparisons of shrimp farming systems rated by the same stakeholders. By distinguishing the importance assigned to individual issues from an overall sustainability ranking, it explains how these two forms of judgement contribute different evidence to sustainability assessment.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于SAFA指南，调查越南4种对虾养殖系统（超集约、集约、半集约、粗放/改良粗放/综合）中94名利益相关者对21项可持续发展主题的感知重要性及系统可持续性排名。经多重检验校正后，21项主题中有18项在不同系统间存在显著差异，超集约养殖在多数可持续议题的重要性评分上最高。首选排名计数显示超集约系统获55票，远高于其他系统；年龄和自我报告知识水平与部分排名对比相关。研究强调上述评分反映的是感知优先级而非实测绩效，样本的目的性构成限制了结果的普适性。

papers.title: Heterogeneity in carbon emission efficiency across global marine capture fisheries: a metafrontier analysis of technology gaps and reduction potentials
papers.authors: Li, Yan; Zhang, Yimeng; Guo, Bing; Han, Qiaoxia
papers.abstract: Improving the carbon emission efficiency of marine capture fisheries is important for the sustainable development of fisheries under climate change. Using 66 major marine fishing countries over 1995-2017 as the sample, we divided the countries into three groups by fishing structure: high-input predatory fish-dominated, mixed, and small pelagic and other finfish-dominated. We measured carbon emission efficiency with a slacks-based measure (SBM) model with undesirable outputs and a metafrontier approach, and decomposed the potential emission reduction into managerial inefficiency and the technology gap. The results show the following. (1) Carbon emission efficiency was generally low, with a mean metafrontier efficiency of 0.331, and the differences between groups were closely related to catch value. (2) The technology gap was concentrated in the high-input predatory fish-dominated group and the small pelagic and other finfish-dominated group, and its causes differed across countries: in Vietnam, Thailand and Malaysia it was associated with fuel-intensive fishing operations, whereas in Peru and Chile it stemmed from the low value of the catch. (3) The mean annual potential carbon emission reduction of the sample countries was 85.4 Mt CO 2 -eq, about 53% of their total emissions, and was concentrated in countries such as Indonesia, India and Vietnam. (4) Managerial inefficiency was the main source of the reduction potential, accounting for 69%. In the mixed group, almost all of the potential came from managerial inefficiency; in the high-input predatory fish-dominated group, the technology gap dominated; and in the small pelagic and other finfish-dominated group, both sources contributed. Countries should therefore choose different pathways according to the source of their reduction potential. For most countries, catching up with the best practice of similar countries could release most of the potential with existing technology, especially in countries where the potential is concentrated, such as Indonesia and India. Countries whose technology gap is accompanied by high fuel intensity should focus on promoting energy-saving fishing gear and propulsion technology, while countries that mainly land low-value catch should increase the value of their catch.
papers.summary_cn: 研究基于1995—2017年66个主要海洋捕捞国家，按捕捞结构分为高投入掠食性鱼类主导型、混合型和小型中上层及其他鱼类主导型三组，采用含非期望产出的SBM模型与metafrontier方法测算碳排放效率，并将减排潜力分解为管理无效率与技术差距。结果显示，metafrontier平均效率仅0.331，技术差距集中于高投入掠食性鱼类组和小型中上层鱼类组，成因因国而异（如越南、泰国、马来西亚与燃油密集型作业相关，秘鲁、智利则源于渔获价值低）。样本国年均减排潜力约85.4 Mt CO2-eq（约占排放总量的53%），主要集中于印度尼西亚、印度、越南等国，其中管理无效率贡献69%。研究建议各国依据减排潜力来源选择差异化路径：多数国家可通过追赶同类最佳实践释放大部分潜力，高燃油强度国家应推广节能渔具与推进技术，低值渔获国家则应提升渔获价值。

papers.title: Portfolio theory is not applicable to fisheries management
papers.authors: Hart, Deborah R.
papers.journal: Canadian Journal of Fisheries and Aquatic Sciences
papers.abstract: There has been considerable recent interest in applying portfolio theory to manage multispecies fisheries, analogous to the management of financial portfolios. It is demonstrated here that this analogy breaks down for several reasons. First, fisheries portfolio theory focuses on mitigating the uncertainty in short-term landings and revenue, which, unlike financial stocks, can usually be predicted to good precision. Meanwhile, it neglects the much more important risks of overfishing and stock depletion. Additionally, while portfolio theory reduces the volatility of the combined portfolio, it may call for highly varying landings of individual fisheries, which can cause considerable hardship. Finally, the control parameters (portfolio weightings) and random variables fundamental to portfolio theory have not been properly defined in the fisheries context, nor do such appropriate definitions seem to exist. Fisheries portfolio theory fails because it focuses on the wrong risk and it calculates this risk incorrectly. Additionally, it is based on an incorrect assumption that the actions of managers do not affect future fishery productivity.
papers.summary_cn: 该文论证金融组合理论不适用于多物种渔业管理。作者指出渔业组合理论聚焦于短期产量与收入的不确定性，而这一不确定性通常可被精确预测，却忽视了过度捕捞与种群衰竭等更重要的风险；组合理论虽能降低整体波动性，却可能导致单个渔业产量剧烈变化，造成经营困难。此外，组合权重等控制参数与随机变量在渔业情境下缺乏恰当定义，且该理论错误假设管理者行为不影响未来渔业生产力。

papers.title: Biological Hazards in Fish Production: Legionella in Aquaculture and Fisheries: A Potential Occupational Exposure?
papers.authors: Cortés-Sánchez, Alejandro De Jesús; Díaz-Ramírez, Mayra; León-Espinosa, Erika Berenice; García-Hernández, Alitzel Belem; Hernández-Nava, Rocío Guadalupe; García-Barrientos, Raquel
papers.abstract: The increasing global demand for fish and fishery products has established fisheries and aquaculture as essential sectors for food security and economic development. However, the intensification of these activities may also increase exposure to biological hazards inherent to aquatic environments and production systems, raising concerns for food safety, occupational and public health. Among these hazards, pathogenic bacteria, associated with water, sediments, and aquatic organisms, are of particular concern. Environmental changes, including climate change and the expansion of aquaculture practices, may further promote the emergence and dissemination of these microorganisms. Within this context, Legionella spp. is recognized as a relevant waterborne pathogen due to its widespread occurrence in natural and artificial aquatic environments and its capacity to cause human disease, primarily through the inhalation of contaminated aerosols. Consequently, workers involved in aquaculture, fisheries, and fish-processing industries may represent a population potentially exposed to this microorganism. Although legionellosis is not considered a zoonosis associated with fish consumption, and no occupational cases linked to these sectors have been reported to date, the persistence of Legionella in aquatic environments highlights a plausible but insufficiently investigated exposure pathway. This narrative review synthesizes information from SciELO, Scopus, Google Scholar, and other relevant bibliographic sources on the biological and clinical characteristics of Legionella, available detection methods and prevention strategies. The aim is to examine the potential for occupational exposure within fish production systems and discuss its possible implications for worker health. By identifying hypothetical exposure scenarios and current knowledge gaps, this review seeks to support future research and contribute to the prevention and assessment of biological risks in the fisheries and aquaculture sectors, without assuming the existence of a demonstrated occupational hazard or an emerging public health problem.
papers.summary_cn: 全球鱼类需求增长使渔业与水产养殖成为粮食安全和经济发展的关键部门，但集约化可能增加从业者对水生环境中生物危害的暴露风险。本文为叙述性综述，综合SciELO、Scopus、Google Scholar等来源文献，聚焦Legionella spp.的生物学与临床特征、检测方法及防控策略，探讨其在鱼类生产系统中的潜在职业暴露途径。尽管目前尚无人鱼消费相关人畜共患病或该行业职业性军团菌病病例报告，Legionella在水生环境中的持续存在提示了一条合理但研究不足的暴露路径，需未来研究加以验证并支撑生物风险评估。

papers.title: Spatial Variation in Fish Assemblages and Their Relationships with Environmental Factors in a Dendritic River Network: The Shimian Reach of the Dadu River, China
papers.authors: Ban, Wenzhuo; Wang, Guowu; Wei, Wenyan; Fu, Suxing; Wang, Yufeng; Qu, Lianshi; Li, Shasha; Zhang, Shilin; Zhang, Yangjun; Yang, Song
papers.abstract: Mountain river networks are composed of a mainstem and multiple tributaries, where complex hydrological processes and habitat heterogeneity provide diverse niches for fishes. Previous studies have documented the fish fauna and diversity in the Dadu River basin, providing baseline information for regional fish conservation. However, differences in fish assemblage composition among river units and their relationships with water environmental conditions require further examination through continuous multi-year surveys. From 2023 to 2025, a three-year continuous survey of fish assemblages was conducted across 28 sampling sites in the mainstem and nine major tributaries of the Shimian reach in the middle Dadu River (upper Yangtze River basin), along with concurrent monitoring of water physicochemical parameters. A total of 54 fish species belonging to three orders and seven families were recorded, with Cyprinidae and Cobitidae being the dominant groups. Fish assemblages were mainly composed of rheophilic, benthic, and demersal-spawning species, reflecting the typical ecological characteristics of fishes in high-gradient river habitats. Fish assemblage composition remained generally stable over the three survey years but showed marked spatial differences among river units. NMDS ordination and PERMANOVA indicated that functional habitat types (mainstem, upstream and confluences) explained a significant proportion of variation in assemblage structure, whereas the effect of survey year was not significant, indicating that spatial differences across habitat types were more pronounced than interannual variation. Distinct fish assemblages were formed among the mainstem, confluences, and individual tributaries, with several natural tributaries supporting higher proportions of endemic and cold-water fishes. Water environmental analyses revealed evident hydrochemical gradients among river units, and redundancy analysis (RDA) showed that water temperature, dissolved oxygen, and nutrient concentrations were closely associated with the spatial distribution of fish assemblages. Building on previous surveys of fish fauna in the Dadu River basin, this study adds three years of fish assemblage data at the mainstem-tributary river network scale and further describes spatial differences in assemblage composition among river units and their relationships with water environmental conditions. These results provide baseline information for understanding the spatial distribution of fish assemblages in alpine canyon rivers and for fish biodiversity conservation and tributary habitat management in the Dadu River basin.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究于2023—2025年对金沙江上游大渡河中游石棉江段干流及9条主要支流共28个采样点开展连续三年鱼类群落调查，同步监测水体理化因子。共记录鱼类54种，隶属3目7科，以鲤科和鳅科为主，群落以喜流水、底栖和底层产卵类型为特征。NMDS排序和PERMANOVA表明，功能栖息地类型（干流、上游及汇口）显著解释群落结构变异，而调查年份影响不显著，说明空间差异强于年际变化；水温、溶解氧和营养盐浓度与鱼类群落空间分布密切相关（RDA）。研究揭示高山峡谷河网鱼类群落的空间格局及其环境驱动因子，为大渡河流域鱼类多样性保护与支流栖息地管理提供基础资料。

papers.title: Insights into potential health risk of heavy metals from farmed fish and fish feed in renowned fish-growing region of Bangladesh
papers.authors: Khan, Md. Badiuzzaman; Kanta, Abeer Hossain; Khan, Md. Al-Amin; Rahman, Md. Safiur; Salam, Abdus; Jiang, Jheng-Jie; Aziz, Azrina Abd; Gautam, Sneha; Min, Baehyun
papers.abstract: Toxic elements can be accumulated into human body through fish chain as fish is exposed to metals through water, sediment and contaminated feeds. Therefore, the study was conducted to determine the heavy metal content of fish species and their feeds, as well as the potential health risks associated with them. Forty-five fish samples were collected from fifteen fish farms whereas thirty feed samples were collected from three upalizas of Mymensingh district during June to August 2022. The collected samples were digested with an acid mixture, and concentrations of twelve heavy metals were measured by ICP-MS. Fe predominates over the other metals in almost all samples. All three fish species contained the higher concentration of Fe, Ni, Zn and Cr. The concentrations of Fe, Ni, Zn and Cr are 20.84, 9.4, 6.60, 1.86 mgkg -1 for Pangasius, 25.8, 13.82, 8.91 and 2.00 mgkg -1 for Rui and 27.58, 7.08, 7.92 and 2.09 mgkg -1 for Tilapia, respectively. The WHO/EU standard limits for Cr, Mn, Ni, and Pb were exceeded in feed samples from farmers and in commercial feeds. Tilapia fish species had a strong propensity to acquire As, Co, and Ni from farmer-supplied feeds and As and Se from commercial feeds as BFAF value was higher than 1. The degree of contamination across all species can be characterized as follows: Tilapia > Rui > Pangasius. The mean estimated daily intake of the heavy metals was lower than the recommended daily allowance. Except for Fe, the THQ values for fish species were less than 1. Conversely, HI in all species was higher than the allowable threshold of 1. Carcinogenic risks from Ni and Pb consumption were present in all fish species. Antibiotics, especially oxytetracycline and tetracycline, were detected in various fish samples. The results suggest that the authority should take appropriate precautions to ensure feed quality and prevent significant heavy metal exposure from farmed fish.
papers.summary_cn: 在孟加拉国Mymensingh地区15个养殖场采集45份鱼样和30份饲料样，用ICP-MS测定12种重金属，并评估膳食摄入与健康风险。饲料中Cr、Mn、Ni、Pb超过WHO/EU限值；罗非鱼对饲料中As、Co、Ni（农家饲料）及As、Se（商业饲料）的BFAF>1，污染程度为罗非鱼>Rui>Pangasius。鱼体Fe的THQ>1，所有鱼种HI均超过1，Ni和Pb存在致癌风险，部分鱼样检出土霉素和四环素。

papers.title: Assessment of post-harvest fish loss in Somali fish markets: drivers, impacts, and mitigation strategies
papers.authors: Hashi, Sakariye Ahmed; Dhore, Khalid Omar; Mohamed, Mohamed Abdi
papers.abstract: Introduction Post-harvest fish loss is an important concern in Somalia's fisheries sector, with potential implications for fish quality, livelihoods, food security, and market development. Methods A descriptive, cross-sectional mixed-methods survey was conducted with 94 fisheries stakeholders across four Somali fish markets: Mogadishu, Kismayo, Bosaso, and Berbera. Data were collected through questionnaires, semi-structured interviews, and field observations and analysed using descriptive statistics and thematic analysis. Results Respondents identified inadequate fish handling, limited preservation and cold-storage facilities, unreliable electricity, transportation difficulties, and weaknesses in quality control and enforcement as major challenges. They reported perceived effects on fish availability, market prices, consumer access, food security, income, business activities, and fish quality. Recommended mitigation measures included improved fish handling, timely icing, better cold-chain facilities, improved preservation technologies, training, stronger quality-control systems, and collaboration among stakeholders. Discussion The findings provide insights into stakeholder-perceived post-harvest challenges and potential mitigation strategies in Somali fisheries. However, the study did not directly measure physical fish losses, discarded quantities, or their economic value. The findings therefore represent stakeholder perceptions and reported experiences rather than measured losses or established causal effects.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在评估索马里四个鱼市场（摩加迪沙、基斯马尤、博萨索和柏培拉）的捕捞后损失驱动因素、影响及缓解策略，采用描述性横断面混合方法调查了94名渔业利益相关者。结果显示，主要挑战包括鱼品处理不当、保鲜与冷藏设施不足、电力不稳定、运输困难以及质量控制与执法薄弱，并 perceived 影响鱼品供应、市场价格、消费者获取、粮食安全、收入和鱼品质量。建议的缓解措施包括改善处理、及时加冰、完善冷链设施、改进保鲜技术、培训及加强利益相关者协作；但研究仅反映利益相关者感知，未直接测定实际物理损失或经济价值。

papers.title: Seismic surveying noise has species-specific effects on two commercial fish, Greenland halibut (Reinhardtius hippoglossoides) and witch flounder (Glyptocephalus cynoglossus), as shown using deepwater acoustic telemetry
papers.authors: Geissinger, Emilie A; Nguyen, Khanh; Wheeland, Laura J; Novaczek, Emilie; Cote, David; Borys, Pablo; Morris, Corey J
papers.journal: Canadian Journal of Fisheries and Aquatic Sciences
papers.abstract: Greenland halibut (Reinhardtius hippoglossoides) and witch flounder (Glyptocephalus cynoglossus) are fished in deep water (>500m) along the continental slope of eastern Canada, which is an area of oil and gas exploration. Virtually no information is available regarding the effects of noise on these species at this depth, however, some commercial fish harvesters believe that noise from seismic surveying displaces fish and causes reductions in catch. We used acoustic telemetry and a control-impact study design to test this hypothesis by measuring fish movement in response to weeks of industrial seismic survey noise. There were no large-scale displacements of tracked fish from the impacted area for either species. Greenland halibut movement, while in the study arrays, did not change with proximity to seismic activity. Witch flounder remained in the impact array longer than the control array and were more likely to remain stationary with increased seismic noise. Noise impact in this study revealed different behavioral effects, even within these two flatfish species, and suggests that effects on commercial catch rates will vary according to species.
papers.summary_cn: 研究利用声学遥测（acoustic telemetry）和对照-影响设计，评估工业地震勘探噪声对格陵兰大比目鱼（Reinhardtius hippoglossoides）和女巫鲽（Glyptocephalus cynoglossus）两种商业鱼类移动行为的影响。结果显示两种鱼均未出现从受影响区域的大规模位移；格陵兰大比目鱼的移动与地震活动距离无关，而女巫鲽在影响阵列中停留时间更长，且随噪声增强更倾向于静止不动。研究表明地震噪声的行为效应具有物种特异性，对商业捕捞率的影响将因物种而异。

papers.title: Engineering of Copper-Doped Zinc Oxide Nanoparticles: Unlocking Synergistic Antibacterial Mechanisms and Biofilm Eradication for Sustainable Aquaculture
papers.authors: Wang, Tao; Wan, Jiaqi; Liu, Lijia; Liu, Wei; Wu, Ning
papers.abstract: The overuse of antibiotics in aquaculture has accelerated the emergence of drug-resistant bacteria and biofilm-associated infections, creating an urgent need for alternative antimicrobial agents. Zinc oxide nanoparticles (ZnO NPs) are promising candidates owing to their low toxicity and cost, but their intrinsic antibacterial activity is often inadequate. Herein, we report a series of copper-doped ZnO nanoparticles (Cu@ZnO NPs, 1-5 mol% Cu) synthesized via a facile solvothermal method. The 2% Cu@ZnO NPs, comprising well-dispersed spherical particles of approximately 200 nm with a highly positive surface charge (+20 mV), exhibited the strongest antibacterial activity, outperforming pristine and commercial ZnO, with a minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC) of 0.2 mg/mL and a minimum bactericidal concentration (MBC) of 1.0 mg/mL against both Escherichia coli and Staphylococcus aureus. Mechanistic studies suggested that bactericidal activity may arise from the synergy of electrostatic adsorption, membrane disruption accompanied by protein leakage, intracellular reactive oxygen species (ROS) generation, and sustained metal-ion release. The nanoparticles were shown to reduce biofilm formation by 80.96% and maintained 88.4% viability of L929 fibroblasts at 20 μg/mL, indicating good biocompatibility. In a zebrafish larvae infection model, 5.0 μg/mL of 2% Cu@ZnO increased the 72 h survival rate from 6.25% (Vibrio-challenged) to 65.0%. Cu@ZnO-loaded filter materials further demonstrated practical applicability for aquaculture water pretreatment. This work elucidates the structure-activity relationship of Cu-doped ZnO nanomaterials and offers a low-toxicity, filter-integrable alternative to antibiotics for sustainable aquaculture.
papers.summary_cn: 针对水产养殖中抗生素滥用导致的耐药菌和生物膜感染问题，采用溶剂热法合成1–5 mol%铜掺杂ZnO纳米颗粒（Cu@ZnO NPs），其中2% Cu@ZnO（约200 nm球形颗粒，表面电荷+20 mV）对大肠杆菌和金黄色葡萄球菌抗菌活性最强（MIC 0.2 mg/mL，MBC 1.0 mg/mL），杀菌机制涉及静电吸附、膜破坏与蛋白泄漏、胞内ROS生成及金属离子缓释的协同作用。该纳米颗粒可抑制生物膜形成达80.96%，在20 μg/mL下对L929成纤维细胞保持88.4%存活率，斑马鱼幼鱼感染模型中5.0 μg/mL使72 h存活率从6.25%提升至65.0%。载Cu@ZnO滤材展示了养殖水预处理的实用潜力，为可持续水产养殖提供了低毒、可集成过滤的抗生素替代方案。

papers.title: Quantifying Land-based and Aquaculture-Derived Pollutant Loads in Xuan Dai Bay, Vietnam: A Source-based Assessment for Sustainable Aquaculture
papers.authors: Minh-Thu, Phan; Hung, Nguyen Van; Nhu, Le Thi Hai; Ha, Tran Thanh; Thao, Vu Thi Phuong; Anh, Vu Tuan; Linh, Bui Duc; Mien, Pham Thi
papers.journal: Asian Journal of Fisheries and Aquatic Research
papers.abstract: Coastal water quality is affected by multiple pollution sources, and their contributions to receiving waters depend on pollutant generation, transport pathways, and delivery processes. This study developed a source-based assessment of pollutant loads in the Xuan Dai Bay area, Vietnam, using 2025 activity data for aquaculture, domestic wastewater, crop cultivation, livestock farming, and stormwater runoff. Annual loads of biochemical oxygen demand (BOD), chemical oxygen demand (COD), total nitrogen (TN) and total phosphorus (TP) were estimated using source-specific emission factors and delivery coefficients. Total generated loads were estimated at 3,945.54 tonnes per year (t yr⁻¹) of BOD, 10,711.35 t yr⁻¹ of COD, 1,447.66 t yr⁻¹ of TN, and 318.95 t yr⁻¹ of TP. After the proposed delivery factors were applied, the estimated loads reaching the bay were 1,577.79, 3,955.95, 716.31 and 193.73 t yr⁻¹, respectively. Aquaculture was the dominant source of estimated delivered TN and TP, contributing 70.44% and 82.12%, respectively, while livestock farming was an important source of organic loads. The results demonstrate that source rankings can change when pollutant transport is considered alongside generation. Although the estimates provide an initial basis for prioritizing pollution-control measures, uncertainty in emission factors and delivery coefficients limits their precision. Local validation and hydrodynamic assessment are needed to refine source attribution and support future assessments of environmental carrying capacity.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于2025年活动数据，采用源特异性排放因子和输移系数，估算越南Xuan Dai Bay区域水产养殖、生活污水、种植业、畜禽养殖和暴雨径流产生的BOD、COD、TN和TP年负荷。结果表明，经输移系数修正后进入海湾的TN和TP负荷分别为716.31和193.73 t yr⁻¹，水产养殖是TN（70.44%）和TP（82.12%）的主要来源，畜禽养殖则是有机负荷的重要来源。研究强调考虑污染物输移过程后污染源排序可能改变，但排放因子和输移系数的不确定性限制了估算精度，需通过本地验证和水动力评估完善源解析并支撑环境承载力评估。

papers.title: Deciphering the Aquaculture Impact: Cage Fish Farming Alters Sedimentary Bacterial Community Assembly and Interaction Networks in Daya Bay
papers.authors: Zhang, Manman; Xiao, Haoxiang; Ouyang, Hong; Gu, Junning; Xiao, Lijuan; Wang, Zhaohui
papers.journal: Journal of Ocean University of China
papers.abstract: The rapid expansion of cage aquaculture raises concerns about its impacts on coastal sediment ecosystems. This study investigated the long-term effect of cage fish farming on the spatiotemporal dynamics, assembly mechanisms, and co-occurrence networks of benthic bacterial communities in Daya Bay, South China Sea. Surface sediments were collected every two months from a cage farm and non-aquaculture sites, and bacterial communities were characterized via high-throughput 16S rRNA gene sequencing. Alpha diversity did not differ significantly between farm and control sites, whereas community composition diverged markedly and was likely driven by aquaculture-derived nutrient enrichment. Sediment from the fish farm exhibited a reduced dominance of core phyla (Pseudomonadota, Acidobacteriota, Planctomycetota) and an enrichment of opportunistic heterotrophs (Bacteroidota, Bacillota, Spirochaetota) that was positively correlated with sedimentary biogenic elements, including total organic carbon (TOC), total nitrogen (TN), and total phosphorus (TP). Co-occurrence network analysis revealed that the farm-associated network had greater complexity, modularity, and stability and a significantly greater proportion of negative correlations, indicating intensified interspecific competition. Null model analysis of assembly processes showed that while deterministic homogeneous selection dominated both the farm and control sites, its contribution was substantially lower at the farm site (59.38% vs. 71.37%). Concurrently, the stochastic process of dispersal limitation increased from 1.73% to 14.20%. These findings demonstrate that cage fish farming restructures benthic bacterial communities and fundamentally alters their assembly rules by enhancing ecological barriers that restrict microbial dispersal. This mechanistic shift provides new insights into aquaculture’s ecological footprint in coastal ecosystems.
papers.summary_cn: 网箱养殖长期影响下，大亚湾养殖区与对照区沉积物细菌α多样性无显著差异，但群落组成明显分化，养殖区核心门（Pseudomonadota、Acidobacteriota、Planctomycetota）优势度下降，机会性异养类群（Bacteroidota、Bacillota、Spirochaetota）富集，且与沉积物TOC、TN、TP正相关。共现网络分析显示养殖区网络复杂度、模块化和稳定性更高，负相关比例显著增加，种间竞争加剧。群落构建以确定性同质选择为主，但其贡献在养殖区降低（59.38% vs. 71.37%），扩散限制等随机过程由1.73%升至14.20%，表明网箱养殖通过增强限制微生物扩散的生态屏障重塑了底栖细菌群落及其构建规则。

papers.title: Effects of Fish Species and Simmering Time on Nutritional and Flavor Attributes of Fish Steak Soups
papers.authors: Jiang, Pengfei; Sun, Shimeng; Li, Guodong; Miao, Xiaoqing
papers.journal: Journal of Ocean University of China
papers.abstract: This study investigated the effects of fish species, simmering time, and deodorization methods on the nutrition and flavor of fish steak soups prepared from New Zealand hoki, Pacific cod, and Atlantic mackerel. Nutritional composition was analyzed via basic component measurement, while flavor profiles were evaluated using electronic tongue, free amino acid (FAA) assay, and GC-IMS coupled with ROAV analysis. Prolonged simmering raised protein, fat, and ash contents but reduced moisture in all samples. Fish Species imposed the strongest effect on taste profiles, followed by deodorization method, while simmering time showed the least influence. Both deodorization treatments improved flavor, with increased electronic tongue responses and FAA levels. GC-IMS detected 89 volatile compounds, mainly aldehydes, alcohols, and ketones. Extended heating increased fishy volatiles and decreased favorable ethyl acetate. While prolonged simmering enhances nutrient release, it simultaneously accelerates lipid oxidation and accumulates fishy off-odor volatiles. Applying sensory masking and yeast extract effectively mitigates these off-odors and boosts sweet and umami amino acids. Optimal simmering was 2 h for New Zealand hoki and Pacific cod soups, and 4 h for Atlantic mackerel soup. Sensory masking showed better deodorization, while yeast extract delivered stronger umami. These results support process optimization and sustainable valorization of fish by-products.
papers.summary_cn: 以新西兰长尾鳕、太平洋鳕和大西洋鲭鱼排为原料制备鱼排汤，考察鱼种、炖煮时间与脱腥方式对营养和风味的影响：延长炖煮提高蛋白质、脂肪和灰分含量但降低水分；鱼种对滋味轮廓影响最大，脱腥方式次之，炖煮时间影响最小。GC–IMS共检出89种挥发性物质（以醛、醇、酮为主），长时间加热增加腥味挥发物、减少良性乙酸乙酯，同时加速脂质氧化。感官掩蔽与酵母提取物均能有效减轻腥味并提升甜味和鲜味氨基酸，前者脱腥更佳、后者增鲜更强；新西兰长尾鳕与太平洋鳕汤最佳炖煮2 h，大西洋鲭鱼汤为4 h。

papers.title: Editorial: Neurobiology and behavior in fish: insights and innovations
papers.authors: Hamilton, Trevor James; Burggren, Warren W.
papers.abstract: This research topic on Neurobiology and Behavior in Fish: Insights and Innovations in Frontiers in Behavioral Neuroscience brings together seven articles on four fish species including zebrafish (Danio rerio), Japanese medaka (Oryzias latipes), the mangrove rivulus (Kryptolebias marmoratus), and the blunt snout bream (Megalobrama amblycephala) with the goal of advancing our understanding of the fish nervous system and behavior through pharmacological, behavioral and genetic investigations.A major theme in this Research Topic is the use of behavioral neuroscience tests to infer neural function, both at baseline and after experimental manipulation. Shinkai et al. investigate the most widely used behavioral assay for testing anxiety-like behaviour in zebrafish -the novel tank dive test (https://doi.org/10.3389/fnbeh.2025.1624277). Fish are placed into a novel tank and vertical location is used as a proxy for anxiety-like behavior, with 'anxious' fish spending more time at the bottom. The authors use a logistic regression analysis on fish tracking data to greatly reduce false detections of freezing. Alteration of stress-like states is manipulated via restraint and darkness which reduces variability in the latency to enter the top half of the tank. However, a combination of darkness and restraint provoke abnormal escape responses. Shinkai et al. report behavioral alteration with test tank temperature and net chasing compared to funnel transfer, and no habituation after five consecutive days of testing.Guan et al. establish an in vitro model of olfactory epithelial cells from the blunt snout bream, Megalobrama amblycephala, reporting that collagenase digestion yields stable cultures with well-preserved ciliated neurons (https://doi.org/10.3389/fcell.2025.1587151). Scanning electron microscopy reveals olfactory neurospheres, while immunofluorescence and molecular assays confirm neuronal identity and olfactory receptor expression. Stimulation with an amino acid mixture or prostaglandin F2α increases pERK-labeled cells, indicating activation of olfactory signaling. RNA-seq analysis further identifies differentially expressed genes enriched in olfactory and reproductive pathways. Collectively, these findings provide a valuable platform for studying how fishes detect environmental odorants and integrate olfactory cues with reproductive physiology.Brain derived-neurotrophic factor (BDNF) is a conserved regulator of brain functioning, including synaptic plasticity and learning. In the study by Rovegno et al. variation of bdnf gene expression is investigated in the MIKK panel of 53 near-isolated medaka lines, revealing up to a 98% difference variation within the populations, (https://doi.org/10.3389/fnbeh.2026.1681619). Seasonal variability is present with higher bdnf in the summer and lower in the winter, but this is also reversed in some isogenic lines. There are no sex differences in the overall population but there are at the isogenic line level.In a second study on BDNF, Rovegno et al. test object recognition memory in a bdnf -/-line of zebrafish and compare them to wild-type siblings (bdnf +/+ ) (https://doi.org/10.3389/fnbeh.2026.1710671). Larvae (14 days post fertilization) undergo a novel object recognition procedure with visual stimuli (lines or crosses). There are no differences in the familiar, nor in novel object preference between the lines. However, using an absolute recognition index that takes into consideration a novel or familiar object preference, there is a significant decrease in preference in the bdnf -/-line.With psilocybin gaining popularity as a compound that may have clinical value, testing its effects in animal models is a first step in assessing its efficacy. Forsyth et al. report on the effects of psilocybin on social behaviour in the mangrove rivulus (https://doi.org/10.3389/fnbeh.2026.1767175). Testing in a dyadic pair of fish, psilocybin decreases the time spent moving and swimming bursts in the focal fish after stimulus fish exposure. Swimming bursts and increased activity in response to a conspecific are related to aggression in the rivulus. Thus, this suggests that psilocybin acts to decrease aggression related behaviours in this candidate model species.Severe tissue hypoxia, including hypoxia arising from cardiac dysfunction, increasingly emerges as a trigger of neurobehavioral change. Yet the effects of early-life hypoxia on anxiety-like behavior and behavioral disinhibition remain poorly understood. In the study by Vazquez-Roman and Burggren, acute, severe hypoxic exposure in zebrafish larvae reduces later exploratory behavior, especially diminished attraction to novel objects (https://doi.org/10.3389/fnbeh.2026.1717856). Inhibition of p38 MAPK (protein kinases that help cells respond to environmental stress and inflammation) rescues growth and prevents hypoxia-induced length restriction, but paradoxically intensifies anxiety-like thigmotaxis. These findings reveal that protective molecular interventions during hypoxia can carry unexpected neurobehavioral trade-offs.With the increasing use of larval zebrafish to test pharmacological compounds and toxicants, Hagen et al., examine the impact of three well known solvents used to deliver poorly soluble compounds (https://doi.org/10.3389/fnbeh.2025.1717998). Thirty-minute exposure to up to 1% DMSO has no detectable effect on locomotion, thigmotaxis, or startle responses (light, dark, and tap). Methanol and ethanol at 1%, however, increase locomotion, and ethanol also blunts the startle response to sudden darkness. For acute experiments requiring a solvent, their data favors use of DMSO.Collectively, the articles of this special issue advance on several fronts our understanding of the fish nervous system and behavior. To continue moving forward, we can prioritize the standardization of protocols (Shinkai et al., 2026) and solvent choice (Hagen et al., 2026), to promote reproducible pharmacological research in fish. Variation in individual, seasonal, and sex-dependent bdnf expression in medaka lines (Rovengo et al., 2026a), along with the role of BDNF in object recognition in zebrafish (Rovengo et al., 2026b), suggest that future research should collect data for both male and female fish, report the season and testing conditions, and use isogenic lines to tease apart genetic from environmental influences. The impact of hypoxia can have long lasting behavioral impacts, with p38 MAPK reversing some physiological damage, but producing later behavioral deficits (Vazquez & Burggren, 2026), demonstrating the complex relationship between physiology and neurobehavior and scarcity of 'silver bullets'. Using the mangrove rivulus to investigate the impact of psilocybin (Forsyth et al., 2026) highlights the value of using fish models other than the zebrafish for pharmacological challenges and pilot drug testing. Mechanistic screening can also take place in vitro with cultured olfactory epithelial cells (Guan et al., 2026) which offers a scalable platform for olfactory odorant research. Notably, neuroimaging, electrophysiology and optogenetics remain underrepresented, and we encourage future work to incorporate these approaches with behavioral paradigms to assess the mechanistic basis in which neural activity confers behavior.
papers.summary_cn: 该专辑汇集七篇文章，覆盖斑马鱼、日本青鳉、红树林鳉和团头鲂四种鱼类，通过药理学、行为学和遗传学手段推进对鱼类神经系统与行为的认识。Shinkai等用逻辑回归改进新型水箱潜水测试中的冻结误检，发现约束与黑暗可降低进入上半箱的潜伏期变异，但二者组合诱发异常逃逸反应，且连续五天测试未见习惯化；Guan等建立团头鲂嗅上皮细胞体外模型，证实胶原酶消化可获得稳定培养的纤毛神经元，氨基酸混合物或PGF2α刺激增加pERK标记细胞并激活嗅觉信号通路。Rovegno等在53个近交青鳉系中发现bdnf表达变异高达98%，存在季节差异且部分近交系中反转，整体无性别差异但近交系水平存在差异；其另一项研究表明bdnf-/-斑马鱼幼鱼在新异物体识别中绝对识别指数显著下降。Forsyth等报道裸盖菇素降低红树林鳉焦点鱼在刺激鱼暴露后的运动时间和游泳爆发，提示其可能降低攻击相关行为；Vazquez-Roman与Burggren发现幼鱼急性严重缺氧降低后期探索行为，抑制p38 MAPK可挽救生长限制但 paradoxically 加剧焦虑样趋触性；Hagen等比较三种溶剂，发现1% DMSO对运动、趋触性和惊跳反应无显著影响，而甲醇和乙醇增加运动，乙醇还削弱对突然黑暗

papers.title: Genomic Organization, Phylogenetic Conservation, and Expression Divergence Highlight the Roles of Integrin Family Members in Growth Regulation and Environmental Resilience of the Pacific Oyster (Crassostrea gigas)
papers.authors: Li, Jian’an; Yao, Boyan; Shi, Chenyu; Liu, Shikai
papers.journal: Journal of Ocean University of China
papers.abstract: Integrins are transmembrane receptors essential for cell adhesion and signaling, with known roles in growth regulation in vertebrates. However, the mechanisms employed by integrins to coordinate growth and environmental adaptation in bivalves remain unknown. The high-quality genome of Crassostrea gigas was referenced to identify 23 integrin genes, which included 8 α and 15 β subunits. Phylogenetic and structural analyses revealed lineage-specific expansion of the β subunits, suggesting functional diversification. Expression profiling across developmental stages, tissues, and selectively bred oyster lines revealed marked expression divergence associated with both growth performance and environmental adaptation. Notably, several integrin genes (e.g., Cg-ITGA1.2, Cg-ITGB1.2a, and Cg-ITGB1.4) were markedly upregulated in the fast-growing strain relative to the growth-depressed inbred line, implicating involvement in growth regulation. Conversely, overall integrin expression was higher in wild oysters than in the ‘Haida No. 1’ strain, suggesting that elevated integrin activity may confer environmental resilience rather than directly promote growth. Together, these findings reveal the evolutionary expansion and transcriptional divergence of the C. gigas family of integrins, highlighting dual roles in mediation of growth and environmental adaptability as a classical physiological trade-off. Functional studies are further warranted to elucidate the molecular mechanisms driving these patterns.
papers.summary_cn: 基于长牡蛎高质量基因组鉴定出23个整合素基因（8个α、15个β亚基），系统发育与结构分析显示β亚基存在谱系特异性扩张。跨发育阶段、组织及选育品系的表达谱揭示整合素表达分化与生长性能及环境适应相关：Cg-ITGA1.2、Cg-ITGB1.2a、Cg-ITGB1.4等基因在速生品系中显著上调，提示参与生长调控；而野生群体整体表达高于“海大1号”品系，提示较高整合素活性可能赋予环境适应力而非直接促进生长，体现生长与环境适应间的生理权衡。

papers.title: Contributions of the BioMar-ACG Project to the exploration and cataloging of marine macroalgae in the North Pacific of Costa Rica
papers.authors: Fernández-García, Cindy; Monge, Kenneth; Viales-Cubillo, Mariana; González, Kaylen
papers.abstract: Introduction: Costa Rica hosts remarkable marine biodiversity, vital for conserving its marine and coastal ecosystems. However, marine macroalgae remains understudied, especially in the Área de Conservación Guanacaste (ACG). To address this, the BioMar-ACG Project began in 2015 as a collaboration between the government, academic institutions, and NGOs, aiming to document marine biodiversity using morphological and molecular tools, with local community involvement. The project has since expanded macroalgal collections, identified new species, corrected misidentifications, and revealed high regional endemism. Objective: To update the marine macroalgae inventory of the ACG using 2009-2024 collections from the BioMar-ACG Project and CIMAR-UCR previous projects, through morphological and molecular identification. Methods: Surveys were conducted at 35 coastal and island sites, from intertidal zones to 20 m depth, using snorkeling and SCUBA techniques. Sampling occurred during both upwelling and non-upwelling seasons to capture environmental variability. Macroalgae were manually collected, documented in situ, and preserved for morphological and molecular analyses. DNA was extracted using commercial kits, targeting six molecular markers (COX, ITS, psbA, rbcL, tufA, and UPA) for genetic identification. Final taxonomic identifications integrated molecular and morphological data. Results: A total of 562 specimens were analyzed, representing 101 species distributed among Rhodophyta (59 spp.), Heterokontophyta (22 spp.), and Chlorophyta (20 spp.). Thirty-one species were newly recorded for Costa Rica, 22 for the Pacific of Central America, and nine genera were documented for the first time in the region. Molecular analyses revealed nine potential new species to science. Conclusions: The BioMar-ACG Project substantially increased knowledge of the marine flora of Costa Rica’s northern Pacific, doubling the number of species previously reported for the ACG. The discovery of new genera and species, together with high genetic divergence within groups such as Ceramiales and Dictyotales, highlights the underestimated and cryptic nature of macroalgal diversity in the Eastern Tropical Pacific.
