Validation reduces the category from 47 families to three, all linked to the sector through inventor-applicants and none under a stricter attribution rule; of 89 NUTS-2 regions, 14 register as twin-active on a co-occurrence indicator while two retain a validated integrated invention. Examining co-filing, we find that green and digital inventions are co-filed with partner populations that barely intersect, the digital ones mostly through individual applicants. We propose a validation protocol for twin-transition indicators and draw out implications for territorial monitoring and cohesion policy.
papers.summary_cn: 基于36,185个专利族（79,378件专利公开）经Orbis匹配至1,767个专利实体，检验欧洲农业、林业与渔业绿色—数字“双重创新”的整合程度。标准共分类规则存在两类系统性假阳性：44.7%被判定为整合的专利族其唯一气候标签实为数字技术自身能效子类，另有部分因申请人匹配错误归属初级部门实体；验证后整合类别由47个专利族降至3个，且严格归属规则下无一成立。89个NUTS-2区域中14个在共现指标上呈双重活跃，仅2个保有经验证的整合性发明；绿色与数字发明的共同申请方群体几乎不重叠，数字发明多通过个人申请人提交。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence Applications in True Crabs (Brachyura) Across Aquaculture, Fisheries, Ecology, and Processing: A Scoping Review
papers.authors: Bual, Cyrus Lawrence C.; Bual, Rachel C.; Vicerra, Ryan Rhay P.
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence is increasingly applied to crab research, yet no prior review has mapped this work or its progress toward real-world use. This scoping review maps artificial intelligence applications in true crabs (Brachyura) across aquaculture, fisheries, ecology, and processing. Following the PRISMA extension for Scoping Reviews, five databases were searched for records published from 2016 to 14 June 2026, yielding 11,172 records, most from databases whose broad field coverage returned papers mentioning crabs or artificial intelligence only in passing. Of these, 88 peer-reviewed English-language primary studies applying artificial intelligence to brachyuran data and reporting at least one quantitative performance metric were included. Each study was charted for species, task domain, model architecture, dataset, performance, and deployment maturity (Technology Readiness Level). The literature is young and expanding rapidly, with nearly half published since 2025, and heavily concentrated, with China contributing most affiliations and three species accounting for more than two-thirds of studies. Twelve task domains were identified, dominated by quality assessment and sex classification. The field has converged on object detectors with attention modules, but accuracy is rarely comparable because datasets and protocols are proprietary. Most systems remain at laboratory validation. Reported accuracy has therefore advanced faster than demonstrated deployment.
papers.summary_cn: 该scoping review旨在系统梳理人工智能在真蟹（Brachyura）水产养殖、渔业、生态及加工领域的应用现状与部署成熟度。遵循PRISMA-ScR指南检索5个数据库（2016—2026年），从11,172条记录中纳入88项报告定量性能指标的英文原始研究，按物种、任务域、模型架构、数据集、性能及Technology Readiness Level进行图表化分析。研究发现该领域年轻且快速扩张（近半数发表于2025年后），研究高度集中（中国贡献最多机构署名，3个物种占逾三分之二研究），共识别12类任务域，以品质评估和性别分类为主；模型趋于采用带注意力模块的目标检测器，但因数据集与协议多为专有，准确率难以横向比较，多数系统仍停留于实验室验证阶段，报告准确率的提升快于实际部署的验证。

papers.title: Species composition and population structure of devil rays (Mobula spp.) in artisanal fisheries of Guatemala's Pacific coast
papers.authors: Hacohen-Domené, Ana; Polanco-Vásquez, Francisco; Moreira Ramírez, José F.; Ortíz Aldana, José; Avalos-Castillo, Cristopher G.; Castillo Villeda, Miriam
papers.journal: Latin American Journal of Aquatic Research
papers.abstract: Incidental capture of devil rays (Mobula spp.) occurs in several artisanal fisheries worldwide, yet biological information from many regions remains limited. This study examines species composition, morphometrics, sex ratio, and sexual maturity of devil rays incidentally captured in artisanal fisheries along Guatemala's Pacific coast. Fishing operations were monitored from February 2019 to February 2020 and from October 2022 to February 2024, including 246 fishing trips, 143 of which recorded mobulids. Data on species identification, disc width, total length, sex, and maturity stage were collected from landed individuals. A total of 453 devil rays were recorded. Of these, 447 were identified to species level: Mobula munkiana (n = 238), M. thurstoni (n = 205), M. mobular (n = 3), and M. birostris (n = 1); the remaining six individuals could only be identified to genus level (Mobula spp.). Of the total captures, 40.4% occurred in small-scale fisheries targeting Caranx caballus, 32.6% in fisheries targeting large pelagic species, and 27.0% could not be assigned to a specific fishery. In M. thurstoni, males exhibited a significantly larger mean disc width (131.78 ± 32.28 cm) than females (105.14 ± 26.46 cm; P < 0.05), with a male-biased M:F sex ratio of 2.01:1 (χ² = 22.56; P < 0.05). Similarly, in M. munkiana, males were significantly larger (89.27 ± 10.28 cm) than females (82.12 ± 10.52 cm; P < 0.05), and the sex ratio was also male-biased (1.64:1; χ² = 13.65; P < 0.05). These findings provide baseline information on species composition and morphometrics relevant to fisheries management and devil ray conservation.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究监测了危地马拉太平洋沿岸手工渔业2019—2024年间246次作业，共记录453尾兼捕的蝠鲼（Mobula spp.），其中以M. munkiana（n=238）和M. thurstoni（n=205）为优势种，兼捕主要发生于针对Caranx caballus的小型渔业（40.4%）及大型中上层鱼类渔业（32.6%）。M. thurstoni和M. munkiana均表现为雄性平均盘宽显著大于雌性且性比偏雄（分别为2.01:1和1.64:1）。研究为该区域蝠鲼的种类组成与形态特征提供了基线资料，可服务于渔业管理与保护。

papers.title: Evaluating the impacts of stock enhancement on the abundance and distribution of Rhopilema esculentum in the southern Bohai Sea
papers.authors: Xu, Bingqing; Dong, Xiuqiang; Cui, Guangxin; Dong, Tianwei; Liu, Shude; Li, Fan; Zhang, Xiaomin
papers.abstract: Stock enhancement is recognized as one of the most direct and effective means for conserving aquatic biological resources. However, the mechanisms by which enhancement strategies influence the spatiotemporal distribution of target species remain unclear. To evaluate the effects of stock enhancement on the abundance and distribution of Rhopilema esculentum, this study analyzed survey data collected before the R. esculentum fishing season in the southern Bohai Sea from 2015 to 2024. A two-way analysis of variance (ANOVA) and Duncan’s multiple comparison test were used to examine the spatiotemporal variation in R. esculentum resources. A generalized additive model (GAM) was applied to analyze the relationships among R. esculentum density, environmental factors, and stock enhancement variables (release number, timing, and location). The results showed that sampling stations could be divided into high- and low-density groups, while years could be classified into better and poorer resource groups. GAM analysis indicated that the spatial structure (tensor product smooth term of longitude and latitude) had the most significant effect on R. esculentum density (P < 0.01), followed by salinity (P < 0.05). The number of R. esculentum released had a significant positive effect on resource density (P < 0.01), contributing to 61.2% of the interannual variation in biomass. This positive effect was significantly enhanced when releases were conducted in late May (20-31 May) and in the western area of the southern Bohai Sea (P < 0.05). These findings confirm that well-timed and appropriately located stock enhancement can significantly increase R. esculentum biomass, but the effect is context-dependent, and poorly timed releases may yield limited benefits. Given the dominance of spatial structure in the study area, future enhancement efforts should prioritize early-season releases in the western coastal waters to maximize resource recovery. Continued monitoring and adaptive management are recommended to further evaluate the long-term effectiveness and potential ecological trade-offs of stock enhancement practices.
papers.summary_cn: 基于2015—2024年渤海南部海蜇（Rhopilema esculentum）开捕前调查数据，用双因素方差分析和Duncan多重比较解析资源时空变化，并以GAM分析海蜇密度与环境因子及增殖变量（放流数量、时间、地点）的关系。空间结构（经纬度张量积平滑项）对密度影响最显著（P<0.01），盐度次之（P<0.05）；放流数量对资源密度有显著正效应（P<0.01），解释生物量年际变异的61.2%，且在5月下旬（20—31日）放流、渤海南部西部海域放流时该正效应显著增强（P<0.05）。结果表明适时适地的增殖放流可显著提升海蜇生物量，但效果依赖具体情境，放流时机不当收益有限；鉴于空间结构的主导作用，今后应优先在西部沿岸海域开展早期放流，并持续监测与适应性管理以评估长期效果及生态权衡。

papers.title: Where Are They Now? Field Surveys and Citizen Science Tracing Six Non-Indigenous and Range-Expanding Fish Taxa in Libyan Waters
papers.authors: Rizgalla, Jamila; Fitori, Amani; Tiralongo, Francesco
papers.journal: Thalassas: An International Journal of Marine Sciences
papers.abstract: In the Mediterranean Sea, citizen science projects have gained momentum in monitoring, detecting, and recording non-indigenous species. By combining mining data from social media platforms, citizen science-based observations and specific field surveys conducted between 2018 and 2025 along the western and eastern Libyan coasts, it was possible to document six non-indigenous and range-expanding fish taxa, namely: the Lionfish (Pterois miles), the Redcoat (Sargocentron rubrum), a fish of the genus Abudefduf, the Red Sea goatfish (Parupeneus forsskali), the Monrovia doctorfish (Acanthurus monroviae), and the African hind (Cephalopholis taeniops). These records update the known occurrence ranges of the studied taxa in Libya and are consistent with broader Mediterranean distribution changes. Their opportunistic nature does not allow population trends or dispersal directions to be established.
papers.summary_cn: 结合社交媒体数据、公民科学观测与2018—2025年利比亚西部和东部海岸的实地调查，记录了狮子鱼（Pterois miles）、红衫鱼（Sargocentron rubrum）、Abudefduf属一种、红海绯鲤（Parupeneus forsskali）、蒙氏刺尾鱼（Acanthurus monroviae）和非洲石斑鱼（Cephalopholis taeniops）共6种非本土及分布区扩张鱼类。这些记录更新了上述类群在利比亚的已知分布范围，与地中海更大尺度的分布变化一致。由于数据具有机会性，无法据此确定种群趋势或扩散方向。

papers.title: Fish and macrobenthic diversity and community assembly patterns in the Jiuduansha Wetland based on eDNA metabarcoding
papers.authors: Zhang, Qiuhao; Wang, Hui; Zhang, Wei; Tian, Yuan; Li, Chenhong
papers.abstract: Abstract Estuarine wetlands are critical zones of land-sea interaction that play vital roles in maintaining biodiversity and ecosystem functioning. As the only remaining natural estuarine wetland in the Yangtze River Estuary, Jiuduansha's fish and macrobenthic diversity and community assembly mechanisms remain poorly understood due to limitations of traditional survey methods in protected areas. We conducted eDNA metabarcoding surveys at 11 sampling sites (6 intertidal zone and 5 riverine sites) in the Jiuduansha Wetland Nature Reserve during May and July of 2023-2024, combined with measurement of environmental variables, to systematically analyse the mechanisms of species composition, diversity patterns and community assembly of the Jiuduansha Wetland. A total of 64 fish species and 35 macrobenthos were detected. The eDNA approach identified approximately 40% more species than historical traditional surveys. Spatially, fish diversity was higher in riverine sites (average 18.6 ± 2.7 species/site), while macrobenthos were more concentrated in the intertidal zone (average 14.2 ± 2.5 species/site). Seasonal patterns differed: fish species richness was higher in May, whereas macrobenthos peaked in July. Generalized linear models (GLMs) indicated that total nitrogen (TN) and chemical oxygen demand (COD) were key environmental factors that have negative influence on both communities' richness. Beta diversity decomposition showed that species turnover was the dominant component of community variation within the study scale (70.7%-70.9% for fish, 60.0%-69.3% for macrobenthos). Neutral community model (NCM) fitting revealed increased migration rates, with Nm values increased from 4 in 2023 to 17 in 2024 for fish and from 9 to 18 for macrobenthos, based on samples collected in May and July of each year. This indicates enhanced dispersal between communities. Both βNTI analysis (|βNTI| 90% contribution of ecological drift) demonstrated that stochastic processes, particularly ecological drift, dominated community assembly.
papers.summary_cn: 基于eDNA宏条形码技术，对长江口九段沙湿地11个采样点（6个潮间带、5个河道站点）开展鱼类和大型底栖动物多样性及群落构建机制研究。共检出64种鱼类和35种大型底栖动物，eDNA方法较历史传统调查多识别约40%的物种；鱼类多样性在河道站点较高，大型底栖动物集中于潮间带，鱼类物种丰富度5月较高而大型底栖动物7月达峰。GLM分析表明总氮（TN）和化学需氧量（COD）是抑制两类群落丰富度的关键环境因子；beta多样性分解显示物种周转为主导组分（鱼类70.7%–70.9%，大型底栖动物60.0%–69.3%），NCM拟合显示迁移率上升（鱼类Nm由4增至17，大型底栖动物由9增至18），βNTI（|βNTI|<2）和RCbray（生态漂变贡献>90%）共同表明随机过程尤其是生态漂变主导群落构建。

papers.title: Communication Strategies of the Malabero Coastal Fishermen’s Group in Responding to the Decline in Fish Catch
papers.authors: Zurahman, Aziz; Octaviani, Vethy; Risdiyanto, Bayu
papers.abstract: This study aims to identify and explain the communication strategies employed by the Malabero Beach Fishermen’s Group in Bengkulu City in dealing with the decline in fish catches. This study employed a qualitative method with a case study approach. The research informants were selected using purposive sampling and consisted of the group leader, senior members, and active fishermen. Data were collected through observation, interviews, and documentation, while data analysis employed the interactive model of Miles and Huberman, which includes data reduction, data display, and conclusion drawing and verification. The study was analyzed using Hafied Cangara’s (2016) communication strategy theory, which encompasses five elements: communicator, message, media, receiver, and effect. The findings show that the communication strategies employed by the Malabero Beach The findings show that the communication strategies employed by the Malabero Beach Fishermen’s Group involved open communication, deliberation, and a family-oriented approach. The group leader and senior members acted as communicators in directing the members, while the messages conveyed included information about fishing locations, weather conditions, wind direction, sea conditions, and appeals to maintain group solidarity. The communication media used included face-to-face communication at the fishing base and mobile phones while at sea. Although mobile phone network connectivity posed a challenge, group members were able to adapt through direct communication. These communication strategies helped maintain coordination, strengthen cooperation, increase participation, and preserve group solidarity in dealing with the decline in fish catches.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在识别并解释明古鲁市Malabero海滩渔民群体在应对渔获量下降时采用的沟通策略，采用定性案例研究方法，通过目的性抽样选取组长、资深成员和活跃渔民进行观察、访谈与文献收集，并基于Hafied Cangara的沟通策略理论（涵盖沟通者、信息、媒介、接收者与效果五要素）进行分析。研究发现该群体采用开放式沟通、协商和家庭式取向的策略，由组长和资深成员担任沟通者，传递渔场位置、天气状况、风向、海况等信息并呼吁维护群体团结，媒介包括渔业基地的面对面交流和海上手机通讯。尽管手机网络连通性存在挑战，成员通过直接沟通加以适应，这些策略有助于维持协调、加强合作、提高参与度并在应对渔获量下降中保持群体团结。

papers.title: Ammonia excretion dynamics of the silverside (Basilichthys microlepidotus) during the juvenile-to-adult grow-out phase, under different body sizes and stocking densities in a recirculating aquaculture system (RAS)
papers.authors: Méndez, Carlos Andrés; Galleguillos, Carla; Nava, María Luisa; Harris-Toro, Cristian; Morales, María Cristina
papers.journal: Latin American Journal of Aquatic Research
papers.abstract: The Chilean silverside (Basilichthys microlepidotus) is an endemic freshwater species with emerging potential for aquaculture and conservation-oriented production. However, key bioengineering parameters required for system design and biomass management remain poorly defined. This study evaluated how body size and stocking density affect total ammonia nitrogen (TAN) excretion rates in a recirculating aquaculture system (RAS) under controlled conditions. Two stocking densities (1.1 and 1.8 kg m-3) and two size ranges (7.8-77.8 g and 80-297 g), as well as their interaction, were tested using a factorial design with triplicate tanks per treatment. Mean TAN excretion rates ranged from 24.5 to 30.6 mg TAN kg-1 fish h-1. A clear diurnal excretion pattern was observed, with peak TAN release occurring 2-4 h after feeding, followed by a gradual decline. Neither body size nor stocking density significantly affected TAN excretion within the evaluated ranges, indicating that these results provide bioengineering parameters for RAS design and scaling.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了智利银汉鱼（Basilichthys microlepidotus）在RAS中不同体规格（7.8–77.8 g与80–297 g）和养殖密度（1.1与1.8 kg m⁻³）下的总氨氮（TAN）排泄动态。采用析因设计，TAN排泄率为24.5–30.6 mg TAN kg⁻¹ fish h⁻¹，摄食后2–4 h出现排泄峰值，随后逐渐下降。体规格和养殖密度在测试范围内均未显著影响TAN排泄率，结果为RAS设计与规模化提供了生物工程参数。

papers.title: Chemical Characteristics of Synthetic LWTX4 and Paralytic Shellfish Toxins Under Standard Post-Column Oxidation (PCOX) and HILIC-MS/MS Conditions
papers.authors: Shin, A-Young; Byun, Eunjung; Kim, Jihun; Kim, Ye Jin; Lee, Jihoon
papers.abstract: The analytical characteristics of Lyngbya wollei toxin 4 (LWTX4), a rare derivative of saxitoxin (STX), remain insufficiently documented due to its limited availability. In the present study, therefore, LWTX4 was synthesized using the previously reported synthetic route developed by Looper to elucidate its fundamental chromatographic behavior. Additionally, three other paralytic shellfish toxin analogues, STX, decarbamoyl saxitoxin (dcSTX), and 12-epi-LWTX4, were prepared from a common intermediate. Analysis of synthetic LWTX4 using the AOAC OMA 2011.02 HPLC-PCOX-FLD method yielded a retention time of 19.8 min, which overlapped with that of STX, and revealed that its FLD response was one-fourteenth that of STX. Meanwhile, under the AOAC 2021 HILIC-MS/MS conditions, LWTX4 eluted at 7.29 min, producing major product ions at m/z 205.1204, 182.0926, 164.0822, and 110.0720. These chromatographic and mass spectrometric characteristics provide useful reference data for assessing the possible presence of LWTX4 during PST profiling of biological samples. The synthetic STX and dcSTX exhibited chromatographic behavior consistent with that of their corresponding certified reference materials (CRMs) under the standard HPLC-PCOX conditions, supporting the potential use of synthesis as a complementary approach to the isolation of PSTs from dinoflagellates for the preparation of CRMs.
papers.summary_cn: 研究合成了稀有麻痹性贝毒（PST）衍生物LWTX4及其类似物STX、dcSTX和12-epi-LWTX4，以弥补其分析特性数据不足。在AOAC HPLC–PCOX–FLD条件下LWTX4保留时间为19.8 min，与STX重叠，荧光响应仅为STX的1/14；在HILIC–MS/MS条件下于7.29 min洗脱，主要产物离子为m/z 205.1204、182.0926、164.0822和110.0720。这些色谱与质谱特征为生物样品PST谱分析中识别LWTX4提供了参考数据，且合成STX与dcSTX的色谱行为与认证参考物质（CRM）一致，提示化学合成可作为从甲藻中分离PST制备CRM的补充途径。

papers.title: Shuck it and see: Adaptive Restoration Engineering in community-led shellfish reef restoration
papers.authors: Porter, Robert J.; Richardson, Marina A.; Copeland, Craig; Porter, Rebecca C.; DiBetta, Sophie; Gilchrist, Gary; Toms, Graham; Hastings, David; Gilby, Ben L.
papers.abstract: Abstract Introduction Shellfish reef restoration occurs across diverse ecological settings. Techniques that perform well in one habitat or species assemblage may perform poorly elsewhere. Objectives We examined how field observations, constraints, and unexpected outcomes shaped restoration structures and developed Adaptive Restoration Engineering (ARE), a framework for iterative refinement and diversification of restoration systems. Methods We assessed 1081 remnant shellfish reef bommies across five Queensland sites and reviewed five restoration structures developed from 2018 to 2026 as practice-based design pathways: chicken-wire baskets, mild steel Robust Oyster Baskets, Stainless Steel Robust Oyster Baskets (SS ROBs), Quilted Oyster Doonas, and Living Oyster Gardens (LOGs). Project records, field observations, design modifications, and deployment outcomes were reviewed to identify constraints, drivers, and design responses. Results Remnant reef morphology showed reefs commonly formed discrete bommies rather than continuous platforms, supporting modular design. Field observations drove shifts from galvanized and woven mesh to mild steel and welded stainless steel. Observed burial and subsidence led to seeding racks, shell foundations, and LOGs, while mussel-dominated recruitment led to SS ROBs where cohesive reefs had not formed before mild-steel degradation. Handling, transport, and decentralized manufacture shaped unit size and fabrication techniques. These observations formed the basis of ARE, which links observation, driver identification, design response, implementation, and monitoring. Conclusions Multiple designs can be refined for contrasting settings rather than relying on a standard unit. ARE provides a restoration-specific application of adaptive management for translating field observations into context-specific design responses.
papers.summary_cn: 研究基于澳大利亚昆士兰5个站点1081处残存贝类礁bommies的形态调查，结合2018至2026年间五类修复结构（镀锌网篮、低碳钢ROB、不锈钢ROB、绗缝牡蛎被、Living Oyster Gardens）的实践记录，分析现场约束与意外结果如何驱动修复设计迭代。结果显示残存礁多呈离散bommies而非连续平台，支持模块化设计；现场观察推动了材料从镀锌编织网向低碳钢和焊接不锈钢转变，沉降与掩埋问题促生了苗架、贝壳基座和LOG设计，贻贝优势附着则推动了SS ROB的应用。据此提出Adaptive Restoration Engineering（ARE）框架，将观察、驱动因子识别、设计响应、实施与监测相链接，为修复实践提供情境化设计路径而非标准化单元。

papers.title: Updated occurrence, habitat associations, and genomic resources of syngnathids in the Sembilan Archipelago, Malaysia
papers.authors: Lim, Kah Kheng; He, Song; Collier, Keiler Arthur; Cauz-Santos, Luiz A.; Seah, Ying Giat; Berumen, Michael L.; Zhan, Peng
papers.abstract: Syngnathid fishes, including seahorses and pipefishes, are ecologically and economically important but remain vulnerable to overfishing, habitat degradation, and trade-driven exploitation. This study documents syngnathid occurrence, habitat associations, body-size observations, and genomic resources in the Sembilan Archipelago, Malaysia, using SCUBA-based visual surveys and high-resolution photographic analysis. Across 32 dives at seven reef sites, we recorded 54 occurrence records belonging to four species: Hippocampus kuda , H. comes , Doryrhamphus janssi , and Trachyrhamphus bicoarctatus . Species differed in their observed habitat associations, while size-depth relationships varied among species. A brooding male and two juvenile seahorses provided evidence of local reproductive activity during the survey period. To establish baseline genomic resources for Malaysian syngnathids, we generated high-quality PacBio HiFi genome assemblies for six individuals from three species, with genome sizes ranging from 0.45-0.61 Gbp and BUSCO completeness scores of 92.3-98.8%. The assemblies were characterized through repeat annotation, protein-coding gene prediction, orthology analysis, and phylogenomics. Complete mitochondrial genomes were generated for all six individuals. These genomic resources provide a foundation for future comparative and population genomic studies of genetic diversity, connectivity, and evolutionary relationships. Together, the ecological observations and genomic resources provide a baseline for future standardized monitoring and conservation research on Malaysian syngnathids.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过SCUBA目视调查与高分辨率照片分析，记录了马来西亚Sembilan群岛海龙科鱼类的分布、栖息地关联及体型特征，在7个礁区32次潜水中发现4个物种共54条记录，并观察到怀卵雄鱼和幼鱼，提示当地存在繁殖活动。同时，为3个物种6个个体构建了PacBio HiFi高质量基因组组装（0.45–0.61 Gbp，BUSCO完整度92.3–98.8%），完成重复序列注释、蛋白编码基因预测、直系同源与系统发育基因组学分析，并获得全部个体的线粒体全基因组。该生态与基因组基线数据为马来西亚海龙科鱼类的种群遗传学、连通性及保护监测研究奠定基础。

papers.title: Multiscale Evaluation of Quercetin Against Vibrio parahaemolyticus and Vibrio vulnificus in Seafood and Food-Contact Surfaces
papers.authors: Meghla, Nigar Sultana; Mizan, Md Furkanur Rahaman; Nesa, Syeda Roufun; Han, Sangha; Kang, Iksoon; Ha, Sang-Do
papers.abstract: Vibrio parahaemolyticus and Vibrio vulnificus biofilms pose a major challenge to seafood safety owing to their persistence on food-contact surfaces and increased tolerance to antimicrobial interventions. This study investigated the antibiofilm efficacy and mechanisms of quercetin using integrated structural, physiological, and molecular approaches. Quercetin exhibited concentration-dependent biofilm inhibition and reduced mature biofilms on abiotic surfaces, while its efficacy in inhibiting biofilm formation was evaluated on seafood. Quercetin suppressed early biofilm establishment by reducing cell surface hydrophobicity, bacterial adhesion, autoaggregation, motility, cellular respiration, and ATP production, thereby limiting bacterial attachment and microcolony formation. Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy revealed changes in the EPS-associated spectral profiles of both species, indicating alterations in the biochemical composition of the biofilm matrix. These spectral changes varied between V. vulnificus and V. parahaemolyticus. Gene expression analysis demonstrated coordinated downregulation of quorum sensing (QS), adhesion, and EPS biosynthesis genes, accompanied by increased membrane permeability, intracellular protein leakage, and metabolic dysfunction. In a 6 h screen, 1/2 MIC caused only minor changes in the color and texture of shrimp and oyster, whereas MIC caused larger changes; no cytotoxicity was detected under the tested conditions. Collectively, these findings demonstrate that quercetin disrupts Vibrio biofilms through coordinated mechanisms with limited short-term effects on seafood color and texture at 1/2 MIC, supporting further evaluation as a natural, industry-relevant strategy for controlling seafood-associated Vibrio biofilms and improving seafood safety.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估槲皮素（quercetin）对海产品及食品接触表面上副溶血性弧菌（Vibrio parahaemolyticus）和创伤弧菌（V. vulnificus）生物膜的抑制效果及机制。通过结构、生理和分子层面分析发现，槲皮素呈浓度依赖性抑制生物膜形成并削减成熟生物膜，其作用涉及降低细胞表面疏水性、黏附、自聚集、运动性及ATP产生，改变EPS生化组成，并协同下调quorum sensing、黏附和EPS合成相关基因。1/2 MIC处理6 h对虾和牡蛎色泽质地影响轻微且无细胞毒性，支持其作为天然控菌策略的进一步开发。

papers.title: Size-structured monitoring and otolith chemistry reveal recurrent tidal-freshwater use by juvenile Japanese grenadier anchovy Coilia nasus in the lower Yangtze River
papers.authors: Guo, Hongyi; Zhang, Xuguang; Tang, Wenqiao; Liu, Kai
papers.abstract: Abstract Tidal freshwater reaches may provide early-life habitat for diadromous fishes, but long-term evidence of their use remains limited. Size-resolved records are needed as a reference for monitoring under the Yangtze fishing ban introduced in 2021. We analysed monitoring data from Jingjiang, 240 km upstream of the river mouth (2002-2017; 519 effective surveys; 10,560 measured individuals), combining size-based catch indices, environmental-window analyses and otolith Sr/Ca profiles from 115 Japanese grenadier anchovy Coilia nasus . Individuals <120 mm standard length were classified operationally as juveniles during August-October, when scale readings supported an age-0 interpretation, whereas individuals ≥180 mm were treated as a descriptive large-fish category throughout the year. Juveniles occurred in every survey year; annulus-free individuals also occurred in winter and spring. The Juvenile Recruitment Index (JRI) showed negative associations with tidal range across the April-July spawning and larval-transport period, although none of the 72 environmental-window correlations remained significant after Benjamini-Hochberg correction at a 5% false-discovery rate. Monthly models also showed a negative lagged association. None of the 40 autumn recruits sampled across four capture years had an accepted elevated Sr/Ca zone; such zones were more frequent in later developmental groups. Total catch obscured contrasting size structures: 2016 combined the series-high JRI with few large fish, whereas 2010 combined the series-high large-fish catch rate with a mid-range JRI. These findings document recurrent early-life use of a tidal freshwater reach and provide a size-resolved pre-ban reference, without establishing a disproportionate contribution to adult production.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于长江靖江江段2002–2017年519次监测调查（共测量10,560尾）及115尾日本鳀（*Coilia nasus*）耳石Sr/Ca剖面，结合体长结构分析，评估潮汐淡水江段作为其早期生活史栖息地的长期利用情况。结果显示，体长<120 mm的幼鱼在每年调查中均有出现，冬季和春季亦有无年轮个体记录；幼鱼补充指数（JRI）在4–7月产卵与幼体输运期与潮差呈负相关，但经Benjamini–Hochberg校正后72个环境窗口相关性均不显著。四个捕捞年份采集的40尾秋季补充个体均未检出可接受的高Sr/Ca区，提示该江段幼鱼利用具有反复性，但尚不能证实其对成鱼生产的贡献比例；总渔获量掩盖了体长结构的年际差异，研究为2021年长江禁渔后的监测提供了体长分辨的禁渔前基线。

papers.title: Gastric and intestinal evacuation of a pelleted meal in rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss) and Mozambique tilapia (Oreochromis mossambicus): a comparison
papers.authors: Foltz, Jeffrey W.; Windell, John T.
papers.abstract: Abstract Knowledge of gastric and intestinal food passage rates are useful to both the fish culture industry and for estimates of a species daily rations in the wild. This study compared gastric and intestinal food passage in two very different species, Mozambique tilapia Oreochromis mossambicus and rainbow trout Oncorhynchus mykiss . Both species were fed a common pelleted meal. The effects of meal size were investigated at temperatures at which each of the species is commonly cultured. Also, the two species were compared at a common water temperature. In addition, the use of chromic oxide as a measure of food passage through the intestine was evaluated. Meal size did not affect gastric emptying times in either species when expressed as a proportion of the meal consumed regressed on the natural log of time since fed. Gastric emptying in tilapia required 24 h at 25 °C and more than 45 h for trout at 13 °C. Chromic oxide was a good indicator for the progression of the meal through the intestinal tract in both species. Meal size did not affect intestinal emptying. Tilapia required 45 h compared with 65 h for trout. Gastric and intestinal emptying at 19 °C did not differ between the two species.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究比较了莫桑比克罗非鱼（Oreochromis mossambicus）与虹鳟（Oncorhynchus mykiss）对同一颗粒饲料的胃排空和肠道排空速率，并评估了饲料投喂量及水温的影响。结果表明，饲料量（以摄食比例对时间的自然对数回归表示）不影响两种鱼的胃排空时间；在各自常见养殖水温下，罗非鱼25 °C时胃排空需24 h，虹鳟13 °C时需超过45 h。氧化铬是指示饲料在两种鱼肠道中推进的良好标记，饲料量不影响肠道排空，罗非鱼肠道排空需45 h、虹鳟需65 h；但在共同温度19 °C下，两种鱼的胃和肠道排空无差异。

papers.title: Absence of males is associated with delayed progression of vitellogenesis in yellowtail Seriola quinqueradiata
papers.authors: Hasegawa, Yuya; Izumida, Daisuke; Yamamoto, Ikki; Adachi, Kenta; Shibata, Kiko; Shimahara, Yoshiko; Shimada, Yukinori; Oda, Kentaro; Sugaya, Takuma
papers.abstract: Abstract Stable hatchery production of yellowtail requires effective brood stock management, particularly control of vitellogenic progression. Although the absence of males impairs oocyte maturation and ovulation in several fish species, its influence on yellowtail reproduction remains unclear. This study compared female-only and mixed-sex groups over two reproductive seasons, referred to as year 1 and year 2, respectively. Oocyte diameter, ovarian histology, and gonadosomatic index were evaluated before human chorionic gonadotropin (HCG) administration, and ovulation was assessed. In both years, maximum oocyte diameter before HCG administration was significantly lower in the female-only group than in the mixed-sex group. The female-only group exhibited individual variation, with some females progressing through vitellogenesis, whereas others showed arrested vitellogenic development. The proportion of ovulated HCG-treated females was significantly lower in the female-only group during year 1 and showed a similar numerical trend in year 2. However, some females with oocyte diameters > 600 μm ovulated under female-only conditions. These results indicate that the absence of males is associated primarily with delayed vitellogenic progression, whereas ovulation can be induced in females that complete vitellogenesis. Therefore, the absence of males should be considered a potential risk factor in brood stock management and may provide a foundation for future maturation control strategies.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究比较了仅雌性与雌雄混合两组黄尾鰤（Seriola quinqueradiata）在连续两个繁殖季的卵母细胞发育与排卵情况，评估HCG处理前的卵母细胞直径、卵巢组织学及性腺指数。结果显示，仅雌性组HCG处理前的最大卵母细胞直径显著低于混合组，且个体间差异明显，部分个体卵黄发生停滞；仅雌性组排卵比例在第一年显著降低，第二年呈类似趋势。结果表明，缺乏雄性与卵黄发生进程延迟相关，但完成卵黄发生的个体仍可诱导排卵，提示雄鱼缺失应作为 brood stock 管理的潜在风险因素。

papers.title: Integrated Biological and Physicochemical Assessment of Ecological Condition in Two Oyster-producing Brackish Systems: Implications for Sustainable Fisheries Management
papers.authors: Atindana, Sandra Akugpoka
papers.journal: Asian Journal of Fisheries and Aquatic Research
papers.abstract: Background: Oyster-producing lagoons and estuaries are exposed to environmental pressures that may affect habitat condition and fishery sustainability. Aims: To assess and compare the ecological condition of the Densu estuary and Anyanui lagoon by integrating benthic macroinvertebrate assemblages with physicochemical characteristics and water-quality indices and to examine the implications of the findings for sustainable oyster fisheries management in Ghana. Study Design: Water and benthic macroinvertebrate samples were collected from four ecologically distinct zones selected to represent the major environmental gradients within the lagoon: (i) the upstream freshwater-influenced section, (ii) the central channel, (iii) the downstream section adjacent to the lagoon outlet, (iv) an area adjacent to agricultural lands/graveyards where diffuse runoff was expected to influence water quality (mapped using QGIS). These locations were selected to capture spatial variability in physicochemical conditions and benthic communities across the lagoon. The modified Delphi technique was adopted to identify priority water quality parameters affecting Crassostrea tulipa growth. Place and Duration of Study: The Densu Estuary and Anyanui Lagoon were studied from November 2023 to December 2024. Methodology: Physicochemical variables were analysed using the Canadian Council of Ministers of the Environment Water Quality Index (CCME-WQI), while benthic macroinvertebrate assemblages were used as biological indicators of ecological integrity. Expert consultation informed the selection and weighting of key physicochemical variables included in the index. Macroinvertebrate assemblages revealed greater taxonomic diversity and ecological integrity in the Anyanui Lagoon than in the Densu Estuary. Results: Macroinvertebrate assemblages revealed greater taxonomic diversity and ecological integrity in the Anyanui Lagoon than in the Densu Estuary. The occurrence of taxa such as Lithophaga lithophaga and Leptocerus sp. indicated relatively stable environmental conditions in Anyanui, whereas the higher Hilsenhoff Biotic Index in Densu (5.06), compared with Anyanui (3.82), suggested greater organic pollution pressure in the Densu Estuary. CCME-WQI scores classified the Anyanui lagoon as marginal (47.14) and the Densu estuary as poor (38.69), indicating environmental conditions that may limit oyster growth, recruitment and long-term fishery productivity. Although both approaches provided complementary information, benthic macroinvertebrates offered a more integrative assessment of ecological condition than physicochemical measurements alone. Conclusion: These findings demonstrate the value of integrating biological and physicochemical indicators for ecosystem assessment and provide a scientific basis for prioritising habitat restoration, long-term ecological monitoring and adaptive management to sustain Ghana's brackish-water oyster fisheries.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在通过整合底栖大型无脊椎动物群落、理化特征及水质指数，评估并比较加纳Densu河口与Anyanui潟湖的生态状况，进而探讨其对牡蛎渔业可持续管理的意义。研究于2023年11月至2024年12月在四个生态分区采样，采用CCME-WQI评价水质，并以底栖大型无脊椎动物作为生物指示物。结果显示Anyanui潟湖的分类多样性和生态完整性优于Densu河口，后者Hilsenhoff生物指数较高（5.06 vs 3.82），指示更强的有机污染压力；CCME-WQI将Anyanui评为边际（47.14）、Densu评为差（38.69），表明环境条件可能限制牡蛎生长、补充和长期渔业生产力。研究表明底栖大型无脊椎动物比单一理化指标更具整合性，为生境修复和适应性管理提供了科学依据。

papers.title: Community-Based Fisheries Downstreaming through the Development of Natural Fish Stock Powder: Evidence from Usaha Mandiri Consumer Cooperative, Belitung, Indonesia
papers.authors: Sufandi, Unggul Utan; Yusuf, Yusuf; Lokantara, I Gede Wyana
papers.journal: Journal of Universal Community Empowerment Provision
papers.abstract: Coastal fishing communities often depend on selling fresh catches, limiting opportunities to increase product value through processing. In Tanjung Binga, Belitung, this highlights the need to strengthen Koperasi Konsumen Usaha Mandiri (KUM) 's processing capacity. This community service programme aimed to develop skills in producing natural fish stock powder and support the cooperative’s product development capacity. Conducted from March to July 2026, it involved 20 women from fishing households and adopted a participatory technology-transfer approach. Activities included socialisation on fisheries downstreaming, processing training, product application, laboratory nutritional analysis, and assistance with packaging, labelling, branding, and business management. The resulting product, Formio, was made from laisi fish and vegetables without added MSG through grinding, cooking, dehydration, and dry milling. Laboratory analysis recorded 52.00% protein, 1,268 mg/100 g calcium, and 855 mg/100 g phosphorus. However, moisture content reached 21.00%, indicating the need to optimise drying and assess water activity, microbiological quality, and storage stability. Overall, the programme established a foundation for valorising local fish resources and strengthening cooperative-based enterprise capacity. The results demonstrate progress in product development and skills transfer, while identifying product standardisation and market assessment as priorities for subsequent development.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在通过开发天然鱼粉产品提升印尼勿里洞沿海渔业社区合作社（KUM）的加工能力，采用参与式技术转移方法，面向20名渔民家庭妇女开展渔业下游化培训、加工实训、营养分析及包装品牌与经营管理指导。以laisi鱼和蔬菜为原料、不添加MSG制成的Formio产品蛋白质含量达52.00%，钙1,268 mg/100 g、磷855 mg/100 g，但水分含量高达21.00%，提示需优化干燥工艺并评估水分活度、微生物质量及贮藏稳定性。该项目为本地鱼类资源增值和合作社企业能力建设奠定了基础，产品标准化与市场评估为后续开发重点。

papers.title: Estimating Water Quality Impacts in Marine Fisheries: The Case of Northern Shrimp in the Estuary and Gulf of St. Lawrence
papers.authors: Wilson, Michelan; Barbier, Edward B.; Archambault, Philippe; Carrier-Belleau, Charlotte
papers.abstract: The Estuary and Gulf of St. Lawrence in Canada is experiencing a decline in oxygen levels, adversely affecting marine life, particularly commercial northern shrimp. This study develops a biological model that links oxygen saturation to the growth rate of northern shrimp to assess how variations in oxygen saturation impact shrimp populations. By simulating scenarios where oxygen saturation levels are increased by 5-25 percentage points, the research indicates that such intervention could have led to significant profit increases from 1995 to 2018, especially under restricted fishing efforts. The findings underscore the importance of effective fishery management practices in maximizing the economic benefits of improved environmental quality. Proactive measures to enhance oxygen saturation can help sustain marine ecosystems and support the fishing industry before the region becomes hypoxic.
papers.summary_cn: 构建了将氧饱和度与北方长额虾生长率耦合的生物学模型，模拟氧饱和度提升5–25个百分点情景下1995–2018年虾类种群及渔业收益变化。结果显示，在捕捞努力量受限条件下，改善溶氧可带来显著利润增长，表明有效渔业管理是放大环境质量改善经济收益的关键，在区域尚未缺氧前主动增氧有助于维持生态系统与渔业。

papers.title: The Combined Effects of River Flow and Water Quality on Freshwater Fish Population Dynamics
papers.authors: Guo, Shenghan
papers.abstract: The aquatic ecosystems of the rivers maintain aquatic biodiversity, and freshwater fish are important bioindicators for the ecological health of a river. Compound stress on fish populations all over the world has been caused by hydrological changes and water quality degradation due to intensive human activities such as dam regulation and pollutant discharge. This study focused on the lower reaches of the Yellow River, and investigated the independent and interactive impacts of river flow and water quality on the dynamics of freshwater fish populations based on multiple-year field monitoring data from 2014 to 2023. Flow variation accounted for 21% of the temporal variation in fish community and was found to have a significant influence on fish spawning cues, habitat availability, and physiological metabolism of the fish, while water quality accounted for 15% of the temporal variation in fish community and was the most limiting factor in the most heavily polluted river reach. Low flow conditions increased risk of pollutant accumulation, flood conditions increased both pollutant accumulations and introduced non-point source pollution risks; there were non-additive coupled interactions between flow and water quality. Benthic resident fish had higher tolerance to composite stress while pelagic and migratory fish had higher sensitivity to hydrological/water quality co-stress. Single factor regulation would hardly be enough to restore fish communities, coordinated regulation of flow regime and water environment was needed. This paper offers scientific evidence for watershed ecological controls and fish biodiversity conservation under various human disturbances.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于黄河下游2014–2023年多年野外监测数据，分析了河流流量与水质对淡水鱼类种群动态的独立及交互影响。流量变化解释鱼类群落时间变异的21%，显著影响产卵 cues、栖息地可用性及生理代谢；水质解释15%，在污染最重河段为最主要限制因子。低流量加剧污染物累积风险，洪水条件同时增加污染物累积与面源污染风险，流量与水质间存在非加性耦合交互作用。底栖定居性鱼类对复合胁迫耐受性较高，而中上层及洄游性鱼类对水文-水质协同胁迫更敏感，单一因子调控难以恢复鱼类群落，需流量情势与水环境协同调控。

papers.title: Effect of Digital Extension and E-Learning Intervention and Adoption Among Cassava and Fish Farmers in Bayelsa State
papers.authors: Ugo, Panebi
papers.journal: INTERNATIONAL JOURNAL OF AGRICULTURE AND EARTH SCIENCE
papers.abstract: This research investigated the effects of digital extension and e-learning intervention and adoption among cassava and fish farmers in Bayelsa State. A quasi-experimental design incorporating pre test and post-test assessments was employed, involving 240 active smallholder farmers selected from Yenagoa, Ogbia and Sagbama Local Government Areas. Agricultural advisory content was delivered through WhatsApp groups, Interactive Voice Response (IVR) and YouTube videos over a twelve-week period. The data obtained were subjected to descriptive and inferential statistical analyses. The results indicated that farmers’ technical knowledge improved after the interventions. Cassava and fish farmers acknowledged the positive contributions of the interventions, with fish farmers expressing greater perceived benefits. The interventions also shaped production decisions and farm management practices, particularly in fertiliser and feed application, input selection, disease control and weed management. Technology adoption emerged as a significant predictor of changes in farmers’ practices after the interventions. Nevertheless, inconsistent mobile network connectivity, expensive data subscriptions, unreliable electricity and inadequate digital literacy limited effective engagement. The research concluded that digital extension and e-learning interventions offer opportunities for enhancing agricultural knowledge dissemination and improving farming practices. It recommended the establishment of public-private partnerships to improve rural network infrastructure and provide subsidised data packages for farmers.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究采用准实验设计，在巴耶尔萨州三个地方政府区的240名木薯和养鱼小农中，通过WhatsApp群组、交互式语音应答（IVR）和YouTube视频开展为期12周的数字化推广与e-learning干预，评估其对农户技术知识和生产行为的影响。结果显示干预后农户技术知识显著提升，养鱼户感知收益高于木薯种植户，干预还影响了施肥与投饵、投入品选择、病害控制和杂草管理等生产决策。技术采纳是干预后农户实践变化的重要预测因子，但移动网络不稳定、数据资费高、电力不可靠和数字素养不足制约了有效参与。研究建议通过公私合作改善农村网络基础设施并提供补贴数据套餐。

papers.title: Effect of Foxtail Millet (Setaria italica) Cookies Fortified with Mackerel Fish Flour on the Nutritional Status of Pregnant Women with Chronic Energy Deficiency.
papers.authors: riskawati syamsul, dian; salam, abdul; Khuzaimah, Anna
papers.abstract: associated with poor maternal nutritional status, anemia, and adverse birth outcomes. Food-based supplementation using locally available nutrient-dense ingredients, such as foxtail millet (Setaria italica) and mackerel fish, may provide a sustainable strategy to improve maternal nutrition. To evaluate the effectiveness of foxtail millet flour cookies fortified with mackerel fish flour in improving body weight, mid-upper arm circumference (MUAC), and hemoglobin levels among pregnant women with CED. A quasi-experimental study using a non-randomized pretest-posttest control group design was conducted among 40 pregnant women with CED selected through purposive sampling. Participants were allocated to an intervention group (n = 20), which received foxtail millet flour cookies fortified with mackerel fish flour, or a control group (n = 20), which received foxtail millet flour cookies without mackerel fish flour, for 90 days. Body weight, MUAC, and hemoglobin levels were measured at baseline and after the intervention. Between-group differences in changes from baseline were analyzed using the Mann-Whitney U test. After 90 days, participants in the intervention group experienced significantly greater increases in body weight (7.95 vs. 5.00 kg, p = 0.001), MUAC (2.09 vs. 2.02 cm, p = 0.035), and hemoglobin concentration (1.64 vs. 1.24 g/dL, p = 0.003) compared with the control group. Foxtail millet cookies fortified with mackerel fish flour were more effective than non-fortified foxtail millet cookies in improving maternal nutritional status, as reflected by greater increases in body weight, MUAC, and hemoglobin levels among pregnant women with CED. These findings support the use of locally sourced, nutrient-rich supplementary foods as a practical strategy to address maternal undernutrition in resource-limited settings
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了强化鲭鱼鱼粉的谷子（Setaria italica）饼干对慢性能量缺乏（CED）孕妇营养状况的改善效果。采用非随机前后测对照组准实验设计，40名CED孕妇分为干预组（强化鱼粉饼干）和对照组（未强化饼干），干预90天。结果显示，干预组体重增加（7.95 vs. 5.00 kg）、上臂围（MUAC）增长（2.09 vs. 2.02 cm）及血红蛋白升高（1.64 vs. 1.24 g/dL）均显著优于对照组。表明强化鲭鱼鱼粉的谷子饼干可有效改善CED孕妇的营养状况，支持在资源有限地区推广本地营养强化补充食品。

papers.title: Fish oil enhances trans-endothelial fatty acids transport and lipid deposition in skeletal muscle by promoting muscular VEGF-B expression via GPR120-CaMKK2-AMPK pathway
papers.authors: Luo, Meiying; Liu, Jinhao; Wang, Junfeng; Cai, Lilin; Fu, Yiming; Liang, Shuyi; Liu, Shuai; Pan, Zhe; Liu, Shilong; Yu, Xiaolei
papers.abstract: Owing to the continuous, tight-junction-sealed architecture of capillary endothelium in skeletal muscle, the trans-endothelial transport of fatty acids from capillary lumen to myofibers constitutes a critical determinant of intramuscular fat (IMF) deposition, thus playing a crucial role in meat quality. This study aimed to investigate the effects of fish oil on trans-endothelial fatty acids transport and lipid deposition in skeletal muscle and explore the underlying vascular regulatory mechanisms. Firstly, preliminary exploratory analyses indicated there may exist an association between IMF content in porcine longissimus dorsi muscle (LDM) and serum VEGF-B level, as well as VEGF-B expression within LDM, hinting at a potential involvement of VEGF-B in skeletal muscle lipid deposition. Meanwhile, the transwell experiments confirmed that VEGF-B enhanced trans-endothelial fatty acid transport by upregulating expression and membrane localization of fatty acid transporters. In addition, DHA, a key bioactive component of fish oil, enhanced trans-endothelial fatty acid transport by promoting VEGF-B expression and secretion of C2C12 myotubes. Mechanistically, the GPR120-CaMKK2-AMPK pathway was involved in DHA-induced VEGF-B expression and secretion. More importantly, fish oil supplementation significantly increased lipid deposition of mice tibialis anterior muscle, alongside the activation of GPR120-CaMKK2-AMPK pathway, the elevated expression of VEGF-B and fatty acid transporters. Overall, these findings suggested that fish oil might enhance trans-endothelial fatty acids transport and lipid deposition in skeletal muscle by promoting muscular VEGF-B expression via GPR120-CaMKK2-AMPK pathway, providing potential molecular targets and nutritional technologies to increase IMF in animal skeletal muscle.
papers.summary_cn: 猪背最长肌IMF含量与血清及肌内VEGF-B表达存在关联，Transwell实验证实VEGF-B通过上调脂肪酸转运蛋白表达及膜定位增强跨内皮脂肪酸转运。鱼油活性成分DHA经GPR120-CaMKK2-AMPK通路促进C2C12肌管VEGF-B表达与分泌，从而增强跨内皮转运；小鼠补充鱼油后胫骨前肌脂质沉积显著增加，伴随该通路激活及VEGF-B和脂肪酸转运蛋白表达升高。结果表明鱼油可通过GPR120-CaMKK2-AMPK通路促进肌肉VEGF-B表达，进而增强骨骼肌跨内皮脂肪酸转运与脂质沉积。

papers.title: In silico Acute Toxicity Prediction of Dimethyl Phthalate on Fish as Per Simulated Molecular Descriptors
papers.authors: Banerjee, Rituparna; Kanti Roy, Pranab; Nath Talapatra, Soumendra
papers.journal: International Journal of Science and Research (IJSR)
papers.abstract: An organic compound, dimethyl phthalate (DMP) is a category of plasticizer that is commonly utilized in plastic materials. The prediction of acute toxicity in fish through an in silico approach is an active assessment because fish is an edible diet of human beings. The objective of the present study was to predict an in silico acute toxicity (median lethal concentration or LC50 at 96hrs exposure) of DMP on fish as per simulated molecular descriptors by using toxicity estimation software tool (T.E.S.T.). The LC50 value of fish was predicted of about 15.97 mg/L or 4.09 -Log10(mol/L) as per similarity coefficient ≥0.5 of mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.03. Different molecular descriptors such as chi connectivity indices, topological descriptor, molecular properties, molecular distance-edge vector, burden eigenvalue descriptors, 2D autocorrelation descriptors, electrotopological state indices, information indices, molecular fragments, etc. were obtained. The average value was predicted for LC50 value as per all of these descriptors. It is concluded that the acute toxicity of fish for DMP was easily predicted after simulation of different molecular descriptors within T.E.S.T tool. It is suggested to evaluate fish toxicity with other phthalate compounds.
papers.summary_cn: 以T.E.S.T.软件基于模拟分子描述符（包括chi连接性指数、拓扑描述符、2D自相关描述符、电拓扑状态指数等）预测邻苯二甲酸二甲酯（DMP）对鱼的96 h急性毒性LC50，预测值约为15.97 mg/L（−log10(mol/L)=4.09），相似系数≥0.5，平均绝对误差（MAE）为0.03。结果表明，通过模拟多种分子描述符可在T.E.S.T.工具中便捷地预测DMP对鱼的急性毒性，并建议对其他邻苯二甲酸酯类化合物开展鱼类毒性评价。

papers.title: Temporal Turnover Outweighs Spatial Differences in The Fish Assemblage of a Peri-Urban Tidal River During the Early Rainy Season: The Egbelu Reach of The New Calabar River, Niger Delta, Nigeria
papers.authors: Chimela, Wala
papers.journal: INTERNATIONAL JOURNAL OF AGRICULTURE AND EARTH SCIENCE
papers.abstract: Tidal rivers that pass through growing Niger Delta towns sustain artisanal fisheries, but surveys rarely collect fish and water quality data at the same places and times. We sampled three stations on the Egbelu reach of the New Calabar River, Rivers State, Nigeria, each month from May to July 2026. On every visit we measured eleven physico-chemical variables and caught fish with gill nets, cast nets and hooks. Salinity, conductivity and total dissolved solids differed among stations (p < 0.001), while only temperature and pH changed from month to month. Dissolved oxygen (6.50-6.80 mg L-1) and BOD5 (2.50-2.80 mg L-1) pointed to well oxygenated water with modest organic loading. We caught 1,533 fish belonging to 20 species and 11 families. Cichlidae made up 28.6% of individuals, Clupeidae 16.0% and Alestidae 11.4%, and Sarotherodon melanotheron was the most abundant species (12.5%). Every species turned up at every station, diversity was almost the same everywhere (H′ = 2.91-2.93; J′ = 0.97-0.98), and Bray-Curtis similarity was above 92%. Sampling month, on the other hand, explained 81% of the variation in assemblage composition (PERMANOVA, pseudo-F = 11.04, p = 0.028), against only 4% for station (p = 0.861). Mugil cephalus, Neochelon falcipinnis, Elops lacerta and other marine-associated species declined from May to July, as Brycinus spp., Hemichromis fasciatus and Chrysichthys nigrodigitatus became more common. In the early rainy season, then, the assemblage changed far more over time than across space, and monitoring of the reach should follow the seasonal cycle rather than add stations.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究于2026年5–7月在尼日利亚新卡拉巴尔河Egbelu河段设三个站点，同步采集鱼类与水质数据，以解析城市近郊潮汐河流鱼类群落的时空动态。共记录20种11科1533尾鱼，各站点物种组成高度相似（Bray–Curtis相似性>92%），多样性指数几乎无空间差异。采样月份解释了群落组成变异的81%（PERMANOVA，p=0.028），而站点仅解释4%（p=0.861），表明时间更替远大于空间差异；海洋关联种（Mugil cephalus、Neochelon falcipinnis、Elops lacerta）随雨季推进而减少。作者建议该河段的监测应遵循季节周期而非增设站点。

papers.title: Determinants of Technical Efficiency in Nigerian Catfish Aquaculture: Stochastic Frontier Evidence and Policy Implications
papers.authors: Adewale, Caleb I.; Deb, Uttam
papers.abstract: Abstract Aquaculture has become an essential sector in Nigeria’s agriculture, significantly contributing to food security, rural employment, and economic diversification. Despite the sector’s rapid growth, Nigeria’s aquaculture industry operates below its potential, with technical efficiency levels far from optimal. This study assesses the determinants of technical efficiency among catfish farmers in Nigeria, using secondary data from a survey of 604 farmers. The result indicate that, despite significant growth in Nigeria’s aquaculture sector, technical efficiency remains suboptimal, with farmers operating at about 67% of their potential output. Using a stochastic frontier production function, we identify key factors affecting productivity and efficiency, including fish stock, household size, culture type, management system, and membership in farmers’ associations. The study highlights the need for targeted policies to enhance resource utilization, promote diversified farming practices, and support farmer associations to optimize technical efficiency in Nigeria’s catfish farming sector. These findings have important implications for improving productivity and ensuring food security in the country.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于604户尼日利亚鲶鱼养殖户的调查数据，采用 stochastic frontier production function 评估其技术效率的决定因素。结果显示养殖户仅发挥约67%的潜在产出，技术效率欠佳；鱼种存量、家庭规模、养殖类型、管理系统及养殖者协会 membership 是影响生产率与效率的关键因素。研究建议通过针对性政策优化资源配置、推广多元化养殖模式并支持养殖者协会，以提升尼日利亚鲶鱼养殖的技术效率与粮食安全保障水平。

papers.title: Water Quality Regulation and Stocking-Ratio Assessment in a Black Seabream-Mussel-Seaweed Integrated Multi-Trophic Aquaculture System
papers.authors: Gao, Linxi; Zhang, Jianlin; Zhang, Jun; Wang, Jiaying; Qian, Sihao; He, Peimin; Wu, Meiqin
papers.abstract: Integrated multi-trophic aquaculture (IMTA) combines fed and extractive species, yet appropriate biomass allocation among trophic groups remains poorly defined. This study investigated water quality regulation and stocking biomass ratios in a black seabream (Acanthopagrus schlegelii)-mussel (Mytilus coruscus)-seaweed (Ulva lactuca) IMTA system. Sequential monoculture, two-species, and three-species experiments were conducted in 300 L aquaria over 15 days, with three replicates per treatment. Black seabream monoculture increased NH4+-N and PO43--P accumulation relative to controls, whereas U. lactuca reduced dissolved nutrient concentrations. Fish-mussel co-culture did not prevent nutrient accumulation, while increasing fish biomass in fish-seaweed co-culture was associated with greater nutrient accumulation and lower seaweed RGR, which may have also been influenced by direct grazing by black seabream. Conversely, seaweed relative growth rate (RGR) increased with mussel biomass in mussel-seaweed co-culture. Among three-species treatments, FMU1 (80 g fish, 600 g mussels, and 150 g seaweed; initial biomass ratio 1:7.5:1.875) showed the best overall balance among the three tested fish biomass levels under the experimental conditions. After 15 days, NH4+-N decreased by 41.18% in FMU1 but increased by 15.91% and 61.65% in FMU2 and FMU3, respectively. These findings highlight the importance of balancing fish loading with extractive biomass to improve water quality regulation and sustain seaweed growth in coastal IMTA systems.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过15天300 L水族箱实验，探讨黑鲷（Acanthopagrus schlegelii）–贻贝（Mytilus coruscus）–石莼（Ulva lactuca）IMTA系统的水质调控与放养生物量配比。结果表明，黑鲷单养增加NH4+-N和PO43−-P积累，石莼可降低溶解态营养盐浓度；鱼–贻贝共养未能阻止营养盐积累，而鱼–藻共养中鱼生物量增加伴随营养盐积累加剧和藻类RGR下降。三物种处理中FMU1（鱼80 g、贻贝600 g、石莼150 g，初始生物量比1:7.5:1.875）综合平衡最佳，15天后NH4+-N下降41.18%，而FMU2和FMU3分别上升15.91%和61.65%。研究强调沿海IMTA系统中需平衡鱼类负载与提取性生物量以改善水质调控并维持藻类生长。

papers.title: Drone-Based IoT System for Spatial Monitoring of Pond Water Quality for Precision Aquaculture
papers.authors: V. B. C. Sekararao, Kurada; Palacherla, Venkatrao
papers.abstract: Aquaculture is an important source of food, employment and economic development, but maintaining appropriate water quality remains a major challenge for farmers. Parameters like temperature, pH, dissolved oxygen (DO), turbidity and salinity have significant effects on the growth, health, feeding efficiency and survival of aquatic organisms. Traditional monitoring relies mainly on manual sampling and periodic measurements, which is time-consuming and may not provide sufficient spatial and temporal information for precision aquaculture. This paper proposes an IoT-based mobile water-quality monitoring architecture with an unmanned aerial vehicle UAV (drone) integrated with an autonomous autopilot system. The system receives the registered GPS coordinates of an aquaculture pond and automatically navigates the UAV to the pond for measurement. When the UAV arrives at the pond, it visits several preselected sites and submerges a detachable multi-parameter sensing module to collect the water-quality parameters. An embedded controller processes the sensor data and transmits the measurements, GPS coordinates and time stamps to a cloud database via wireless communication. One mobile sensing unit can monitor multiple ponds and form a spatially indexed historical database of water quality. The architecture lays a foundation for AI-based anomaly detection, water-quality prediction, disease-risk assessment, and intelligent decision support for precision aquaculture.
papers.summary_cn: 针对传统池塘水质监测依赖人工采样、时空信息不足的问题，提出一种基于IoT的移动水质监测架构，将无人机（UAV）与自主飞控系统集成，可按预设GPS坐标自动巡航至池塘并下放可拆卸多参数传感模块，采集温度、pH、溶解氧（DO）、浊度及盐度等指标，经嵌入式控制器处理后通过无线通信将测量值、GPS坐标与时间戳上传至云数据库。单套移动传感单元可服务多个池塘，形成空间索引的水质历史数据库，为基于AI的异常检测、水质预测、疾病风险评估及精准水产养殖智能决策支持奠定基础。

papers.title: Effects of commercial scale bivalve aquaculture on the microbial carbon pump: implications for climate change mitigation
papers.authors: Tan, Karsoon; Wu, Zhou; Li, Zexin
papers.abstract: The ocean, the world's largest carbon pool, plays a critical role in regulating the global climate. Within this system, the microbial carbon pump (MCP) is a key mechanism for long-term carbon sequestration, converting organic carbon into diverse and structurally complex dissolved molecules that persist in the environment. Despite the dramatic expansion of bivalve aquaculture in recent decades, its contribution to carbon sequestration through the MCP remains poorly understood and understudied. This article critically assesses the impact of bivalve aquaculture on the carbon cycle, particularly its role in enhancing the MCP. Bivalve aquaculture influences the carbon cycle in several ways. First, it increases dissolved organic carbon (DOC) in surrounding waters through direct excretion by bivalves and enhances primary productivity, particularly in oligotrophic waters. These changes boost microbial biomass and may potentially accelerate the production of recalcitrant dissolved organic carbon (RDOC), a key component of long-term carbon storage; however, increased DOC release and microbial activity do not by themselves demonstrate RDOC production, and direct evidence from bivalve aquaculture is currently lacking. Second, intensive bivalve aquaculture alters phytoplankton community structure, shifting dominance from diatoms to cyanobacteria and picophytoplankton. These smaller phytoplankton groups tend to release more RDOC into the environment compared to diatoms and microphytoplankton, further contributing to carbon sequestration. By elucidating the mechanisms through which bivalve aquaculture enhances carbon sequestration via the MCP, this article provides valuable insights for developing sustainable bivalve fisheries and aquaculture management strategies. Such strategies can harness the potential of bivalve aquaculture to mitigate climate change impacts while supporting global food security.
papers.summary_cn: 本文评估商业规模双壳类养殖对微生物碳泵（MCP）的影响及其在气候变化缓解中的潜在作用。双壳类养殖通过直接排泄增加水体溶解有机碳（DOC）并提升初级生产力，可能促进惰性溶解有机碳（RDOC）生成，但目前缺乏直接证据。养殖还改变浮游植物群落结构，由硅藻向蓝细菌和超微型浮游植物转变，后者倾向于释放更多RDOC，从而增强碳封存。研究为可持续双壳类渔业与养殖管理策略提供了理论依据。

papers.title: Integrating TPB and NAM to explain organic aquaculture transition intentions: evidence from Thanh Hoa, Vietnam
papers.authors: Ngo, Thi My Thuy; Do, Man Thi
papers.journal: Journal of Agribusiness in Developing and Emerging Economies
papers.abstract: Purpose This study examines aquaculture households' intentions to transition to organic aquaculture in Thanh Hoa, Vietnam. Building on the theory of planned behavior (TPB) and the norm activation model (NAM), the study distinguishes perceived benefits into economic and non-economic dimensions, incorporates moral norm as an internal moral consideration and examines the moderating role of subjective norm in the relationship between moral norm and transition intention. Design/methodology/approach A quantitative research design was employed using survey data collected from 323 aquaculture households in Thanh Hoa, Vietnam. The proposed model was tested using partial least squares structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM) to examine the hypothesized direct, indirect and moderating relationships. Findings Perceived economic benefits, perceived non-economic benefits, subjective norm, perceived behavioral control and moral norm are positively associated with transition intention, with moral norm showing the strongest association. Moral norm is positively associated with perceived non-economic benefits but not with perceived economic benefits, indicating a distinction between the two dimensions of perceived benefits. In addition, the interaction between subjective norm and moral norm is positive and statistically significant, indicating that the positive relationship between moral norm and transition intention becomes stronger as subjective norm increases. Research limitations/implications This study is limited by its cross-sectional design and its focus on transition intention rather than actual behavior. The model also does not fully account for socio-demographic, structural and institutional factors that may affect the intention-behavior gap. Future research should use longitudinal data, incorporate these external constraints, examine mechanisms that may bridge the intention-behavior gap and test the model across different geographical contexts. Originality/value This study extends behavioral research on organic aquaculture in three respects. First, it distinguishes perceived economic and non-economic benefits to provide a more differentiated understanding of benefit-related considerations associated with transition intention. Second, building on TPB and NAM, it examines subjective norm not only as a direct predictor of intention but also as a moderator of the relationship between moral norm and transition intention. Third, by applying this framework to aquaculture households in Thanh Hoa, Vietnam, the study provides context-specific insights for policymakers, extension agencies and other stakeholders in designing policies and support programs for organic aquaculture transition.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于计划行为理论（TPB）与规范激活模型（NAM），以越南清化省323个水产养殖户为样本，采用PLS-SEM检验其向有机水产养殖转型的意愿。结果表明，感知经济效益、感知非经济效益、主观规范、感知行为控制与道德规范均正向影响转型意愿，其中道德规范关联最强；道德规范仅与感知非经济效益正相关，且主观规范正向调节道德规范与转型意愿的关系。研究为有机水产养殖转型政策设计提供了差异化效益认知与道德-社会规范交互作用的实证依据。

papers.title: Sub-ice thermal gradients strongly influence winter depth use of an iconic cold-water fish
papers.authors: Shi, Lidi; Wells, Mathew G.; Ridgway, Mark S.; Dunlop, Erin S.; McMeans, Bailey C.; Fisk, Aaron T.; Blanchfield, Paul J.; Cooke, Steven J.; Rennie, Michael D.; Young, Joelle D.
papers.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
papers.abstract: In a thermally stratified lake, freshwater fish select habitats that align with their thermal preferences. While most studies of dimictic lakes have focused on habitat selection during summer stratification, less attention has been given to winter when inverse thermal stratification occurs with water temperatures between 0 to 4 °C. Our results show that winter thermal stratifications vary considerably among lakes. Much of the variation in winter depth use by the cold-water predator, Lake Trout ( Salvelinus namaycush ), can be explained by the depth of the 2 °C isotherm. Selection ratios further support preferential use of this thermal boundary after accounting for habitat availability. Larger, shallower, and windier lakes tend to exhibit colder mean temperatures near 0 °C and deeper isotherms, typically within the 1 to 2 °C range. In contrast, deeper or more sheltered lakes maintained warmer temperatures close to 4 °C and a shallower 2 °C isotherm. Using multiyear acoustic telemetry of Lake Trout from 11 different lakes, we found that in warmer lakes with depth-averaged temperatures above 2 °C, Lake Trout used thermal habitat averaging 2.6 ± 0.6 °C, which occurred in relatively shallow depths (0.1 to 11.3 m). In contrast, in the one large, shallow lake studied, where maximum water temperatures were below 2 °C, Lake Trout occupied the deepest waters during winter (16.8 to 26.4 m) and experienced average temperatures of 1.5 ± 0.4 °C. Applying our model to 877,927 Canadian and Alaskan lakes predicted a roughly even split between warm and cold winter conditions; however, 73% of the 66,500 known Lake Trout lakes exhibited warmer winter conditions, where Lake Trout would occupy the upper water column during winter.
papers.summary_cn: 研究基于11个湖泊的多年声学遥测数据，探讨冬季逆温分层下湖鳟（Lake Trout）深度利用与热梯度的关系。结果表明，2 °C等温线深度可解释湖鳟冬季深度利用的大部分变异，且其偏好利用该热边界。较大、较浅、风浪较强的湖泊近表层温度接近0 °C且等温线较深，而较深或遮蔽良好的湖泊温度接近4 °C且2 °C等温线较浅；在平均温度高于2 °C的湖泊中湖鳟利用约2.6 °C的浅层热栖息地，而在最大水温低于2 °C的浅湖中则占据最深水域。模型预测加拿大和阿拉斯加湖泊冷暖冬季条件大致各半，但73%的已知湖鳟湖泊为暖冬季条件。

papers.title: Two snapshots of fish diversity and body size in an Amazonian market
papers.authors: Bartolotta, Lilia R.; Fasulo, Nicholas J.; Kapusinsky, Collin J.; Madigosky, Stephen R.; Swierk, Lindsey
papers.abstract: Tropical freshwater fisheries support both biodiversity and human livelihoods, yet long-term fishery characteristics data remain scarce across much of the Amazon Basin. Fish markets offer an opportunity to assess patterns in fish diversity and body sizes from exploited aquatic communities. Fish diversity and body sizes (standard length; SL) of common, locally harvested fish sold in Mercado Belén, Iquitos (Peruvian Amazon), were measured using photographic surveys conducted 11 years apart, in 2008 and 2019. Mean SL of the 10 most abundant species or genera differed significantly between these two years for seven taxa, increasing in five taxa (including Prochilodus nigricans and Plagioscion squamosissimus ) and decreasing in two, notably in a large, predatory Cichla sp. Taxonomic richness and diversity showed small declines between these two years. Minor differences in community composition were observed between years, but the dominant taxa were similar. These two time points serve as a baseline for future comparisons and by themselves do not demonstrate temporal or regional trends. Market surveys provide a useful, low-cost complement to field-based ecological studies in tropical freshwater ecosystems.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用相隔11年（2008年和2019年）的摄影调查，评估秘鲁亚马逊Iquitos的Belén市场中常见捕捞鱼类的多样性和体长（SL）。10个最丰富物种或属中有7个类群的平均SL在两年间差异显著，5个类群体长增加（包括Prochilodus nigricans和Plagioscion squamosissimus），2个类群体长减小，尤其是大型捕食性Cichla sp.。分类丰富度和多样性略有下降，群落组成年际差异较小但优势类群相似。该研究为未来比较提供基线，并表明市场调查是热带淡水生态系统野外生态学研究的低成本补充手段。

papers.title: Dopaminergic stimulation of intestinal maltase activity in the freshwater fish Oligosarcus jenynsii
papers.authors: Albanesi, Camila; Domanski, Dardo; Michiels, Maria Soledad
papers.abstract: Intestinal disaccharidases are key determinants of carbohydrate assimilation in fish. Here, we characterized maltase and sucrase activity in juveniles of Oligosarcus jenynsii (Günther, 1864) and evaluated the modulation of maltase activity by dopamine. Maltase activity was detected across a broad pH (6.0-8.0) and temperature (4-45 °C) range and followed Michaelis-Menten kinetics (Km :1.22 mM), whereas sucrase activity was not detected. In vitro assays showed that dopamine significantly stimulated maltase activity in a concentration-dependent manner, with increases at 10-4 and 10-3 M. This stimulatory effect was not observed in the presence of the D1 receptor antagonist SCH-23390 or the D2 receptor antagonist chlorpromazine. These results demonstrate that intestinal maltase activity is responsive to dopaminergic stimulation under in vitro conditions and suggest the participation of dopaminergic pathways in this response. The physiological significance of this modulation in vivo remains to be established. These findings contribute to the understanding of the biochemical regulation of intestinal disaccharidases in a freshwater fish species.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究表征了淡水鱼Oligosarcus jenynsii幼鱼的肠道二糖酶活性，并评估多巴胺对maltase活性的调控作用。结果显示maltase在pH 6.0–8.0和4–45 °C范围内均有活性，符合Michaelis–Menten动力学（Km 1.22 mM），而未检测到sucrase活性。体外实验表明多巴胺以浓度依赖方式显著刺激maltase活性（10⁻⁴和10⁻³ M），该效应可被D1受体拮抗剂SCH-23390和D2受体拮抗剂氯丙嗪阻断，提示多巴胺能通路参与该调控，但其体内生理意义尚待阐明。

papers.title: Strengthening the Mandiri Consumer Cooperative through Grade C Fish Valorization: A Community Empowerment Program for Fermented Feed Production in Belitung, Indonesia
papers.authors: Mayasari, Dessy; Lokantara, I Gede Wyana
papers.journal: Journal of Universal Community Empowerment Provision
papers.abstract: The Consumer Cooperative Usaha Mandiri in Tanjung Binga Village, Belitung Regency, encounters challenges in valorizing underutilized grade C fish catches, while local livestock farmers remain reliant on relatively expensive commercial feed sourced externally. This community engagement initiative sought to enhance cooperative capacity by converting low-value fish resources into fermented feed ingredients within a circular economy framework. Conducted over eight months, the program utilized a participatory approach that included needs assessment, community engagement, technical training, technology transfer, production trials, and ongoing institutional mentoring. The initiative's unique contribution is the integration of fish boiling, rice bran addition, brown sugar and EM4 supplementation, anaerobic fermentation, and product development into a cooperative-based fish valorization model. The intervention enabled the transformation of underutilized fish resources into value-added feed products and strengthened members' technical skills and business management practices, particularly in financial record-keeping, production planning, and market development. Laboratory analysis indicated an energy content of 392 kcal, protein content of 73.97 g, fat content of 8.97 g, and carbohydrate content of 3.93 g per 100 g. This initiative provides a foundation for reinforcing local value chains that connect fisheries, cooperatives, and livestock production. Future initiatives should focus on formulation standardization, nutritional validation, feed safety assessment, economic feasibility, and regulatory compliance to ensure product quality and long-term business sustainability.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在通过将低值C级渔获转化为发酵饲料原料，提升印尼勿里洞Tanjung Binga村Usaha Mandiri消费合作社的能力，缓解当地养殖户对高价外购商业饲料的依赖。项目历时八个月，采用参与式方法开展需求评估、技术培训、技术转移、生产试验和机构辅导，将煮鱼、米糠、红糖及EM4添加与厌氧发酵相结合，构建合作社为基础的鱼类增值模式。实验室分析显示产品含能量392 kcal、蛋白质73.97 g、脂肪8.97 g、碳水化合物3.93 g（每100 g），并提升了成员在财务记录、生产计划和市场开发方面的能力。后续需聚焦配方标准化、营养验证、饲料安全评估、经济可行性及法规合规，以保障产品质量与业务可持续性。

papers.title: Maternal genetic diversity and population structure of four mandarin fish ( Siniperca chuatsi ) populations inferred from mitochondrial D-loop sequences
papers.authors: Yao, Yuefei; Li, Fei; Zhu, Chao; Jiang, Wenping; Chi, Meili; Liu, Shili; Cheng, Shun; Luo, Junzhi; Zheng, Jianbo; Zhang, Haiqi
papers.abstract: Mandarin fish ( Siniperca chuatsi ) is an economically important freshwater aquaculture species in China, yet the maternal genetic composition of cultured stocks from different regions remains insufficiently characterized. To assess maternal genetic diversity and population structure, 120 individuals were sampled from one wild-origin population from Huzhou, Zhejiang Province (ZJHZ), and three cultured populations from Chizhou, Anhui Province (AHCZ), Wuhan, Hubei Province (HBWH), and Jiangmen, Guangdong Province (GDJM). Mitochondrial D-loop sequencing generated 118 high-quality sequences and identified 22 haplotypes. Haplotype diversity ranged from 0.543 to 0.805, and nucleotide diversity from 0.00604 to 0.01095. Three common haplotypes were shared by all four populations and represented 94 of the 118 individuals, whereas most remaining haplotypes were population-specific and occurred at low frequencies. AMOVA attributed 94.17% of the mitochondrial variation to within-population differences and 5.83% to among-population differences, with the among-population component being statistically significant (FST = 0.05831, P = 0.00196). Pairwise FST tests detected significant maternal differentiation between GDJM and each of the other three populations, whereas differentiation among AHCZ, ZJHZ, and HBWH was generally low. Overall, the four populations shared a broad maternal genetic background while retaining low-frequency variation within individual stocks. These findings provide population-specific baseline information for maternal-lineage identification and female broodstock management in S. chuatsi . However, mitochondrial D-loop data do not capture paternal contributions or genome-wide diversity. Broader geographic sampling combined with genome-wide nuclear markers and pedigree information will therefore be required for a comprehensive assessment of broodstock genetic structure.
papers.summary_cn: 研究对鳜（Siniperca chuatsi）1个野生群体（浙江湖州）和3个养殖群体（安徽池州、湖北武汉、广东江门）共120个个体进行线粒体D-loop测序，获得118条高质量序列和22个单倍型，单倍型多样性为0.543~0.805，核苷酸多样性为0.00604~0.01095。3个共同单倍型为4个群体共享，涵盖118个个体中的94个，其余多为群体特异低频单倍型。AMOVA显示94.17%的变异来自群体内，群体间分化显著（FST=0.05831，P=0.00196），其中GDJM与其他3个群体间存在显著母系分化，而AHCZ、ZJHZ与HBWH间分化较低。研究为鳜母系溯源和雌性亲本管理提供了群体特异性基线资料，但作者指出线粒体D-loop数据无法反映父系贡献和全基因组多样性，需结合核基因组标记和系谱信息进一步评估。

papers.title: Material-dependent effects of fish-scale-derived nano-hydroxyapatite on the mechanical, physicochemical, and optical properties of conventional glass ionomer cements
papers.authors: Abozaid, Dina; El-Aal, Mohamed Abd; Ahmed, Mohammed H.; Azab, Amr; Alhotan, Abdulaziz; Mohamed, Pansai A.
papers.abstract: To evaluate the effects of fish-scale-derived nano-hydroxyapatite (nHA) incorporation on the mechanical properties, surface characteristics, hydrolytic behavior, and color stability of conventional glass ionomer cements (GICs). Nano-hydroxyapatite synthesized from black tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) fish scales was incorporated into Fuji IX GP and Riva Self Cure conventional GICs at 5 wt% and 10 wt%. Unmodified materials served as controls (n = 10/group). Flexural strength, flexural modulus, surface roughness, and color stability were evaluated before and after thermocycling. Water sorption and solubility were evaluated once, without thermocycling. Data were analyzed using ANOVA, Mann-Whitney U, and Kruskal-Wallis tests (α = 0.05). nHA significantly affected the mechanical and physicochemical properties of both GICs. The 10 wt% nHA-Riva group exhibited the highest flexural strength before (40.34 ± 6.84 MPa) and after thermocycling (38.32 ± 2.93 MPa), with the smallest median percentage change following aging (- 4.75%). In contrast, the 10 wt% nHA-Fuji group demonstrated a median percentage change of - 56.90% after thermocycling. Water sorption was reduced in the modified Fuji groups, with the lowest value observed in the 10 wt% nHA-Fuji group (2.05 ± 0.13%). Surface roughness increased with increasing nHA concentration and after thermocycling. Most modified groups exhibited color changes exceeding clinically acceptable CIEDE2000 thresholds. Fish-scale-derived nHA affected the measured properties of conventional GICs in a material- and concentration-dependent manner. Reinforcing effects were most evident in Riva Self Cure, whereas 10 wt% nHA was associated with a pronounced loss of flexural strength in Fuji IX GP after thermocycling. Although nHA reduced water sorption in selected formulations, increased surface roughness and compromised color stability may limit clinical applicability. As remineralization and ion-release behavior were not assessed, these findings should be interpreted as material-performance data rather than evidence of clinical bioactivity. Conventional glass ionomer cements are widely used because of their fluoride release and chemical adhesion but remain limited by insufficient mechanical durability. Bio-derived nano-hydroxyapatite has emerged as a promising reinforcing additive; however, evidence regarding fish-scale-derived hydroxyapatite in different commercial glass ionomer formulations is limited. This study demonstrates that reinforcement is highly material- and concentration-dependent, with improvements in mechanical performance observed primarily in Riva Self Cure, while increased surface roughness and color instability may restrict esthetic applications. Clinicians should recognize that nanoparticle modification requires formulation-specific optimization, and that remineralizing potential was not evaluated in this study, before routine clinical use.
papers.summary_cn: 以尼罗罗非鱼（Oreochromis niloticus）鱼鳞合成的纳米羟基磷灰石（nHA）按5 wt%和10 wt%掺入Fuji IX GP与Riva Self Cure两种传统玻璃离子水门汀（GIC），评估热循环前后挠曲强度、挠曲模量、表面粗糙度与颜色稳定性，并单次测定吸水率与溶解性。nHA的影响呈材料与浓度依赖性：10 wt% nHA-Riva组热循环前后挠曲强度最高（40.34±6.84 MPa与38.32±2.93 MPa），老化后中位变化仅−4.75%；而10 wt% nHA-Fuji组热循环后中位降幅达−56.90%。改性Fuji组吸水率降低（10 wt%组最低为2.05±0.13%），但表面粗糙度随nHA浓度及热循环升高，多数改性组颜色变化超出临床可接受CIEDE2000阈值。该研究未评估再矿化与离子释放行为，结果应视为材料性能数据而非临床生物活性证据。

papers.title: Socio-Economic Characteristics and Constraints of Fish Farmers in Three Agricultural Zones of Imo State, Nigeria
papers.authors: Agbabiaka, C. N.
papers.journal: INTERNATIONAL JOURNAL OF AGRICULTURE AND EARTH SCIENCE
papers.abstract: This study assessed the socioeconomic characteristics and constraints confronting fish farmers in three agricultural zones (Owerri, Orlu and Okigwe), of Imo State, Nigeria. Targeted population were fish farmers whose sources of livelihood were from fish farming using earthen and concrete ponds fish culture system. A structured close-ended questionnaires were administered, in a random sampling procedure to a total of one hundred and twenty (120) fish farmers who were selected for the study, with forty (40) each from the three agricultural zones in Imo State. Items on the questionnaires were organized, categorized and coded correctly. Data were analyzed using Statistical Package for Social Sciences (IBM/SPSS) software version 22.0. The results obtained indicated that majority of the fish farmers were male (75%) across the three zones indicating gender disparities which may be due to land tenure system. The active workforce is within the age bracket of 40-49 years (35%). Majority of the farmers are married and has large family size. In terms of tenancy, it was observed that most of the farmers are tenants in Owerri unlike the other zones. It was also observed that (38%) of the fish farmers possess tertiary education certificate. In the study area, 13% of the respondents identified lack of storage facilities for fish products as a constraint, In addition, 73% of the respondents attributed poor power supply as a challenge confronting them in the aquaculture operations in the study area. Similarly, 67%) of the respondents ascribed inability to access loans or credit facilities as one of the challenges facing aquaculture. Besides, 83% and 92% of the respondents ascribed high cost of feed and inadequate capital respectively as major challenges confronting aquaculture activities in these area. While 13%, 20% and 23% of the respondents believed that poaching, high cost of land and high cost of fingerlings respectively were the challenges confronting them in fish farming. Moreover, poor pricing of harvested fish (30%), poor water supply (13%) and lack of technical skills (87%) were some of other significant (p < 0.05) constraints faced by fish farmers in the studied areas in Imo State.
