Therefore to enhance the development of aquaculture in the state, measures should be taken to reduce the cost of fish production through subsidizing cost of inputs, giving grants, organizing workshops, trainings, seminars, field days, radio programs and the use of Extension Agents (EAs). The state government through the Imo State Ministry of Agriculture can establish Fish Demonstration Farms in the three agricultural zones to serve as fish skill acquisition farms, for regular training of fish farmers in the state. All these will definitely assist in the development of aquaculture in Imo State
papers.summary_cn: 本研究调查了尼日利亚伊莫州三个农业区（Owerri、Orlu、Okigwe）养殖渔民的社会经济特征与制约因素，采用结构化问卷对120名以池塘养殖为生的渔民进行随机抽样分析。结果显示，渔民以男性为主（75%），主力劳动力年龄为40~49岁，38%具有高等教育学历；主要制约因素包括饲料成本高（83%）、资金不足（92%）、缺乏技术技能（87%）、电力供应差（73%）及贷款渠道不畅（67%）。研究建议通过投入品补贴、培训推广及建立鱼类示范农场等措施促进该州水产养殖发展。

papers.title: Potentially Toxic Elements (PTEs) Bioaccumulation in Fish from the Aries River, Romania: Screening-Level Human Health Risk Assessment
papers.authors: Voica, Cezara; Marincas, Olivian; Gati, Gabriel; Feher, Ioana
papers.abstract: Background: The Arieș River basin in Romania is historically mining-impacted, and data on metal accumulation in its fish and the associated risk to consumers are scarce. Aims: This study investigated elemental accumulation in fish from the Arieș River and evaluated the potential health risks associated with fish consumption. Methods: A total of 40 fish representing five species were collected by angling between June and September 2025, after the legal fishing prohibition period. Eight tissues per fish (muscle, gills, liver, skin, bones, scales, eyes, and caudal fin) were analyzed by inductively coupled plasma-mass spectrometry (ICP-MS). Contamination and exposure were evaluated using the pollution index (PI), metal contamination index (MCI), estimated daily intake (EDI), target hazard quotient (THQ), and hazard index (HI) for non-carcinogenic risk, and carcinogenic risk and total carcinogenic risk (TCR) for carcinogenic risk. Species and tissue patterns were examined by multivariate analysis, including linear discriminant analysis (LDA). Results: Multivariate statistical analysis revealed distinct species- and tissue-related patterns in elemental composition. LDA differentiated species with an initial classification accuracy of 82.5% and a leave-one-out cross-validated accuracy of 72.5%, with Cr, Mn, Pb, Sr, and Ni having the highest contribution. Tissue discrimination was lower (approximately 60%), with Sr, Zn, and Cu as main discrimination variable. THQ values for individual elements and HI were below 1, indicating no appreciable non-carcinogenic risk under the assumed exposure conditions. The highest CR values were associated with Ni (nase muscle, 2.26 × 10-6) and As (nase skin, 6.28 × 10-7). TCR ranged from 3.16 × 10-7 to 3.37 × 10-6 and remained below 1 × 10-4, within the acceptable range. Conclusions: Elemental contamination in fish from the Arieș River was generally low, and species and tissue type influenced elemental composition and dietary relevance. Continued monitoring is advised, with seasonal sampling, inorganic arsenic speciation, and attention to species such as nase when assessing consumption risk.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究分析了罗马尼亚Arieș河5种40尾鱼8种组织中的8种潜在毒性元素（PTEs），采用ICP-MS测定并结合PI、MCI、EDI、THQ、HI及致癌风险指标进行健康风险评估。多元统计（含LDA）显示元素组成呈明显的物种和组织特异性，物种判别准确率82.5%（交叉验证72.5%），Cr、Mn、Pb、Sr、Ni贡献最大。THQ与HI均小于1，TCR为3.16×10⁻⁷~3.37×10⁻⁶，表明假定暴露条件下无显著非致癌风险，致癌风险在可接受范围内。作者建议继续开展季节性监测、无机砷形态分析，并重点关注nase等物种的消费风险。

papers.title: Comparative Analysis of the Economic Feasibility of Using Extruded Pellets and Raw Fish-Based Moist Pellets as Aquafeed in Olive Flounder (Paralichthys olivaceus) Aquaculture in South Korea
papers.authors: Kim, Nam-Lee; Hur, Sang Woo; Park, Kyoung-Il; Jeong, Seong-Mok; Choi, Ji Yong; Kim, Kang-Woong; Kim, Do-Hoon
papers.abstract: South Korea’s olive flounder aquaculture industry predominantly relies on raw fish-based moist pellets (MP), raising concerns regarding marine resource use and environmental sustainability. This study compared the growth performance and economic feasibility of extruded pellets (EP) and MP through a 12-month feeding trial conducted at two commercial olive flounder farms in Wando, South Korea. At each farm, three replicate tanks were assigned to each dietary treatment. Economic feasibility was assessed using net present value (NPV), internal rate of return (IRR), and sensitivity analyses of key production and cost variables. Final body weight and survival rate were significantly higher in the MP groups than in the EP groups at both farms. In the baseline analysis without government subsidies, Farm A recorded an NPV of USD 793,446 and an IRR of 14.1% for EP, compared with USD 2,244,588 and 28.8% for MP. At Farm B, the corresponding values were USD 705,580 and 13.1% for EP, compared with USD 2,836,482 and 34.3% for MP. Although both feeding systems were economically feasible, MP demonstrated greater economic returns, primarily due to higher growth performance and lower feed costs. These findings highlight the need to improve EP performance and cost-effectiveness while considering the long-term sustainability of aquaculture feeding strategies.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过在南韩莞岛两个商业养殖场开展为期12个月的投喂试验，比较了挤压颗粒饲料（EP）与生鱼基湿性颗粒饲料（MP）在牙鲆（Paralichthys olivaceus）养殖中的生长性能与经济可行性，并采用净现值（NPV）、内部收益率（IRR）及敏感性分析进行评估。结果显示，两养殖场MP组的终末体重与存活率均显著高于EP组；无补贴基准情形下，养殖场A的EP与MP的NPV分别为793,446与2,244,588美元（IRR 14.1% vs 28.8%），养殖场B分别为705,580与2,836,482美元（IRR 13.1% vs 34.3%）。两种投喂方式均经济可行，但MP因生长性能更优、饲料成本更低而经济回报更高，提示需提升EP的性能与成本效益，并兼顾养殖投喂策略的长期可持续性。

papers.title: Evidence of Natural Nervous Necrosis Virus Infection in Juvenile Greenfin Horse-Faced Filefish (Thamnaconus septentrionalis) During an Aquaculture Mortality Event
papers.authors: Wang, Yu; Chen, Xiao-Ling; Qiu, Liang; Huang, Jie
papers.abstract: Viral nervous necrosis (VNN), caused by nervous necrosis virus (NNV), is a devastating viral disease affecting marine fish aquaculture worldwide, particularly during larval and juvenile stages. Although NNV has a broad and expanding host range, the susceptibility of greenfin horse-faced filefish (Thamnaconus septentrionalis) has not been established. To determine whether T. septentrionalis is susceptible to NNV, we investigated an outbreak of abnormal mortality in juveniles from a marine aquaculture farm in Rizhao, Shandong Province, China. A comprehensive etiological investigation combined bacterial isolation and identification, real-time quantitative RT-PCR (RT-qPCR), tissue-distribution analysis, histopathology, transmission electron microscopy (TEM), and RNA2-based phylogenetic analysis. Diseased fish exhibited characteristic VNN-like neurological signs, including spiral swimming, loss of equilibrium, anorexia, and body darkening. Several bacterial taxa, including Vibrio- and Tenacibaculum-related isolates, were recovered from diseased fish, indicating the possibility of bacterial involvement. However, the concurrent detection of abundant NNV RNA in neural tissues, together with characteristic neurological signs, compatible histopathological lesions, and NNV-like particles, provided convergent evidence supporting natural NNV infection. NNV RNA was detected in all ten diseased fish, whereas the other screened viral pathogens were not detected. Pooled brain-eye samples contained 4.62 × 108 to 1.33 × 109 NNV RNA copies/μg total RNA, and abundant NNV RNA was also detected in brain, spleen, kidney, and trunk tissues. Histological examination showed vacuolar and degenerative lesions in the brain and retina, and TEM revealed numerous non-enveloped, spherical virus-like particles approximately 25 nm in diameter in neural tissues, consistent with NNV morphology. Phylogenetic analysis of the RNA2 capsid protein gene placed the detected virus within the RGNNV RNA2 lineage. Together, the neurological signs, NNV RNA detection, compatible histopathological lesions, NNV-like particles in neural tissues, and RNA2 phylogenetic evidence provide evidence of natural NNV infection in T. septentrionalis. These findings document evidence of natural NNV infection in T. septentrionalis under aquaculture conditions, highlight the need for further investigations into pathogenicity and transmission, and provide a basis for VNN surveillance and biosecurity management in filefish aquaculture.
papers.summary_cn: 为确认绿鳍马面鲀（Thamnaconus septentrionalis）是否对 nervous necrosis virus（NNV）易感，本研究对山东日照某海水养殖场幼鱼异常死亡事件开展了病原学调查，综合采用细菌分离鉴定、RT-qPCR、组织分布分析、组织病理学、透射电镜及基于 RNA2 的系统发育分析。病鱼表现螺旋游动、失衡、厌食和体色发暗等 VNN 样神经症状，虽分离到弧菌和黄杆菌类细菌，但脑眼组织 NNV RNA 载量高达 4.62×10⁸–1.33×10⁹ copies/μg total RNA，并伴有脑和视网膜空泡变性及约 25 nm 的无囊膜球形病毒样颗粒，RNA2 系统发育分析归入 RGNNV 谱系。多项证据共同支持绿鳍马面鲀自然感染 NNV，提示需进一步研究其致病性与传播途径，并为该鱼种养殖的 VNN 监测和生物安全管理提供依据。

papers.title: Phytobiotics from the Lamiaceae, Asteraceae, and Fabaceae families: Mechanisms, efficacy, and emerging nanotechnological applications in sustainable aquaculture
papers.authors: Ashouri, Ghasem; Imperatore, Roberta; Paolucci, Marina; Hoseinifar, Seyed Hossein; Nekouei Fard, Ali; Bagherzadeh Lakani, Forouzan; Torfi Mozanzadeh, Mansour; Rezaeishoorijeh, Reyhaneh; Hoseini, Marziyeh; Ghafarifarsani, Hamed
papers.abstract: Global aquaculture is rapidly developing as a production system for aquatic animal-derived foods. Sustainable production in the marine industry is not only hindered by disease challenges but also limited by the use of synthetic drugs against these disease outbreaks because of their tissue accumulation, which leads to resistant pathogens. As an alternative, medicinal herbs are mentioned in aquaculture as eco-friendly and safe products for preventing pathogens, enhancing growth, and improving the immune system. Moreover, medicinal herbs protect aquatic animals from stressful stimuli, including overcrowding, high temperatures, and poor water quality. Given the increased need of the aquaculture industry for phytoconstituents and their potential sources, this review mainly focuses on providing information on the nutritional, biochemical, and physiological impacts and the action mechanisms of herbal medicines from the Lamiaceae, Fabaceae, and Asteraceae families on aquatic species. Recent studies indicate that nano-enabled delivery systems can substantially improve the performance of herbal compounds, and this review therefore highlights the growing potential of integrating nanotechnology with phytobiotics to enhance their stability, bioavailability, and functional outcomes in aquaculture. Emerging nanotechnological delivery systems, including encapsulation in polymeric nanoparticles, liposomes, and metal-based nanoparticles synthesized using plant extracts, offer significant advantages for improving the stability, bioavailability, and targeted delivery of phytobiotic compounds. Nanoencapsulation of essential oils and bioactive phytochemicals (e.g., thymol, curcumin, rosmarinic acid) has shown particular promise in enhancing their solubility, protecting them from degradation in the gastrointestinal tract, and enabling controlled release, thereby maximizing their immunostimulatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects in aquatic species. Essential information is presented about phytobiotics from these plant families and their mode of action, mode of administration and dosage, and other vital issues for phytobiotic research in aquaculture. Importantly, the review suggests that the practical use of these green drugs requires further investigation to uncover the biological functions of active compounds responsible for growth, immune, and pathogen resistance across diverse species of aquatic animals. With analysing 162 peer-reviewed studies, this review provides, for the first time, a comprehensive comparative analysis of phytobiotics from the Lamiaceae, Fabaceae, and Asteraceae families, integrating their mechanisms of action, dose-dependent effects, nanotechnology-based delivery systems and emerging nanotechnological applications, while identifying critical research gaps and future directions for sustainable aquaculture. The knowledge derived from the current discussion provides an exciting opportunity for the practical use of natural drugs in aquaculture.
papers.summary_cn: 基于162篇同行评审研究，系统比较了唇形科、豆科和菊科植物源phytobiotics在水产养殖中的作用机制、剂量效应及纳米递送系统应用。这些植物提取物可替代合成药物，发挥促生长、免疫增强、抗氧化和抗病原功能，并缓解拥挤、高温及水质恶化等应激。纳米封装（聚合物纳米粒、脂质体、植物提取物合成的金属纳米粒）可提升thymol、curcumin、rosmarinic acid等活性成分的稳定性、生物利用度和靶向释放，从而增强免疫刺激与抗菌效果。综述指出活性化合物的生物学功能尚需在多种水产物种中进一步验证，并识别了关键研究空白与未来方向。

papers.title: Growth Performance of Tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) Cultured in a Rainwater-Harvesting Aquaculture Pond
papers.authors: Nathaniel, K. Geethanjali; Sudhakar, S.
papers.abstract: Rainwater-harvesting ponds offer opportunities for freshwater aquaculture by enabling the additional productive use of existing water-storage structures. Nile tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) is widely cultured because of its adaptability to different freshwater environments. However, evaluating its growth under site-specific pond conditions is essential for understanding its performance and the potential suitability of rainwater-harvesting ponds for fish culture. This study described the weekly growth of Nile tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) cultured in a rainwater-harvesting aquaculture pond at H.H. The Rajah’s College, Pudukkottai, from September 2023 to February 2024. Fish received commercial feed daily, and average body weight and body length were recorded at weekly intervals over a 24-week culture period. The initial recorded mean weight and length in Week 1 were 3.0 g and 1.5 cm, respectively. By Week 12, mean weight had increased to 110.0 g and mean length to 16.9 cm. At Week 24, the corresponding values reached 550.0 g and 30.2 cm. Across the recorded observations, average body weight increased by 547.0 g and average body length by 28.7 cm. Both measurements increased in every successive weekly record. Weight gains were smaller during the initial weeks and larger in absolute terms during the later stages, whereas increases in length followed a steadier pattern. These results document a continuous rise in mean fish size during one culture cycle in the study pond. However, the absence of a comparison pond, water-quality measurements, fish counts, variability estimates and feed-utilisation data prevents attribution of the growth pattern to the rainwater-harvesting system or assessment of production efficiency. The observations indicate that this pond supported tilapia growth during the monitored period, while further measurements would be required to evaluate broader culture performance.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究记录了印度Pudukkottai地区雨水收集养殖塘中尼罗罗非鱼（Oreochromis niloticus）24周（2023年9月至2024年2月）的周生长表现，鱼体每日投喂商业饲料并每周测定体重与体长。初始均重3.0 g、体长1.5 cm，第12周增至110.0 g和16.9 cm，第24周达550.0 g和30.2 cm，整个养殖周期体重净增547.0 g、体长净增28.7 cm，体重呈前期增长较慢、后期绝对增量较大的趋势，体长增长则较为平稳。结果表明该雨水收集塘在监测期内可支持罗非鱼持续生长，但缺乏对照塘、水质数据、放养数量、变异估计及饲料利用数据，尚无法将生长表现归因于雨水收集系统本身或评估其生产效率。

papers.title: Macrobenthic fauna associated with maërl beds near aquaculture installations in the north-eastern Corinthian Gulf, Greece, with remarks on two taxa
papers.authors: Chatzigeorgiou, Georgios; Lampa, Maria; Rallis, Ioannis; Maidanou, Maria; Naletaki, Maria; Plaitis, Wanda
papers.abstract: Maërl beds, also known as rhodolith beds, are biogenic benthic habitats formed by unattached coralline algae and support diverse macrobenthic assemblages. In the Mediterranean, especially its eastern basin, information on their distribution, ecological condition and associated fauna remains limited. Maërl beds are sensitive to physical disturbance, sedimentation and organic enrichment, including pressures associated with aquaculture activities. This data paper describes the macrobenthic fauna associated with maërl beds located near and further from finfish farms in the Traxilos area of the north-eastern Corinthian Gulf, Greece. The dataset comprises eight sampling events and 328 abundance-based occurrence records representing 6,410 individuals. The paper also provides morphological notes on two polychaete taxa, Syllis nigricirris and the Neanthioides acuminata species complex, documenting variation in diagnostically relevant characters.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究记录了希腊科林斯湾东北部Traxilos海域鱼类养殖场附近及远离养殖场的maërl beds（rhodolith beds）大型底栖动物群落，填补了东地中海该生境分布与生态状况数据不足的空白。数据集包含8次采样、328条基于丰度的出现记录，共6,410个个体。文中还对两种多毛类分类群（Syllis nigricirris和Neanthioides acuminata种复合体）的形态鉴别特征变异进行了描述。

papers.title: The Wearing Layer Influences Long-Term Material Loss from Composite Floats for Oyster Aquaculture: An Accelerated-Weathering Comparison of Eight Candidate Materials
papers.authors: Mun, So Youn; Jang, Pilseong; Jang, Jun Hwan
papers.abstract: Expanded polystyrene floats have been identified as a significant source of marine microplastic in oyster aquaculture, yet no certification criterion assesses the material that the certified alternatives shed. Gravimetric mass loss, normalised to a common exposed area of 7200 mm2, is reported under accredited accelerated weathering to KS F 2274 for eight float materials: expanded polystyrene at three densities, expanded polypropylene, three injection-moulded polymers, and a continuous-fibre basalt-reinforced thermoplastic composite. Specimens were dried to constant mass before weighing, so the quantity measured is a net change: an upper bound on particulate release, not a measure of it. Mass exceeded the initial value in all three stabilised expanded polypropylene specimens. At 3000 h the loss spanned a factor of 54, and every foamed material exceeded every non-foamed one, while tripling the density of expanded polystyrene reduced loss by only 25% (n = 3; p < 0.0001 across the foamed groups). For ten injection-moulded grades the accelerated ranking reproduced that of 2.5 years outdoors (Spearman ρ = 0.89), though the ratio varied from 0.4 to 6.3. A wear model indicates that the pure-polymer barrier providing water tightness contains 905-1180 g L-1 of polymer against 578 g L-1 for the laminate beneath, so the wearing layer, not the bulk material, may govern release in service.
papers.summary_cn: 研究比较了8种牡蛎养殖浮球材料在KS F 2274加速风化条件下的质量损失，以评估认证替代材料的颗粒释放潜力。结果显示发泡材料损失普遍高于非发泡材料，3000 h时组间差异达54倍，而发泡聚苯乙烯密度增至三倍仅使损失降低25%。10种注塑材料的加速老化排序与2.5年户外暴露一致（Spearman ρ = 0.89）。磨损模型表明，提供水密性的纯聚合物耐磨层聚合物含量（905–1180 g L⁻¹）远高于下层 laminate（578 g L⁻¹），提示实际使用中释放可能由耐磨层而非主体材料决定。

papers.title: Evaluation of Semen Quality Indices in Cultured and Wild Broodstock of Clarias gariepinus: Implications for Aquaculture Reproduction and Broodstock Management
papers.authors: Uruku, Ndekimbe Mamndeyati; Abutu, Agnes; Uruku, Ndenyangtse Ndekimbe
papers.journal: Asian Journal of Research in Zoology
papers.abstract: African catfish (Clarias gariepinus) is an economically important aquaculture species in Nigeria, and sustainable hatchery production depends partly on the availability of suitable male broodstock and good-quality semen. This study compared selected semen quality parameters of cultured and wild male C. gariepinus to assess differences associated with broodstock source. Six sexually mature males, comprising three (3) cultured and three (3) wild individuals, were examined. Semen was obtained through testicular extraction following dissection. The evaluated parameters included gonad weight, gonadosomatic index (GSI), milt volume, sperm motility, sperm concentration, sperm viability, sperm morphology, and semen pH. Descriptive comparisons indicated that wild broodstock had higher mean gonad weight (5.33 ± 1.20 g), milt volume (2.72 ± 0.10 mL), and sperm concentration (5.82 ± 0.23 × 10¹⁰ sperm cells mL⁻¹) than cultured broodstock, which recorded 3.50 ± 0.76 g, 2.58 ± 0.17 mL, and 5.56 ± 0.11 × 10¹⁰ sperm cells mL⁻¹, respectively. The percentage of active spermatozoa was also numerically higher in wild fish (69.17 ± 7.77%) than in cultured fish (63.33 ± 14.00%). Semen pH was 7.00 in both groups. Wild broodstock recorded a higher mean proportion of morphologically normal spermatozoa (88.00 ± 2.16%) than cultured broodstock (76.80 ± 12.95%). The reported statistical analysis, however, indicated no significant differences between the groups (P > 0.05). Qualitative characteristics, including semen colour, viscosity, and liquefaction time, varied between the two sources. These findings indicate that both cultured and wild broodstock produced measurable quantities of testicular semen with broadly comparable characteristics under the conditions investigated. Further studies involving larger numbers of broodstock and controlled fertilisation trials are necessary to determine whether the observed differences influence fertilisation success, hatchability, and larval performance. This study provides preliminary information that may contribute to broodstock evaluation and management in African catfish aquaculture.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究比较了养殖与野生非洲鲶（Clarias gariepinus）雄鱼亲鱼的精液质量指标，以评估亲鱼来源对繁殖性能的潜在影响。通过解剖取精，测定了性腺重、GSI、精液量、精子活力、精子浓度、精子存活率、精子形态及精液pH等参数。野生亲鱼在性腺重、精液量、精子浓度及形态正常精子比例上均值较高，但统计分析显示组间无显著差异（P > 0.05）。作者建议扩大样本并结合可控受精试验，以明确这些差异是否影响受精率、孵化率及仔鱼表现。

papers.title: Determining the Aquaculture Potential of Campus Ponds Based on Water Quality Parameters for Nile Tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) Farming
papers.authors: Khairunnisa, Eka Nurriza; Wahyu, Ilham; Horisanto, Abraham; Yadi, Aril; Ridwansyah, Ahmad
papers.journal: AJARCDE (Asian Journal of Applied Research for Community Development and Empowerment)
papers.abstract: Water quality largely determines the success of Nile tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) cultivation. This study assessed whether two campus ponds at Politeknik Negeri Sriwijaya Banyuasin, Indonesia, are suitable for tilapia culture, using physical and chemical water-quality parameters and a descriptive quantitative design. Water was sampled at three stations per pond (inlet, center, outlet) on two occasions, with duplicate measurements. We reported temperature, total dissolved solids (TDS), dissolved oxygen (DO), pH, ammonia, phosphate, biochemical oxygen demand (BOD), and chemical oxygen demand (COD). Mean temperature was 32.00 ± 0.43 °C in Pond 1 and 32.42 ± 0.51 °C in Pond 2, and DO was relatively high (6.53 ± 0.19 and 6.55 ± 0.20 mg/L). TDS was low (26.42 ± 2.07 and 30.50 ± 1.68 mg/L). Mean pH was slightly acidic (6.09 ± 0.14 and 6.15 ± 0.14): below the 6.5-8.5 range used for tilapia culture, but inside the 6-9 range of Class II in Government Regulation No. 22/2021. Ammonia (0.48 ± 0.06 and 0.41 ± 0.10 mg/L), phosphate (1.25 ± 0.08 and 1.36 ± 0.09 mg/L), BOD (8.84 ± 1.44 and 10.93 ± 2.79 mg/L), and COD (29.00 ± 6.64 and 35.67 ± 9.11 mg/L) exceeded the comparison values used. Both ponds therefore offer supportive oxygen conditions but are constrained by organic loading and nutrient enrichment. They should be regarded as usable only after water-quality management and confirmatory monitoring, including dawn-time DO, nitrite, alkalinity, and the analytical basis of ammonia and phosphate. Contribution to Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs):SDG 2 (Zero Hunger)SDG 4 (Quality Education)SDG 6 (Clean Water and Sanitation)SDG 12 (Responsible Consumption and Production)
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估印度尼西亚两处校园池塘是否适合养殖尼罗罗非鱼（Oreochromis niloticus），采用描述性定量设计，在各池塘进水口、中心和出水口三个站点采样，测定温度、TDS、DO、pH、氨氮、磷酸盐、BOD和COD等理化指标。结果显示溶氧条件良好（约6.5 mg/L），但pH偏酸（约6.1），氨氮、磷酸盐、BOD和COD均超出参考限值，表明存在有机负荷和营养盐富集问题。两池塘须经水质管理和验证性监测后方可用于罗非鱼养殖。

papers.title: Environmental radioactivity in marine food webs of the Tamil Nadu coast: sources, transfer pathways and radiological implications
papers.authors: Singaravel, Vijayapoopathi; Moovendhan, Meivelu
papers.abstract: Seafood constitutes a major pathway for the transfer of naturally occurring and anthropogenic radionuclides from marine ecosystems to humans. The Tamil Nadu coast, spanning the Bay of Bengal, Palk Bay, Gulf of Mannar and the Indian Ocean, supports intensive fisheries, aquaculture and seafood consumption while encompassing nuclear installations, mineral-rich coastal sediments, major ports, estuaries, industrial zones and riverine inputs that collectively influence marine radioactivity. This review critically synthesises current knowledge of radionuclides in marine fish, crustaceans, molluscs, seaweeds and other edible organisms along the Tamil Nadu coast, with emphasis on their sources, environmental behaviour, bioaccumulation, trophic transfer and implications for seafood safety. Naturally occurring and cosmogenic radionuclides (^210Po, ^210Pb, ^226Ra, ^228Ra, ^238U, ^232Th, ^40K and ^14C), together with surveillance-relevant anthropogenic radionuclides (^137Cs, ^134Cs, ^90Sr, ^3H, ^99Tc and plutonium isotopes), are evaluated with respect to environmental sources, sediment interactions, tissue-specific accumulation, spatial variability and radiological significance. Under normal/background conditions, across Tamil Nadu studies that quantified radionuclide ingestion dose, ^210Po ^210Po frequently represented the largest contributor among the radionuclides assessed, although the magnitude of exposure varied substantially with seafood group, tissue selection, processing state and consumption assumptions. Anthropogenic radionuclides were less extensively characterised and generally contributed smaller reported doses in the available surveillance studies; however, their relative radiological importance may increase substantially following accidental or off-normal releases. Comparability among studies remains constrained by differences in sampling design, target species, tissue selection, analytical methods, reporting basis, detection limits, seafood-consumption data and dose-assessment assumptions. This review therefore emphasises the need for harmonised, long-term radioecological monitoring integrating seawater, sediments, plankton, representative marine biota and commercially important seafood, together with robust QA/QC, whole organism ecological dose assessment and category-specific probabilistic dietary exposure modelling. Establishing spatially and temporally resolved baseline datasets will strengthen seafood-safety assessments, improve source attribution, support rapid evaluation of accidental releases and provide a more robust basis for environmental protection and coastal management along the Tamil Nadu coast.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述系统梳理了泰米尔纳德邦海岸海洋食物网中天然与人为放射性核素的来源、环境行为、生物累积及营养级传递，重点评估了^210Po、^210Pb、^226Ra、^40K及^137Cs、^90Sr等核素在海产品中的辐射剂量意义。研究表明，本底条件下^210Po通常是海产品摄入剂量的最大贡献者，人为核素在常规监测中贡献较小，但在事故释放情景下其相对重要性可能显著上升。研究间因采样设计、组织选择、分析方法和消费假设差异而可比性受限，呼吁建立统一的长周期radioecological监测体系并整合海水、沉积物、浮游生物及代表性海产品，以支撑海产品安全评估与海岸带管理。

papers.title: eDNA metabarcoding and random forest identify super-connector fish species across mangrove-seagrass-coral reef continuums in the South China Sea
papers.authors: Liu, Chunchun; Wu, Gongguo; Zou, Chujun; Wu, Donghai; Xie, Pengfei; Wang, Sai; Wang, Ping
papers.abstract: Background Tropical coastal seascapes rely on ecological connectivity between mangrove, seagrass, and coral reef habitats to sustain fish biodiversity and fisheries productivity. However, identifying key fish species that facilitate cross-habitat energy flows remains challenging due to limitations of traditional survey methods in turbid, structurally complex environments. Methods We integrated environmental DNA (eDNA) metabarcoding with Random Forest (RF) machine learning to map fish assemblages across a mangrove-seagrass-coral reef continuum in Hainan Island, South China Sea. Results We detected 234 fish species across 78 families - a 4.03-fold increase over conventional gillnet surveys (58 species, paired t-test, t = 11.34, p < 0.001). Using RF classification, we identified 23 "connector species" with high cross-habitat fidelity, of which three super-connectors - Lutjanus russellii , Siganus fuscescens , and Gerres oyena - accounted for 47% of cross-habitat network flow. Simulated removal of these three species reduced overall network connectivity by 68%. The RF model achieved 90.7% accuracy (Kappa = 0.86) in predicting habitat occurrence from eDNA data. Variable importance analysis revealed a salinity threshold at 28 PSU and a distance-to-reef threshold at 2.5 km as primary drivers of community turnover. Our bipartite network analysis showed significant nestedness (NODF = 47.3, p < 0.001), indicating that generalist species disproportionately maintain seascape connectivity. Discussion These findings demonstrate that integrating eDNA with machine learning provides a scalable, high-resolution toolkit for defining functional connectivity and prioritizing species for ecosystem-based fisheries management in the Anthropocene.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在识别红树林—海草床—珊瑚礁连续体中对跨生境能量流动起关键作用的鱼类。方法上整合eDNA metabarcoding与随机森林机器学习，在海南岛南海沿岸海景中解析鱼类群落。共检测到234种鱼类（78科），为传统刺网调查的4.03倍；随机森林模型以90.7%准确率识别出23种高跨生境保真度的“connector species”，其中Lutjanus russellii、Siganus fuscescens和Gerres oyena三种super-connectors贡献了47%的跨生境网络流量，模拟移除后网络连通性下降68%。盐度28 PSU和距礁距离2.5 km是群落更替的主要驱动因子，二分网络分析显示显著嵌套结构（NODF=47.3），表明广适种对维持海景连通性具有不成比例的作用。

papers.title: Integrating morphology and otolith chemistry for distinguishing hatchery-reared and wild Japanese glass eels
papers.authors: Gishi, Ryunosuke; Okamura, Akihiro; Yamada, Yoshiaki; Shirai, Kotaro; Kuroki, Mari
papers.abstract: Advances in captive breeding techniques are expected to increase the production of artificially reared glass eels of the Japanese eel Anguilla japonica and expand their distribution in the market. This development has raised concerns about the lack of clear distinction between hatchery-reared and wild individuals during the distribution process. We developed a practical method to distinguish between these groups using differences in external morphology and otolith chemical signatures that reflect rearing environments. Compared with wild individuals, hatchery-reared glass eels exhibited shorter body length, greater body depth, relatively longer lower jaws, and broader heads. Morphometric analysis based on landmark methods for head shape in dorsal view distinguished between the two groups with 98% accuracy. Analysis of otolith oxygen stable isotope ratios (δ18O) and Sr/Ca ratios revealed clear differences in environmental history. Notably, δ18O values were completely separated between wild and hatchery-reared individuals, achieving 100% identification accuracy. These findings demonstrate that a stepwise identification approach combining rapid, noninvasive morphological screening with high-precision otolith δ18O analysis supports the development of a field-applicable framework. This method is expected to contribute to traceability in Japanese eel aquaculture and to provide a fundamental basis for future monitoring and management measures.
papers.summary_cn: 日本鳗鲡（Anguilla japonica）人工育苗技术进步使放流/上市玻璃鳗中养殖个体与野生个体难以区分，本研究基于外部形态与耳石化学特征建立鉴别方法。养殖玻璃鳗较野生个体体长更短、体高更大、下颌相对更长、头部更宽，基于地标点的背视头形形态测量判别准确率达98%；耳石δ18O与Sr/Ca比值反映的环境史差异明显，其中δ18O可完全分离两组，鉴别准确率100%。据此提出先以快速无创形态筛查、再用耳石δ18O高精度确认的阶梯式鉴别框架，可服务于日本鳗鲡养殖溯源及后续监测管理。

papers.title: Oceanic spawning migration of tropical Indian Ocean eels from Madagascar
papers.authors: Schabetsberger, Robert; Chang, Yu-Lin Eda; Razafindranaivo, Estelle Fenohanta; Andriamahefa, Denis Miranto; Higuchi, Takatoshi; Sztatecsny, Marc; Tambets, Meelis; Ratsoavina, Mihaja Fanomezana; Feunteun, Eric; O'Brien, Gordon
papers.abstract: Little is known about western Indian Ocean anguillid spawning areas. Marine migrations of 15 silver-phase tropical eels (1 Anguilla bicolor bicolor , 10 A. mossambica , 4 A. marmorata ) released off eastern Madagascar (2022-2025) were tracked using pop-up satellite archival transmitters. Tags remained attached from a few days up to 181 d. Two A. mossambica and two A. marmorata migrated for more than 100 d, travelling 660-960 km northeast into the South Equatorial Current (SEC) within a warm ~18-20°C band at ~14-20° S, confirming the inferred spawning region from larval drift backtrackings. A. marmorata reached furthest northeast into the Mascarene Basin. Two A. mossambica released at the same location near the SEC bifurcation migrated in opposite directions, one north and one south of Madagascar, suggesting that some individuals may occasionally be entrained in boundary currents that influence their offshore trajectories. All individuals performed pronounced diel vertical migrations, ascending ~200 m (15-20°C) at night and descending to ~900 m (5-7°C) during daytime. In the Indian Ocean, the deeper occurrence of cold isotherms could explain these greater depths compared with Pacific congeners, implying that temperature, rather than light, limits their deep daytime migration. Eels may descend into frigid 5-7°C depths beyond the thermal limits of most epipelagic predators. Full moonlight suppressed nighttime ascents by ~140 m, indicating that visual cues modulate swimming depths. Together, these results refine our understanding of tropical eel spawning migrations and their sensitivity to oceanographic conditions in the western Indian Ocean.
papers.summary_cn: 2022–2025年在马达加斯加东部外海放流15尾银化期热带鳗鲡（双色鳗鲡1尾、莫桑比克鳗鲡10尾、云纹鳗鲡4尾），用弹出式卫星档案标记追踪其海洋产卵洄游，标记附着数日至181天。2尾莫桑比克鳗鲡和2尾云纹鳗鲡洄游逾100天，向东北移动660–960 km进入南赤道流（SEC），处于约14–20°S、18–20°C暖水带，证实了此前由仔鱼漂流回溯推断的产卵区，云纹鳗鲡向东北抵达最远的马斯克林海盆。同点放流的两尾莫桑比克鳗鲡在SEC分叉附近分别向南、北相反方向迁移，提示部分个体可能被边界流挟带而改变离岸轨迹。所有个体均表现明显的昼夜垂直迁移，夜间上浮约200 m（15–20°C）、白天降至约900 m（5–7°C）；印度洋冷水等温线更深可解释其下潜深度大于太平洋同属种类，表明限制其白天深潜的是温度而非光照，鳗鲡可下潜至5–7°C、超出多数上层捕食者热耐受的深度；满月抑制夜间上浮约140 m，显示视觉线索调控其游泳深度。

papers.title: Rubble, refuge and season: grouper recruitment across habitat types in the Philippines
papers.authors: Tupper, Mark H; Shipway, J Reuben
papers.abstract: Groupers (Epinephelinae) are ecologically important reef predators and key targets of Indo-Pacific fisheries, yet quantitative data on juvenile recruitment across habitat types remain scarce. We surveyed juvenile grouper recruits (25-50 mm TL) across five benthic habitat types (branching/corymbose coral; coral crevice and ledge; dead coral with macroalgae; seagrass; coarse sand and rubble) at two reef systems in the Surigao Strait, northern Mindanao, Philippines, over six survey periods spanning the northeast (amihan) and southwest (habagat) monsoon seasons in 2016-2017. A total of 344 recruits representing five species were recorded. Coarse sand and rubble was the dominant recruitment habitat, supporting over half of all recruits at densities more than eight-fold higher than any other habitat. Species composition was strongly habitat-dependent, with Epinephelus fasciatus and Plectropomus areolatus dominating in rubble, Cephalopholis spp. dominating dead coral with macroalgae and seagrass, and Epinephelus ongus predominating on branching coral. Overall recruit density was nearly three times higher during habagat than amihan, with the seasonal contrast most pronounced on sand/rubble. This seasonal increase was driven by the two rubble-associated species, whereas recruitment of the species associated with vegetated and structurally complex habitats showed little seasonal variation. These patterns are consistent with basin-scale larval supply as the primary driver of seasonal recruitment. Protecting rubble habitats from physical disturbance, including dredging, sedimentation from coastal development, wave-driven mobilisation, and restoration interventions that consolidate rubble beds to promote coral recovery, and incorporating physical environmental drivers into reef fisheries monitoring is recommended.
papers.summary_cn: 在菲律宾Surigao海峡两个礁系、2016–2017年东北季风（amihan）与西南季风（habagat）共6个调查期，对5类底栖生境（枝状/伞房珊瑚、珊瑚缝隙与岩架、带大型藻类的死珊瑚、海草、粗砂与碎石）中25–50 mm TL的石斑鱼幼鱼补充量进行了调查。共记录5种344尾补充个体，粗砂与碎石是主要补充生境，承载过半补充个体，密度比其他生境高8倍以上；物种组成高度依赖生境，Epinephelus fasciatus和Plectropomus areolatus在碎石中占优，Cephalopholis spp.在死珊瑚带藻和海草中占优，Epinephelus ongus在枝状珊瑚中占优。总体补充密度habagat期约为amihan期的3倍，砂/碎石生境季节差异最明显，且该季节升高由两种碎石关联种驱动，而植被和结构复杂生境关联种的补充季节变化很小，符合 basin-scale 幼体供给为主要季节驱动因子的格局。建议保护碎石生境免受疏浚、海岸开发沉积、波浪扰动等物理干扰，并审慎对待以固结碎石促进珊瑚恢复的修复措施，同时将物理环境驱动因子纳入礁区渔业监测。

papers.title: Variables associated with the distribution of a recovering South American sea lion population in Patagonia, Argentina
papers.authors: Grandi, María Florencia; Sánchez-Carnero, Noela; Pisoni, Juan Pablo; Rodríguez Pérez, Daniel
papers.abstract: Understanding the environmental factors determining colony distribution is essential for interpreting the recovery and spatial dynamics of colonial marine predators. The South American sea lion Otaria flavescens has shown population recovery and recolonization along the Patagonian coast during recent decades, yet the habitat characteristics associated with colony establishment remain poorly understood. We analysed colony distribution along the Patagonian coast of Argentina using Ecological Niche Factor Analysis (ENFA), a presence-only habitat suitability approach. The coastline was subdivided into 230 coastal segments (~5 km), and 12 ecogeographical variables describing coastal geomorphology and nearby marine conditions were assigned using GIS analyses, nautical charts, satellite imagery, and field validation. ENFA models incorporating colony abundance were developed separately for colony types and age classes. All models showed good performance (cBI > 0.68). Colony occurrence was primarily associated with geomorphological variables, particularly beach slope, absence of cliffs, nearshore bathymetry, and beach width. Breeding colonies exhibited lower specialization than mixed and non-breeding groups, indicating occurrence across a broader range of environmental conditions. In contrast, non-breeding groups showed relatively high specialization, indicating association with a more restricted subset of available conditions, while sub-adult males showed high marginality in some models. Several currently unoccupied coastal sectors showed high relative habitat suitability, identifying areas with environmental conditions potentially suitable for colony use. These results highlight the combined role of coastal geomorphology and proximity to potentiallyproductive marine areas in structuring sea lion colony distribution and provide information relevant for conservation planning under increasing anthropogenic pressure and environmental change.
papers.summary_cn: 以230个约5 km海岸段和12个海岸地貌与近岸海洋变量，用ENFA构建仅基于出现的栖息地适宜性模型，分析阿根廷巴塔哥尼亚南美海狮（Otaria flavescens）群体分布与群体类型/年龄组的关联。所有模型表现良好（cBI>0.68），群体出现主要与海滩坡度、无悬崖、近岸水深和海滩宽度等地貌变量相关。繁殖群特化程度低于混合群和非繁殖群，非繁殖群特化程度较高，亚成体雄性在部分模型中边缘性高；若干当前未占用海岸段适宜性较高，提示潜在可定殖区域。

papers.title: Space use during foraging is individually consistent within and among breeding seasons for Atlantic Leach’s storm-petrels Hydrobates leucorhous
papers.authors: Collins, Sydney Morgan; Hedd, April; Studholme, Katharine R.; Fifield, Dave A.; Montevecchi, William Alan; Wilson, David R.
papers.abstract: Several factors influence space use by animals, including consistent individual differences identified in numerous taxa. Individuals may benefit from returning to the same reliable foraging sites because this minimizes search effort or intra-specific competition. However, consistency in space use may put individuals at recurring risk from anthropogenic activities within their home range. Previous tracking of the small seabird, Leach’s storm-petrel Hydrobates leucorhous , in eastern Canada demonstrated their wide foraging range and overlap with offshore oil platforms. Here, we examined the intra- and inter-annual consistency of space use in the context of foraging trips (trip duration, total trip distance, maximum distance from the colony, time spent foraging, locations of home and foraging ranges) in Leach’s storm-petrels breeding at the large (ca. 2% of the global breeding population) colony of Gull Island, Witless Bay Ecological Reserve, Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada. Individuals exhibited highly repeatable foraging space use within and among years. Importantly, consistent individual differences in space use led to consistent differences in overlap with oil production platforms, and we estimated that nearly half of the Gull Island population consistently flew through light and oil pollution catch basins during the breeding season. Within catch basins, one tenth of all tracked birds interacted with the surface of the water (i.e., where theoretical oiling risk would be high) or flew past platforms at night (i.e., when light poses attraction risk). These results will be important for future conservation considerations, marine spatial planning, and environmental impact assessments of future offshore developments.
papers.summary_cn: 对加拿大纽芬兰Gull Island繁殖的Leach’s storm-petrel（约占全球繁殖种群2%）进行追踪，检验其觅食空间利用在年内和年间的个体一致性。个体在觅食行程时长、总距离、离巢最大距离、觅食时间及家域/觅食区位置上均表现出高度可重复性，且这种个体差异导致与海上石油平台重叠程度的一致性差异。估计近半数Gull Island种群在繁殖季持续飞经光照与油污汇集区，其中约十分之一被追踪个体在水面活动（理论油污风险高）或夜间飞经平台（光吸引风险）。

papers.title: Habitat complexity and benthic structure drive tidepool fish assemblage and diet on sandstone reefs in the northeastern Brazil
papers.authors: Alves, José Carlos Albuquerque; Albuquerque, Maria Luísa de Araújo; Vieira, Edson A.; Machado Pessanha, André Luiz
papers.abstract: Tidepools in sandstone reefs are dynamic habitats where environmental conditions and resource availability are strongly modulated by substrate structure, influencing resident fish assemblages. We investigated the effects of habitat complexity on the composition, relative abundance, and trophic ecology of tidepool fishes in a sandstone reef at the mouth of a tropical estuary in northeastern Brazil. We hypothesized that pools with greater habitat complexity would support higher number of fish and richness, and consequently a more complex trophic structure. A total of 162 tidepools were sampled during 6 field campaigns in 2018. Pools were classified into 2 categories based on substrate cover: structured pools (SRT) covered by algae, and simple pools (SMP) lacking algal cover. We recorded 5609 individuals from 15 species, with Scartella cristata , Bathygobius geminatus , and Entomacrodus vomerinus accounting for 92.3% of individuals and 68.3% of total biomass. As predicted, relative abundance, biomass, and species richness were highest in SRT pools during the rainy season. However, habitat complexity not only enhanced these metrics but also altered trophic organization. In pools, fishes segregated into 2 trophic guilds: herbivores and omnivores. Diet analysis confirmed algae and microcrustaceans as primary food resources. Our findings demonstrate that habitat complexity, particularly algal cover and refuge availability, drives both assemblage structure and trophic function in tidepool fishes, highlighting the role of habitat heterogeneity in maintaining diversity in tropical sandstone reef ecosystems.
papers.summary_cn: 巴西东北部砂岩礁潮池中，藻类覆盖等栖息地复杂性显著提升鱼类相对丰度、生物量和物种丰富度，雨季结构化潮池（SRT）上述指标最高；162个潮池共记录15种5609尾鱼，Scartella cristata、Bathygobius geminatus和Entomacrodus vomerinus合计占个体数92.3%、总生物量68.3%。栖息地复杂性同时改变营养结构，鱼类分化为植食者和杂食者两个营养 guild，藻类与微型甲壳类是主要食物资源。藻类覆盖和庇护所可得性通过驱动群落结构与营养功能，维持热带砂岩礁生态系统多样性。

papers.title: Rapid vaterite-mediated shell repair for acid-induced damage in a deep-sea mussel
papers.authors: Chen, Yu; Jia, Zice; Kiel, Steffen; Liu, Yali; Xu, Chenlu; Lu, Yang; Wang, Xudong; Li, Niu; Li, Jie; Zhang, Si
papers.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
papers.abstract: Mollusks are able to secrete and repair the most diverse and complex calcareous tissues in the animal kingdom, yet the detailed molecular mechanisms of these biomineralization processes, especially for the deep-sea calcifiers, remain to be elucidated. Here, using an in situ experiment, we report a repair mechanism for acid-induced shell damage via biologically mediated vaterite formation in the deep-sea cold-seep mussel Gigantidas haimaensis . Interestingly, the mussels secreted and recrystallized amorphous calcium carbonate into vaterite to seal the acid-induced dissolution porosities within 30 h. Calcium and nucleation substrates were potentially supplied by the mantle, including calcium-binding proteins and hydroxyapatite. Calcium then reacted with readily available carbonate in the extrapallial space, whose precipitation can be promoted by the nucleation substrates. This rapid repair mechanism is likely an advantage in the habitat of these mussels, which are characterized by pulsed acidification events from the seeping fluids. Furthermore, our finding expands our understanding of the diverse biomineralization mechanisms by which mollusks maintain their protective shells.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过原位实验探究深海冷泉贻贝 *Gigantidas haimaensis* 对酸诱导壳损伤的修复机制。研究发现，贻贝在30小时内将无定形碳酸钙分泌并重结晶为vaterite（球霰石），以封闭酸蚀孔隙；钙源与成核底物（含钙结合蛋白和羟基磷灰石）可能由外套膜供给，并在外套腔中与可用碳酸根反应沉淀。该快速修复机制可能是对渗流流体脉冲式酸化生境的适应，拓展了对软体动物生物矿化多样性的认识。

papers.title: Interspecies and intraspecies variation in hypoxia tolerance in lentic and lotic cyprinid fish species
papers.authors: Xiang, Ping; Tang, Yan; Zhang, Na; Zhang, Yong-Fei; Fu, Shi-Jian
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Freshwater habitats display highly diverse flow regimes and oxygen tension (PO2) dynamics, driving lentic and lotic fish to evolve distinct physiological strategies for sustaining oxygen supply capacity (α) under hypoxic stress and high energy demand. We hypothesized associations of α with metabolic traits that differ between lentic and lotic species: lower PO2 thresholds for maximum metabolic rate (MMR) and other physiological functions in lentic fish, and higher MMR and metabolic rate (ṀO2) at given PO2 thresholds in lotic fish. We tested this by comparing MMR, hypoxia tolerance and hypoxic tissue metabolite responses in the lentic Pseudorasbora parva and lotic Acrossocheilus fasciatus. Pseudorasbora parva had superior hypoxia tolerance [lower critical PO2 at maximum and routine metabolic rate (Pcrit-MMR, Pcrit) and lower PO2 at loss of body equilibrium (PLOE)] via enhanced α, higher liver glycogen, and hypoxia-induced lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) upregulation, while A. fasciatus exhibited higher MMR, matching lotic aerobic demands. Within each species, elevated α correlated with lower Pcrit-MMR, Pcrit and PLOE. Unexpectedly, α was uncorrelated with MMR in both species. Biochemical analyses revealed brain LDH activity as a key determinant of hypoxia tolerance in P. parva, while interorgan transport inefficiency causing brain lactate accumulation and glucose depletion limited hypoxia tolerance in A. fasciatus. These findings demonstrate habitat-associated shifts in physiological and biochemical coping mechanisms, highlighting the complex environment-physiology adaptation interplay rather than categorical divergence.
papers.summary_cn: 缓流与急流鲤科鱼类在低氧耐受上的种间与种内差异：以耐低氧的 Pseudorasbora parva（缓流）与 Acrossocheilus fasciatus（急流）对比，缓流种通过更高的供氧能力（α）、肝糖原储备及低氧诱导的 LDH 上调，表现出更低的 Pcrit-MMR、Pcrit 和 PLOE；急流种则具更高 MMR 以匹配其有氧需求。种内 α 升高与更低的 Pcrit-MMR、Pcrit 和 PLOE 相关，但 α 与 MMR 无关联。生化分析显示，P. parva 的脑 LDH 活性是低氧耐受的关键决定因素，而 A. fasciatus 因器官间转运效率不足导致脑乳酸积累与葡萄糖耗竭，限制了其低氧耐受。

papers.title: Comparative SEM-EDX analysis of intestinal calcium deposition in a teleost (Sardinella longiceps) and an elasmobranch (Rhinobatos annandalei): implications for marine carbonate cycling and coral reef ecosystems
papers.authors: L, Jeyapraba; P, Paul Sweetlin; K, Sofia Revathy; S, Nirmala; I, Viji Margaret.
papers.journal: International Journal of Drug Delivery Technology
papers.abstract: Marine teleosts precipitate carbonate minerals in their intestines and excrete them, and these precipitates contribute an estimated 3-15% of oceanic carbonate production. Whether elasmobranchs form comparable deposits is almost unknown. This study compared the morphology and elemental composition of solid material recovered from the intestinal fluid of a teleost, the Indian oil sardine (Sardinella longiceps), and an elasmobranch, the Bengal guitarfish (Rhinobatos annandalei). Intestinal fluid was filtered, and the retained material was oven-dried and analysed by scanning electron microscopy with energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (SEM-EDX). Calcium was detected in both deposits. The ray-fish deposit contained 27.47 wt.% calcium (15.27 at.%), 2.32 times the 11.82 wt.% (6.22 at. %) of the sardine deposit; the difference of 15.65 ± 2.21 percentage points was about seven times the combined analytical uncertainty. The ray-fish deposit was also richer in phosphorus (14.62 vs. 6.83 wt.%), whereas the sardine deposit was dominated by silicon (21.65 vs. 3.52 wt.%) and contained aluminium (7.82 wt.%). SEM showed rosettes of spindle-shaped crystallites and ovoid granules in the ray-fish deposit, and diatom frustules in the sardine deposit. Ca/P atomic ratios (1.45 and 1.34) were consistent with calcium phosphate, while the ray-fish deposit alone held oxygen in excess of oxide stoichiometry (15.1 at.%), consistent with an additional carbonate or hydrated phase. These results provide a first elemental comparison of teleost and elasmobranch intestinal deposits and identify the mineral-phase and replicated analyses needed to assess the role of elasmobranchs in marine carbonate cycling.
papers.summary_cn: 比较了硬骨鱼（长头小沙丁鱼 Sardinella longiceps）与板鳃类（安氏犁头鳐 Rhinobatos annandalei）肠道滤出物的形态与元素组成，采用 SEM–EDX 分析干燥后的肠道液截留物。两种沉积物均检出钙，但鳐类沉积物钙含量为 27.47 wt.%（15.27 at.%），是沙丁鱼 11.82 wt.%（6.22 at.%）的 2.32 倍，差异约7倍于分析不确定度；鳐类沉积物磷更富集（14.62 vs. 6.83 wt.%），沙丁鱼沉积物则以硅为主（21.65 vs. 3.52 wt.%）并含铝（7.82 wt.%）。SEM 显示鳐类沉积物为纺锤形微晶组成的玫瑰花状及卵形颗粒，沙丁鱼沉积物中为硅藻壳；Ca/P 原子比（1.45 与 1.34）符合磷酸钙特征，仅鳐类沉积物氧含量超出氧化物化学计量（15.1 at.%），提示存在额外碳酸盐或水合相。该研究首次提供硬骨鱼与板鳃类肠道沉积物的元素对比，并指出评估板鳃类在海洋碳酸盐循环中作用所需的矿物相与重复分析。

papers.title: Comparing drone imagery and in situ quadrats for monitoring Mytilus galloprovincialis cover on Portuguese intertidal rocky shores
papers.authors: Mateus, D. R.; Boaventura, D.; Oliveira, P. B.; Hawkins, S. J.; Altieri, A. H.; Paula, J.; Cruz, T.
papers.abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs, or drones) have been used as a valuable tool for monitoring intertidal habitats, offering a safe, efficient, and cost-effective alternative to traditional field surveys. We compared the percentage cover of the mussel Mytilus galloprovincialis obtained from drone imagery and traditional in situ quadrat sampling across 13 rocky shores along the Portuguese continental coast. Drone surveys were conducted at 2 flight altitudes (2 and 5 m) and across upper and lower mid-shore levels. Mussel cover obtained from drone imagery did not differ significantly between flight altitudes, between mid-shore levels, or from estimates obtained using in situ quadrats. A Bland-Altman analysis showed a low average bias (~2% higher estimates from drone imagery) and no evidence of proportional bias across the range of mussel cover values, although the limits of agreement suggest that moderate variability may occur at the scale of individual observations. These results demonstrate that drone imagery provides estimates of mussel cover in open rocky intertidal habitats comparable to traditional methods, supporting its use as a reliable alternative for monitoring purposes.
papers.summary_cn: 在葡萄牙大陆海岸13处岩石潮间带，比较无人机影像与原位样方估算的贻贝（Mytilus galloprovincialis）覆盖率，无人机调查设2 m和5 m两个飞行高度并覆盖中潮带上、下部。无人机估算的贻贝覆盖率在飞行高度间、潮位间均无显著差异，与原位样方估算也无显著差异；Bland-Altman分析显示平均偏差低（无人机估算约高2%），无比例偏差证据，但一致性界限提示单次观测尺度上可能存在中等变异。结果表明，在开阔岩石潮间带，无人机影像可获得与传统方法相当的贻贝覆盖率估算，可作为监测的可靠替代手段。

papers.title: Co-occurring seagrass and macroalgae foundation species differentially support fauna through multiple pathways
papers.authors: Searles, Adam Ross; Reynolds, Laura K.; Martin, Charles William
papers.abstract: Foundation species support fauna through a diversity of pathways which simultaneously act to structure complex ecological communities. The co-occurrence of multiple foundation species can increase the number and diversity of these pathways, which can subsequently augment community complexity. Marine macrophyte beds provide a prime example of co-occurring foundation species. Indeed, co-occurring seagrasses and macroalgae support fauna through several trophic and non-trophic pathways, such as the provision of epiphytic food resources and complex physical habitat. However, many knowledge gaps remain about how seagrass and macroalgae can simultaneously and differentially influence ecologically important fauna species. We conducted field surveys, grazing assays, and predation trials to determine how the seagrass Thalassia testudinum and the macroalgae Caulerpa paspaloides and C. prolifera differentially influence ecologically important grazer populations. Grazer abundance was consistent across seagrass, C. paspaloides , and mixed habitats when epiphyte resources were highly and moderately available. However, grazer abundance was significantly higher in C. paspaloides habitats when epiphyte resources were in low abundance. Grazing assays showed that the presence of epiphytes and the decomposition state of macrophytes moderate grazer feeding preference, suggesting that grazers may use C. paspaloides habitats for alternative trophic resources when epiphyte resources become scarce. Furthermore, we found no evidence to suggest that predation potential differed among habitats. Our study identifies pathways through which seagrass and attached macroalgae can differentially support fauna, thereby augmenting the diversity of trophic and non-trophic support pathways through which co-occurring foundation species structure ecological communities.
papers.summary_cn: 野外调查、摄食实验与捕食实验表明，海草 *Thalassia testudinum* 与大型海藻 *Caulerpa paspaloides*、*C. prolifera* 对生态重要植食性动物种群的影响存在差异：当附生藻类资源丰富或中等时，海草、*C. paspaloides* 及混合生境中植食者丰度相近；但当附生藻类稀少时，*C. paspaloides* 生境中植食者丰度显著更高。摄食实验显示附生藻类的存在及大型植物的分解状态会调节植食者的摄食偏好，提示植食者可能在附生资源匮乏时转向 *C. paspaloides* 获取替代性营养资源；各生境间捕食压力未见差异。共生的海草与附生大型海藻通过多条营养与非营养途径差异化地支撑动物群落，从而增加了基础物种构建生态群落的支持途径多样性。

papers.title: Invasion-driven homogenization overrides habitat fragmentation in intertidal rockpool communities
papers.authors: Soler-Fajardo, Ana; Gestoso, Ignacio; Pardiello, Mauro; Soccio, Federica; Gómez, Alejandra; Pérez-Rodríguez, Valle; Rodil, Iván Franco; Bernal-Ibáñez, Alejandro
papers.abstract: Invasive macroalgae can profoundly alter coastal ecosystems, yet their interaction with habitat fragmentation remains poorly understood in marine systems. Using intertidal rockpools as natural mesocosms, we investigated how invasion by the non-native brown alga Rugulopteryx okamurae and experimental habitat fragmentation influence community structure, ecosystem functioning and biodiversity on temperate rocky shores of the Gulf of Cádiz. Rockpools along a gradient of invasion intensity were subjected to controlled fragmentation treatments by creating bare substrate patches of different sizes, generating varying edge effects to mimic different levels of habitat fragmentation. Short- and long-term responses of macroalgal cover, metabolic rates (net primary production and dark respiration), photochemical efficiency and associated macrofaunal assemblages were quantified. R. okamurae cover increased over time regardless of fragmentation, leading to homogenization of macroalgal assemblages and displacement of the native calcifying alga Corallina officinalis. Fragmentation had limited effects, influencing primary production and photochemical efficiency but failed to limit the spread of the invasive species. High invasion levels were associated with elevated respiration rates and reduced macrofaunal diversity, whereas native algae maintained high photochemical efficiency even under strong invasion pressure. Over time, macrofaunal communities became more homogeneous, with diversity remaining higher in less-invaded pools. These results demonstrate that biological invasion can override habitat fragmentation effects, acting as a powerful homogenizing force that reshapes intertidal communities and ecosystem functioning across temporal scales. Our findings highlight the importance of early management interventions to prevent long-term dominance by invasive macroalgae in intertidal systems.
papers.summary_cn: 以Cádiz湾温带岩岸潮间带岩池为天然中宇宙，沿入侵强度梯度设置不同大小裸底斑块模拟栖息地破碎化，量化大型藻类覆盖、代谢率、光化学效率及大型底栖动物群落对非本地褐藻 Rugulopteryx okamurae 入侵与破碎化的短期和长期响应。R. okamurae 覆盖度随时间增加且不受破碎化限制，导致藻类群落均质化并挤占本地钙化藻 Corallina officinalis；破碎化仅影响初级生产与光化学效率，未能遏制入侵扩散。高入侵水平伴随呼吸率升高和大型底栖动物多样性下降，且动物群落趋于均质化，而本地藻在强入侵压力下仍保持较高光化学效率。结果表明生物入侵可压倒栖息地破碎化效应，作为强均质化力量重塑潮间带群落与生态系统功能，凸显早期管理干预对防止入侵大型藻长期主导的重要性。

papers.title: Intra-seasonal patterns of maternal investment and calf growth in South African southern right whales
papers.authors: Shuttleworth, Loraine; Christiansen, Fredrik; Ganswindt, Andre; Vermeulen, Els
papers.abstract: Reproductive success is critical for population growth and persistence in mammals. In long-lived, capital breeding baleen whales, such as southern right whales (SRWs) Eubalaena australis , reproductive success is closely linked to foraging success. Under changing conditions in the Southern Ocean, changes in prey availability may compromise foraging success and subsequently maternal body condition, with implications for calf growth and survival. We used uncrewed aerial vehicle based photogrammetry to quantify intra-season morphometric changes in lactating females and their calves in the South African population of SRWs to provide a contemporary baseline for reproductive investment. On average, calves grew at a rate of 2.7 cm d -1 and gained 0.066 m 3 in body volume d -1 , while lactating females lost approximately 0.27 percentage points of body condition d -1 . While maternal body condition loss was comparable to estimates from other SRW populations, calf growth rates appeared slightly slower. In contrast to other baleen whales, changes in calf morphometric traits were minimally influenced by maternal factors relative to day of year, likely reflecting limited variation in size and body condition among sampled lactating females. These findings suggest that maternal investment during early lactation remains broadly consistent across populations, yet subtle differences in calf growth dynamics may indicate emerging energetic constraints or local adaptation. Continued long-term monitoring will be essential to detect potential shifts in reproductive success under a changing climate.
papers.summary_cn: 南非南露脊鲸（SRW）繁殖群体中，泌乳雌鲸与幼鲸的母体投入和幼鲸生长在季节内呈现稳定格局：无人机摄影测量显示幼鲸平均日增长2.7 cm、日增体积0.066 m³，泌乳雌鲸体况每日下降约0.27个百分点。雌鲸体况损失与其他SRW种群相当，但幼鲸生长速率略慢；与其它须鲸不同，幼鲸形态变化主要受日期而非母体因素影响，可能反映样本雌鲸体型与体况变异有限。早期泌乳期母体投入在各种群间大体一致，但幼鲸生长动态的细微差异或提示能量约束或局部适应，需长期监测以捕捉气候变化下繁殖成功的潜在变化。

papers.title: Using amino acid δ15N and δ13C to trace trophic ecology and contaminant accumulation in ecologically distinct Greenland and Norway killer whales
papers.authors: Plint, Tessa; Remili, Anais; Dietz, Rune; Sonne, Christian; Rikardsen, Audun H; Rosing-Asvid, Aqqalu; McKinney, Melissa
papers.abstract: Compound-specific stable carbon and nitrogen isotope analysis of amino acids (CSIA-AA) may provide novel insight into diet and its link to persistent organic pollutant (POP) accumulation in long-lived apex marine consumers. We compared how successfully bulk and compound-specific amino acid (AA) δ 13 C and δ 15 N reflected trophic ecology and explained biomagnifying blubber polychlorinated biphenyl (PCB) concentrations in 2 groups of North Atlantic killer whales with previously characterised diets (i.e. direct observation, fatty acid analysis). As anticipated, bulk and CSIA-AA indicated distinct isotopic niches. Trophic position (TP) estimates using δ 15 N Thr-Phe and δ 15 N Pro-Phe were most similar to direct observations of diet. Most trophic-source AA pairs produced lower than expected TP estimates, likely due to 15 N-enrichment of source AAs in high trophic level marine predators. Although the correlation was moderate to weak, source-corrected TP did predict biomagnifying PCB concentrations, with δ 15 N Pro-Phe providing the best result. However, ‘traditional’ trophic-source pair δ 15 N Glx-Phe failed to accurately predict both TP and PCB concentrations in killer whales. CSIA-AA is a promising tool to track diet and POP biomagnification but requires a better understanding of trophic discrimination and source AA 15 N-enrichment in odontocete tissues.
papers.summary_cn: 对两种生态型虎鲸（格陵兰与挪威）比较了bulk与氨基酸单体稳定同位素（CSIA-AA）δ13C、δ15N对营养生态的反映能力及其对鲸脂中生物放大的PCB浓度的解释力。δ15N Thr-Phe与δ15N Pro-Phe估算的营养级（TP）与直接食性观测最接近，多数营养源氨基酸对给出的TP偏低，可能源于高营养级捕食者源氨基酸的15N富集。经源校正的TP与PCB浓度呈中至弱相关，以δ15N Pro-Phe预测最佳，而传统δ15N Glx-Phe对TP和PCB均预测不佳。CSIA-AA可用于追踪食性与POP生物放大，但需更好理解齿鲸组织的营养分馏与源氨基酸15N富集。

papers.title: Decline in mid-shore Mytilus galloprovincialis cover between 1997 and 2022 differs along the Portuguese coast
papers.authors: Mateus, D. R.; Boaventura, D.; Oliveira, P. B.; Hawkins, S. J.; Altieri, A. H.; Paula, J.; Cruz, T.
papers.abstract: Long-term changes in species distribution and abundance reflect the combined influence of environmental variability and barriers to connectivity. We re-surveyed distribution patterns of the mussel Mytilus galloprovincialis Lamarck, 1819 along the Portuguese mainland coast to compare coverage between 1997 and 2022. Potential biogeographical discontinuities in coverage associated with the Nazaré Canyon, Lisboa-Setúbal Canyon and a sandy beach were examined. Spatial analysis across 30 sites in 4 regions (North, Centre, Southwest, South) in 2022 revealed a clear north-south decline in mussel abundance, with the highest cover in the North (36.1%) and a marked decline south of the Nazaré Canyon. Compared to 1997, the North maintained high abundance, while the Centre and South showed significant declines, matching the Southwest region, which remained low. The North had significantly lower sea surface (SST) and air temperatures and higher significant wave height. No interannual variation trends (1992-2022) were detected for the mean and SD of most of the physical variables (SST, air temperature, significant wave height, atmospheric and marine heatwaves) except for the SD of SST in summer, which showed a positive trend over 30 yr in all regions and higher values in the South. This may suggest greater climatic variability, which could explain the observed sharp decline in mussel populations from 36.5 to 1.6% in the South region. North of the Nazaré Canyon, mussel populations appeared resilient over 25 yr. The vulnerability of southern populations suggests a concerning trend consistent with declines reported for mussels elsewhere in the world.
papers.summary_cn: 2022年重新调查葡萄牙大陆海岸30个样点（分属北部、中部、西南、南部4区）的Mytilus galloprovincialis覆盖度并与1997年比较，发现覆盖度呈明显南北梯度，北部最高（36.1%），Nazaré峡谷以南显著下降。与1997年相比，北部维持高丰度，中部和南部显著下降，南部由36.5%降至1.6%。北部海表温度与气温显著较低、有效波高较大；1992—2022年多数物理变量均值与标准差无年际趋势，仅夏季SST标准差在全部区域呈30年上升趋势且南部更高，提示气候变率增大可能解释南部种群骤降，而Nazaré峡谷以北种群25年间表现 resilient。

papers.title: Dungeness crab Metacarcinus magister zoeal distributions across time and space in the Northern California Current
papers.authors: Anderson, Meredith Paige; Sponaugle, Su; Swieca, Kelsey; Sutherland, Kelly R; Cowen, Robert K
papers.abstract: Early pelagic larval stages play a critical role in shaping recruitment variability of Dungeness crab Metacarcinus magister , yet zoeal distributions across the Northern California Current (NCC) remain poorly resolved at broad spatial and temporal scales. We used depth-discrete Multiple Opening/Closing Net and Environmental Sampling System (MOCNESS) sampling during 4 winter research cruises (2018, 2019, 2022, 2023) to characterize spatial, temporal, and ontogenetic patterns in Dungeness crab zoeae across the NCC. Zoeal abundances varied strongly among years, with winter 2023 exhibiting orders-of-magnitude higher concentrations. Across all years and regions, zoeae were most concentrated in the upper 50 m of the water column, with abundances declining with depth and no evidence of significant diel vertical migration. Clear ontogenetic structuring was evident across the shelf: early-stage zoeae were concentrated nearshore, mid-stage zoeae spanned the mid-shelf, and late-stage zoeae were predominantly offshore. Regional differences in abundance were present but modest relative to interannual variability, suggesting that year-specific oceanographic and biological processes exert stronger control than latitude alone. Together, these results demonstrate that Dungeness crab zoeae are neither temporally nor spatially uniform across the NCC and highlight the importance of incorporating early larval dynamics into a mechanistic understanding of recruitment variability and fishery forecasting.
papers.summary_cn: 2018、2019、2022、2023年四个冬季航次以MOCNESS分层采样，刻画北加州流（NCC）Dungeness crab（Metacarcinus magister）溞状幼体的时空与个体发育分布。幼体丰度年际差异显著，2023年冬季高出数个量级；各年各区均集中于上层50 m，随深度下降且无明显昼夜垂直迁移。陆架上的个体发育分层明显：早期幼体近岸、中期居中、晚期主要在外海；区域差异相对年际变异较小，表明年份特异的海洋学与生物过程比纬度影响更强。

papers.title: Metabolomic plasticity of intertidal mussels in different microhabitats during an extreme cold event
papers.authors: Zhang, Xiao-Ning; Zhang, Ning; Lv, Chen-Ming; Dong, Yun-Wei
papers.abstract: Extreme cold events are becoming more frequent and more intense. Whether species persist or perish hinges on 2 factors: the shelter provided by benign microhabitats and the physiological resistance of the organisms. In the present study, we recorded the body temperature of intertidal mussels Mytilus galloprovincialis inhabiting different microhabitats, including tidal pools, exposed rocks, and shaded rocks, during a winter extreme cold event to characterize the distinct thermal regimes. We also determined the metabolomic responses of the mussels to the cold stress using high-throughput metabolomics. Our results indicated that mussels inhabiting tidal pools experienced less extreme, less fluctuating temperatures and suffered significantly lower mortality. Metabolomic responses of mussels living in the 3 microhabitats showed different patterns, suggesting metabolomic plasticity across varying microhabitats. Mantel correlation analysis revealed that temporal metabolomic responses of the mussels were significantly associated with environmental factors. These findings suggest that the refuge effect of benign microhabitats and microhabitat heterogeneity can influence metabolic plasticity, offering insights into assessing and predicting species’ vulnerability to climate change.
papers.summary_cn: 极端冷事件下潮间带贻贝的代谢可塑性：潮池、裸露岩面与遮阴岩面三种微生境中，潮池个体经历的温度更温和、波动更小，死亡率显著更低；高通量代谢组显示三种微生境下代谢响应模式不同，体现代谢可塑性；Mantel检验表明代谢组的时间变化与环境因子显著相关，提示良性微生境的庇护效应与微生境异质性可影响代谢可塑性，为评估物种气候变化脆弱性提供依据。

papers.title: Growing pains: juvenile habitats, ontogenetic shifts and recruitment bottlenecks in blue cod Parapercis colias from the Marlborough Sounds, New Zealand
papers.authors: Anderson, Tara J.; Stephenson, Fabrice; Morrison, Mark A.; Cole, Russell G.
papers.abstract: Nursery habitats for many commercially and recreationally important fish species remain poorly defined, even for heavily exploited or well-studied stocks. Coastal fishing using bottom-contact gear degrades benthic ecosystems, including potential nursery areas. Blue cod Parapercis colia s -a culturally and economically significant coastal reef fish in New Zealand-has been fished for over a century, with ongoing stock declines; yet juvenile habitat requirements remain poorly understood. A dual-gear survey across the Marlborough Sounds identified 4 key habitats supporting newly settled and juvenile blue cod: mixed-biogenic habitats, horse mussel Atrina zelandica beds, shell-debris mounds and cobble substrata. Ensemble boosted regression trees (BRTs) revealed strong predictive relationships with low-relief, high-rugosity habitats. These juvenile habitats were restricted to the mid to outer Sounds and offshore banks, with none in the inner Sounds despite available structure. Adult distributions mirrored these patterns, indicating coupling across life stages. Ontogenetic habitat shifts were evident: transitional-sized fish (20-30 cm) occupied intermediate habitats between juvenile and adult habitats, while large adults (>30 cm) were associated with rocky reefs. Highest settlement occurred in offshore biogenic habitats, rich in prey and largely devoid of cannibalistic adults. In the Marlborough Sounds, large-scale spatial distributions appear to be constrained by larval supply, while the availability and quality of juvenile habitats limit recruitment locally. Loss or degradation of these habitats (particularly offshore mixed-biogenic habitats) represents a critical recruitment bottleneck. Protecting and restoring key nursery habitats will be critical to rebuilding blue cod stocks and supporting the long-term sustainability of this iconic fishery.
papers.summary_cn: 新西兰 Marlborough Sounds 蓝鳕（Parapercis colias）幼鱼栖息地研究通过双网具调查识别出混合生物生境、horse mussel（Atrina zelandica）床、贝壳碎屑堆和卵石底质4类关键幼鱼栖息地，BRT模型显示其与低起伏、高粗糙度生境关系密切；这些幼鱼栖息地仅分布于中外部海湾及离岸浅滩，内湾虽有可用结构却无分布，成鱼分布与之吻合，体现生活史阶段的耦合。个体发育中存在栖息地转换：20–30 cm过渡个体占据幼鱼与成鱼栖息地之间的中间生境，>30 cm大个体则与岩礁相关；补充量最高的离岸生物生境饵料丰富且少有同类相食成鱼。研究表明该区域大尺度空间分布受幼体供给限制，而幼鱼栖息地的可获得性与质量在局部制约补充，离岸混合生物生境的丧失或退化构成关键补充瓶颈，保护与恢复关键育幼生境对蓝鳕种群重建及渔业可持续性至关重要。

papers.title: Zooplankton volume and euphausiid abundance stability despite warming trend in the Gulf of California
papers.authors: García-Fernández, Franklin; Gómez-Gutiérrez, Jaime; Lavaniegos, Bertha E.; Gendron, Diane; Sánchez-Uvera, Arturo; Silveyra-Bustamante, Ángel A.; Ambriz-Arreola, Israel; Aceves-Medina, Gerardo; De Silva-Dávila, Roxana; Avendaño-Ibarra, Raymundo
papers.abstract: Persistent warming over the past 3 decades in the epipelagic Gulf of California has been hypothesised to reduce zooplankton abundance and shift community composition. These changes in the food web are considered potential drivers of recent population declines in several megafauna species. We tested the hypothesis that zooplankton volume decreased between 1984-1988 and 1997-2019 and euphausiid abundance between 1978-1985 and 2005-2019. Diel variability and seasonal temperature variation (cold December-June vs. warm July-November seasons) were the main modes of variability influencing zooplankton volume and euphausiid abundance. Generalised additive models indicated that maxima occurred under neutral El Niño-Southern Oscillation conditions and at intermediate temperatures. Quantile regression and density distribution analyses provided no evidence of a long-term decrease in night-time zooplankton volume or euphausiid abundance between periods. A semi-quantitative comparison with 4 landmark California Cooperative Oceanic Fisheries Investigations cruises in 1957 similarly showed no detectable long-term decrease. Overall, these results suggest that zooplankton standing stock has remained broadly stable despite sustained sea-surface warming, or that any decreases were too small relative to the dominant diel, seasonal, and interannual variability to be detected across the available oceanographic cruises conducted in the Gulf of California.
papers.summary_cn: 对加利福尼亚湾表层水体持续30年变暖可能降低浮游动物丰度并改变群落组成的假说进行了检验，比较了1984–1988年与1997–2019年的浮游动物体积以及1978–1985年与2005–2019年的磷虾（euphausiid）丰度。昼夜变化和季节温度差异（12–6月冷水季与7–11月暖水季）是影响浮游动物体积和磷虾丰度的主要变异来源，广义加性模型显示二者在中性ENSO条件和中等温度下达到最大值。分位数回归和密度分布分析未发现夜间浮游动物体积或磷虾丰度在时段间存在长期下降，与1957年4次CalCOFI调查的半定量比较同样未检出长期减少。结果表明，尽管海表持续变暖，浮游动物现存量总体保持稳定，或任何下降相对于主导的昼夜、季节和年际变异过小，以致在现有加利福尼亚湾海洋调查航次中无法检出。

papers.title: Effects of temperature, wave action and spore origin on the growth and survival of seeded and outplanted kelp juveniles in the Northwest Atlantic
papers.authors: Pratt, Conrad J.; Metaxas, Anna; Charness, Hannah
papers.abstract: Kelps are brown seaweeds and important habitat engineers of ecosystems found throughout temperate and polar coastlines, which have been declining because of multiple stressors. Recruitment is an important process which combines post-settlement survival and growth of the juvenile life-history stages to reproductive adults and can enhance resilience and promote persistence. We examined growth rate and survival of juveniles of the numerically dominant kelps Saccharina latissima and Laminaria digitata on the Atlantic coast of Nova Scotia, Canada, in the northwest Atlantic. We manually seeded spores on blocks made of Oceanite TM (a mineral matrix designed to promote settlement), which we transplanted after 7 mo (July 2022) into kelp populations at 3 locations that differed in temperature and wave exposure. We also deployed unseeded blocks made of Oceanite TM and concrete at 2 sites in November 2021, during the period of in situ spore release. We used generalized linear modelling to examine the relationships of growth and mortality of manually seeded kelp juveniles with temperature, wave exposure and spore origin, and the growth and change in density of naturally seeded kelp juveniles with temperature, wave exposure and substrate material. For both species, the most significant predictor of growth rate for manually seeded sporophytes over the first 5 mo of outplanting was temperature, with observed patterns following those expected based on limited known optimal thermal ranges (mainly for adults). The main predictor for survival was temperature for L. digitata and wave action for naturally seeded sporophytes. Juveniles from seeded blocks with spores of S. latissima collected from sites separated by ~100 km had similar growth rates, suggesting lack of genetic differentiation at these distances likely because of stepwise dispersal. Our study underscores the importance of understanding the role of environmental conditions in regulating kelp recruitment, and can help inform enhancement or restoration efforts.
papers.summary_cn: 在新斯科舍大西洋沿岸3个温度与波浪暴露不同的地点，将人工播种孢子（采自约100 km外不同来源）的Oceanite基质块于2022年7月移植，并在2021年11月原位孢子释放期布设未播种的Oceanite与混凝土块，用广义线性模型分析糖海带（Saccharina latissima）与指状海带（Laminaria digitata）幼体的生长与存活。移植后前5个月，两物种人工播种孢子体生长速率的最显著预测因子均为温度，其格局与已知（主要基于成体）的最适温度范围预期一致；指状海带存活主要受温度影响，自然播种孢子体存活主要受波浪作用影响。相距约100 km的糖海带孢子来源幼体生长速率相近，提示该距离尺度上缺乏遗传分化，可能与逐步扩散有关。

papers.title: Potential habitat distribution of small yellow croaker Larimichthys polyactis in Korean waters: past and future
papers.authors: Bang, Minkyoung; Jung, Heeseok; Sohn, Dongwha; Choi, Wonkeun; Ji, Hwan Sung; Kim, Sangil; Kang, Sukyung; Jang, Chan Joo
papers.abstract: Small yellow croaker Larimichthys polyactis , commercially important in Korea and China, is a demersal species found mainly in the shallow Yellow and East China Seas. Given its demersal nature and semi-enclosed habitat, the species is vulnerable to climate change due to limited access to climate refugia. However, most habitat studies have focused on Chinese waters or on specific seasons, with limited consideration of Korean waters and seasonal variability. Here, we projected seasonal habitat changes for the yellow croaker for the 2050s under SSP1-2.6 and SSP5-8.5 scenarios using 4 species distribution models driven by outputs from a regional ocean climate model and incorporating 3 environmental predictors: bottom temperature, salinity, and depth. Our results indicate that yellow croaker habitats are projected to contract year-round along the Korean coast in the Yellow and East China Seas, while expanding in the central Yellow Sea and across the East China Sea during summer and fall. These changes were associated with contrasting spatial effects of bottom temperature and salinity: projected increases in bottom temperature were associated with an increased presence probability in the Yellow Sea but a reduced probability in the East China Sea, whereas decreasing salinity showed an opposite spatial pattern. Our findings suggest that the future habitat of the yellow croaker may shift offshore, reducing its availability along the Korean coast. These spatial shifts may affect Korean yellow croaker fisheries by potentially increasing vessel travel distances and operational costs.
papers.summary_cn: 基于区域海洋气候模式输出与4个物种分布模型，结合底层温度、盐度和深度3个预测因子，在SSP1-2.6与SSP5-8.5情景下预测了2050年代韩国海域小黄鱼（Larimichthys polyactis）的季节性栖息地变化。结果显示，黄海与东海韩国沿岸栖息地全年收缩，而夏季和秋季黄海中部及东海海域栖息地扩张。底层温度升高与黄海出现概率增加、东海降低相关，盐度下降则呈相反空间格局。未来栖息地可能向离岸移动，减少韩国沿岸的可利用性，或增加渔船航行距离与作业成本。

2026-W48.topic: 水文极端事件与水产养殖效率及生态安全研究进展
2026-W48.keywords: 水文极端(Hydrologic Extremes), 生物安全(Biosecurity), 外来鱼类入侵(Invasive Fish), 水产养殖效率(Aquaculture Efficiency), 浮游植物生产力(Phytoplankton Productivity), 鱼类群落周转(Fish Assemblage Turnover), 贝类养殖区(Shellfish Culture Area)
2026-W48.article:
## 本周研究概览

本周共收录4篇渔业相关论文，研究尺度从美国全国河流鱼类群落到日本宫津湾贝类养殖区，涵盖水文极端事件对鱼类群落周转的影响、喜马拉雅东部淡水生态系统的入侵鱼类生物安全框架、美国水产养殖技术效率评估，以及半封闭海湾浮游植物初级生产力的营养盐来源解析。整体来看，本周研究呈现出"宏观生态格局—入侵防控治理—养殖经济效率—养殖海域生态过程"的多层次格局，既有对气候水文驱动机制的探讨，也有面向管理决策的政策与效率分析，体现了渔业科学在生态机制与管理应用之间的持续衔接。值得注意的是，本周论文以区域性和应用性研究为主，缺少方法学层面的突破性进展。

## 高影响力期刊亮点

本周暂无。

## 创新性研究

1. **Evaluating Fish Assemblage Turnover in Relation to Hydrologic Extremes Across the United States**（Ecology of Freshwater Fish）
   该研究以时间beta多样性（temporal beta diversity）为切入点，在全国尺度上系统评估水文极端事件与鱼类群落周转的关系，将群落动态与水文极值事件直接耦合。其创新在于跨流域的大尺度比较设计，有助于识别不同水文情势下群落重组的普遍性与地域差异，为气候变化背景下的河流鱼类监测提供可操作的指标框架。

2. **Safeguarding the Eastern Himalayan Freshwater Ecosystems: An Integrated Biosecurity, Policy, and Community‐Led Framework to Prevent Invasive Fish Introductions in Northeast India**（Fisheries Management and Ecology）
   该文提出将生物安全、政策工具与社区主导行动整合为一体的入侵鱼类防控框架，突破了以往单一关注检疫或法规的研究路径。其创新点在于把社区参与纳入生物安全治理链条，对生物多样性热点地区的外来种管理具有可推广的制度设计价值。

3. **An assessment of technical efficiency in U.S. aquaculture production**（Journal of the Agricultural and Applied Economics Association）
   研究采用四分量随机前沿模型（four-component stochastic frontier model），将技术非效率分解为时变与非持久性成分，并分九个养殖种类面板进行估计。该方法学处理使长期结构性低效与短期波动得以区分，为水产养殖效率评估提供了更精细的分解工具，对产业政策制定具有参考意义。

4. **Seasonal Variability in Nutrient Sources and Phytoplankton Primary Productivity in a Shellfish Culture Area of Miyazu Bay, Sea of Japan**（Fisheries Oceanography）
   该研究聚焦半封闭海湾中不同营养盐来源对浮游植物初级生产力的季节贡献，弥补了物理条件与营养盐供给强季节变化背景下来源解析的不足。其创新在于将营养盐来源识别与初级生产力估算结合，对贝类养殖容量评估与海域营养管理具有直接应用价值。

## 推荐阅读

1. **Evaluating Fish Assemblage Turnover in Relation to Hydrologic Extremes Across the United States** — 全国尺度上水文极值与群落周转的耦合分析，方法框架对气候变化下的鱼类监测具有借鉴意义。
2. **An assessment of technical efficiency in U.S. aquaculture production** — 四分量随机前沿模型对效率的时变/持久分解处理细致，是养殖经济效率研究的方法学参考。
3. **Safeguarding the Eastern Himalayan Freshwater Ecosystems: An Integrated Biosecurity, Policy, and Community‐Led Framework to Prevent Invasive Fish Introductions in Northeast India** — 生物安全与社区治理整合的制度设计，对入侵种防控政策研究有启发。
4. **Seasonal Variability in Nutrient Sources and Phytoplankton Primary Productivity in a Shellfish Culture Area of Miyazu Bay, Sea of Japan** — 营养盐来源与初级生产力季节动态的结合分析，支撑养殖容量与海域管理。
5. **Evaluating Fish Assemblage Turnover in Relation to Hydrologic Extremes Across the United States** — 若关注群落生态学与水文驱动的交叉议题，该文的跨流域比较设计值得优先细读。

2026-W47.topic: 水产养殖环境治理与渔业资源管理研究进展
2026-W47.keywords: 水产养殖(Aquaculture), 渔业管理(Fisheries Management), 种群基因组学(Population Genomics), 微塑料污染(Microplastic Contamination), 鱼类疾病检测(Fish Disease Detection), 重金属风险评估(Heavy Metal Risk Assessment), 增殖容量模型(Ecological Carrying Capacity), 鱼类种群同步性(Fish Population Synchrony)
